tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 28 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'bur gzhon pa dang / gtsosgrig pa/ rkarma bde legs/gtso sgrig gasmo pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ci bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chosasgron/rishes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/ ci

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal ce'in zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/—1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag po/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'chug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug snol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ spyod sgrub kyi shing rta r+pā po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang cas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis khrung rtsis sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu spungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos sno gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun khang dar khyab che/tsa mi thog tsha zurang dzog tsho sgyuramipashe/ ༷re/ /ni) rme mizu mid lta' char bad rag pa'am bad kya sa ga sa su grags pa 'ad nyad 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mkho de/ dper na/ oka si phor dhi dang to wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags wo gyi slob grwa r+pā mo —1—

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ gangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por sgyer pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang chabs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'bos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bsgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams garber+shas/ 'o9/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka'i slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba macesan ma'ugrin/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gathon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tag 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4

ba༄/ sgrig gas95 ngakhrind/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+de dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod —1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras spungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2

gis nyams chag 3|ra ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon tan bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a re ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 214byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras spungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras spungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtagang 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig ——— —5

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas garma bde legs kyis/—6

khong ni slob dpon chen hūṃ shārnyi /byehūṃ dzinas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'brungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi 'o1 rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'brul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis —1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen sdo/nga rigs rgya maces/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thogo nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kai tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum dwagasapodhi rje'ibakame'abum ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mi tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug : ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ga'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /nigu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra ha'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug lha hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+dha ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'bor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'bor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogasadabang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drag yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud rāgrel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang shed ra thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mopha'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go / de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pur+ṇa nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang barmi/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni rbu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'bor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhedas/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ri ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang —bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhanayangadabang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyi rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras spungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste ba3/ngathan/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas garma bde legs kyis/— —10—

dpal ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa/ 1dpal ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor chog dang bcas pa 20bla ma mgon po dbyer med nyid la bstod pa/ 29dpal ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor bzlog bsdo/sa pa'i lag len/ 31gtor chog snying po gsal ba/ 35bskang gso'i phyogs sgrig 'phrin las rnam rol/ 62dpal gur gyi mgon po'i dmar chen gtor bzlog gi cho ga bar chad kun sel/ 109mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i sgos bskang / 133mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i bskang gso nyer bsdus/ 146zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug gi gtor ma chen po'i sgrub 'phen gyi lag len cho ga las bzhi lhun grub/ 149gtor chen du grags pa zhes bya ba drag gtor/ 165

lha chen lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs dgra bgegs kun 'joms zhes bya ba/ 183dpal mgon trakad kyi bskang gso'i cho ga las bzhi rnam rol/ 195legs ldan ma hā kā la 'khor mang gi bstod pa 'phrin las kun 'khru/ba/ 221legs ldan nag po'i bstod pa/ 227dpal mgon trakad kyi 'phrin las bskang gso sogs nyer mkho 'ga' zhig 229dpal legs ldan nag po trakad kyi gtor sgrub kyi lag len/ 238dpal mgon po'i zungs gso thabs kyi lag len cho ga 243gser skyems/ 8 247rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi drag gtor shin tu zab pa rtags mngon gyur can/ 250dpal lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i bskang ba nyer mkho/ 275dpal lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i gtor chog ngag 'don/ 288yas gtam dang bsngo ba mdor bsdus/ 294smon lam da/sa pa kun 'byung / 321—2

gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa 'phrin las gter mdzod bzhugs so//༄tsho//chaswā sti/dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma'i chog dngabacas pa 'phrin las gter mdzod ces bya ba/bla ma mgon po dbyer med la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o//spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje khros pa'i sku//ma rung bdud dpung phye maralasanamadzad pa//bla ma mgon po dbyer med zhabs pad la//gus pas btud nas sgrub thabasamado tsamabri//rnal 'byor pa dam tshig dang ldan pa 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs kyi rim pa mtha' dag legs paramanos pa zhig gis/bris sku mchod gtor sogs mtshan nyid tshang bar bshams la/bdaganyid yi dam gyi rnal 'byor la gnas pas/nang mchod byin rlabs yi dam gyi mngon rtogs ltaras/'og nas 'byung ba'i gtor ma byin rlabs ltar byas la/gnas khang mchod rdzas gtor ma rnams lagator/a mṛ tas bsangs/swa bhā was sbyangasastong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gi dbusasu a lasaye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing gyoche ba rnams kyi nang du/hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/zhabasabasil/tshetog/bdug spos/mar me/dri chab/zhal zas/rol mo rnamasanamamakha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/mgo pa byin rlabs kyi sngags dang /rolamosrinadas spyi dang mthun par bya/gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/yaṃ las rlung /raṃ lasame/kolasamimago'i skyed pu gsum/a las ka pā la dum bu gsum pa phyi dkar la nang—1—

dmar ba dbusasun las mi'i sha /shar du go las ba lang gisha /lhorakulas khyi'i sha /nub tu da las rta'i sha /byang du ha las glang po che'i sha rnams〉rgyu e dzi khaṃ rnarmesakyis mtshan pa/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su mulasadris shar du bi las dri chen/ lho ru ra lasarak+ta/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ byangadu molas sha chen gyi dang ma rnams/ baṃ paṃ lo paṃ haṃ gyis mtshan pa de rnams kyi stengadu oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du a lasazla ba hūṃ lasardorje'am gri gug hūṃ gisamatshan pa hūṃ lasa'od 'phrosarlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzasarnams zhu zhing khol ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song ba/ oṃ dang 〉la phog pasabadud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzags hūṃ gi 'od kyisade bzhin gshegs pa thamasacad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te thim/ oṃ yig bzla ba rdo rje'am gri gug dang bcas pa lhung ste/ rdo rje'am gri gug gis lan gsum du dkrugs nas/ thams cad zhu ba gtor ma zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥ& ha khohrīḥ o swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shurnyo3nya/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las byungaba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang / mi bzad pa'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus su paṃ lasasnatshogs pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du rka dkar po 'od du zhu bag dpalatshogs kyi bdag po dkar po glang po che'i dbu la spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yasasa'i snying po la phug lo ma dang bcas pa zhal du gsol ba/ g.yon ne'u lorin po che skyug pa 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ kha bshang ba spu'i khung bu rnams nas nor bu'i char 'bebs pa nyal stabs su gnasapa/ de'i steng du hūṃlas rdo rje gri gug 'bar ba hūṃ mthing nag gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer—2

'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thamasacad tshar bcad/ 'phags pa mchod/sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus te thim yongs su gyur pa las/ myuramadzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhi du skong ba/ skumadog du( mtha'i sprin ltar rab tu gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gril ba khong nas zhabrugs shing rngam pa'i zhal drag tubazhad pa/ sma ra dang / smin ma dang / dbu skra khams nag gyen du brdzesapa/dpral bar sin+dha ra'i thigs le byugs pa/ spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyasabatab pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje gri gug dang / g.yon dngaposathod pa dgra bgegasakyi sha khrag gis gang ba thugs khar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyagagayas bar pas thod skam gyi phreng ba/ tha mas ḍa ma ru drag tu 'brolab/ g.yon gnyis pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ tha ma na rdo rje zhags pa nag po bsnamasapa/zhabs gnyis srid gsum rnam par gnon pa'i shugs can mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bgegs kyi rgyal po gnon zhing brdzis pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabasaladar ljang khu'i ske rags bcings pa/ klu chen po'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa tshe sbrul sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing / dmar po'i snyan cha/ khra bo'i dpungabargyan/dkar po'i mgul rgyan/ ser po'i lag gdub/ ljang khu'i do shal/ dkurapo'i rkang gdub dang / ske ragasacan/ phyag zhabs thams cad la drilabu g.yerakha'i 'phreng ba dang ldan pa/ sbom thung lto ba rgyas shing yan lag hragasapa/ bachod paradaka' ba'i gzi brjid mtha' yas pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang/—3—

rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gisamadzesapa/ gi po che'i dbu rgyan can/ ha ha dang / hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭalasogasapa waṃgasapa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pas/ bdud dang dgra bgegs thamasacad rlagapar mdzad pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbusan bzhugs shing / tsan dan gyi sdong po la rgyab brten pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du khragazhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ bh+yoḥlas dpalaldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog nag mo rngam zhing khros pa phyag g.yas kyis bdud kyi khram shing nag po 'phyar zhing / g.yon nad kyi rkyal ba 'dzin pa/chibasakyi snga long la sho rde'u dkar nag dang / byang dmar khres po/ phyi longalaskab gyi gru gu ste sprul pa'i mtshoni cha lnga dang bcas pa/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs khroganyer bsdus pa/ dbu skra gyen du 'khyil zhing spyi bor rma bya'i mdongs kyisabargyan pa/ lte ba nas nyi ma dang / spyi gtsug nas zla ba 'char ba/dre'urta rkangagasusalachibs pa/ srin po'i ya mgal la sga'i snga ru byas shing / ma mgalalaphyi drakhyasapa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing / ba glang gi ko bas smad g.yogasapa/ relde'i sham thabs dang / gos nag gsol ba/ rus pa'irgyan dang / mimago'i dbu rgyan dang / do shal/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul/ g.yon pa lasengages brgyan pa/ tshedapung dang rlung nag 'tshub mar 'tshub pa'i dbus nabazhugasashing 'khor sha za dang / ma mo mkha' 'gro 'bum sdes bskor ba'o/ / stob mdun du k+ṣe las gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pā la sku mdog mthing nag kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs nas dgra la 'o dod 'bod pa/ shangs nas dus mtha'i rlungaldang—4—

ba/phyag g.yas pas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar bas lha dang lha min thamasacad skrag par byed pa/g.yon thod khrag dgra bgegs kyi snying dang bcasapa gtsobo'i zhal du stob pa/dom nag smyon pa la phyibs(chibs pa/'khoraganod sbyin gdug pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/g.yas su hūṃ las dbang phyug dzi na midra/sku mdog dmar nag srin po khros pa'i gzugs can/zhal nas dug dngakhragagi char 'bebs pa/phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru drag tu 'khrol zhing /g.yon sdigasamadzub kyi rtse la me 'bar ba/'khor gza' dang srin po'i tshogs kyis bskorab/rgyab tu ṭaṃ las gshin rje ṭak+ki rā dza sku mdog nag po mi'i sha khrag la ches rngams pa/phyag g.yas rgyu ma'i zhags pa dgra la 'phen zhing /g.yon sdigasamadzub gnod byed la sdigs pa gshin rje'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/gsusaga'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing /stag lpags kyi sham thabasacan/g.yon du hūṃ las bdud mgon chen po trakad sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa/phyag g.yas ru mtshon mdung dmar rtsegasum pa dgra bo'i snying khar bsnun pa/g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba zhal du gsol ba/ya sos ma mchu mnan zhingamache ba gtsigs pa/dar nag gi 'jol ber mun pa'i g.yung drung ris dang /sag ti'i lham yu rings gsol ba/gser gyi ska ragasabacings pa/bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/'khor lha dang bdud dmag gotshogs dpagatumed pas bskor ba/bzhi ga'ang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dgra bgegasal sdang mig tu blta ba/mi bzad pa'i mche ba rnam pa bzhi gtsigasapa/gtusazhing khros la cher 'khrugs pa sbom thung mi sdug pa'i rnam pa can/sma ra dang smin —5

ma dang dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ thod skam gyi dbu brgyan dang/mimago khrag 'jog pa'i do shal can/ me rlung drag tu 'tshub pa'i klong dkyiladu bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu shar du brgya byin ser po glang po che la rgo pa rdorje 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po smug nag ro langs la zhon pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ nubatu chu lha dkar po chu srin lashon pa sbrul zhagasa'adzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang khu sha ba la 'on pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa nor busams pa'i be con 'dzin pa/ byang shar du 'byung po dkar po glang la zhon pa rtse gsum 'dzin pa lha mo go ri la 'byud pa/ steng du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la zhon pa bum pa 'dzen pa/ sog tu sa bdag nag po phag pa la nyon pa rin po che 'bar ba 'dzin pa/thams cad kyang rang rang gi rigs mtshungs 'bum 'bum gyis yongs su bskor ba phyag g.yon pas gtso bo la 'dud pa'o/ /gzhan yang mahā de ba la sogasapa lha chen po brgyad/ nor rgyas la sogs pa klu chen po brgyad/ nyi ma lachogasapa gza' chen po brgyad/ drag po la sogasapa 'jigs byed chen podagusmin drugal sogs pa rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ yul 'khor bsrung la sogs pa rgyalapo chen po bzhi ste/ gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga po thams cad kyanga'akhor bye ba bye ba'i tshogs kyisabaskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du lā'i dam ༄ rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogisalha ma srin sdebargyad rnams sha la dga' ba khrag la rol ba/snying rje med pa/ kha gdangs pa/ mig rtsa dmar ba/ mchobagatsegasapa/ bzhin —6 ci

bsdus pa/gtum zhing 'jigs la mi sdug pa'i rnam pa can/lagan gdugapa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa/skad cig la skye 'gro thams cad kyi srogadabugs bsdud pa/gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang /sha za dang/gosto rje dang/bdud dang /ma mo'i cha lugs can/sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i dbyingasathams cad yongs su gang ba/thams cad kyang sgrub pa po'i re 'dod tshulabazhin du skong bar mdzad pa'o//de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkarapo/masi para.āḥdamar po/thugs gar hūṃ sngone po/rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zera'aphros/shar lho dur khrod wo po bsil ba'i tshal/tsan dan gyi shingarkangagacenapa'i drung nas/myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa steng na rtsa brgyud kyibla ma/g.yas na dpa' bo ngar dang bcas shing /g.yon na dpa' mo'agrumadangabacas pa bka' sdod zhing skyong pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad skad cig de nyid la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra sil li li/khrol lo lo//'ur 'ur/d+ku d+ku du byon par gyur/hūṃ/dad padang ni dam li gis//tshur gshegs mahā ka la che//dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dngabacas//dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//k+ṣe tra pā la la sogasapa//'khor gyi bka' nyan gnod sbyin tshogs//bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhesapa'i//dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol//dkyil 'khor gnas 'diragashegs nas kyang //rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes pa//rtag dngamatshan maston pa dang //bachol pa'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//oṃ badz+ra mahā kā lasapa riwā ra k+ṣiṃ/k+ṣiṃ ring po nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/de nas k+ṣiṃ gi gnas su/e h+ye hi 'ag padang/ri 7

badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bcug pa lan gsum gsum brjod pas/ myur mdzad 'khor bcas spyan drangs/hūṃ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga sto /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar/ /byin gyisabarlabs pa'i gnas 'di sa /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gshegs/ dza8PROBPROB hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i mchod yon 'di/ /mgon po 'khor dang bam5la'abul/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya sa pa ri wā ra arnya pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhi du/ zhabs bsil/ purgya/ mertag puspro bdugaspos/ dh+wa pe/ snang gsal/ ā lo te dri chab/ gharnye/ zhalazas/nile te/ rolamo/ shasto/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod 'bul/ chos dbyingasaparalas ma g.yos kyang / /gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i sku/ /bstan pa'i rusa'ajoms mdzad pa'i/ /nag po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas sa gyi ga.a wo gtor chog tsam bya bar 'dod na/ 'og gi gtor ma 'bulab man chadatsam byas pas kyad rung lkayang bla ma mgon po dbyer med dang / gril sel dang / gnad dbab kyi bka' legs par thob cing /de dag gi don nyams su len par 'dod na/ dmigs pa dang gnad rgyas pa rnams man ngag ltarashes par byas la/ dang po bla ma mgon po'i gsol 'debs ni/ mgon po'i dbu gtsugatudrin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog ser po nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa/phyag g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu thugs gar gtod cing / g.yon gseragyi dril bu dkur brten pa/ rdorje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing rgyan thamasacad kyis brgyan pa/ rdorje 'chang nas brtsams te brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma'i sku las 'od 'phros/ mgon po 'od dang bde ba'i tswa—8—

bzhin du 'ur 'ur/ sil sil gar mdzad/ mgon po las 'od 'phros/ blama'i sku la thim pas/ bla ma 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ dril bu g.yer ba'i sgra sil sil/ khrol khrol gar mdzad bla ma nyid mgon po/ mgon po nyid blam/bla ma dang mgon pe rdzodabyer med par gyur/ bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mgon po bla ma dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs go khrin can rtsaba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen la gsolab 'debs so/ /dpal ldan shā bā ri dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debasago /mnga' bdag mi tri ba chen po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /grub cheb rā hu la chen po lagasol ba 'debs so/ /mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debasaso/ /mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rtogasaldan zhang sgom chos seng la gsol ba 'debs so/ /dbon ston skyer sgang ba chen po lagasol ba 'debs so/ /snyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debasaso/ /'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mkhasagrub shangs ston chos rje la gsol ba 'debs so/ khyung po tshul khrims/ mgon po lagasol ba 'debs so/ /bya bral ri khrod ras chen la gsol ba 'debasaso/ /mkhyen ldan shangs pa dkar po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang la gsol ba 'debs so/ khris chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rgya sgom legs pa rgyalamatshan la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog la gsol ba —9

'debs so/ /rje btsun lha dbang grags pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /'jamadabyangs kun dga' snying po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /na mo bud+dhā ya/ na moguruhe/ badz+ra bī ra bī ri ṇi/ shrī ḍa ka ḍa ki nī/ dzo ga dzogini/ sabobud+dhabo dhi satwa ya sha rā ṇi/ gats+tsha mi/ kyai/ phyogarjo bcu sdus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i ༵ ma dam pa rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs shig /yi dam dkyil 'boragyi lha tshogs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpa' bo dang dpa' mornal 'byoramarnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drugapa'ilha tshogs ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/mthu dang nus pa la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mimanga' ba khyed rnams kyi sku'i sgonas byin gyis rlobs shig /gsung gi sgo nas byin gyisarlobs shig /thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig /sku gsung thugasapon tan 'phrin las mizad pa'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig /da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ bdag ni dad pasagasola'adebs kyis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ tan mongs malusabasal ba dang / dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /gnyis pa grib sel ni/ mgon po'i dbu gtsug tu rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje semasadapa' sku mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yas shel gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugasaspuraspuṇi pa/ g.yon pas mnyam bzhag gi steng du thod pa bdud rtsis gangab/ zhabasaskyil —10

krung du bzhugs pa/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ thugasakunasa'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ steng gi nam mkha' la 'khod par gyur/ḍā sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa tso nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pa'i mthar/ rdo rje 'chang dang dpalaldan shā bā ri/ /rgyal ba mi tri grub wo rā hu la/ /a mi de ba lokeshwa radang / ha ya gri ba pad+ma sting gnas dpal/ khyung po dzo gi rat+na bīr+ya dang / /sto singaha :nye(5(sku da tsha de ma gog ra po sbyonge 'ukhye'u/ shā)dharma pradzñā dang / / nga ha shangs stan chas rja sags/ / na brgyud pa bla ma dgongs su gsol/ /'gro ba'i re skong yon tan rab rdzogasapagi /brgyud ldan bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la/ /dag pa gnyis ldan chos skur martogasapa/ /'jig rten rtog bcas dbang gyur mthol lo bshags/ sku gsungathugasadang yon tan phrin las dang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i lha rnams dgongs su ga'//bdag cag theg mchog sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas/ /rtsa ba yan lag 'galanyams mthol lo bshags/ /mthu stobs nus pa 'phrin las phun chogasashing/ /skad cig dran pas bar chad thams cad sel/ /'du 'bral med par dngosagrub ster mdzad pa'i/ /ye shes mgon po phyag drug dgongs su gsol/ /durasgo nags mtha' chu gling bas mtha' mā /phyi nang rten dang dam rdzas tshogs gyuranas/ /bsnyen sgrub bskang bshags tshul bzhin ma grub par/ /le logayebaba'i dbang gyur mthol lo nyags/ khyad par gsang ba'i rten mardzo glan kho/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med bde wo sku/ khyod la yid ches mos gus 'bralar kyis/ /rnam rtog i skur ma rtogs mthol lo nyags/ /bdag ni marig—11— — ca

'khrul pa'i dbang gyur te//bla ma mgon po 'khor dang bcas rnamasakyi//sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa//gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems dang bcas nas kyang //lha mchog khyod kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags//ye shesabaka' sgrub las kyi pho nya mdzad/r+sātra pā la dzi na mi tra dang /ṭaḥrādzapaṇa rem ti//phyogs skyong bcu dang gtsang rigs dgongasasu gsol//ji ltaralko kyis khas blang dam bcas bzhin//bdag gis 'phrin las yengs med sgrub pa la//yid chad bgyis shing sha khrag gtor tshogs kyis//gtang rag dusasumathengs mthol lo bshags//mngon shes med pa'i nyes skyon ma rtogasapar//bstan pa 'jig dang bla ma'i sku dgra la//drag po'i las kyis tshar gcod slabagyis par//gsang ba bsgrags shing byams bgyis mthol lo bshags//dmanyams grib phog gtam 'dres zas zos dang //rgyu chud phud nyams 'gala'akhrugs nor la sogs//nyes skyon 'byul pa'i tshogs rnams ci mchisapa//gnod zhing 'grod pa'i sgo nas mthol lo bshags//sku'i dam tshig nyamasapa mthol lo bshags//gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags//thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags//rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa mtholalo bshags//yan lag dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags//tshorate dmatshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags//ma tshor dam tshig nyams pa mthol lobashags//nyams grib dag phyir bshags pa 'di byas pas//bla slamagon po'akhor dang bcas rnams kyis//pha ma bu tsha bzhin du bzod bzhesal//gemegrub thams cad dus 'dir stsal du gsol//bshags dang bshags par bya ba —12

ma dmigs kyang / /rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags dag bya'i phyir/ /rje btsun dam pa yul gyi mchog rnams la/ /rab tu bshags pas bde chen thob gyuracig /gsum pa gnad dbab ni/ mgon po'i dbu gtsug gi drin can rtsa ba'iblamadenyid/ sku mdog dmar po g.yas thod pa'i ḍa ma ru 'brol zhing / g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thugs gar 'dzin pa/ bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can/ sgeg cing lang mtsho la bab pa/ chags pa'i nyams can/ spyan gzigasapa tsam gyis mkha' 'gro dang srid gsum dbang du bsdud pa/ skyil krung gisabazhugs pa mgon po'i dpral ba'i sirgyu ra'i thig le gru gsum gyi steng na yi ge hrīḥdamar po 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi ngo bo bcu gsum yongs su gyur pa las/ gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dmar molang mtsho ma/ zhalagacigaphyag gnyis ma/ g.yasacang teg g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pa'i gar stabs can/ spyan gsum namamakha' la hrig hrig gzigs shing gar mdzad pa bcu gsum sgrol ma'i ngo bo/khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad bdag gi dbang du bsdus/ dgoga'adod thams cad char bzhin babs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra na ra kri kri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭaphaṭaswāhā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las sngagasakyi phrengab rnams kha dog nag po 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba/ 'phreng rdog ltar gnasapa la/'od zer sna lnga 'phreng thag gi tshul du brgyus pa/ rang gi zhal nasathon/ mgon po zhal du zhugs pa mgon po'i thugs ga'i hūṃ la thim/ yang hūṃ las byung/—13—

lo//zhabs gdub dang bcas bi nā ya ka mnan//nag po chen po stagagoshamathabs can/phyag drug sprul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan//g.yas pa gri gugabar pa 'phreng ba 'dzin//tha ma ḍā ma ru ni drag tu 'brol//g.yon pa thod pa dngani mdung rtse gsum//de bzhin zhags pa bzung nas 'ching bar byed/khragapo'i zhal gdangs mche ba rnam par gtsigs//spyan gsum drag po'i dbu skra gyen du 'bar//dpral bar sirgyu ra yi thig le byugs//spyi bor mi bskyod rgyalaposargyas btab brtan/khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can//rin chen thod skam lnga yi dbu la brgyan//shing las byon nas gtor ma len mdzad pa'i//dpal ldan phyag drug pa la phyag 'tshal bstod//sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang //dbon mchog dbu 'phang gnyan po bstod pa dang //bdagacanadapon slob 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi//rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad zhib dang //ci 'dod dngos grub myur du stsal du gsol/ /lang ka pu ri gsusabasregs shing //sangs rgyas bstan skyong bdud dpung 'joms//zhalagazhinaphyag drug nag po che//'jigs pa'i gzugs can khyod la bstod//bh+yoḥkhrag mtsho chil chil khol ba'i klong dkyil na//mtsho chen dre'u'i steng na gzi brjid 'bar//mthig nag sku la zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma//bdud kyikhramashing nad kyi rkyal pa rnams//sku'i sprul pasasangasargyas bstan pa bsrungag/gsung gi sprul pas khams gsum g.yo bar byed/thugs ni mi 'gyur 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma/ma cig re ma tī la phyag 'tshal lo//hūṃ dpalaldan mgon po'i phyogs bzhi'i bka' mnyan pa//ye shes bka' bsgrub las kyi pho nya mdzad//ma —15

rungs kun 'dul sprul pa sna chogs 'gyed//las byed pho nya bzhi la bdagacanabastod//dbang po gshin rje chu lha gnod sbyin dang //me lha srin po salha khrungapo dang /steng gi tshangs pa sa'i lha mo ste//sprul pa'i phyogs skyong bstolaphyaga'atshal bstod//dpalamagon bdun bcu rtsalnga dang //dam can rgya mtshodamagatshogasarnams//sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la//rnal 'byor bdagacana'akhor bcas kyi//mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chod sol//mthun pa'i dngosagrub stsol ba dang /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod//thunagator yod nasgroname btsugs te khang steng la sogs par 'bul zhing /dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā la dang/ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma tī//lcam dral khyed kyi bka' lasami'ada' ba'i//k+ṣe tra pā la dzin mi tra dang / /ṭak+ki rā dza bdud mgon paṇa sogs//dpal ldan nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhesashig/'dzam bu ti ba'i zhal zas 'di bzhes cig/dza gad dpa' po'i sman phung 'di bzhes cig/sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/da brgyasalasakyi gsol 'debs gnyan por bzhes//'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnamasabazlog pa dang //sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogag/bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po//thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlagaparamadzod//bstan pa rgyas pa'i las ni myur du sgrubs/rnal 'byor brgyasaba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/thun gtor med na rgyun gyi bsnyen pa'i skabs spyi btab 'di byami dgos so//yig brgya mang du bzlas/ma 'byor pa dang nyamasapa dang/ sto nga/—16

ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang / /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ /bla ma mgon po dbyeramed la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sems can thamasacad kyi/ /nyon mongs ma lus sel par shog /oṃ khyed kyis semasacan don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yuladu gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ramuḥ gnamagron kyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thimapar gyur/ rten yod na brtan btsos bya/ smon lam btab/ yon tan rab rdzogs gangs kyi ri bo bzhin/ /byin rlabs chu bos skal bzang tshim mdzad cing / /rangasemasalhan cig skyes par ston mdzad pa'i/ /chos rje bla ma mchog gi bkra shisashog /sgrub pa po la bu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing / /mi 'bral lus dang grib mdzibazhin du/ /dam tshig can la dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i/ /yi dmalha tshogasarnams kyi bkra shis shog /dam can sgrub pa po yi rjes 'brangs shing / /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod sogs/ /sna tshogs 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /snang ṣ+ka tswagrolasgyum rmi lam bzhin/ /bde ba chen mo rgyun chad med pa'i nyams/ /yid labyaramed stong gsal nam mkha' dang / /bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shisashog /sgrub pa po la brten zhing mchod pa dang / /skur ba 'debs pa'i skye 'gro gangayin pa/ /thams cad byang chub lam la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /mnyam med byang chub sems kyi bkra shis shog /'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa thams cad kyis/ /bkra shisago—17—

'phang ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /phun sum tshogs pa chu bo'i gzhungabazhin du/ skye'agro yongs la rtag tu bkra shis shog /bsod namasadar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin/ /snyan grags chen pos nam mkha' bzhin du khyab/ /tshering nad med gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis shog ltasabakra shis bka' rgya ma brjod do/ /yang dpal ldan lha mo phyag bzhi ma la mos na/phyagagayas na ral gri sdig pa'i yu ba can dang gri gug /g.yon na nal bu'i rgyal mtshan dngathod rlon 'dzin pa/ yang na phyag gnyis ma g.yas ral gri 'bar ba dang / g.yogathod khrag 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka la yang srin po'i ma mgal sga'i snga rur byas pa khram bamadang/ma mgal phyi rur byas pa la nad rkyal btags pa/ sngags kyang phyag bzhi ma la/ skye'o ma ma sarba tsa dur bhak+ṣa dzaḥ re ma ti 'ur ba 'ur ba/ sa ma tri ra ngaPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROB/ gaganyis ma 'di la yang gong dkyus ltar gyi sngags dang / oṃ trag rag mo rak+ta ru ti maPROBPROBPROB/ces pa dang / bstod pa'i skabs su yang phyag gnyis ma la/ ral gri 'bar ba dngani thod khrag 'dzin/ zhes pa dang / phyag bzhi ma la ni/ mthing nag sku la 6lta/gtsegaphyagabazhim/ /ral gyigri gug rgyal mtshan thod rlon 'dzin/ /spyo 'don pasto/lasamanarnams kyang / k+ṣe tra pā lasmug nag dang / dzi na mi tra cang te dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ṭak+kirā dzacangate dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa dang / bdud mgon phyag bzhi pa/ mdung dmar bing chen tho bathod khragarnams 'dzin pa ltar byas kyang rung / yang dzi na mi tra g.yas rdzas kyis rdo rje pha lam dag g.yonagacod pa'i 'khor lo 'phen pa'am ḍā ma ru dang 'khor lo'adzin pa/ ṭak+ki rā dza spu gri dang thod snyinga'adzin pa ltar ram/ gshin rje gri thod 'dzin pa ltar yang rung / yang phyag mtshan dkyus ltaralas/dzi na mi tra ljang khu dang / ṭak+ki rā dza dmar po byas pa yang yod de/ de dag thams cad gang ltarabyas—18—

kyang rung ba'o/ /las sbyor gyi tshe bshon pa can du byas te/ nges par lha mo dang bdud mgon phyag bzhi par bya/ dzi na mi tra seng ge dang / ṭak+ki rā dza stag la zhon pa/ phyag mtshan snga moltararam/byuspyangagilachibs pa/ lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin par bsgom la gtor ma la 'bul ba yin no/ /'khor rnams rgyas par bskyed mi nus na/ gtso bo'i mngon rtogs kyi rjes su 'khor rnams kyi mtshan tsamabarjod pa'am/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur/ dpral bar oṃ zhesapa man chad bya/ gtor chog 'bring po ni/ 'khor mi bskyed par gtso rkyang bskyed nas spyan 'dren paman chad bya/ mchod pa'i tshigs bcad rnams kyang dor bas 'grub cing / bsdus pa ni/ dmatshig pamibaskyed pa ra ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa yin te/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros shar lho durakhrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal zhes sogs man chad bya ste/ 'bring bsdus gnyis la gnad gsum gyidamigs pa bor te gtor ma 'bul ba sogs bya'o/ /bsnyen pa'i dus ma yin pa rgyun gyi bzlas pa'i skabs kyang phal cher phyi ma 'di nyid gtso bor bzung ngo / /bdag bskyed ni/ spyir yi dam gangal brten kyang rung mos kyi/ gtso bor ni bde kyi 'jigs byed rta mgrin rnams gang rung gcig la brten nas mdzad par snang ngo / /bdag mdun dbyer med du byed pa dang tha dad du byed kyang mgon pogatsorkyang gi mngon rtogs 'di nyid dam/ gsang bsgrub rgyan can la brten pa sogs kyang man ngag khungs ma las kyang 'byung zhing / lung rigs dang 'gal ba med pa'i phyir shin tu rung mod kyi/'on kyangalas dang po pa rnams kyis dkyus ltar nyams su blangs na mchog go /'dir smras pa/ de ltar bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi/ /sgrub thabs mdor bsdusatsam zhig brjod pa 'di/ /dam pa snga ma rnams kyis yang nas yang / /gsal bar mdzad mod gzhan gyisabaskul ba'i ngor/ /shin tu gsal zhing rgyas bsdus skyon bral bar/ /go bde'i tshogs gis bstod na blo dman la/ /phan par 'gyur snyam mos pa sna tshogs dang / /mtshungs pa'i rim pa so sor byeb—19

yin//dge des bdag cag byang chub sgrub pa la//bar chad kun zhi mthun rkyen kunagrub nas//mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus par//da lta nyid du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/gdug cingasdang sems ldan pa rnams//skad cig tsam gyis tshar bcad de//zhi rgyas dbang dngabragapo yis//'phrin las phyogs bcur spel bar shog/ //ces pa'ang mchog tu gyur pa'i dge ba'i bzhesaganyen mang pos bskul ba'i ngor/rgyalakhams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer bdun pa nag pa'i zla yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la legs par sbyar ba'o//zhus dag/bkra shis 'phel//dge legasa'aphel//dar rgyas 'phel lo// sarba maṅga lo//riṣ+ṭha//dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor chog dang bcas pa bzhugs so//ra༅༅//swā sti/dpal chen he ru ka dpal khros pa'i sku//'jig rten dbang phyug thugasalasa'abrungs pa yi//bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gas nas//de nyid mchod pa'i cho ga mdorabasdusabris//yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su nyer 'kho thams cad tshogs par byas la/bdag bskyed gang yang rung ba sngon du 'gro bas/mchod pa rnams/a mṛ tas bsangs/gabhā wasasbyas/stongapa'i ngang lasa.a las ka pā la rnams kyi nang du hūṃ zhu ba las/mchod yon nasarol mo'i bar nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/oṃ badz+ra am+bha swāhānas shap+ta āḥ& gi bar brjod/oṃ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/stong pa'i ngangalasarangagi mdun du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du —20

rga las tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dkar po spyan gsum pa glang po'i gdong can/g.yas la phug lom dang bcas pa gsol zhing /g.yon thod pa bsnamasapa/dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa nyal stabs su 'gyel ba'i stengadu/hūṃmathinganag las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongasasu gyur pa las/myur mdzad ye shesakyi mgon po skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba/zhal gcig phyag drugapa/zhal gdangs shing mi bzad pa'i mche ba gtsigs pas drag tu bzhad pa/smarasmin ma dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/dmar shing 'khrug pa'i spyan gsumadang ldan zhing /dpral bar sin dhu ra'i thig les byugs pa/phyagadangapo gnyesagri gug dang thod khrag thugs gar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/g.yas gnyis pasathod skam gyi phreng ba/gsum pas cang te'u drag tu 'brol ba/g.yon gnyisapasamadung rtse gsum pa/gsum pas rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa/stagalpagasakyi shamathabs can/'jigs su rung ba'i thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang /tho pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/rus pa'i rgyan drug dang /dar ljang khu'i ska rakagabastosapa/phyag zhabs la dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng bas brgyan pa/sprul nyon po'i thod bcings/dmar po'i snyan rgyan/khra bo'i dpung rgyan/dkar ngo'i mgulargyan/ser po'i lag gdub/ljang khu'i do shal/dkar pos ska ragasadang rkangagadub byas pa/sku lus sbom thung rags shing /zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i gyad kyibagegs kyi rgyal po mnan pa/spyi bor mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa/de'i g.yon na khrag zhag 'khrug pa'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo'adod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi/—21—

g.yas gnyis na/ ral gri dang gri gug /g.yon gnyis na rgyal mtshan dngathod rlon khrag gis gang ba/ khro gnyer bsdus shing / glang wo gyi ko rlon gyi stod g.yogs dang / re lde'i sham thabs/ sprul nag du ma'i ska ragasacan/ khragagithig le/ zhag gi sor ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu can/ lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba/ dre'u rta rkang gsum la chibs pa/ ma mo dang sha za'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bo'i mdun du k+ṣ-i las gnod spyin k+ṣe tra pā la sku mdog mthing nagashangs nas dus mtha'i rlung 'tshub pa/ kha gdangs nas dgra la 'o dod 'bod pa/g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod pa snying bcas gtso bo la stobasapa/shin tu khros shing mi gdug pa/ dom nag spyon pa la zhon pa/ gtso bogayasasupad nyi dang ro'i gdan la/ hūṃ las dbang phyug dzi na mi tra sku mdog dmaranagagayas ḍā ma ru drag tu 'khrol zhing / g.yon thod pa khrag dron gyis gang ba bsnams pa/ rgyab tu pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la/ ṭaṃ las gshin rje ṭak+ki rādzosku mdog nag po g.yasazhags pa dang / g.yon sdigs mdzub/ gshin rje rab tukhros pa'i cha lugs can/ lha mo'i g.yon du hūṃ las bdud mgon trakad sku mdogadud sprin ltar gnag pa/ g.yas ru mtshon dmar po 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag thugs gar 'dzin pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan zhing mche ba gtsigasapa/ daranag gi 'jol ber dang / sag ti'i lham gyon nas rta nag rting dkar lachibasapa/ 'khor bzhi char khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ rang rang gi 'khor 'bum 'bum dang bcas pa/ gtso'akhor drug ga'ang me dpung 'baraba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i phyi rol tu shar du rgya byin/ shar lhoramelha/stor—22

gzhin rje/lho nub tu srin po/nub tu chu lha/nub byangadu galha/byangadu gnod sbyin/byang shar du dbang ldan/steng du tshangs pa/'og tusa'i lha mo/de thamasacad rang rang gi 'bor bye ba bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa/gzhan yang lha ོ brgyad/klu chen brgyad/gza' chen brgyad/rgyu skar nyi shu rtsabargyad/'jigasabyed dgu/rgyalawo bzhi ste/gtsang rigasakyi mgon po bdud brgyartsalnga/de'i phyi rol du dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs/sha la dga' ba/khragalarolab/snying rje med pa/gtum zhing mi sdug pa/mig rtsa dmarab/khagadangasapa/mtsheb gtsigs pa/lag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogasapa thogs pa/skad cigal skye 'gro thamasacad kyi srog dbugs bsdud pa/gnod sbyin dang/srin po dang /gshin rje dang bdud kyi cha lugs can/sa gzhi bar snang phyogasabacu thams cad du sprin gtibs pa ltar 'khod par gyur/mdor bsdu na/mi das rgyas btab pa/'khor dpal ldan lha mo re ma tī/las byed bzhi/gtsangarigasabadun cu rtsa lnga/dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa/zhes pa tsam gyi chogathams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/mgrin par āḥdamar po/thugasadzinahūṃsngon po/rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis shar lhor dur khrod bsilaba'i tshal tsan dan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung nas/nag po r+pā po steng na rtsabargyud kyi bla ma/g.yas na dpa' bo ngar dang bcas shing /g.yon na dpa' mo'agrumadang bcas pa/'khor bka' sdod kyi tshogs dang bcas pa/ḍā marudangadrilabu g.yer ga'i sil khrol gyi sgra dang /gad rgyangs 'ur 'ur chem chem dang bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥbaskang ba sogs kyi tshe spro na bzhengs shig sogs nas/dam tshig ldan pa'i gnas —23—

'dir gshegs//zhes pa'i bar bya/mi spro na rgyun gtor sogs la/hūṃ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis//tshur gshegs mahā kā la ya//sngon gyi thugs dam rjesadagodasal//dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//k+ṣe tra pā la la sogasapa//'khor gyi bka' gnyan gnod sbyin tshogs//bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhesapa'i//dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol//oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sapa rilhara.e h+ye hi/k+ṣiṃ nyer gcig brjod/dza8PROB baṃ hoḥ.a pad+ma ka ma laya s+t+waṃ/arnya lasakha pas mchod/chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos kyang //ma rung 'dul phyir khros pa'i sku//bstan pa'i dgra bo 'jom mdzad pa'i//nag po che laphyaga'65brna//nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/sngags rnams kyi mthar 'bru gsum btagasal 'bul/bsdu na mchod bstod 'di med kyang chogamagon po'i spyi bor rtsa ba'i glamasku mdog ser po nor bu dang dril bu 'dzin pa/rdo rje skyil krung /dar dang phyi poches brgyan pa/bla ma'i sku lasa'od 'phros/mgon po la phog 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du ltem ltem gyur/'ur 'ur sil sil gar mdzad/mgon po las 'od 'phros bla ma la phog/'od dang sogs gong bzhi/mgon po nyid blam/bla ma nyid mgon po/bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so//spro na bar 'dir brgyud pa'i bla ma gsol 'debs bya/de nas/na mo bud+dha ya nas/dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol gyi bar ci mang gis gsol ba btab/yang spyi bo'i bla mardorje sems dpa' dkar po g.yas shel gyi rdo rje/g.yon ka pā la bdud rtsisagangab 'dzin pa/sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad blama'i gnas gsum du thim/bla ma'i gnas gsum nas yi ge brgya pa dkar dmar—24

mthing gsum byung / mgon po'i gnas gsum du thim/ sku gsung thugasakyinyams chags thams cad dag par gyur/ yig brgya nyer gcig sogs bzlas gsopasaskabs yod na/ rdo rje 'chang chen dpal ldan shā bā ri sogs dang / rin wo brgyud pa'i bla ma sogs rgyas par bya/ bsdu na/ sku'i dam tshig nyams pa mtholalobashagasanas/ dus 'dir stsal du gsol gyi bar dang / khyed thugs gsang ba sogasago lokagacig bya/ yang mgon po'i spyi bo'i bla ma dmar po ḍā ma ru dang thod pa won pa/lta bas mi ngoms shing / bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can/ gzigasapa tsam gyi ci 'dod dbang du bsdud pa/ dpral ba'i sin dhu ra'i thig le'i nangadu/hrīḥdamar po bcu gsum yongs su gyur pa las/ gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro mdamar mo ḍā ma ru dang thod khrag 'dzin pa bcu gsum du gyur/ bla ma'i sku lasabyung ba'i 'od zer dmar po mkha' 'gro ma la phog pas de rnams ḍā ma ru dang g.yer kha'i sgra khrol khrol/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs ling ling pa/ spyan gsumanam mkha' la jig hrig gzigs pa/ mgon po dang mkha' 'gro ma'i 'od zeragyis sems can thams cad bdag gi dbang du bsdus/ dgos 'dod char ltar babs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra na ra kri kri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ denasatwasapa'idamigasapa gsal btab ste/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la 〉snye tra bisnrun bi nā ya ka 〉(phaṭaphaṭaswāhāci mang bzlas pa'i mthar shā sa na bzla/ oṃ trag rag mo rak+ta ru dhi ra (phaṭa/ ṣāñtsatra pāl bisnrin hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzi na mi tra wa shaṃ ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ṭak+ki rā dzasamaya bh+yo du dza hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ du yog dza mahā kā la traka shad hūṃ phaṭa/ rnams kyang ci rigs bzla/ gtor ma/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i nganga'athag yaṃ lasarlung/ raṃ —25

las me/kai las mi mgo'i snyed pu gsum/de'i steng du a las chod pa mtshan ldan yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sum̐ e dzi khaṃ hūṃ rnams las sha lnga/yaṃ me paṃ haṃ baṃ rnams las bdud rtsi lnga/steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po a lasazla ba/hūṃlas rdo rje rnams brtsegs pa/hro g.yos me sbar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga 'od du zhu/yi ge 'bru gsum las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/de rnams kyi 'od kyis sangasargyas thams cad kyi rdo rje gsum ye shes kyi bdud rtsir spyan drangs te thim/oṃdang zla ba rdo rje rnams kyang 'od du zhu zhing thim pas/kha dog dri ro nus mthuphun sum tshogs pa zad mi shes pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/oṃ āḥ& ༅gatho/sngar gyi sngags re re'i mthar/i dam ba l+la ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/bamutal lan gsum mam bdun bdun gyi 'bul/oṃ shrī mahā kā la sa pā ri bā ra a:pratīts+tshaswāhāde bzhi du/pā rdu/puṣ+ṭi āḥ&/dhu pe/ā lo kegarnye/nai be t+ya/shap+ta āḥsnyisngags so so'i mthar/oṃ ā:nyu btags lanang mgo 'bul/dpal ye shes kyi mgon po legasaldan nag po/bdud gcod kyi skyes bu/srog gcod kyi bshan pa/bdu 'dulagyi dmag dpon/srin po lang ka pu ri grong khyer gsum brtsegs brlag paramadzad pa/rnal 'byor pa'i dgra lha/rigs 'dzin gyi srung ma/dmanyamasakyi srog bdud wo/ po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dam rdzas brgyan dang ldan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/dkon mchogagidabu 'phangs bstod/dge'adun gyi chos 'khor skyongs/bla ma'i skutshesringagag par du dkon mchog gsum la gnod par byed pa dang /bdag cag 'choradangabacas pa la bsam sbyor ngan pa byed pa thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig/galate —26

zhi bas 'dul du ma'atshal na/ bsad pa dang / bskrad pa dang / dbyeb dang /rengs pa dang / gzir ba dang / sdigs shing / dpa' skong ba lasogasapa dragapo'i phrin las kyi tshar bcad du gsol/ bla ma mgon po 'khor bcasal/ /bdag gis mchod gtor phul ba yis/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phangs smod pa dang / /theg pa chen po sun 'byin dang / /bstan pa 'jigs dang dbyin byed dang / /bla ma'i sku la brdo ba dang / /rna la 'byor bdag le sdang ba rnams/ /dekun nag po chen pos bsgrol/ /mā ra ya phaṭa/ sa ma ya/ rgyas pa la spro na/ rngam pa sgra sgrog sogs bstod pa dang / 'khor dang lha mo'i bstod bskul khyung pos mdzad pa byin can rnamasagatso bor gyur pa'i ci rigs bya/ 'bring du bya bar mos na/ kho bos zur du bkod pabazhi bya/ṭhā gtor sogs bsdus pa'i ske bas/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs sogs kyi gtso bolabazhi/khrag mtsho chil chil khol ba'i klongs dkyil na/ /mtsho chen dre'u'i steng na gzi brjid 'bar/ /mthing nag sku la zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ /ral gri gri gugargyal mtshan thod rlon bsnams/ /sku'i sprul pas sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung/ /gsung gi sprul pas khams gsum g.yo bar mdzad/ /thugs ni mi 'gyur 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma/ /ma cig re ma tī la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i phyogs bzhi'i bka' mnyam pa/ /ye shes bka' bsgrub las kyi pho nya mdzad/ /ma rungs kun 'dul sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed/ /las byed phonya bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dbang po gshin rje chu lha gnod sbyin dang / /melha srin po rlung lha 'byung po dang / /steng gi tshangs pa sa'i lha mo ste/ /sprul pa'i phyogasaskyong bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang / /dmacan —27—

rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogis rnams//sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ltasaga'abyorabadag cag 'khor bcas kyi//mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol//'dod don thams cad sgrub pa dang //mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol ba dang //brgyasaba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//ces bstod/de nas thun gtor 'bul na/dpalaldan mgon po mahā kā la dang sogs spyi btab bya/rgyun gtor la 'di ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med do//de nas yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas la/ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyi bzod tsogasogakhyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/sogs kyi gshegs su gsol ba'am/tsheyodan brtan bzhugs bya/de nas smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs pa byas nas/thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go/ma lus gzhan 'phrul sder bcas 'joms pa'i lha//sa steng dgra bo'i tshogs rnamasarab nyams byed//dngos grub ma lus stsol mdzad nag po che//bla ma mgon po dbyer med sgrub padag/mchod pa'i bya ba rgyas bsdus skyon bral zhing //tshang la ma nor man ngag ldan pa 'di//kun dga' snying po'i zang zing bral ba yis//zol med 'gro laphan pa'i bsam pas bris/zhes pa'angasmras go/'dir shin tu bsdus pa dang bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs thun phyi ma gsum la gsar du bskyed chog mi dgos par/snying ga'i 'od kyis skad cig laspyan 'dren pa man chad tshang bar byas pas rung bar khyung po'i yig chung du bshad pas de ltar bya'o//zhes pa myur mdzad byin rlabs kyi mgon po'i sgrub thabs 'di yang /mi dbang gzhon nu rnam dpyod kyi spyan ras lhag par bsal ba gang gis nye bar bskulate/rgyal khams pa kun dga' snying pos rang lonyer gsum pa chu stod can gyi mkha' 'gro 'du bslatshes la bris pa ste tshong 'dus 'gur mo'i pho brang du'o// //maṅga lo//shu bha mastu sarba dzagarta//zhus so// //—28—

༄༅/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med nyid la bstod pa bzhugs so/ /༄tsho/ /ye shesabaskal pa'i me yi klong dkyil na/ /thabs la mkhas pas rab khros skur ston pa/ /mi bsrun bdud sde 'joms pa'i dpa' bo ma khyuramadzad spyan ras gzigasal phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag tu 'grol khyab pa'i thugasarjeyis/ /rab tu zhi yang mchog tu gtum pa'i sku/ /dus mtha'i sprin dngamigasman ltar gnag pa/ /'jigs byed khrag 'thung gtso la phyag 'tshal go /rab bzhad rdo rje'i gad mo wo po yis/ /bdud dang gshin rje'i snying 'gas klad pa 'gem//lha dang lha min ma rungs sder bcas lhung / /drag shul bzod dka'i gtsolaphyaga'atshal lo/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs rgyal rnams kyi/ /brtsechen gcig tu bsdus pa spyan ras gzigs/ /dngos grub kun stsol byin rlabasamagon po mchog /'phrin las myur sgrub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ngasamache gtsigasaspyan gsum me ltar 'bar/ /sma ra smin ma dbu skra gyen du brjeg/klu chen brgyad dang g.yer kha'i phreng bas brgyan/ /phyag drug mgon po khyod laphyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen cod pan khrag 'dzag mgo phreng can/ /phyagagayasagri gug thod phreng cang te 'brol/ /phyag g.yon thod pa rtse gsum zhagasapa bsnams//stag lpags na bzas mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam dang g.yon brkyangagyad kyi dor stabs sogs/ /sna tshogasagar kyi log 'dren steng na rol/ /pad nyi'i chi 29

gdan bzhugs tsan+dan ljon pa'i drung //brten mdzad mahā kā lar phyag 'tshalalo//zhabs sen cung zad brdabs pas sa gzhi g.yo/hūṃ sgras ri bo ralazhingachu gter 'khrug/spyan tsam bskyod pas bar chad thams cad sel//thogasamed mthu stobs mnga' la phyag 'tshal lo//sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma rin po che//bar chad srung phyir chos skyong bka' sdod sku//sgrub pa po la bu bzhi stogasamadzad pa'i//bla ma mgon po dbyer med la phyag 'tshal//rdo rje sgosadapa'i robo sgrib kun sbyong //nyid kyi dpral bar brten pa'i chos khrungadabyibs//gisathig le yum gcig rnal 'byor ma//chos kun bskyed ma khyod la phyag 'tshalago/de dbus hrīḥyig dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon/khams gsum dbang bsgyuramakha' 'gro ma rnams spro//'gugs byed bcu gsum yig 'bru'i gsang sngagasamachog/'phags ma sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal//mibaskyod dbang phyugarigasakyi bdag por bzhugs//bcom ldan gshin rje gshed kyi mthu stobs k+ṣi/khyod la phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi//rtag tu gsol ba 'debasasophyin gyis rlobs//sgrub la bar ho med par byin gyis rlobs//chos ca rgyu marartogs par byin gyis lhos//rmi lam rang grol 'char b.ri byin gyisaphyog/gas mo'i bde wo 'char bar byin gyis rlobs//'od gsal phyag r+pā rtagasapar byin gyis lhos//tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par byin gyisardzog/b.ratso 'jigs pa sel bar byin gyis lhos//bar dor longs sku thob parabyin gyis rlobs//'gal rkyen thams cad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs//mthun rkyen thams cad 'grub par byin gyis rlobs//thugs yid gnyis su med parabyin —30

gyis rlobs//sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// //zhes bla ma mgon po dbyer med nyid la bstod pa 'di'ang tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum pa la'o//gcig zhus//bkra shis//dge'o//dgogi/dge'o//༄7//dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor bzlog bsdus pa'i lag len bzhugs so//༄༅//chaswā sti/myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon pa'i gtor zor bsdus pa'i lag lenani/gtor shom sogs gtor chog dang snang gso gzhung srang /lcags snod sogs su dmar gosko zur gsum dbal can khrag gis sbags pa/yungs gar gyi gang bu dang /tsher ma zan lingasogasabatsugs/chos 'byung gru gsum me ri dang bcas pa'am/stag lngags dang mi lpags sogasakyi steng du stegs bu'i kha labazhag/sgos kyi mchod pa bshams/khrag gam khrag tu rdzus pa'i mchod yon zhabs bsil/dbang po lnga'i me tog/'khris pa'i dri chab/zhal zas dmar rīrgyan can grugasusasogs drag po'i mchod rdzas bshams/gtor chog bskang bshags bstod pa tshar gcig song ba'i mtshams su slar yang mchod pa byin rlabs bya ste/dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tu mos/gtorasladakyusabazhi byin gyis brlabs/denyid gtor chog ltar mgon po 'khor 4sa su bskyed cing spyan 'tho mchod bstod bya/bskang gtor yang gsos/rgyag gtor la mtheb skyu gru gsum sha khrag gisabayo pa bdun las mi nyung ba btab/chab dang nang mchod kyis bran/gtor ma gsos pa rnams byin gyis —31—

brlabs/rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/dgra bgegs thamasacad bkunacing tshar bcad gtor ma la thim pas sha khrag gi rgya mtshor gyur/dgra bgegasakyi sha khrag nam mkha' gang ba zhal du bstab par mos te/cigator chog ltabaka'ama'abul/shā sa na mang du bzlas/slar yang bskang gso mchod bstod tshar gcig sogs ji ltara'osapa bya/de'i mtshams nas mgon po'i bstod pa ji ltar 'os pa zhig dang /'khor gyi bskularnamasabyaste/hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po yi/shar gyi phyogs kyi bka' mnyan pa//gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pā la ni//zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog smug/phyag g.yas gri gug dgra srog gcod//g.yon pa thod snying gtso la stobs//zhalagadangasamache gtsigs 'jigs pa'i gzugs//dom nag rgyug cing dgra larngam/khyod kyis mi thub gang yang med//sangs rgyas bstan pa khyod kyis bsrungs//dgon mchog dbu 'phang khyod kyis bstod//bla ma'i sku dgra khyod kyisasgrol//rnala'abyor 'phrin las khyod kyis bsgrubs//sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhesal//bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod//drag las dmigs gsal yod na 'di kho khrug cing /de min/gnod byed thal ba rdul du rlog/ces bad/desarisazhwasate/dpal ldan mgon po nag po yis//lho'i phyogs kyiḥ dbang phyug dzi na mi tra ni//zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo//phyag g.yasacang te'u mkha' la'akhrol//g.yon pa gcod pa'i 'khor lo 'phen//spyan rtsa dmar po glog ltarakhrug/seng ge rgyug cing khyod kyis sangs rgyas bstan pa so༈sngadangawa/dpalaldan nub kyi —gshin rje ṭak+ki rā dza ni//zhal gcig phyag gnyisasku mdogadamar//phyag g.yas rgyu zhags dgra la 'phen/g.yon pa sdigs mdzub bgegs —32
