la sdigs/ /me 'od 'bar ba'i spyan gsum bgrad/ /stag mo rgyugacing— khyod kyis dpal ldan byang gi srog bsdud trakad nag po ni/ /zhalagazugaphyagaganyis sku mdog nag /phyag g.yas ru mtshon rtse gsum 'dzin/ /g.yon pa tsan+dan bing chen bsnams/ /rngam brjid khros la 'jigs pa'i sku/ /rta nag rgyugacing khyod kyis zhes pas bskul/ arnya nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ snying po'i mthar/ sutiṣ+ṭha dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ gtor ma'i lha bris sku'i thugs gar thim/ gtor ma la dgra bgegs bkunayaṃ dmigs pa yang bya/ sha khrag gi rgya mtshor gyur pa gong bzhin du bstab/ lhag ma dug dang me dang mtshon cha'i phung po r+pā por gyur/ de nas sgo dbye bya ste/ hūṃ bka' ni dkon mchogagasumagyis bka'/ /las ni dam can yongs kyi las/ /do nub dgra la zor 'phen gyi//'byung po thams cad sku zur cig /sgo ba rnams kyis sgo phye zhing / /'phrangab rnams kyis 'phrang sol cig /do nub zor kha gnyan po 'di/ /steng golha lami'aphen no/ /'og gi klu la mi 'phen no/ /bar gyi btsan la mi 'phen no/ /sde brgyad rnams la mi 'phen no/ /yul lha rnams la mi 'phen no/ /sabadagarnamasal mi 'phen no/ /mtho ba rnams ni zhabs bskum shig /dma' ba rnamasani dbu chums shig /bar pa rnams ni sku zur cig/zor 'di sdang ba'i dgra la'aphen/ /zor 'di gnod pa'i bgegs la ya/ lko sgo phye nas/ sgos mchod rnams 'kho ga'alabatab/ chos 'byung yod na de yang phyags te blug /gser skyems dang gtor ma phyi ro'adu khyeranas/phyogs skyong gas skral 'di sga'i phyi rol tu byas kyang rung ste/ dpal ldan mgon po nagapo ni/ /shar sgye phyogasakyi dur khrod nas/ /dri za 'bum gyi 'boradang bas/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /de khas rigs 'gre ste/ dpal ldan mgon po nagapo —33—

ni/ /shar lto mye lha lho yi gzhin rje lho nubaza lga po nub kyi chu lha nub byang rlung lha byang gi: gnod sbyin byang shar 'byung4 steng)tshangs bza dpal ldan 'og gi sa bdag khyod kyi dpalaldan— gnasabadag ma mo'i pho brang nas/ /'jigs byed ma mo chen mo ni/ /mthing nagadrirta rkang gsum chibs/ /phyag na khram shing nad rkyal bsnams/ /'khor du mamo 'bum gyis bskor/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ re re'i mthar/ dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /ces pa re sbyar kyang chog /de nas gtor ma rgyagasarakhyer nas/ gser skyems dang po nam mkha' mdzod kyis sngags rgyas/ bla ma dkon mchog la'abulgaganyis pa sde brgyad spyi la 'bul/ gsum pa yul lha gzhi bdag la 'bul/ bzhi pa lam na gnasapa la 'bul/ lnga pa dgra bgegs kyi lha la byin la/ gdug pa can la bsrung skyob ma byed cigaces bya/gong gi sgo dbye de las sgo ba rnams kyi sogs tshig gnyis bzhag /hūṃ dur khrod 'jigs surungaba'i shar phyogs nas/ khyod kyis bka' gnyan las byed pho nya po/ /mi'i gzugs la srin po'i gdong pa can/ /gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pā la lasamadzod cig /hūṃ dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i lho phyogs nas/ khyod kyi bka' gnyan lasabyed pho nya po/ kha nas dug dang khrag gi zor 'phen pa/ /dbang phyug dzin mitra lasamadzod cig /des rigs 'gre ste/ nub phyogs nas mi sha khrag godritshorabazod rlags med/ /gshin rje ṭak+ki rā dza las mdzod cig /hūṃ/ durakhrod 'jigs su rung ba'i byang phyogs nas/ khyod kyi bka' bdud mgon minagarta nag rdzu 'phrul can/ /srog bdud trakad nag po las mdzod cig /hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /gri gug 'bar bas dgra sogasagacod/ /thod —34—

rlon 'bar bas dgra khrag gsol//spu gri rnon pos dgra snying thon/tangate'urgyoyis dbang du bsdus//tsan+dan bing chen klad la rgyob//bdag gi bsamapa'i don sgrubs las//gnod byed rdul phran bzhin du mdzod//ces 0masajola'i sgra chen po dang bcas te gtor ma zor du 'phang /dmigs pa bla ma'i zhal las blangs/slarayangalog ste/yaṃ raṃ baṃ lo/zhes 'byung bzhi'i ra bas lam bcad/slob dpon gyis rtingamanan nas 'ongs/nang du mchod bstod sogs rjes chog rnams bya'o// //gtor bzlog bsdus pa'i yi ge 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o//zhus dag/ dge legs 'phel//༄tsho//gtor chog snying po gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs rber+sha//༄༅//chaswā sti/na ma7glekā la tsakra ya/kun mkhyen dol po sangasargyasal phyaga'atshal lo//rtsa ba'i bla ma laphyag 'tshal lo//'dir dpal jo nang ba'i lugs kyi gtor chog nyer mkho rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ni/gtsang zhing bzang ba'i rgyu dam rdzas dang bcas pa la/spyi bungs skos med du o na gtor ma gcig gis kyang chog la/bskos can du byed na/rgyas pa mgron tshan gyi grapasadangamanyam pa'am/'bring po/bla ma yi dam mgon po dang //rnam sras zhalabazhi mkha' 'gro ma/khabadag gnyis gcig bsrung ma dang //spyi gtor gzhi bdag zhes bya bcu/zhes pa ltar yangarung mod/rgyun gtor la lnga tshar du byed pa shas che ba/lag len ltar bshams/de yang dus getoral dmardzas gal che yang /rgyun gtor la ni dkar gtor 'ba' zhig gis kyang chog go/de lanyin zhanade nyid kho na'i thun mtshams gas la bdag bskyed sngon du song na/skabs 'dir snying po ngag tu brjod —35—

pa'i sgo nas thun mtshams kyi lhar skad cig gis gsal btab pas chog la/ de ltar ma song na/bdag bskyed rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang yang rung ba zhig skabs 'dir rnal 'byor du bya'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi la/ thog ma kho nar/ mchod pa dngos su bshams na byin gyis brlabs/de nasagator ma rnams byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ oṃ āḥ:hraḥphaṭa/ ces pa'am/ oṃ phre badz+ra ḍā ki ni/ badz+ra dhā tī shwa rī/ ga ga na swa bhā wa sarba drwa bya bi sho dha ni/ sabodrabya ṇi bisho dha ya hūṃ phre phaṭa/ ces pas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngangalasayaṃ 'dzigarlungagi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhi(gzhuka'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las mimago'i skyed pu la gnas pa'i oṃ yongs su gyurapa las/ thod nga dum bu gcig pa/ de'i nang gi dbus su a las byangasems/shar du i las rkang dmar/ lhor ṛ las rak+ta/ byang du ulasadrichu/ nub tubla las dri chen/ rlung mtshams su lī las glang po che'i sha /dbang ldan du mūlasab glang gi sha bden bral du dṛ las rta'i sha /me mtshams su sī lasakhyi'i sha /dbus kyi steng du ā las mi'i sha /lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du zla ba laganasapa'i oṃ sku rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis ma dag pa'i rdzas rnams sbya4paragyur/ mawo badz+ra tsan+d+ra sarba dharma bi shud+dha swa bhā ba sarba dharma na bi sho dha ya swāhā/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du nyi ma la gnas pa'i āḥgasung rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis dag pa'i rdzas rnams spel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra srur+ya sarba dharma gabodha ka sarba dharma ṇa pra bo dha ya swāhā/ lag pa gnyis ka sbyar ba'i dbus su/ sgra can gyi dkyil 'bor la gnas pa'i hūṃ thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od kyis rdzasarnams—36—

sbar bar gyur/ oṃ hūṃ badz+ra a na la sarba dharma pra dī pa ka sarba dharma ṇa pra dī pa ya swāhā/ mkha' lding gi phyag rgya'i dbus su dus me la gnas pa'i hoḥyig ye shesardo rje'i ngo bo de'i 'od zer gyis bdud rtsir byas par gyur/ oṃ hoḥsarba sto badz+ra.a mṛ ta ka ra sarba dharma ṇa badz+ra a mṛ haṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes 4ge /de nasablama'i gtor chog rgyas pa byed na logs su 'byung ba ltar byed dgos pa yin mod kyi/ bla ma yi dam dbyeramed la'abul ba nyid lag len zor yang zhing / don la'ang gsang sngags kyi lam la zhugs parnams kyis de ltar byed dgos pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid rtsa brgyud bla ma'i ngo bor shes par bya'o/ /de la mgron spyan drangs pa ni/ sangs rgyas yab yum srasadangabacas pa g.yog 'khor dang / /grogs bcas gnyen rnams dag gis bskor ba'i tshogs pa ni/ /lha dang lha mo dag gis mnyes par byed rnams dang / /mchogagirdo rje sems dpa' dag ni gshegs su gsol/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ ha hā hi hi badz+ra bhe ra wa arnya ya ak+ṣa ya/ prabe sha ya / prabe sha ya/ ban dha ya ban dha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ dzaḥsarba ho badz+rashā kyini hri da yaṃ rnyu hūṃ phre rlu phaṭa/ ces pas mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ sngagasatsamagyisgo nas mchod pa bcu gnyis 'bul te/ oṃ badz+ra gas pra tīts+tsha na maḥ nas/ kā mokyi b.rabartsod/de nas gtor ma dang po dkyil 'bor la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ ā:nyu ho7gle kā la tsakra/ badz+rasgrir wa bhi ka rā ya sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes rdo rje'i phyag rgyas spyan dras gdenasayabardo rje'i phyag rgyas 'bul ba ni/ i rda/ ba liṃ/ gan+dhe/ puk+ṣi dhā gidipe/ ak+ṣa) da dā ma he/ te dza ā ga t+ya sa pa ri wā raḥ shrī r+ghaṃ i rdab/ ba ma grihā sa khyadasapi—37—

pa bcu gnyis 'bul/ nang mchod ni/ oṃ badz+re hai ra wa/ ha ya ra wa la/ nganya ṇa man/gha dzha rte bha dha/ ga dza ḍa ba da/ kha tsha ṭha pha tha/ gtsasapa ta/ oṃ āḥ dzad phro/rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po/ /dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ khre bosna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin/ khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyi gtso/ /dus mas i mtshihe ru kā /rdorje shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam dag chos kyi dbyingasalamagayos kyang / /thugs rje wo pos rngam pa'i skur ston zhing / /bdud dnganyon mongs snying khrag gsol mdzad pa'i/ khrobo'i dbang po rdo rje shugasala'adud/ /dpal ldan gtsug gtor gnod mdzes shin tu stobs/ /dbyug sngon rmugasabyed 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang / khengs byed mi g.yo rengs byed stobs pone /tswa brjid khrorgyal bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha' rlung me chu dang sa rnamasak+shi/zad par bsnyes pa rnam pa gnyis gnyis te/ /phyogs bcu rang rang 'byung ba'i gdan bzhugs pa'i/ /grub pa chen po bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangasapa khyab 'jug bden bral rlung lha dang / /gshen rje me lha rgya mtsho drag po dang / /lha yidabang po dang ni gnod sbyin te/ /phyogs skyong ོ po bcu la phyagalasalko /grogacan dus me zla ba nyi ma dang / /gza' lhag bkra shis pa sangasaphurabu dang/ /du ba mjug rings dang ni spen pa ste/ /gza' mchog chen po bcu la phyaga'atsharalo/ /rgyal ba rnam rgyal stobs rgyu pad+ma dang / /nor rgyas dung skyong mtha' yasarigs ldan dang / /'jog po dang ni pad+ma r+pā po ste/ /klu rgyal wo po bcu laphyag 'tshal lo/ /ro langs grul bum khyi dang bya rog dang / /phag dngabya thod —39

stag dang 'ug pa dang / /lte spyang nam mkha' lding gi gdong can te/ /'byungapo chen po bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdedrug srung ma drug cu 'khor bcas la mchod gtor 'di dang dri dang me tog dang / /bdug spos snang gsal ma nyamasabadaga'abul gyi/ /de rnams 'khor dang bcas pa tshur byon la/ /gtor ma'adi rnamasalen zhing gsol ba dang / /btung bar mdzad de shin tu mnyes pa yis/ /'gro lazhi rgyas srung skyobs sba ba rnams/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol/ /klu dang 'byung pos lus kyi khams bsrung zhing / /gza' dngaphyogasaskyong ngag gi khams bsrung ste/ /zad par khro bos sems kyi khams bsrung zhing/khams drug ldan pas khams kun rab bsrungs nas/ /'khor lo drug tu rlungasems rab 'chings te/ /rgyal ba rigs drug go 'phang myur thob shog /gnyis pa dpal mgon po nag po chen po 'khor bcas la 'bul ba ni/oṃ āḥ/ hoḥ swa bhā was stong par sbyang la/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi namamakha'i gnas su/ dur khrod chen po'i dbus su dgra bgegs thams cad mnan pa'i steng du/ paṃ las pad+ma dang / rolas nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃ mthing nagalasa'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dusayongasasugyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po wo po dus kyi mun pa lta bu'i sku mdogatso/ tshezhingacher 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa khragagis gang ba thugs gar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis char gyi dbusanarnama'aphrul gyi garnye bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhalamache ba gnyagasapa/dbu skra cu po gyen du brjes pa/ mimago skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang/tho pa —40

khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyisabargyan pa/ stag gopags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna chogasakyi cod pan dang lhabalhub kyis klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel ba'i 'dug stangs kyi ro'i steng na bzhugasapa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag /g.yon na khyi nag /rgyab na lcags spyang / mdun na mi nag /steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'khoralasabyed sprul pa yang sprul/ sdebargyad kyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor bgo/de'i g.yon du me las e ka dza ti sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag ciganyisakyisabadud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs gar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzasarjod g.yogs shing / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa lan bu gtsegatugyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangasapa'i nangadu/traka las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa/ sku mdog sngo nagazhalagatsenaphyag bzhi ma/ g.yasakyi dang po na ral gri gnyis pa na thod pa khragagisagangab/g.yon gyi dang po na mdung / gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgoskamapo lnga'i dbu brgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drugadangaldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing / ba glang gi ko bsasmad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang po'i ske ragasabacingasapa/spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigasapa/snyan g.yas pa la dug sprul dang / g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/skulakhrag—41—

gi thig le dang / zhag gi zo ris dang / thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ yin turid cing / lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba/ ma momakha' 'gro sha za 'bumasde'i dbus na hūṃ dang bh+yoḥ'i sgra sgrogs pa'o/ /gzhan yang lcam dral gsum gyi sku'i mtha' bskor du/ dgug gzhug bcing mnyes mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro chen mobazhi/ sku gsung thugs kyi rnam 'phrul pho nya bye ba grangs med pa'i tshogs dngaphyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / lha dang / gnod sbyin dang / lga po dang /gshin rje dang / ma mo la sogs pa/ lha srin sde brgyad kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas ya dang / lha mo'i thugs ka nas oṃmadun du spros pa las/ ya las nag po gnod sbyin g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing/ g.yon spar ba gdengs pa'i lag mthil nas nyi ma 'char ba/ mi lpags kyi g.yangagazhi gyon zhing / gser gyi sna cha can/ de'i g.yon du me las nag mo gnod sbyin g.yas gser gyi sbu gri dang / g.yon spar ba gdengs pa'i lag mthil nasaslab 'char ba/ dar nag gi na bza' dang / byi ru'i lan tshar can/ de gnyesakyi thugs ka nas yab las tri gnyis dang / yum las bh+yoḥgacig sprosapa 'thag puṭa ming sring gsum du gyur te/ de dag gi mdun du 'khod pa ni/ tri lasapu ṭanag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas shang lang gri ring 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod pa klad khrag drod mos gang bar 'dzin zhing zhal du gsol ba/ men kre'i gsha dang / dar nag gi na bza' can/tri lasabha ṭa nag po/ daragyi gzha dang/stag slog gyon pa/ g.yas dam shing dang / g.yon mi snying 'dzin zhingagasolab/spyolasasring mo ral gcig ma/ g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang / g.yon rgyu ma—42—

'dzin zhing / mig nas khrag 'dzag pa/ kha nas me 'bar ba/ lnga charayabaskumadog mthing nag /mon bu pho mo'i cha lugs can/ mimago'i rgyan dang ldan pa/rab tu khros la rngam zhing 'khrugs pas gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na 'gying ba'o/ /de'i mtha' skoradu/ g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ g.yon gyiru'adren pa dge slong gi gzugs can brgya/ slad kyi rjes su 'brang ba ban de nagapophurathogs brgya/ mdun gyi bshul byang 'dren pa bud med nag mobargya/ gzhan yangadam nyams kyi rjes gcod pa'i bya nag khyi nag /lce spyang la sogs pa pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pasabaskor bar gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃ/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ 'ogamin rnamaparasnang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang / rang bzhi gyi gnas nas lha modang / rdo rje gdan gyi spo nas las mgon dang / gzhan yang dur khrod ོ po brgyad dang / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gdan sa khyad par can rnamasanag mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa thamasacad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mgon po sku gshegs gdan las bzhengs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugasapa'i gnas ngan yang / khwakya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī mahākā laya e h+ye hi/ dzaḥ(2 hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ bh+yoḥ lha mo sku gshegs nas/ gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ mahā kā li de bī e h+ya nas/ s+t+waṃ/ lasamagon skugashegasags/gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ kā la yak+ṣa ye/ kā lī yak+ṣa si/ yak+tamu g.ye/ rusabha —43—

ṭa ya/ru lu rak+ṣa si/e h+ya nas/s+t+waṃ/oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/mahā kā li de bi ye/griste rda arnya swāhā/nas/shap+ta'ibar gyis mardzo/thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba mgon po'i dam tshig gi phyag gyodang /thalamo sor mo'i rtse mo bsnol ba lha mo'i dam rgya'o//oṃ shrī mahākā laya/mahā kā li de bī ye/sa ma ye sma ra sa ma ye/ma ti kra ma ye/samaye rak+ṣan+tu/dpal rdo rje nag po r+pā po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thamasacad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/rtsa ba dngabargyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/dam tshig srungs/bstan pa skyongs/dkon mtshogagodabu tsongabastod/khyad par du bstan pa dang /bstan pa 'dzin pa rnamasadang/rnala'abyorapa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang /lam sgrub pa labar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabasakyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/gal te zhi bas 'dul du ma 'tshal na/gang la gang 'tshamasapa'ichad pas bcad pa dang /bskrad cing gzir ba dang /dbye ba dang /sdigasashingasaskong bar mdzad du gsol/mdor na chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang /bsam sbyor chos dang mthun pa'i yid bzhin du grub cing /bstan pa dang /bstan pa 'dzin pa dang /'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/oṃ kā la yak+ṣa nas/rak+ṣa si/griste rda arnya sogs kyis mchod/mgonawa'i dmargyas/rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag la/oṃ kā la yak+ṣa sogs la/sa ma ya smarasogasabatags/las kyi mgon po bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams—44

cad nas/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ gyi bar gong bzhi las bcol/ sa'adirabazlas pa byed na/ man ngag bzhin dmigs pa gsal btab la/ skyed mahā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ ces yi ge bdun pa dang / oṃ mahā kā la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes yi ge bcugacigapadang/rtsaba'i sngags shā sa nasang bzla/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba rjod gika ma la raka snyiḥbh+yoḥzhes lha mo dang / a li a li ma dza dza shaṃ shaṃ li shi ded a shwa ded mo rmugasapu ṭis li ma dza dzaḥ nag mo sha la rubs dza dzaḥ zhes dregs pa pho rgyud kyilen sngagatag yoro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la a shug me ma hūṃ ma bh+yoḥdza dzaḥ kho dregs pa mo rgyudakyi 'go sngags rnams kyang ci rigs par bzla'o/ /de nas gtor ma 'bulab ni/ rdo rje thalamo khayo du phye la/ oṃ mahā kā la ya/ mahā kā lide bī ye/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yobi shwa mukhebh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ.uṅga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ/ griste rda bā srid ye swāhāgoltar mchod/ yang na/ na maḥsarba'i tshab tu/ a kā ro btags pas phul kyang rung ngo / /de bzhi du/ tso( kā la yak+ṣa sogs kyi mthar nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags sam/ ā kā tres btags pa lan gsum gyis las mgon rnams la phul/ de nas rak+ta dang phud gtor zhing / skyed shrī mahākā 'i/ya/shā sa na u pa ha ri ṇi e kho a piñtsa ma ka lo/ a yaṃ i rda/ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa ka ri ṇi/ ya ti pra ti dzñā sma ra si ta dā/ i rda duṣ+ṭan kha kha khāhi khāhi/ māramār/groṇ+ḍa grihā/ ban dha ban dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsapa tsa/di na migen hūṃphaṭa/oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba khyod si ka ma la rak+ṣa si hūṃ bh+yoḥshudebazhi du sa li.a li ma sogs dang / ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa lasogs brjod/de nasastodapani/hūṃ/ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer gsum brtsegs 'jigs byed pa/ /gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /—45

mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che//gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yag/g.yon pa gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod//thod 'phreng can la bdag bstod do/khros pas zhabs brdabasas gzhi g.yos//'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bskyel//dam tshig nyamasapa'i snying 'byin pa'i//dam tshig can la bdag bstod do//dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā la ya//lha chen dpal 'bar nagapo mthubo che//mahā de ba'i sras po drag shul carne//tshogasabadag chen pomahākā lāya//legs ldan nag po grong khyer sum brtsegasadagra//bstan pa longs kyi bsrungamonag po che//chosa'akhor yongs kyi srog shing nag po che//dam tshigatso gyi dgra lha nag po che//'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shigasha khragadamar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhesashig/'dzam bu ti ba'i zhal zas 'di bzhesashig/sman rag phud kyi gtor ma 'di bzhesashig/sngar bcol lasakyi gsarag gnyan por 'bul//da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyan por bzhog/'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang //sdang ba'i dgra dngaganod pa'i bgegs la sogs//bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams mngago/thamasacad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol//bstan pa rgyas pa'i lasarnams myuradu sgrubs/kho dang /bh+yoḥgang gi sku gsung thugasakyi mthus//'dod pa'i khams ku na zilamanan nas//'dod pa'i khams la dbang bsgyur ma//'dod khamasadabang phyug ma la 'dud//dpal ldan lha mo khyed kyi sku//ri rab lhun po ltaburabarjid//dbang po sngon po lta bur 'bar//nyi ma'i zer ltar sprulapa tshud//dbu skra so po smo du 'bar//spyan rtsa dmar po klog ltar 'gyug/mirokhar—46

bcug mche ba gtsigs/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / /'jigasapa'i mtshon chas phyag rnams brel/ /mi mgo rin chen rus pas spras/ /klu dbangasengagelcags sgrog dang / khrag dang zhag gi thig les brgyan/ /ko rlon re ldogosasugyon/ /bong bu gwa zhon mtshan mo rgyu/ zhan tu rid cing mi sdugam/ /'jigasagazugs ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi gsung gi nga ro'i dbyangag /'brugastongaldir ba'i sgra sgrogs pas/ khams gsum ma lus zil mnan nas/ /sagasumagayo bar mdzad la 'dud/ khyod thugs zhi la rab gzhol yang / snyingarje'i dbang gis srid la bzhugs/ khrodang 'khrugs dang rngam pa yis/ /bdud dpunganges par 'joms la 'dud/ /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsumabadag /'dir gshegs sogs kyis bstod cing 'phrin las bcol/ gnod sbyin yab yum 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /rngam shing 'khrugs pa'i cha lugs kyig /bdud dang dgra bgegs 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bstan srungs yab yumatshelabastod/ /mon bu pu ṭa nag po skyod/ /men kri'i ga sha sku la gsol/ /sherashingasenashingaphyag na bsnams/ /pu ṭa nag po khyod la bstod/ /mon bu bha gastagaslogabakra/ /dar gyi ga sha sku la gsol/ /phyag na dam shing rnon po bsnams/ /mon bu bha ṭakhyod la bca/ /r+yā mo gser gyi sbu gri ma/ /nag mos molngaworam/ /phyag na gser gyi spu gri bsnams/ /nag mokhyod la bdag bstod do/ /ha med nag mo chen mo brgya/ /gshegs kyi de ni bshul yang 'dren/ /g.yasakyiphyogasanas ru 'dren pa/ /skyes pa stag masabargyan pa brgya/ /g.yon gyi phyogasanasaru'adren pa/ /dge slong nyan thosadagra bcom brgya/ /slad kyi rjes 'bunga'ajigs—47

rung ba/ /ban de nag po phur thog brgya/ /'khor bcas rnamasal bstod pa 'bul/ /skabasagasum bdag kyang bstod pa 'bul/ /las kyi mgon po pho nya 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir gshegasargyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sogs gong bzhin 'phrin las bcol/ bsdu na 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi zhes pa so so la sbyar gdapal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /sha khrag dmar gyi sogasani gcig gis 'phrin las bcol lo /gsum pa rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras lagator ma 'bul ba ni/ slar yang / oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dang / oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa dz+wa la rtsidzolare phaṭa phaṭaraṃ/ spyo phyogs kun tu bsangs gtor bya/ rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od zera'aphrogabyang phyogs nas rgyal po rnam thos sras gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzasadamapa'i mchod yon ni/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ be+e shā ma ṇa sa pā ri wā ra arnya pra tīts+tsha oṃ āḥ(de bcadu/zhabs bsil nas/ rol mo'i bar/ pā hūm̐ nas/shap+ta'i bar du spegadabon mchogagasum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs rgyun bshags bya/ bdag nyid kyi gnasagasum nas/ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ rgyal po zhakhoradangabacas pa'i gnas gsum du thim pas/ 'od du zhu nas stong pa nyid du gyur/ oṃswa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuzlo3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ e yaṃ raṃ baṃ lo6rnams las/ srung 'khor 'byung bzhi brtsegs pa gling bzhi ri rab dang bcasapa'i steng du/ bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs lasagrub pa'i pho brang / grubazhi sgo—48—

bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ kha nang ltas khor yug tu bskorabazhi sharashel/ lho be+eḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga /byang 'dzam bu chu bo'i gseralasagrub pa/phyogs re re nas ka ba nyis stong lnga brgya lnga brgyas btegs pa'i gdung ring dang /gdung thung gis mdzes par phub pa/ phyi rol du dpyangs pa'i dra ba drabyed/ pha gushar bu/ mda' yab sogs rgyan thams cad dang bcas pa/ dbus surin po che'i khang bzang sum brtsegs su yod pa/ sa thog tu gter gyi khang pa bcolnga dang bcas pa/ phyi rol du 'khor sa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ 'khor sa dang po la phyogs mtshams brgyad du khang bzang brgyad/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi roladu bum pa bzang po brgyad/ dpag bsam gyi shing brgyad/ rin po che'i ljon shingabargyad/ rdzing bu bzang po ljon shing dang me tog ldan pa ba.o/ 'os le'i ba mo brgyad rnams spel mar gnas pa/ phyi rol rin po che'i ra bas yongasasubaskor ba'o/ /dbus kyi pho brang gi nang du hrīḥlas sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab mabargyad pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i saṃ las sengagodakar po/ de'i steng du be+e ser po las yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ rin po tsho mas pa'i rgyal mtshan be+e yig gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phrog 'phagasapa mchod/ sems can gyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ 'jigarten khamasakyi dpal dang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus te be+e yig la thim/de yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal po wo po ngal gsos po sku mdog gserabatsom lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le yid bzhin gyi—49

nor bu'i char 'bebs pa bsnams pa/ zhe'u le la mig mngon du phyogs pa'i sengage dkar po lus nyams rtsal dang ldan pa/ nyal stabasasu gnas pa'i stengan rol ba'i stabs kyisabazhugs pa/ zhal nas 'dod dgu'i char 'bebasapa nyi ma 'bum dus gcig tu shar ba lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ rin po che'i thor tsugs dang / dbu rgyan la sogasapa rgyan thamasacad kyisabargyan zhing / darasnatshogasapa'i na bza' lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yas nas nyi ma dang/ g.yon nasazla ba 'char ba/ mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa'i sku can du gyur pa la/ lha klu gnod sbyin mthu bo che du ma dang / gnod sbyin bye bsabasnyoba'o/ /phyogs mtshamasakyi khang pa brtsegasapa brgyad la/ shar du dzilasardzabha la ser po rin po che bsnams pa/ lhor paṃ lasagang ba bzang po ser po rin po che'i bum pa gang ba 'dzin pa/ nub tu chalasanor bu bzang po dkar po norabu 'dzin pa/ byang du keṃ las ku be ra nag po ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhorase lasayang dag shes ser po ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub du rga las 'brog gnas nag po rin po che'i mdung dmar 'dzin pa/ nub byang du paṃ las lnga rtsen ser skya khangabartsegs 'dzin pa/ byang shar du paṃ las 'dzam po 'khyil pa dkarapo/ g.yasagri dang / g.yon phub 'dzin pa/ thamasacad kyang g.yon na gter gyi zhe'ulebasnams shing / rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rta la chibs shing / daradangarin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pasaspras pa/ dpa' zhing brjid la/ misdug pa'ichabyad can/ de rnams kyang rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa/ 'khor sabarapa na/ kluchen brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa dang / 'khor sa tha ma na lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi—50

tshogs rnams sku mdog ma nges pa/mi sdug cing brjid la rngam pa/mtshon masnatshogs pa 'dzin pa/'bor sa tha ma de nyid kyi nang rim na/ded dpon nyi shu rtsabargyad po thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar nag ral gri dang phub 'dzin pa rnams dang /phyi rim la stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis po thams cad sku mdog ljanganagago cha dang bcas pa/mdung dang ral gri 'dzin pa rnams rang rang gi ge'itshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa/thams cad kyang g.yon na gter gyi ne'ule 'dzin pas/sgrub pa po la dngos grub kyi char 'bebs pa'o//rangagithugasaga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/'od zer gyi sne la khrobo 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcagasakyu dang zhags pa thogs pa byung ste/rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra samādzaḥlcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bos/mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam can//da ltasnyigs ma lnga yi dus//thams cad nyen mongs 'dam bying bas//mtshamasamed lnga ni kun spyod cing //gzigs shing gshegs pa'i gnas ngan kyang/shākya sengage'i spyan sngar khyod//thugs dam gang bzhes de dgongs la//'dren pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang //sems can kun la sman slad du//byang phyogs gnasan bzhugs pa rnams//sems can don phyir gshegs su gsol//oṃ bai dzomaṇa sa pā ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥsnyi baṃ hoḥ.o be+e swāhā/4be+e shā ma ṇa āgarnya ya dzaḥbe+e ring po brjid dang ldan pa mig 'grum sum cuso gnyis kyi yun rgo du brjod/a mṛ ta'isngagasakyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs skud/rgyal po'i thugs gar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi 'dab mare re la be+e bzhi bzhi/bdag mdun gyi thugs 'od zer gyi lcags kyus sbrelabaragyur/oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa mo/spyo cod pan gyi dbang skrar/dpralabarayo/—51—

legs par mngon la/ bsdun gong du byin rlabs grubapas/ oṃ āḥsnyi hoḥ zhesagasal bsha patsam gyis kyang chogago/rdo rje thalamo kha yo du phye la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ be+e shā ma ṇa brda ba bikṛñtsan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sirnyi me pra 'khyu'i/masarba garma swa dha a mo gha ya swāhā/ zhes lan bdun lasogs pas gtso thodagayodzamabha la ye i rda sogs rang rang so so'i ming sngags spel bas rta bdag brgyad dang / oṃ aṣ+ṭa nā gsha ta sa ha sra ko ṭi yak+ṣa rāk+ta sa i rda sogs kyis 'khor spyi la 'bul/ bsdunayi/kā ro'am/ oṃ be+e grwa ma ṇa ye sa pa ribā rasogs kyis phul kyang sto gnod sbyin rgyalapowo po rnam thos sras/ /nor la dbang bsgyur 'dod yon r+pā du 'bebs//dbul ba'i gdung sel mgon po thugs rje can/ /rgyal wo zhanaradang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhesal/ nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gyi bar gyis 'phrin las bcol/ /bzhi pa pho nya mgon po zhal bzhi pa la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥ( hoḥ swa bha wasastongaparasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnasag polasapad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃ las gri gug hūṃ gis mas pa las 'od 'phros/dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs sugyurapa las/ nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal brtsegs ma gnyisanagapo/g.yas g.yon gnyis ljang nag /phyag bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyisakyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang / dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag gis gangaba'i thod pa snying bcas thugs rkar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas ralagri 'bar ba 'debs pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin zhing / g.yon 'og mas mi rus kyi 'phreng—53

sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po drim gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchogarab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shisaganyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /midangalha dang lha ma yin gyi mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dngadapal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pazho /stengan byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bdud kyi phyogs gnas lha ma yin rnams mchog tu 'jigasabyed dang / /mi yi 'jig rten dag na phyogs dang phyogs braladu gnas khro bo'i rgyal po btsun mor bcas rnams dang / /sa 'og dag na gdengasacan dbang po gang dag gdon tshogs mi dge dus kun du ni 'ching byed pa/ /de rnams thams cad nyin zhag so so'i dus su mi shes 'jig rten kun nas skyong bar byed gyur cig /smon lam gdab pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde gyuracig/sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yig /de yi sangs rgyas myur thob 3(ga /ma sgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma19/ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bces la/ /da ltanyid du gnas par shog /rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya ci rigs su bzlas la/ ma'abyorapa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dngani bgyid stsal ba/ /de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /oṃ khyod kyi semasacan —59

don kun mdzad/ /rjesasu mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangasargyasayuladu gshegs nasakyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /chabadz+ras ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang nyid lathim/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs kyang bya/ bsod namasa'adi yisa'agro rnamasadu ba la sogs lam gyisalhan skyesabade ba mchog bsgomasate//'gro ba'i bla ma sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan sku ni chos kyi 'khor lor yang dag gnas/ /lha rnams mgo bo'i gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer tshogs kyis zhabasakyi pad+mo la gtugasashing / /dam pa'i lam ston nyin byed bzhin du mun pa kun bcom dusakyi 'khor lo nyid gyur cig /nyi ma dang bcas thub pa'i rigs rnamasakyis ni shesarab ye shes thob par gyur ni ji ltar bar/ /rnam gsum srid paraganas pa'i semasacan rnams ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i drin las e waṃ nyid gyur cig /skyes bu gang dag bdud kyi grogs kyis rtag tu mi bden mun par songazhing lam nyams pa/ /de rnams thams cad lam 'di thob nas rdo rje nor bu'i khyim dang ring ba min par 'ong gyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag cag rnal 'byoramathob rab tu g.yo ba'i yid kyis gal te shi bar gyur na yang / /dpal ldan miyi 'jig rten du ni rab mchog thub pa'i rigs su rnal 'byor ldan par skye ba dang //sngon gyi goms pa de yis slar yang ye shes rnal 'byor yangs pa dag ni kun du 'dzin pa dang / /ye shes thob nas mi zad mchog gi gnas su rab 'gro gangadu slar yang skye ldan min gyur cig /dgra dang seng ge glang chen dbang po me dngaltos 'gro'i bdag dang chom rkun zhags pas 'ching / /chu gter 'brugs dang sha za 'chi ba'i 'jigs byed nad dang dbang po'i nye bar 'tshe ba dang / /dbuladang—60

bud med dang bral mi bdag 'khrugasapa'i 'jigs dang rdo rje lhung dang don nyamasarnams//bdag gis rnal 'byor ma rnams zhabasanigasal bar dran pa'i mthu las rab tu nyamasagyur cig/dge ba 'di yisamyur du bdagakhusakyi 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas//'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa//de yisasala'akhod par shog/rigs su skye dang dam tshig can//spyo med dus kyi g.yoloston//bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan//skye zhing skye bar 'gyur b.rasheg/lagapasardo rje dril bu 'brol//zab mo'i chosani klog pa dang //btsun mo'i khub mnya za can//skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog/mgo bor bla ma'i rdzo pan 'chang //lag tu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin//ngag tu gsang sngags rgyalapo bzlas//yid kyis zung 'jug sgom par shog/lha mo rgo ma dam tshig 3 mdang//desagasungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te//bden pa de yis lha mo de dgagis//bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ces smon lamastebaste/slarayang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs pa brjod do//yang gang dag chos skyong dmigs gsa'achan mi bsten zhing /dpaladus kyi 'khor lo kho na'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas ni/sgrub pos subashad pa'i gtor chog de kho nas rdzo ste/gtso bo khro bo bcudang cas pa lagator ma phul sa/'jigarten las 'das pa'i lha mtha' dag la phul bar 'gyur zhing /zad par phyogs skyong gza' dngaklu'akhor dang bcas pa la phulabs/srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po mtha' dag la phul bar 'gyur bas/rtsing po thams cad pa'i spyi gtor rgyas pa yin la/yang po bcuni phyogs btso mgon po yin zhing /de rnams la phul bas/mgon po spyi gtor du 'gyur zhing /dpal lha mor gragasapho rigs rnams kyang /phyogs bas rab gas mor 'dus pa dang /de rnams 'byung po btso yugayin wo/—61—

nag po r+sā po lcam dral gyi rigs 'khor dang cas pa thams cad de la tshang ngo //rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma spyi lagator chog dngos su gsal ba ltar yine la/yulabadag grong bdag lagazhi bdag gtoram sogs mtha' dag 'dus pa'i phyir/de tsam gyis gtor ma'i cho ga ma tshang ba med pa mtha' dgagrub pa yin no//de ltar bris pa'i dge bas/'gro ba thams cad myur du sangs rgyas kyisago 'phangathob par gyur cig/ //gtor chog snying po gsalab 'di/rgyalakhams pa tā ra nā pos sbyar ba'o//bkra shis//maṅga lo//༄7//bskang gso'i phyogs sgrig 'phrin las rnam rol bzhugs so//ra༅༅//skye'oswā sti/bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dang /phyogs bcudus gsum na bzhugasapa'i sangasargyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//kun mkhyen jo nang ba chen po shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo//'dir gtor chog snying po gsal ba dang rjesasu 'brelabar/yi dam dang bstan srung khyad par can rnams mchod pa'i bskangs bshags kyi go rim ca zad gcig bshad par bya la/de la so so thad ga'i tshig rnams ni/sngon byon gong maskyesabumachog rnams kyis mdzad pa nyid byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'gran zla med pa yin pas/de dgalabacos bslad dang /rang blos gsar du brtags pa'i tshig spyor lhur byed pa spangs shing /gorisamo'abrugs par sgrig pa dang /tshig rgyas po dag gi snying po cungazad bsdus nas brjod do//'di la don tshan bcugasum las/dang po yo byad bshams pa ni/bsnyen sgrub lasagasusagyi skabs so so'i dkyila'akhor dang 'brelabar dgos kyang /bskangs bshags tsam gdakyil—62

'khor rgyas bsdus rnams ma 'grub na/ bris sku'am maṇ+ḍal lasogs pa rten gang rung la brtenapas chog cing / mchod gtor las gzhan pa'i rten med kyang / bskang bshags tsam la mi rungabam yinano/ /des na/ gzhan rnams man ngag gi yi ge rnams las shes par bya la/ 'dir dang poraphrad lo (〈rja〉 la ) yi dam 'khor bcas kyi gtor ma dang / dkon mchog spyi la'abulargyu'i zhalazas sogs bya/ de rjes chos skyong bsrung ma ye shes kyi gtor ma dang zhalazas sogs bzhedagade rjes chos skyong 'jig rten pa yod na de'i gtor ma dang / de nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dgalhag malasngon 'gro gtor ma dang gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs bya'o/ / de la yi dam gtor ma ni/ zlum gtor brjid bag can labashos bu drug gis bskor bas/gtso bo'i gtor ma'i mdun du bshos bu drug ltar byed pa'i lugs kyang yod/ rtag gtor du byed na thams cad zur gsum du byed pa yin kyang / dkyus la zlum gtor du bya zhing / mgon po'i gtoramalas cung zad tshad chung bar bya zhing / de'i tshe/ stegs bu lhag par mtho bar byasapas/chos skyong ṣ+kagator ma rnams las rtse mo mtho ba 'ong bar bya/ yi dam gyi gtor ma'i g.yon phyogs stegs dma' bar/ chos skyong gi gtor ma rnams bshams par bya ste/ dang por dpal gur gyi mgon pogagator ma nor gzugs ma'am/ snying gzugs mar grags pa/ rtsa ba zlum la rgyas pa/sum chayan chad sked pa ngos rnams zlum shing rgyas la/ zur gsum dbaladu dod pa/ rtse mo zlum po cusad rno ba'i tshul du bya/ de'i rtsa ba pad 'dab kyi rnam pa can nam/ zan leb gru bzhi'i rnam pa can gyi'atheb skyus bskor/ dpal lha mo 'khor du sgrub pa yin pas/ gtor ma logs pa med kyang chog rtestebyed na/ snga ma dang mtshungs par byed pa'i lugs kyang yod mod/ gru gsum du mdzad pa legs par mthong ste/ mgon po'i gtor ma'i g.yon du bshams/ de'i g.yon du/ rnam thos sras kyi gtoramargyanag ma ltar khang bzangs su byed na/ rten gtor la sum thog dgos kyang / 'bulagator lathog gtsen—63—

ma sogs ji ltar bde bas rung zhing /'on kyang bskang gso tsam lade ltar ma 'grub na zlum gtoragyis chog cing /rgya gar ma la gtor ma 'di kho na yin zhes grags so//de yang dkar gtoradu mdzad pa'i lag len shas che zhing /sha gtsang mas rgyan du rung bar yang bshad pas/de ltarayangabya la/dbyibs zlum po/rtsa ba rgyas pa/rtse mo ha cang rno ba yang ma yin pa dbus ldirazhing/rtsemo dang dbus kyi mtshams phyed pa/rtsa ba'i mtha' bskor du zan leb phra mos bskor ba/gtso 'bor thamasacad de la 'dus pa'am/'khor gyi gtor ma logs su byed na/bsgos phran brgyad kyis bsgorabarabyed/zhal bzhi pa la snang ba byed na de'i g.yon du bshams te/gur gyi mgon po'i gtongamadanga'adra ba las/phyogs bzhir bshos phran zur gsum re dang /mtshams bzhin zan gyi thod gzugasare byed pa yang yod cing /dbus kyi gtor ma yang zur gsum 'phra rings su byed pa'i lugs kyangayod pa spyir 'dam ka yin kyang /'di nyid chos skyong gi gtso bor byed na snga ma dang /chosaskyongagongama'i las mkhan du 'dogs na phyi ma ltar legs so//bskang gso mi byed par gtor 'bul tsam byed pa yin na/thun gtor bshams pa kho nasachog pas/gtor ma chen po mi dgos/las mkhan pu ṭa sogs la/lcam dral gyigatorama'i 'phro nas bsngo ba yin pas/sgos bskang dang sgos sgrub kyi skabs ma gtogs/sgos gtor ces par bshams dgos pa ni ma yin/bsham par spro na/dkyus de lami bsham par/stegasabudama' ba la/lha mo'i gtor ma'i mdun tsam du zur gsum lnga tshar ram gcig bshams/lnga tsharadu byed nadabus ma mtho bar bya/sngar gyi gralagyi 'phros la mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang /gzhi bdagagator marnams/zlum gtor m+wa ring re bya/'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gas yod na/pu ṭa jogs labashams pa ltar mdun du bshams par bya'i/dkyus la sgrig pa mi legs par mthong ngo/de dgagi mdun du mchod pa rnams bshams par bya ste/de yang yi dam gyi gtor ma'i mdun nam mtha' —64

bskor du/ mchod pa bcu gnyis sam spyi 'gros kyang rung ste/ g.yon bskor du bshams/chosaskyongarnams la bsgos mchod re re 'grub na legs kyang / bsdu na gcig gis chog cing mchod pa de'i phyirol du/ spyi mchod snod che ba gcig tu bshams/ lhan tu bsdu na spyi mchod tsam labasdusapas chog /yang cung zad spro na/ mgon po ladam rdzas dang 'brelaba'i mchod pa dang / rnam thos srasalagayoma'i mchod pa bshams na yang legs/ mtho dman gang yang rung bar/ mgon po'i gtorama'i g.yas kyi thad gar/ man dzi sogs la ka pā lar ka phud kyis bkang ba dang / g.yon gyi thad kurasman phud kyis bkang ba bzhag go /gzhan yang spyan gzigs sna tshogs bgram/ dbang po lnga'i me tog la sogs pa sgom don dang mthun pa'i bris pa'am/ rang la 'dus byas pa nges par bshams/ sgrub pa po'i mdun du rdor driladang nang mchod sogs cha tshang bar bshams/ bskang gso zhag sbrel du byed na/ nub tha mamagatogs thun gtor rgyas pa gal che/ nub gcig ma la yang / dam rdzas kyi rnam grangs yin pas thun gtor re dgos shing / de yang srung ma drug bcu'i thun gtor zlum po'am gru gsum dkar gto gcig dang / mgon po la gru gsum dang / rnam thos sras la zlum gtor sho lu lta bu bya/de dgagazhoms spyir ji bde ba yin gyi nges can med na'ang / bskang ba las mtho sar mi bshamago /bskang gso dang mchod sprin gyi tshig rigs la yod pa'i mchod rdzas bsham par 'os pa rags rim rnams dngos su yod na bshams pas legs shing / ci ste dngos su med na/ bris thang ngas/gzugs 'gros kyi tshul kyis kyang bsham pa gal che'o/ /gnyis pa cho ga spyi'i sngon 'gro chos gnyis ni/ de nas sgrub pa po rnams tshogs gasngon 'grogator ma btang / gnas dang yo byad byin rlabs byed dgos te/ dpal dus kyi 'khoralo'i dkyila'akhor gyi cho gar blta bar bya'o/ /gsum pa bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa ni/ dpal dus —65—

kyi 'khor lo la rten pa byed na/bsrung 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa larten pa dang /dkyila'akhor yongs rdzogs larten pa dang /thugs dkyil tsam larten pa nas/lhan skyes kyi bar gangagis kyangarung mod/bsrung 'khor la rten pa dang /gtso rkyang zhal phyag yongs rdzogs la rten pa gtso che zhing/phyis g.yin du shes par 'gyur la/dang po ltar na/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje semasadapa'i sgom bzlas rnams sngon du btang /rdo rje'i zhal dag pa'i cho ga nas bzung /mthar bsrunga'atshiyongs su rdzogs kyi bar byas kyang rgyas shing legs par 'gyur la/'on kyang 'di la/gong du sngon 'gro gtor ma btang zin na/'dir yul bdag grong bdag gi gtor ma mi dgos la/'dir de byed par spro na/gong gi de mi dgos kyang /lag ho spyi dang mthun par sngon 'gro gtor mobs nas/'dir yul bdag gi gtor ma mi mdzad do//'on kyang rdo rje'i zhal dag pa/rigs sgya dgo panas/bdud bsreg pa'i bar/cho ga lugs g.yin yin pas ma 'grub kyang chog gasgrub thabasanas yang ba ltar/bdag nyid dus kyi 'khor lor gsal ba'i thugs gar zhesapanas/oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa ko3haṃ/zhes yaṃ sagyichogasabasagasaganyis byas nas/stong pa'i ngang las haṃ las byung ba'i spyo pa nas tshomasate/ringadu bros par gyur/zhes pa'i bar gyi phur btab yan chad rdzogs par byas/oṃ badz+ra gas sogasamachod pa bcuganyis kyis mar/rdo rje 'jigasabyed sogs kyis bstod/bar 'dir gsapagang yang rung ba zhig gang nus bya/slar yang mngon rtogs bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/'byungapo'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol gyi bar byas nas 'khor rnams rang la bsdus/bzhi pa yi dam gyi gtor ma 'bul ba ni//de nas gtor ma rnams chang chu nang mchod kyisabran la/oṃ āḥ( hraḥphaṭa ces pa nas/rgyal ba rigs drug go 'phang myurathob shogaces pa'i bar gtor sto bzhi no//lnga pa mgon po'i gtor 'bulal/don wo dang ponamong—66—

ma yin pa'i mar rdzas byin brlab ni/de nas chos skyong gi gtor ma yig 'bru bzhis byin gyis brlab pa gsos btab/rak+ta/oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/kyis bsangasasu bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las a lasathod pa'i nang du/raṃ lasanyi ma'i stengadu/ra yig zhu ba las/sha khrag rus pa'i rba klong 'khyil b.ragyur/chamahārak+ta āḥ(/lan bdun/sman phud kyang de bzhi du bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngangalasa.a lasabyung ba'i thod pa'i nang du/oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrīḥ.a rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shesabadud rtsilnga'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/oṃ sarba pañtsa a n+t+rata āḥhū7ga twan gyis byin gyis brlabs/'og nas 'byung ba ltar sngags drug gis thun mong du byin rlabs byasana'ang legs so//don wo gnyis pa lha bskyed cing spyan 'dren pa ni/de nas swa bhā was stong par sbya4pa nas/mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ'i bar gastochogatushad pa ltar ro//(〈rdza〉/klinadad pa dang ni dam tshig gis//tshur gshegs mahā kā la'i tshogs//bsgrub cing mchod pa'i gnas 'di rtswa/'khor bcasamalusagashegs su gsol//mahā kā la gnas 'dir gshegs//lha chen dpala'abaraganas 'dir gshegs//lha mchog sras po tshogs bdag chen po gnas 'jigs byed chen po gnas legs ldan nag po yum chen ekadzati srid gsum nag mo gnod sbyin lcam dralaḥ pu ṭa ming sring —gdongs rnamaba'i pho nya mngag gzhugs sha za'i tshogs//ma mo mkha' 'gro dregasapa can//rangarang dam tshig bka' nyan rnams//mthu dpung gzi brjid cher bskyed la//lasal ma g.yel da tshur byon//don phywa gsum pa mar nas dam la bzhag pa ni gtorachogatu —67

shes par bya ba las/khyad par lhag po ni/dam bas gi skabs/gtor ma gyochen po 'di bgo la/rdo rje 'cha /bram ze mardzo sred/nor bu gling babadeba'i rdorje/shud+dha ka ra warma/lo tsā ba rin wo bzang po/brag steng pa yon to tshulakhrimagamal lo blo gros grags/bla ma saskya ba wo po/slob dpon bgo namasartsemo/rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/chos rje sa paṇa/chos rgyal 'phagasapa/a gnyan dam pa/bdag nyid chen po/dga' ldan pa kun bsod/shar pa kun dga' seng ge/kun mkhyen wo po dol po pa/slob dpon don grub rgyalamagon/bla ma bkra shis rin chen pa/nyi ma rgyal mtshan/datan mchogargyalamatshan/bsod nams rgyal mtshan/chos kyi dbang phyug/kun dga' dpala'abyor/bkra shis rnam rgyal/lung rigasargya mtsho/rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/go brjod/don wo bzhi pa gtor ma bsngo ba niganarnatu shes par bya'o//don wo lnga pa mardzo phreng ni/dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi//rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rab bskyil ba//sbu ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa yi//arnya mchogagi mchod pa 'di//dpal ldan mahā kā la dang //'dod khams dbangaphyugamala'abul//dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang //bathol ba'i 'phrin lasagrub par mdzod//oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye/mahā kā li de bi ye/mahā rak+ta samun dra.arnya pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi//rna ba migadabade bzhi sna//lce dang tsit+ta yang dag ldan//dbang po lnga'i me toga'adi//dpalaldan 'dod khams:dam tshigatsha bcol ba'i oṃ shrīmahākā laye/mahākā lide wi ye/pañtsa yin tra gu h+ya puṣ+ṭi āḥ(/dgra bgegasakun gyi tshulachen go/—68— —

bdud rtsi lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /byin za chen pos bsregs pa yi/ /bdugapa'i sprin gyi mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan sogs/ oṃ shri mahā kā laye/ mahākā lade wi ye/ mahā me da gu h+ya dhu pe āñtsaPROB/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi sbrangachen po/ /grab ras kyi sdong bur bcas/ /yi dwags me yis sbar ba yis / /snangagasalamachogagi mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldanaḥ yo shrī ma hā kā la ye/ mahā kā li de wi ye/ mahā ma du ra gu h+ya ā lo ke āḥtsū/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi sha dang khrag /bdud rtsilnga yis yang dag sbags/ /nus pa mchog dang rab ldan pas/ /rab tusbyaraba'i drimachog 'di/ / dpal ldan ba sa shrī mahā kā la yi/ mahā kā lide wi ye/ ba surudhi ra gu h+ya garnye āḥsnyi/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi sha rus kyi/ /bza' ba khragagibatung bar ldan/ / ri dang rgya mtshor mnyam pa yi/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan rma shrī mahā kā la ye/ mahā ka li de wi ye/ mahā me sa rak+ta bhu dza ta pi pa tha āḥsnyi/ dril bu dam tshig bskul ba'i sgra/ /rnga chen kun nasabarjid pa'i sgra/ /dung chen gling bu snyan pa'i sgra/ /cang te'u 'phrin lasabaskulaba'isgra/ /gsang ba'i rnga chung dbang bsdud sgra/ /sna tshogs rol mo mchod pa'i sgra/ /'jigs byed chen po mnyes byed pa'i/ /rab brjid snyan pa'i sgra dbyangasa'adi/ /dpal ldan oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye/ mahā kā li de waṃ ye shap+ta pū dzi te āḥ&/ g.yang gzhi'i bla re nam mkha'i rgyan/ /rgyu rlon lda ldi bar snang rgyan/ /keng rusaphrengab sa gzhi'i rgyan/ / phyag rgya rnam drug sku yi rgyan/ /'jigs byed chen po mnyesabyed pa'i/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan oṃ shrī mahākā laye/mahā kā li de wi ye/ gu h+ya a lo kri ta pu tsite āḥ myos byed stongagibaston —69

bsdusapa/ /lcagasakyu lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /bdud rtsi lnga dngarab sbyarate/ /ye shes lnga yis byin rlabs pa'i/ kha dog ro dang nus par ldan/ /dngosagrub pad+mo 'byung ba'i gnas/ /mkha' 'gro ngang pa 'du ba'i gzhi/ /gsangaba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di/ /dpal ldanaḥ o shrī mahā kā la ye/ mahā kā li de waṃ ye/ gu h+ya mṛ ta sa mun tra pu tsi te ulhasne/ dgra bgegasarnams kyi sha dang khrag /sgron me lnga dang bdud rtsilnga/ /bza' dang btung ba sna tshogs bcas/ /sna tshogasargyan gyisamadzes byas pa/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /bzhed dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtshor ni/ / mngon par byin gyis brlabs nasakyang / /dam tshigabazhin du bdag 'bul gyis/ /thugs dam bzhin du bzhes mdzod la/ /dam bces bzhin du rjes dgongasanas/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba yi/ /lasarnamasathams cad grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ mahā kwa li de wi ye/ mahāpañtsa a mṛ ta ba ling ta pu tsi te sacisne/ mchod 'bulani/ rak+ta sgrengs la/ dgra bgegs sgral ba'i sha dang khrag /dbang po lnga dang don snying lnga/ /bdud rtsi lnga dngasrog dbugs rnams/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal du 'bul/ /mahā me sa la khā hi/ mahā rak+ta la khā hi/ mahā tsit+ta la khā hi/ mahā ko ro tsa na la khā hi/ mahā ba su ta la khā hi/ mahā keṃ ni ri ti khā hi/ sman phud sgrengs la/ mkha' lasabyungaba'i dadzinadamar dang / /dri sman bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul/ /sna tshogs 'bru yi bcud bsdus pa'i/ /myos byed ro mchog ldan pa 'di/ /rang byung gdod nasarnamaparadag /rtsa brgyad stong dang sbyar ba'i sman/ /dgesapa wo posarol tugasol/ /thugs rjer dgongs la dngosagrub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a n+t+rata lakharo—70

khā hi/de nas bstod pa bsdus pa gtor chog ltar bya'o//de nas drug pa rnam thos srasakyigatora'abul ladon tshan dang po rgyal chen rnam sras kyi dam tshig pa bskyed cing ye shes pa dgug pa ni/oṃ a mṛ tas bsangs gtor byed pa nas tshong /rgyal po 'khor dang bcas la badz+rasamādzaḥ'i bar gtor sto bzhin/de nas gyer dang cas te/be+e/gser gyi mdogatso zhalagacig phyag gnyis pa/g.yas pa rgyal mtshan 'khor gyi 'khu zlog 'jims//g.yon pa ne'u les sgrub la dngos grub ster//rin chen gyis brgyan 'khoragayog rgyas par mdzad//phrag gong nyi zlas sgrub la tshe dpal stsol/rnamamangathos sras dbus nas sku bzhengs shig/dbang sdud dmag zlog longs spyod rgyas pa dang //byag cing mngon shes zhing bcu sgrol ba dang //tshe'aphel lothogargyasasogs 'phrin las phyir//rta bdag brgyad po phyogs mtshams nas bzhengasashig/'khor sa bar par gnas pa'i klu chen brgyad//klu phran 'bum dang bcas nas sku bzhengs shig/'khor sa tha mar gnod sbyin bye ba dang //lha ṅga sdebargyad la sogs pho nya'i tshogs//mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs nas sku bzhengasashig/sgrub mchog dbul phongs bsal ba'i don slad du//gzhal ṣ+ka phobrangaganas mchog dam pa nas//bdag gis mos pas bskyed pa'i gnasa'adi mā/'khor bcas rtag par 'dir ni gshegs su gsol//gshegs nas sgrub mchog bsam pa bskyang du gsol//spyo brjod do//mgon po kun gshegs nas/phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad pa'i bar gtor chog bzhin bya/don wo gnyis pa mchod nas gtor ma 'bul ba yang gtor chog bzhi bya'o//de nas don 'a gsum pa mchod 'bulani/stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na//—71—

lha rdzasadage ba'i mchod rdzasakun//rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la'abul/thugs rjes brtser dgongs dngos grub stsol//oṃ be+e shā wa ṇa sa pa ri wā rabh+yaḥsarba pū dza me gha nir+ya ta yā mi/dkar gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dang//mngaragasum bu ram bdud rtsi dang //gtsang ba'i gser skyems mchod para'abul/thugs rjes brtser dgongs dngos grub stsol//oṃ pishā ba ṇa sapa ribā ra.asgopra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa mā ye hūṃ/man+ta ra dang ut+pa la//pu rusha gtsaspa ka/mañdzu sha ka li shi sogs//me tog sna tshogs dbu la 'bul//thugayopung tsan+dan dkar dmar a ka mā/ga bur 'bras dkar phye tshadang//radakar 'o mas bran pa sogs//sna tshogs bdug spos shangs la 'bul//thugs ཿdhu pe gser sogs rin chen snod nang du//til dmaramachonagisayongs bkang ste//mar me nyi zla'i bsgrag la sogs//snang gsal snachogasaspyan la 'bul//thugs ā loke rin chen sna tshogs snod nangadu//gaburagur gum bzang la sogs//gtsang ma'i chab kyisabran pa dang //drimachonasnatshogs sku la 'bul//thugs garnye nas gro 'bras dang sran mdang/khrorgod 'bru sna sna tshogs dang //shing thog rnam pa du ma dang //zas snasatshogasazhaladu 'bul//thugs ni be ṣ+ṭha rnga wo dril bu cang te'u dang //dung dang gling bu snyan pa'i sgra//rnal 'byor gdung bas 'bod pa'i dbyangs//rol mo sna tshogasasnya la 'bul//thugs shap+ta —gtor chog ltar bstod pa bsdus pas bstod do//twan parjesa'abrang gi gtor ma bsngo ba ni bar 'dir zhal bzhi pa'i gtor bsngo nas gzhi bdag gtor ma'i bar rnams dang rdo rje'i glu bkra shis smon lam rnams bya'o//brgyad pa thugs dam bskang ba la gnyisakyi/—72

dpal nag po r+ṣa po'i bskang ba ni/skang rdzas rnams sngags drug phyag rgya drug/ting nge'adzen sgya gis byin gyis brlab ste/de yang oṃ sarba bi shud+dha dharma te badz+ra sid+dha hūṃzhesapasasbyas/na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khebh+yaḥ sarba paṇa.ut+pa te s+pha ra ṇa i mogagan khaṃ swāhā/zhes pas spel/oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ces pas bdud rtsirabar/oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇi a phywa zhut+pasno twad/oṃ ā2PROBPROBPROB swāhā/kho pasa'adod don bsgrubs/na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/zhesapasathobapar byas/oṃ ru ru spu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirnyi lo tsa ni sarba athe swā dha ne+e swāhāgongasamanyam por thob par byas/spyo te/de dag gi dmigs pa dang phyag rgya spyi dang 'asgo/bdagagobasam pa'i stobs dang ni//de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang//chosakyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis//don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun//de dgathams cad ci rigs pa//thogs pa med par 'grub gyur cig/cesargan stosabarjod la/de nas 'di skad ces gyer ro//hūṃ dad pa dang ni dam rdzo gis/khuragashegs dpal ldan nag po che//rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga mā/ji ltarakhasablangs dam bcas ltar//byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di mā/'phrin lasarnam bzhi sgrub pa'i phyir/khas blangs dam bcas ma g.yel bar//mahākā lagashegs su gsol//hūṃ chos nyid ngang las ma g.yos kyang //bstan srungachosaskyong skur bstan pa//nag po wo po stobs po che//dus la bab kyilasalabyon//hūṃ nag po wo po 'bor bcas rnams//'bar ba r+pā po'i dkyil 'bora'adir//drag po'i las la spyan 'dren na//bzhugs nas dgra bgegasabasgraladu gsol//hūṃ dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol mdzad pa'i//mahā kā la'i thugs—73—

dam bskang / /lha chen dpal 'bar thugs dam bskang / /'jigs byed chen po'i lha mchog nag po'i thugs gdug pa tshar gcodapa bstan srungo po'i khyed kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas/ /lug nag rgyal mtshan dgagisabaskang/ /g.yab dar nag pos thugs bdud rtsi sman gyis gri rgod snyingagi4 luganag snying gisaḥ dmar nag gaX|sa bus dmar chen ar+ghas zilachen dud pas rten gtor wo pos rgyun gyi gtor mas 'dod yon tshogasakyisathugs dam bskang / /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di dag gis/ /nag po chen po 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs dam gnyan po skong gyur nas/ /bdag cagarnala'abyor 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon gdug pa zhi bar mdzod/ /dpala'abyorasnyan grags rgyas pa dang / /tshe dang longasaspyod 'phel bar mdzod/ /midang mimin skye 'gro rnams/ /thams cad malus dbang du bsdus/ /bstan 'asdangaba'idagra bgegs rnams/ /mngon spyod drag po'i bsgral du gsol/ /hūṃ rnamadagatshogs kyi gtor ma 'di/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas spel/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /thugs dam skong la g.yar dam mdzod/ /hūṃ mdzes pa'i spu sdug mkha' lding la/ /bya nag lcags kyi mchu sder can/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /thugs dam skong la 'phrin las mdzod/ /nyurta mchog nag po sprin gyi shugs/ /myur mgyogs mdzes pa'i rgyan dngaldan/ mgon po thugs dmaḥ hūṃ g.yag rgod lcags rmig khro chu'i mig /mdzes pa'i rwa dang rnga yab can/ /mgon po thugs dam hūṃ khyi nag dung gi mtsheb can/ /sengage'i stobs ldan rngam zhing rgyug /mgon po thugs dam hūṃ lug nagalcagasarudar—74—

gyis brgyan//bdud kyi spu nor mdzes pa 'di/mgon po thugasadam ཿminag 'gying po rdzu 'phrul can//las la 'khol ba'i stobs ldan 'di//mgon po thugs dmaḥ snro dpal gyi zhalazas 'brang rgyas mchog/rak+ta'i thig les brgyan pa 'di//mgon po thugs dmatsharak+ta'i yon chab rab bskyelab//srog rtsa'i lam nas 'don pa 'di//mgon pa thugs dam ཿgri snyingartsalagam nyams pa//rin chen lnga dang sman gyis bskang //mgon po thugasadam hūṃ 'bru bcud stong gi bcud bsdus pa//gzi brjid cher 'bar lnga bskyed chang //mgon po thugs dam hūṃ mnyen drang sba snyug rtse rgyal la/spu sdugabya yiphod dang bcas//mgon po thugs dam hūṃ nam mkha' sku rten rgyangabu la//'phan gdugs mdzes pas bskor dang bcas//mgon po thugs dam rnala'abyor bdag gi nyams chags kun//skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol//mthun pa'i dam rdzas tshang ba 'dis//dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs dam bskang/legs ldan nag po'o:khrag 'thung chen po'i— ma gcig lha mo'ilasamakhan nag po'i bka' sdod pho nya'i khyed kyi thugs dam skong gyuranas//bdagaladangos grub rnam gnyis stsol//dgra dang 'byung po chom la phob//hūṃrapabazhi rnam dag dbyings nyid las//thugs rje chen po'i sku sprul pa//skye med ngangalasa'ajigs byed sku//dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs dam bskang //thugasadamabaskang ba'i rdzas mchog ni//bdud lug nag po spyi dkar dang //mkha' ldinganag po gser mig dang /bdud rtsi rnam lnga sbyar ba dang //dmarachen khragagorgya mtsho dang //dpa' bo chang gis ra ro dang //sman rnams sbyar ba'i rilabu dang //—75

rin wo sna lnga'i phye ma dang //zhal zas tshogs kyi mardzo pa dang /jigapo'i bsgos bu zur gsum dang /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang //daramatshon snalnga'i mar pa dang //sna rdzos rol mo'i sgra dbyangs 'dis//dpalasi mgon po 'khor bcas mchod//dges pa'i dam rdzas mchod pa 'dig/dpalaldan mgon po'i thugs dam bskang //nyams chagasaci bgyis bzod parabasgo/sngar byas legs pa'i btang rag gtong //da bcol legs pa'i gseraskyemasa'adren//dam rdzas gser skyems mchod pa 'dis//dpal ldan mgon po zhanarabacas kyi//thugs dam gnyon po bskang bar bgyi//sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir//chosaskyong mgon po'i thugs dam bskang //rgyal ba'i wen las bsgrub pa'i phyir//legs ldan nag po'i lha min dmag tshogasagayulabazlog phyir/lha wo dpal 'bar dam li gawo por srungaba'i phyir/rnala'abyor dgra lha'i bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub pa'i phyir//rig 'dzin bsrungama'i lamyur mgyogs cho phrul r+sā pa'i phyir//pho nya las mag 'os yon mchod pa rnam lnga dang //dza gad bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang //la du laphugadzamabu ti//sha khrag dmar gyi gtor chen dang //dgra bgegs rnam gnyisabasgralab yi//don snying nang khrol dbang po lnga//rus pa rkang klad i bu dang//byas mda' dang dar nag 'phan/gri rgod snying dang lug nag sogs//chogasakyi mgo pa rgya wo 'dis//mardzo do mgon po 'khor bcas mar//3ngangothugs dam gnyan po bskang /bh+yoḥdus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyiyum//ekadza ṭi'i thugs dam bskang //dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas la//thugasadam—76—

bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni/ /gtor chen sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan/ /midabanga'abras bu smin pa'i sha /shing lo sa la ma lhung dang / /bya mo nag molasogasate//'dod pa'i dam rdzas dpag med kyis/ /mchod do 'dod khams dbang mo mchod//bskang ngo lha mo'i thugs dam bskang / /dgra bgegs gnas nas 'gugasapa'i phyir/ /pho nya rnams kyi dgra bgegs zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir/ /gnamolcags khyung gi dgra bgegs sha la rol ba'i phyir/ /bya nagatshogasakyi dgra khrag skom du 'thung ba'i phyir khyi nag tshogs kyis dgra bgegs srogartsagacod pa'i phyir/ /mi nag tshogs kyis dgra bo'i bla phyir 'gyed pa'i phyir/lcags spyang sngon mos khyod kyi mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni/ /bza' ba sha yiribo la/ /btung ba khrag gi rgya mtshor bskyil/ /dri bsur dud pa sprin du 'khrigag /nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa 'dis/ /pho nya las mkhan thugs dam bskang / /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las bzhis/ /ji ltar bcol bzhin grub par mdzod/ /hūṃ dpalaldan mgon po 'khor bcas kyi/ /gzhan yang dgyes pa'i mchod pa ni/ /ri rab gling bzhi gling phran bcas/ /ri bdun rol ba'i mtsho bdun dang / /rin chen bdun dang rin chen gter/ /skye 'gro sems can sna tshogs bkod/ khyung chen glang po ma he rta/ /gser g.yu mutigabyi rushel/ /darazab gos dang 'bras bu'i tshogs/ /mi zad longs spyod gter dang ldan/ /bzhes shig thugs skem stong bar mdzod/ /bstan pa gnyan po bsrungab dang / /bsgrub pa'i bar chad sel ba dang / /rkyen ngan thod gtong med paramachod/ /hūṃ lha chen dpal 'bar mthu ma chung / /ma mo mkha' 'gro bang ma bul/ /pho nya —77—

las mkhan rtsal ma zhan/ /dpal 'bar mahā kā la ni/ khram kha sgyur ba'i mthu bo che/ /bdud kha bsgyur ba'i nga ro can/ /do nub bzlog bsgyuradusalabab/ khrid pa'i khram kha da bsgyur cig/lha 'dre'i dmag sna dgra la cadas/ /gzhan gyibasamasbyor ngan pa dang / /byad kha phur kha gtong ba bzlog /tshe zor yungasazoraphen pa bzlog /khrung r+ya thod zor gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskorapa spyod kyi khram kha ston pa ma mo'i khrag zor 'phen pa klu yi byad du bcugapa thobrangabasris la rku ba mu stegs bar chad byed pa rgyal po'i spyo 'bog gtorabaḥ ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bsti ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu rmi lamangan dang mtshan ltas sdig /nad rims gzhi brgya rtsa bzhing lo skeg zla sgeg zhagaskeg drangahrengagaza'i ki rkaḥ zhang zhung rtso mar 'phen pa sum pa'i glang zora'aphen pa ban dhe'i sngags zor 'phen pa bon po'i rta zor 'phen pa skyes pa'i ga' zora'aphen pa bud med dmod zor ཿ rlung gi gshed bzhi mchis pa dang / /mortsisangan pa thams cadaḥ mkha' 'gro ma dang ro langs dang / /rgyal srin bar chad byed pa de la sogs pa'i gdug semasarnams/ /thams cad sdangaba'i dgra labh+yoḥ /thams cad rbod gtong steng du bh+yoḥ /srin po'i gzugs kyi nag po mre /das mchog gsum gyi srung ma khyod/ /sngon gyi dam bcas bzhin du gyis/ /snyigasama'i dus 'dir gnod byed pa/ /'di dag bstan pa'i dgra bo ste/ kha'akhāhi dgra larol/ /grohā grihā dgra bo bzung / /ban+ta ban+ta dgra bo chings/ /ha na ha na dgralargyob/ /da ha da ha dgra bo bsregs/ /pa tsa pa tsa dgra bo tshos/ /di na tshesadagra bo sgrol/ /ma ra ma ra dgra bo bsod/ khrag gi rgyun yang 'thungabaragyis/ /dam—78—

nyams dgra ni myur du sgrol/ /rus pa klad pa nang khrol zo/ /til 'brutsasayangamed par gyis/ /nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas/ /dus la bab po 'phrin lasamadzod/ /bdagagis bcol ba'i las rnams ni/ /da lta nyid du grub par mdzod//rgyal chen rnam sras kyi bskang ba ni/ bskang rdzas byin rlabs gong bzhin byas la/'di skad ces gyer ro/ /hūṃ be+e/ rin chen mang sprul rgyal po chen po ste/ /bdemadzad srid gsum 'phongs dang rgud pa las/ /myur skyob dpal 'bar bkra shis bde sterab/ mgon po dngos grub gter mdzod thugs dam bskang / /gosaston lungathara'aphreng ba cang shes rta/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang gter bum dpag bsasashing/ /gsang chen bris sku bltams pas thugs dam bskang / /don dam spros bralaskye 'gag gnas gsum bral/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang rgyal po chen po yang / /tinga'adzen 'ja' tshon lta bur dus kun spyod/ /lta spyod sgom pa bzang pos thugs dmabaskang / /gsang sngags bsnyen sgrub thun mong khyad par dang / /sku dngagasungathugs spyi dang bye brag gi /dam tshig gtsang ma dag pa ci mchis pag /mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / /rtag gtor rgyun gtor dus gtoraganyan po dang / /mchod pa lnga dang 'dod yon rnam lnga dang / /rin chen bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyis/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dmabaskang / /nas 'bras gro sran til dang 'bras bu'i tshogs/ /dza ti guragumagapur tsan+dan dang / /gla rtsi dri lnga 'bras bu lnga dang ni/ /bya gri seng gri ha sade ba dang / /gaṇ+ḍi ka dang sman mchog rnam lnga dang / /chu yi snying po lan rnartsithogadang//shing thog sbrang rtsi til mar bu ram bcas/ /sman lnga snying po lnga yis thugasadam—79

bskang / /lus 'phags po dang 'dzam gling ba glang spyod/ /sgra mi snyan dngaglingaphran brgyad po yang / /ri rab nyi zla kun bzang mchod pas spras/ /mgon po'akhor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam gnyan po dbyingasasubaskong gyur cig /bdag cag sgrub pa po la dngos sgrub stsol/ /be+e/ mgon po gnas bsrungs 'khor bcas la/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin las byung ba'i/ /kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /mchod yon zhabs gsil me tog spos/ /mar me dri bzang zhal zasamachog /zag med bde bskyed nyer spyod rnams/ /'jig rten mtha' dag bkang nasa'abul/ /pi waṃ gling bu zangs dung dang / /dung dang rdza rnga rnga bo che/ /rol mo'i khyad par stong phrag bcu/ /snyan pa sgra yis rab tu mchod/ /dge ba'i stobasalasa'akhrungs pa yi/ /dpag bsam shing las byung gyur pa/ /lha rdzas yo byad malusarnams/ /blo yis blangs nas 'bul bar bgyi/ /'khor lo la sogasarin chen bdun/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /gdugs sogs bkra shisabargyad po yang / /gnas bsrungs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /gzugasasogs 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /ral gri la sogs grub pa'i rdzag khris pa nyi shu rtsa bdun yang / /rgyal r+pā thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir 'bul/ /datan mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / /gsang sngags rig sngags mthustobasadang/ /chos dbyings rnam dag byin rlabasakyis/ /gtor ma 'di ni lha rdzasakhri /bdud rtsi la sogs longs spyod kyis/ /zag med bde ba bskyed nus pa'i/ /ngal bsos 'khor bcas spyan lam du/ /nam mkha' gang bar 'byung gyur cig khyed la—80

bkres pa mi mnga' yang //zag med bde ba rgyas pa'i rgyu//rnal 'byor bdag gi don slad du//dmigs med tshul gyis bzhes su gsol//lha min g.yulalasargyal byed pa'i//nor bu'i tog 'bar ba dan g.yo//rgyal mtshan 'di'abulabadud dpung gi/dgra las rgyal bar mdzad du gsol//rin chen bdun lasagrub pa'i gzhal med khang //sna tshogs na bza'i khyad par mtha' yasapakhadog mdzes pa'i rgyan 'phreng du ma dang //rta mchog rin wo lta bu 'di dbazhi//dkar ser dmar dang 'tshal lu zhur yod dang //ngang pa 'ol pa la sogasasnatshogs 'di//rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi//'dod 'jo'i ba dang nor bu dpag bsam shing //bum bzang ma rmos 'brungs pa'i lo thogadang/khrus rdzing sman ljongs skyes mos tshal la sogs//mchod rdzasayid 'ong posasacad 'bul bar bgyi//shol chen g.yag 'di khyed la 'bul bar bgyi//lugagi khyu 'di'ang khyed kyi 'brog tu 'bul/sru brtan mdzes pa'i go cha sna tshogasa'adi//mi shigs rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul//'khrul 'khor mda' dngastobs wo me mda' dang //'bigs byed mdung dang gcod byed 'khor lo dang //'phang mdung la sogs sna tshogs mtshon cha rnams//ye shes mchogatubyin gyis brlabs nas 'bul//rin chen rgyu las mkhas pas legs sbyangasashing //rno ngar rtsal dang ldan pa'i ral gri 'di//rgyal r+pā 'boradangasalala'abul bar bgyi//bstan pa'i dgra rnams gshom phyir bzhes su gsol//gser dngul gos dar ja ras stag gzig dang //snam bu sha mar ka ra bu rasadang //spyan gzigasayo byad rnam pa sna tshogs kyang //rgyal wo 'khoradang—81—

bcas la 'bul bar bgyi/ /mgon po khyed la 'phongs pa mi mnga' yang/ /bdag sogs sems can rnamasakyi don slad du/ /bzhes nas 'gro ba'i 'os don sgrub pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ /dgu pa bshags pa la/ dpalamagon po 'khor bcas kyi bshags pa ni/ dpalaldan mgon po 'khor bcas la/ /zhu zhing gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /bdagazhi lasadanganyon mongs dang / /mi shes pa las bag med dang / /ma gus snyomasalasadabangagyur pas/ /rang bzhin dang ni bcas pa yi/ kha na ma tho bgyisapa dang/ /dmatshig mi ldan tshogs 'dresadang / /spyod lam gcig tu gyur pa dang / /bsnyen pa sgrub la ma brtson dang / /srung ma khyad par can rnams khyed/ /dus su ma mchod ma gsol ba'i/ /dbang gi sku gsung thugs rnams kyi/ /dam tshig nyamasachagasagyur pa yi/ khyed rnams thugs dang 'gal gyur pa/ /thamasacad sprosamed mirtog pa'i/ /dbyings nas mthu stobs thugs rje yis/ /dbang phyug dmapa khyed rnams la/ /mthol zhing bshags so bzod par gsol/ /mkha' la sprin ni dengs pa dang / /rgya mtsho'i rlabs ni zhi ba ltar/ /nongs dang chagasanyamasamed gyur cig /zhi zhing rab tu zhi gyur cig /sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis//byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod gtor dang / /rta mchog rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang//tshogs kyi 'khor lo bcas pa 'di/ /dpal mgon khyad par can rnamasakyi/ khyed kyi thugs dam bskongs gyur cig /bzhed 'grub re ba rdzogs gyur cig /de ltar gyur nas bdag cag gi /sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang / /'phralagyi rkyen lasagyur pa yi/ /nad dang bar du gcod pa kun/ /thams cad bzlog paramadzad du —82

gsol//tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang //dbang phyug dam pa thamasacad kun//phun sum tshogs par mdzad du gsol//'jig rten 'jigarten 'dasapa yi//dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/khyed thugs gsang ba dmapa'i mdzod//dgyes pa wo po'i sgo phye nas//dngos grub byin sasa'adu rtsiyi//char gyis bdag rgyud gtams par mdzod//bh+yoḥ'agro ba'i don du skumachoga'ajigs pa las//nga rgyal dregs pa mtha' dag 'dul mdzad cing //malusagasal bar khyab par mdzad pa yi//yon tan rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tsharalo//'da' dka' dam tshig gtan nas gnyer mdzad pa//spyi dang dam tshig lhagapa'i dam tshig dang //bsrung bar dam bcas sku'i dam tshig rnams//dmabacasabaka' las 'da' rgyu ma lags na//sku'i dam tshig tshul bcin ma brtagasatekhams gsum khyab pa'i sku la bzod par gsol//hūṃ rnal 'byor bdag cana'adir 'dus gdung sob rnams//spyi dang khyad par dam tshig mi gtong yang//klong du ma gyur rtsal shugs chung ba dang //'du shes chung ba'i skyon rnams ci mchos pa//ma gcig lha mo'i sku la bzod par gsol//hūṃ thugs rjesangesapar gzigs pa'i lha mo la//dam rdzas tshang ba'i mchod pa ma bshamasate//phangs sems dbang gis mchod pa'i rgyu chung ba//rdzong mo dka' bzlog skulabazod par gsol//hūṃ bu yi tshul gyis rgyun gyi dam tshig las//leloganyid dang bre mo gtam la sogs//thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa ci mchis pa//thugs rje chen pos tshangs par stsal du gsol//hūṃ rnal 'byor gang zhig dmatshig 'dzin pa rnams//ma yi tshul du thams cad bsrung ba dang //zhe sdangagadug—83—

pa'i dgra bgegasagang byung bar/ /ma gcig thugs rje ldan pa der 'byungazhing//drag shul dbang dang mthon spyod 'phrin las kyis/ /ji ltar mtshams pa bzhin du 'phrin las mdzod/ /de nas rgyalar+sā rnam sras la shags pa 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ rdo rje 'chang dang phyagan rdorje dang / /i kyi rdo rje 'gro bzang snying po dang / /rin chen rdo rje khache das pa ba/ /zangs dkar lo tsā g.yor po jo ston dang / /bu cer bsod rin 'ad pu pad+ma pa/ /stag pa jo bzang khro phu lo tsā ba/ /byang chub dpal dngagatsangapa dbangaphyug grags/ /mkhas pa byang grags mkhan chen dwangs ma ba/ /dusagasumasangs rgyas kun mkhyen jo nang ba/ /ra ston rin rgyam k+shi ston rin chen dpal//bsod namasagragasadapal bsod nams rin chen dang / /rgyal ba phyag na kun dga' blo gros dang / /kun dga' rgyal mtshan byang chub dpal ldan dang/ shesarab don grub rab 'byams chos rin dang / /chosakyi seng ge sangs rgyas yeshesadang / /byams pa lhun grub rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /brgyud ldan bla ma thamasacad dgongs su gsol/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad dang/ /gzebarjid mtha' yas rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /'khor bcas brtse bsabadagaladagongs su gsol/ /rgyal po khyod kyi sku gsung thugs dang ni/ /spang dngablangaba'i dam tshig bsrung mtshams las/ /rnal 'byor mi brtson dbang gis 'dasasrid na/ /bzod par bzhes shing bu bzhin skyang du gsol/ /dang po spangabarabya ba'i dam tshig las/ /ro la 'jus shing ro gos gyon pa dang / /rta nags rdzore nag bting pa dang / /zhwa nag gos nag gyon pa mthol lo bshags/ /rta bong—84

sha khrag zos shing 'thungs pa dang //yug mos sbyar ba'i kha zas zosapa dang//gas shing chag pa'i nang du ltosas pa//rgyal wo go kyi sku la bzod paragasol//dang du blang ba'i dam tshig las 'das te//bsnyen pa mthengasagand la bor ba dang //sbyin pa ma bto 'dod wo nor blangs dang //dusasutshang gtor ma byas mthol lo bshags/khyed kyi rten mchog 'chang bar dam bcasanas//phyi nang gsang ba'i rten gsum ma rnyed dang //bced (〈lirnyed )kyang lus la ma bcangs bral ba dang //lung thang 'phreng ba ma bgrang mtholalobashags//mdor na chos skyong khyed kyi dam tshig dang //'gal zhinganyamasaparagyur pa ci mchis pa//gnod sbyin khyed la bzod par gsol lagasakyig/tshangs par stsal nas sgrub mchog bskyang du gsol//rgyal chen rnam mang thosadang nor mang ldan//gser ri lhun po lta bur brjid chags pazhi/i bralanyi ma stong gi gzi ldan pa//'dod dgu'i char 'bebs de la phyag 'tshalalko/mkha' khyab yid thong lha rdzas dngos kun dang //bka' 'bangs bran slad rangalus nyer sdogs bcas//ma chags ma zhum zab dang gyoche'i phyir//dgongasachen sgrub phyir dge tshogs rgya mtshos mchod//rang gi rgyu sngon ma bsags 'brasa'adod dang //don med don log cung zad don gyi phyir//ha cang 'dod wo bskyed dang chog mi shes/ /bsam sbyor nongs pa gang bgyis mthol lo bshags//lha klu mi rnams 'jigs dang 'phongs pa las//myur skyob 'jigarten skyong rgyal 'jig rten las//kun bsgral kun la phan phyir bde sterab//'phrin las rgyun chad med la rjes yi rang//sna tshogs ya nga 'jigs dngamagon — —85

med dang //sdig sdug brel 'phongs rgyal gzir skal ngan rnams//dbugasadabyung slad du thugs gsung sku mchog dang //nyi zla ne'u le rgyal mtshan rnamarolasku/khyod sku khrodang 'dzum dang brjid mdzes 'gyid//sgeg dul brtan lobogadapa' bo'i gar dgu yis//mi bsrun tshar gcod skal ldan rjes 'dzen phyir//bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' bdag gsol 'debs//de ltar 'gro skyob khyod la 'gro brten slad//lha mchog lhag pa'i lhar bzung dbang bskurabag/bdag sogs mgon med mgon mdzad rtag tu yang //shes rab thugs rjesami bsnyel mi gtong shog /bcu pa bstod pa las/dang po yi dam 'khor dang thos pa la bstod pa ni/zhugangathugs mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang //thugs rje chen pos gdug pa'i tshogs 'dul phyir//rab khros 'jigs su rung ba'i skur ston pa/khrobo'i dbangapo rdo rje shugs la 'dud//'jigs dus bskal pa'i me ltar rab 'bar zhing//'byung po'i dbang po zhabs kyi 'og tu brdzis/khro rgyal rnams la so sorabaga' stsol ba//nyi ma bye ba'i 'od ldan khyod la 'dud//steng dang 'ogagobagegasaca 'joms mdzad pa//gtsug gtor gnod mdzes rgyal po ljang sngon sres/'jigs pa'i mtshon chas bdud rnams phye mar rlog/ha ha'i gad rgyang can laphyag 'tshal lo//shar dang shar lhor bdud kyi tshogasa'ajoms pa//bgegasadagra dbyug pa sngon po 'jigs pa'i gzugs//char sprin mdog can ljagasa'adril mche ba gtsigs//sdang mig me ltar 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo//lho dngabaden bral mtshams su bgegs 'joms pa//rmugs byed 'dod pa'i rgyalapo—86

mer ltar 'bar//skad cig tsam gyis bgegs kun thal bar bzlog/mizad nyi ma'i gzi la phyag 'tshal lo//byang dang dbang ldan mtshams su gnas pa'i bgegs//ma lus rtsad nas gcod mdzad khrobo'i rgyal//pad+ma mtharabyed rab brjed mi g.yo mgon//gangs ri lta bur brjid la phyag 'tshal gozhub dang rlung du bgegs kun tshar gcod pa//gshin rje mthar byed khro rgyal stobasapo che//gser gyi ri ltar rab brjid 'jigs pa'i sku//'od stong 'baraba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo//zad par stong pa rlung me chu sa yi/rnala'abyoragrub pa gzugs dang gzugs med gzhan//sems la dbang bsgyur snang ba rgyasamadzad pa/khams lnga grub pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo//tshangs pa khyab 'jugabaden bral rlung golha//gshin rje me lha rgya mtshodabang ldan dang //khangapoganod sbyin mtshon cha bzhon par ldan//phyogs bcu skyong mdzad gzhan laphyaga'atshal lo//sgra gcan dus me zla ba nyi ma dang //zla skyes bkra shisadakurapo lha yi bla//ke tu nyi ma'i bu can gzi brjid che//mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul ldan laphyaga'atshal lo//klu rgyal rgyal ba rnam rgyal stobs kyi rgyu//pad+ma nor rgyasadungaskyongamatha' yas dang //rigs ldan 'jog po dang ni pad+ma che//mthu ldan kluchen gzhan la 'byung po'i tshogs gzhan ro langs grul bum che//mi'am tsidangade bzhin skyes bu'am ci//dri za 'byung po srin po yi dwags che//brjed byed mkha' lding mchog la klu dang 'byung po sogs dang /sde drug bsrung ma drugacuzhaborabacas rnams//'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/sbyangs spel sbar ba'i gtor maḥbadud rtsir bsgrub pa'i mgo pa phyi nang g.yagasaḥ—87—

bdag cag mardzo gi dngos grub thob pa'i phyir//rdo rje bzhi yi rnal loramathar phyin zhing //bcu drug bzhi yi rab dbye bskyed rim dang //rigasasngagasabazlas pa'i mthu yang grub par mdzod//ral gri la sogs dngos grub phra modang //'dod dang gzugs khams rig 'dzin dngos grub dang //'gyuramed phyag rgya wo po'i dngos grub rnams//tshe 'di ṣ+ka la 'grub pa'i sdong grogasamadzod//zhi rgyas la sogs dge ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//dbang dgugalasogs gang 'dul sbyor ba dang //bsad bskrad zengs sogs drag po'i 'phrin las kyis//gdul dka' 'dul ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol//rgyalaba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang //'gro kun 'dod dang thar pa'i sa la'agod//bdag cag dus 'dir gegs med bde skyid 'phel//chos spyod yar ngo bzhin du 'phel bar mdzod//de nas bka' bsrungs rnams las thog mar mgon po 'khor dang bos pa la bstod de/hūṃsngon tshe bde gshegs pho brang spyan snga mā/bstan pa bsrung phyir nag po wo po la//rjes mthun 'phrin las khyad par gang bsgo ba//dam bcas 'phrin lasamadzad la phyag 'tshal lo//mgon po'i bka' nyan 'khor gyi tshul 'dzin zhing//gdug pa 'dul phyir mi bzad gzugs 'chang ba//byams dang snying rjesa'agro ba'i don mdzad pa'i//nag po wo po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//bstanalas dga' mthu stobasabasam mi khyab//dbon mchog gsum la gnod byed tsharagacod cing //rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍi phyag gi dbus na bsnams//nagapo chen po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo//rgyu ma mi 'amago 'phreng ba'i do shal 'dzin//g.yasapa'i phyag—88—

gis zangs gri rnon po bsnams/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na thod pa khrag bkanga'adzin//nag po chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon tshe bde gshegs spyan sngar khasablangs te/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro la phan gdags phyir/ /dam bcasami'ada' dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /gsol gdab las mdzad bdag don yongasardzogs mdzod/ /hūṃ gang gi thugs ni dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /dpal chen gas po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod sku lhun poltaburak+ṣe brjid cing / /mi 'gyur nam mkha'i mdangs ltar shin tu mdzes/ /chosaskude bzhin nyid du gcig pa'i dbu/ /bden gnyis zab mo'i don ston phyag dang zhabs/ /skyon drug gcod phyir bdud sde'i dpung 'joms phyir/ /g.yasapa'i phyag gi gri gug thugs gar 'dzin/ /'dod khro rmongs spangs g.yon pa'i phyagagis ni/ /gdug pa'i khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa 'dzin/ /chos sgra chen posabadud kyi klad 'gems phyir/ /rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍi phyag gi dbus na bsnachag /debazhin gshegs pa lnga ni rnam dag pas/ /mi rmogo skam po lnga yi dbu rgyan can//ā li kā li lnga bcu dag pas na/ /gdug pa'i mgo rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'dzin/ /gzung 'dzin rab spangs stag gi sham thabs can/ /klu chen dbangadu bsdus pas sprul gyis brgyan/ /rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis rab tusgog /bdud sdodapung bcas ma lus 'joms pas dpa'/ khroganyer mche ba rab gtsigs mi sdug pa/ /sna tshogos sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gangagi gsungani nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa/ /ha ha hi hi la sogs rab tu bzhad/ /zlakli—89

phaṭa phaṭa la sogs drag shul sgras//log 'dren tshogs rnams ma lus skragamadzod pa//dpa' bo'i gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong sgra//shin tu waṃgasatsosgrog mdzad de la 'dud/khyod kyi thugs ni spros las rnam grol yang//snyingarje'i dbang gis 'gro ba kun la gzigs//skad cig gis ni khams gsum malusapa//za bar nus pa'i rngam pa mchog dang ldan//de lta'i sprul pa snatshogasarab ston yang //rang bzhin chos sku nyer zhi thugs la 'dud//dpa' bo sgri kyisathub pa'i bstan pa mchog/rab tu bskyang phyir log 'dren 'dul ba dang//gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugasapa'i//lam la gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa skyongs//bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi//rmi lamaltasasdigaskal ba ngan pa dang //rang dang gdon dang dus min 'chi la sogag/mimathun phyogs kun zhi bar mdzad du gsol//bdag dang bdag la phan par gangasems pa//de dag kun gyi tshe dang bsod nams dang //'khor dnga'ongasaspyod phun sum tshogs rnams kun//rtag tu mi nyams rgyas par mdzad du gsol//lha dang mi dang klu dang gnod sbyin sogs//'gro ba kun gyi gdug pa'i semasazhi nas//thamasacad bdag gi dbang du gyur nas kyang //theg chen bstan pa'isnod du 'gyur bar mdzod//gang zhig zhi bas 'dul bar mi nus pa//gdugacing sdang ba'i sems dang rab ldan pas//bla ma dam pa'i sku la bsdob dang//sems can rnams 'tshe sangs rgyasabastan la gnod//rnal 'byor rdo rje 'dzen pa bdag cag gi/dge la bar du gcod par byed pa yi//gdon dngalogapara'adren pa'i tshogs rnams kun//gas po khyod kyi mngon spyod lasakyisani//—90
