bskrad gzir bcings shing rengs par byed pa dang / /rmugs shing dran pa nyamasapar byed pa dang / /de yi lus ngag yid kyi rdzu 'phrul dang / /mthu dang longasaspyod bsod nams dbang phyug dang / /skad cig gcig gis thams cad rab nyams te/ /'du ba rnams bzhi'i nad kyis gzir nas kyang / kha nasakhongakhragadron mo rab skyugs nas/ /da lta nyid du bskrad cing bsgral bar gyis/ /bdagagis bskul ba'i las 'di ma bsgrubs na/ /sngon tshe bde bar gshegs pa'i spyan snga sa /thub pa'i bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa/ /dam bcasatsamade dusalas ma 'da' zhig /hūṃ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i/ /hūṃlasabyungaba'i nag po che/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs gad mo sgrogs/ /'jigasabyed khyod la mngon par bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun la bsnyen bkur brtags/ /mgul la thod pa'i 'phreng bas brgyan/ /dgra bgegs ma lus tshar gakhyod pazhi/mgon po khyod la mngon par bstod/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba ni/ /mkhyen gsal dbyings su gcig pa dang / /thung zhing sbom la brjid pa'i sku/ /thugs rjes sdang mig gzigs la 'dud/ /dbu skra khams nag gyen du 'bar/ /thugs rjes zhi khro phyogs bcur 'phro/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug g.yas/ /g.yon pas ban+ta khrag bkang 'dzin/ /sha chen lnga dang sman lngas bgang/ /dugagasum ma lus zhal du gsol/ /dgra bgegs thams cad sgrol byed pazhi /sku gsum srin po'i gzugs 'dzin bstod/ /'od zer dug lnga bsreg pa'i me/ khroganyer smin ma rab bskyod cing / /ljags 'dril khros pas 'phrin lasamadzad/ /hūṃ sgrog phaṭa spro khyod la bstod/ /mchogatsigs lce las me stag 'phro/ /brkyang—91—

bskum 'ur sgra thug chom gyis//srid gsum zhing khams ma lus g.yo//thugasarjes 'gro don mdzad la 'dud//gas wo khro bo mang 'phro ba//'gran zla r+sā pa'i mche ba las//'phrin las sprul pa lhun gyisagrub/khams gsumakun 'dul khyod la bstod//phra min tshogs rnamasaskrag byed pa'i//ha ha cherasgrogagatum la bzhad//zhal nas khrag rgyun 'dzag pa ste//dkon mchogagasusaskyongakhyod la bstod//bla ma dang ni theg chen dang //sems can rnams la'atsho byed pa//de dag khyod kyi maphro spyod kyis//skad cig wo la brlag par mdzod//yum e ka dza ti la bstod pa ni/bh+yoḥkun tu bzang mo'i rig pa lag/mgayos u ma de wa'i sku//ma mo thams cad bskyed mdzad ma//yumachen khyod lamangon par bstod//thugs rje mi 'gyur sku mdog nag/ye shes sku gartsega'agying zhing khro//g.yu yi ral pas srid gsum sgrol//snyan gnyis 'gro drugagasol 'debs gsan/khangs nas rlung sgrom bag chags 'joms//skyeshi rtsad gcod mche ba gtsigs//spyan gsum 'gro la gzigs shing bayid//tharapa'i lam ston gsung dbyangs snyan//thabs dang shes rab phyag gnyis kyig/g.yu'i bum pa thugs gar 'dzin//tshe 'dzin bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis /skye 'gro gso ba'i yum gcig ma//e ka dza ṭi dpal ldan ma/yumachen khyod laphyag 'tshal bstod//ces pas yum labastod//lha mo 'dod khams ma la snyod pa ni/hūṃ bh+yoḥdapal ldan lha momi phamasrid gsum bdag/rang don sgrub phyir rnam thar gsum gzhol yang //snyingarje'i dbang gis rjesal thob pa yis/khres rab sna tshogasabadag gis 'gro don —92—

mdzad//dpalaldan lha mo'i sku mdog char sprin mdog/mtshan monagamoshin tu gtum pa'i gzugs/khren tu rid cing keng rus gzugs can ma//zhalagacig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis brjid pa'i sku//ral ba gyen 'greng lan bu thuradu 'byil//skra gseb sprul dang thod pa'i phreng thod can//rna ltagatshetogadaranag cod pan can/khrag gi chang gis ra ro spyan rtsa dmar//mi ro rid pa kharabacug mche ba bzhi//rnam par gtsigs shing khrag la shin tu dgeg/snyan g.yas sprul gyi mgul nas dril bu gsil//gdug pa btul nas tshangasapa'i sgrasgrog ma/(〈rdza〉 /snyan cha g.yon na seng ge'i ral ba dmar//dpa' mo khams gsum seng ge'i sgra sgrog ma/)/phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang po ral gri 'dzin//'og ma dung wo rak+ta dmar 'khyil 'dzin//g.yon gyi dang po shasnyi mtshon cha 'dzin//'og ma tri shu mgul nasadar dpyangs 'dzin//sha: ral gri mtshon gyisabacad pa yi//lha mayin gyi mgo sogs do shal byas//glang po che yi lkotho r+sā g.yogs byas//smad ni ba glang ko rlon dras pa la//phyed ni re zheserapo'i shamabus dkris/ci/klu'i dbang po gzhibs pa'i sked chingasacan//zhabasaganyesalcags sgrog mdzes pa dag gis brgyan/khrag dang zhag gothig le tshom burabris//bong bu gwa wo mas mo dur ṅga rgyu//bong bu'i rmig pa glogagi shun (gshog )pa can/khams gsum skad cig tsam gyis bskor b.rabyed//skad ni dung dang 'brug gi sgra ltar sgrog/mkha' 'gro ma mo sha za dbang du bsdug/dmapa'i sa nas gzugs sku gnyis 'dzin zhing //ting 'dzin dbang thob gakhugasakyi khams su byon//tshangs pa'i rgyal po la sogs phyag byas ma//g.yin ladabang—93

bsgyur 'dod khams mthar phyin ma/ /dbang phyug chen po'i sku la dges para'akhril/ /sum cu rtsa gsum tshal du byon pa'i tshe/ /lha rnams dbugasa'abyin brgyabyin phyag byas ma/ /lha mayin rnams phung bar byed pa'i tshe/ /lha rin dbangapo rnams kyis phyag byas ma/ /sku mchog ri rab rtse dang 'gran pa'i tshe/ /lte ba'i thad ga'i phyogs nas nyi zla 'char/ /rgyal chen bzhi sogs lha rnams phyagabyasam/ /rgya mtsho'i gting nas me 'bar mtsho skem ma/ /sa 'og dbang po rnams kyisaphyagabyas ma/ /lha mokhyod kyi cho 'phrul 'di bstan pa/ /bdud dang gos rje'i chogasarnamasa'adar zhing 'dud/ /ma mo srin po'i tshogs rnams rngam zhing cad/ /dmasri'i tshogs rnams 'dar zhing dam la 'dud/ /tsit+ta rin chen gur phub gzhalayas nas/ /nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor brtsegasapa'i ga'u 'bar/ /phyogasabs 'jig rten bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus nas/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag lathimamadzad ma/ /bdud rtsi'i rlangs pas dkar po'i phyogasarnams kyis/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams gcod mdzad ma/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyal mo dam la 'dud/gang zhig khyod la dad rnams ma bas byams/ /de phyir ma zhig nad bdagasman gyigatso/ /bdud rtsi'i lha mo khyod la rtag tu bstod/ rgyalab shākya thub pa'i spyan snga mā/bdag gis deng nas 'khor ba ji srid bar/ /dkar po'i phyogasakyi nad dngasdug bsngal sogs/ /zhi bar bya zhing tshe dag bsod nams spel/ /nagapo'i phyogs rnams dgug cing dam la 'dud/ smyo 'bog bsad bskrad la sogasa'aphrin las kyis/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las rnamasamyur sgrub bgyi/ /'di lasa'adas na rgyal ba'i bka' bslus pas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rdo rjes mgo— —94

'gems so/ /de skad rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs pas/ khas blangasabazhin du dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /dam bcas bzhin du 'phrin las myur sgrub mdzod/ /dpal ldan lha momi pham srid gsum bdag /rnal 'byor bdagadangabadag gi 'khor bcas la/ khyod kyi zhal nas bdud rtsi'i char phob la/ /nad dang sdug bsngal tshogs rnams zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod namasadabang thanga'aphel bar mdzod/ /zang zing longs spyod 'bru yi phung po dang / /lhu wo k+to'agros rnams kyang 'phel bar mdzod/ /sdang dgra gnod bgegs thams cad tshar chod la/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i lasa'adi myur du bsgrubs/ /las mgon 'khor bcas labastod pa/ pu ṭa'i sgos bstod rgyas pa ni/ gyi dpalaldan 'phrin las kun rdzogasapu ṭa khyod/ /sku mdog mthing nag me yi 'phro 'du can//rngams pa'i stabasakyi 'gying zhing shang lang bsnams/ /ging chen 'dug pa 'dulakhyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab brjid dpa' la rngams pa'i zhal gdangasashing/ /glog ltar 'gyug pa'i ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs/ /klad khrag dron mogasolazhing spyan rtsa dmar/ /ging chen gdug pa 'dul khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po'i do shal dar nag na bza' gsol/ /yon tan kun rdzogs khams gsumadagra las rgyal/ /'jigs byed chen po dpa' bo'i gar stabs kyi/ /sprulapasa'agro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lam la gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams/ /bden pa'i stobs dang dad pa'i nus mthu yis/ /gsang sngags mchog 'dzin dgra lha khyod mchod kyi/ /rje btsun bdud las rgyal ba dges paramadzod/ /bsad pa'i sha dang sbyar ba'i dza gad dang / /bsgral ba'i khrag dang dam rdzasasna—95—

tshogs kyis/ /dam rdzo can khyod mardzo kyi chos 'khor skyongs//blta pa bsrung ba'i 'phrin las myur du sgrubs//so so'i bstod pa bsdus pa ni/hūṃ sngon tshe shākya seng ge'i spyan snga mā/bstan pabasrung bar zhal bzhes dam tshig can//'phrul dang mngon shesaldan pa'i stobasapo che//las mkhan 'khor dang bcas la bstod par bgyi//stobasaldan gangazhig srid pa'i byed po ste//mi bzad sngags dang mtshon cha 'khrul 'khor gyig/bdud dang mu stegs thal bar brlag mdzad pa//rab 'jigs nag po gnod sbyin khyod la bstod//sha khrag rgya mtshor rol ba'i gnod sbyin yum//dgra snyingaspar gyis 'debs pa'i rdzu 'phrul can//stong khams bdag mo srid pa'i nyulalem//nag mo 'jigs su rung ma khyod la bstod/sde brgyad kun gyi dmagadapon drag shul che//chos 'khor yongs kyi bsrung ma bgegs kyi dgra//skye'agros gyi srog la mnga' mdzad pa//las mdzad ོ po pu ṭa ṅga la ba'i//dmanyamasakun gyi gshed ma dam tshig can//'jig rten kun khyab sprul pa snatshogasa'agyed//dpa' bo yid sgyur mkhas shing glog phreng 'khrug/thog serabadagapo bha ṭa khyod la bstod//sngags kyi bsrung ma 'jig dusame ltar rno//sgri po stongagi grogs dang lhan cig rgyu//ma mo yongs la brda sbyor ral gcigam/khrin mo 'bar ma dam can khyod la bstod//ces pa'am/sa pa ladaga' na 'od dzir+sāspodagalung bu pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa rgyas pas bstod do//de zhes sgo ma'i snyod pa ni/seng ge'i gdong can so gcig srid gsumaza//lcags kyu 'dzin zhing thod rlon 'phreng ba can//seng ge stag dang bya nag mngango'i —96

tshogs/ /byams pas log 'dren 'gugs pa khyod la bstod/ /gzigagigadongacan dur khrod khrag ldag ma/ /zhags pa thod pa 'dzin zhing las labartson/ /gzig dang sbyang mo dang ni mkha' lding tshogs/ /thugs rjes legs par 'dren mdzad khyod la bstod/ /dom gyi gdong can khams gsum sal le gzigs/ /lcags sgrog sgron me bsnams pa'i mthu mo che/ /glang chen dom dang mkha' ldingasprul pa'i tshogs/ /dga' bas log pa 'dul ba khyod la bstod/ khred kyi gdongacan sde brgyad kha lo bsgyur/ /tho ba dang ni lcags kyu 'bor lo bskor/ /dred mogayag dang mkha' lding pho nya'i tshogs/ /btang snyoms chen pos don mdzad khyod la bstod/ /kun kyang ma mo mkha' 'gro nyi zla'i spyan/ /'jigs tshul tshelathabs mkhas snying rje che/ khams khams tshig tshig sha dang khrag la dganya/ /'jigs pa'i nga ro can khyod mardzo cing bstod/ /rgyal r+sā rnam thos sras 'khor bos la bstod pa ni/ rin chen pho brang dmapa na/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri steng na/ /be+e las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngalabasosadage ba stobs po che/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung dag gis bzhugs/ /g.yasan rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams/ /sku ni gser gyi 'od pas mdzes/ /zhal nas rin chen char pa 'bebag /thugasarjesa'aphongs pa las sgrol mdzad/ /rin chen rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan/ /byangaphyogs rgyal por sku yang sprul/ /rnam thos sras su mtshan yang gragag /gterabadag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbu la rin chen cod pan gsol/ /yon to rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs kyi bskor/ /sde bo tshel—97

phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan gyi dpung rnams 'joms par byed/ /stobs po tshelaphyag 'tshal lo/ /bum pa bzang pos rnam par brgyan/ /dpag bsamayidadangarin wo shing / /rdzing bu bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /gakho bdag sgo laphyaga'atshal lo/ /dzam+bha la ni gser gyi mdog /rdzu 'phrul rta'i steng na bzhugag /g.yon pa ne'u le g.yas pa na/ /rin chen bsnamasal phyag 'tshal lko /gangab bzang po sku mdog ser/ /rdzu 'phrul rta'i steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon bumapa bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ nor bu bzang po sku mdog dkar/ lju'aphrularta'isteng na bzhugs/ /g.yon pa — nor bu bsnams la phyag ku we rani skumadoganag /rdzu 'phrul rta'i steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon pa: ral gri bsnamasal yangadag shes ni sku mdog ser/ /rdzu 'phrul rta'i steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon pa /gser gri bsnams la phyag — /'brog gnas sku mdog nag po la/ rdzu 'phrul rta'i steng na bzhugs/ g.yon pa /mdungadamar bsnams la phyag lnga rtsen sku mdog ser skya la/ /rdzu 'phrul rta'i steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon pa khang ribasnams la phyag: pi tsi kuṇ+ḍalo ni dkar/ /rdzu 'phrul rta'i stengan bzhugs/ /g.yon pa ne'u le g.yas pa na/ /gri phub 'dzin laḥ klu chen brgyad nisku mdogaser/ /rin chen sprul dang gdengs gas brjid/ /phyag gnyis 'dod dgu'i chara'abebs pa'i/ /nor bu 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ shar du ring po migabazangadang / /gang po ser skya sa pa gnas/ /seng ge nye seng dung can dang/ /dga' ba shin tu sa pa lho/ /seng ge seng ge'i ral pa dang / /bla ma seraskyanagaponub/ /'dzin pa 'dzin dga' brtson skyong dang / khyab 'jug nye nag byang duzho /lnga spyod —98—

nyi ma byang shar na/me ru tshig lnga ser po zla//ri mkho tshezhi lho nub tu'o//seracan rlung ni nub byang na//gnod sbyin sde dpon nyi shu brgyad//zhalagashinaphyagaganyis 'jigs pa'i gzugs//smug nag rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan//sriphub 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo//dbang po zla ba chu zla dang //skye bdag gdosapa'i rgyal mtshan dang //dbang ldan tsan dan 'dod pa'i gtso//mgrin ldan mgulanges pa ṭi dang //nor bu nor spyod dgra rab dang //nyer lnga dang ni rimosadang //ser can gang po ser can dang //g.yon phyogs lha dang ba glangaskyong//'brog gnas mi yi rgyal po dang //rgyal ba khyu mchog tshig lnga ser//bzhin bzang dang ni ring po dang //dri za sna tshogs 'bras bu gsum//mgulagasusalcags mdung ring po dang //lha las byung ba'i ma ldan te//sa ga'i rigasalasabyung ba yis//stobs wo sum cu rtsa gnyis yin//steng 'og phyogasamatshamasabasrung zhing skyong //ljang nag gri mdung 'dzin la bstod//lha rgyaladakarapo rdorje 'dzin//klu rgyal dmar po sprul zhags bsnams//gnod sbyin ser po ne'ulebasnams//dri za dmar po rgyud mangs can//lha min sngo nagagomatshon 'dzin//mkha' lding gser mdog gshog pa rgyas//mi ci'i rgyal po rta mgog//lho'aphye sngon po sprul mgo can//lha srin sde brgyad 'khor bcas rnams//ca kyangarang mdog rgyan gyis brgyan//phyag g.yas mtshon cha sna tshogs dang //g.yon pa ne'u le 'dzin la bstod//de ltar bstod cing rab bsngags pas//bdagacana'akhor bcas bsrung ba dang //'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub pa dang//bgogasarnams ma lus med par mdzod//tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang//'khor—99

dang longasaspyod rgyas pa dang / khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba dang / /bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ /bcu gcig pa de nas las la bskulab la/ rgyun bskul dang / drag bskul gnyisalas/mgon po 'bor cas kyi thugs dam sa bskul ni/ hūṃ/ 'das dang ma byon da ltaragyi//bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /nag po khyod ni yin pa ste/ /gdug pa tshar gcod 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /ral pa nag po gyen du 'khyil/ /stengagilha tshogs 'jigs par byed/ /spyan bgrad ljags 'dril bar gyi lha gdon sdigag/g.yas kyi gri gug gnod sems can la sdigs/ /g.yon pa gdug pa'i khragabakang zhal du gsol/ /zhabs bsdabasaganod sems can gyi lus la snyed//gang zhig dkon mchog gsum smod dang / /bla ma brnyas byed semasacan 'kho /bdag gis bsgo ba kun khug la/ /ling ga 'di la myur du chug /'di yisha phrokhrag la 'thung / /rus pa klad pa nang khrol zo/ /rigs brgyud rtsad nasachod las (〈rdza〉 la ) shog /'dza' ba kun dang phrol las (〈mi la)thong / /bdag gis bsgo ba ma nyan na/ /nag po khyod ni nyamasapara'agyur/ /hūṃ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan sngar rang rang gi /srog gi snying po phul nasadamabacas pa/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das srung ma'i tshogs/ /kun gyi gtsobo dpal ldan nag po che/ /lcam bral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khoradangabacas/ /rnam 'phrul du ma hūṃ phaṭa sgra sgrog cing / /ha ha'i gang rgyang srid gsum g.yo b.rabyed/ /ru ru rozhes gdug pa'i khrag rgyun gsol/ /ma ri'i sgra 'byin bajod labartson rnams kyi/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /bstan la—100

gnod byed gdug pa'i tshogs rnams kun//dam bcas ji bzhin myur du mngon par khug/sgrihā bhan+tas bzung zhing bcings nas ni//ha na ha nas bsnun zhingardeg par gyis//pa tsa pa tsas bsregs bcad gtubs nas ni//ma ramarasamyur du bsgral pa yi//sha khrag las grub mchod gtor rgya chen 'di/khakha'ahis legs par btab pa yis//rang gi sha gcod lta bur bzlog nas ni//dam nyams snying khrag 'thung la myur du rol/kha 'jam sems rtsub rang gi phyogasa'adzin zhing //gzhan la khu byed gtor ma'i las tsam gyis//bu ltarabacosapa'i gsang ba'i dgra bo 'di//myur du tshar gcod bdag don yongasardzogasamadzod//hūṃ bh+yoḥdapal ldan mahā kā la dang //lha mo mi pham srid gsumabadag/dpalaldan mgon po lcam dral gyi//bka' nyan gnod sbyin pho mo'i gzugs/jigalarngams pa'i cha byad can//glog 'gyu ma ra'i sgra sgrog cing //dgra bgegasabamaril khrag la gzer//snying khrag 'thung zhing 'phyong zhing rgyagakha rlangasa'abarabs me stag 'phro//nyi zla 'bar ba'i spar shad kyis//don snying dusanasazhaladu gsol//thog gi ser 'bebs khyod la bstod//lcam dral bga' bstod mon po'i gzugs//las kyi mgon po ming sring las//mon bu puṭanagaposkyod//men tri'i ga zha sku la gsol//sher shing bsreg shing phyag na bsnams//pu ṭanag po khyod la bstod//mon bu bha ṭa stag slog bkra//dar gyi ga zha sku lagasol//gser gyi dam shing phyag na bsnams//bha ṭa nag pokhyod labaston//sring mo gser gyi spu gri ma//nag mo chen mo kha 'bar ma//phyagan gseragyi spu gri bsnams//bdud monag mo khyod la bstod//bka' yi dam tshigarjes—101—

mdzod//ces bskul lo//bcuganyis pa gtor rdzongs la/sngon du 'gro ba bzhags pasabani/hūṃ yon tan lhun rdzogs dngosagrub mnga' ba'i lha//ma lus m+mu byung phan bde'i dgongs pa can//'phrin las rnam bzhis bdud dpung tshar gcod bzhi/legs ldan nag po 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol//sku gsung thugs dngayon tan 'phrin las kyi//spyi dang khyad par gsang ba'i dam tshig rnams//bsrung bar dam bcas 'da' rgyu ma lagasan//bdag cag ma rig lus dang bkasems kyi//bag med tshul gyis dam la 'ga' ba rnams//srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bzod par gsol//zhes pa'o//de nas spyi btab kyi tshig gis gtor rdzongs bya ba las/dang por srung ma spyi khyab tu 'bul ba ni/hūṃ hoḥrdo rje'i 'jigs byed dus kyi 'khor lo ni//rnam 'phrul khro rgyal tshogs dang bcas pa yi//bka' nyan zad paragrub pa'i 'khor dang bcas//tshangs pa la sogs phyogs skyong 'khor dngabacas//sgragacan la sogs gza' mchog 'khor dang bcas//rnam rgyal la sogs kluchen 'khor dang bcas//ro langs la sogs 'byung po 'khor dang bcas//mas yas srid gsum rgyu ba'i sde brgyad kun//'dir gshegs mchod gtor gyochen bzhesasu gsol/khams drug dwangs ma rdo rje'i srog thob cing //b.rar ca sol 'phrin las thams cad sgrubs//dathos grub mtha' dag stsol ba'i sdongagrogasamadzod//ces phul/de nas mgon po 'bor bos kyi spyi btab ni/rgyudapalaldan mgon po mahā kā la dang //dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsumabadag/lcamadral khyod kyi bka' lasami 'da' ba'i//dur khrod bdag po'i zhing skyong 'tshadang bcas//snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/khregasapa pho brgyud —104

mo brgyud 'khor dang bcas//mkha' lding la sogs bya gcan 'khor dngabacas//pu ṭa la sogs las mkhan 'khor dang bcas//'dir gshegasargyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/dzam+bha ti ba'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shigasha/ khragadamar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/dza gad dpa' bo'i sman phud 'dibazhes shig/sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan por 'bul//da bcolalas kyi gsol 'debs gnyan por bzhes//'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang //sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs//bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po//thams cad rdul phran bzhin du rlagapar mdzod//bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di myur du sgrubs//gogyeranyidasar drag gtor dang 'brel ba'i skabs yin na/skabs 'dir yang /mahā kā la stobasapoche//zhes sogs pho nya bskul ba de byed pa'i lag len snang ngo //de nas rgyal chen rnam thos sras la 'bul ba ni/be+e/byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos srag/'khorabacasamathu stobs rdzu 'phrul ldan pa rnams//gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes sugasol//mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di dag bzhes nas kyang //bdag cana'akhorabacas ma lus thams cad la//bu gcig bzhin du rtag par skyong ba dang//bstan pa bsrung zhing dge legs kun stsal nas//bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod//bdag la gnod par sems pa dang //logaparazhugasapa'i dgra dang bgegs//de'i phru ma gzhom pa dang //gtan nas brlagapa'i 'phrin las mdzod//zhi dang rgyas dang mdzo spyod kyi//las kyi dngosagrus bdag la stsol//sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang //bcol ba'i las la mthu —103—

bskyed cig /stobs dang rdzu 'phrul che mnga' ba'i/ /gnod sbyin dbangapo 'khorabacas kyis/ /bdag gis bsam pa ma lus kun/ /myur du grub paramadzad du gsol/ /spyo gyer ro/ /de'i rjes su/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lusa'abyungaba'i gzhi/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / /de 'dzin byed pa'i skyesabu dam pa kun/ /dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan shog /bdagacag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sumatshogs/ /don rnamasathams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par re|ga /ces dge legs su gsolaba'i tshig su bcad pa ganga'os kyis gsol ba btab/ /bcu gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ slar yang mchod pa kha gsos/ sangs sbyangs byin rlabasagator chog ltar ram/ spyi mthun ltar bya/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi/ /lha rdzasabazang po'i mchod yon 'di/ /yi dam chos skyong tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhesanasabadag la mchog stsol mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra arnya pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhabasabasil/ tshetog rol mo'i bar sbyar zhing / oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥ&/ bar kyang sbyar ro/ /stongapa nyid dngasnying rje'i bdag /ces sogs dang / srin po'i gzugs kyi sogs dang / gangagoskugasum sogs dang / gdong lnga nyi zla'i gdan steng na/ /sogs sho lo ka re so god/'dod don gsol ba btab rgya cher bya/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan bdun/ ma 'byorapa dang nyams pa sogs bzod gsol man chad bkra shis kyi bar du gtor chog nas byung ba ltar bya'o/ /spyir bdag bskyed yi dam rang gang mos labyas pa chog cing / mdun bskyed yi dmadagagator ma gnas yo byin rlabs sogs/ bdag bskyed kyi rim pa dang mthun par sbyar na chog lka—106

bdag bskyed yi dam gzhan la rten nas/ mdun bskyed yi dam gzhan la'ang gtor ma 'bul du drang bas/ spyir go ba 'phrul chags pa gcig byung na/ ji ltar byas kyang ma nor bar 'gyur bar sla ba yin mod/ 'on kyang tshig don sna tshogs su 'chol bar 'gyur ba'i nyen yod pas/ lugs 'di 'dzin pa rnams kyis gong du bshad pa 'di kho na gzhung bsrang bar bya'o/ /ci ste mgon po'i bskang ba brgya tshar stong tshar sogs byed dgos pa'i tshe/ sngar gyi rgyas pade ma lcogs na/ phyis gang zag phal pas sbyar ba lasnying po med pas/ yig rnying gtum chen mar grags pa nyid bya ste/ de yang gtor ma rnams kha gsos mchod pa gsar pa re bsham thub na ragamin na yang kha gso ba dang / gtor ma la sman dang rak+tas bran/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug tingange 'dzin drug gis byin gyis brlabs te/ 'di skad ces gyer ro/ /hūṃ gtum chen nagapo lcamadral dang / /e ka dza ṭi la sogs pa/ /bka' bsdod pho nya 'khor bcasal/khyad par dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho dpag med dang/ oṃsa'i rgyan can gahor ma dang / /phyag mtshan rgyan can dmapa dang / /phyi nangagasangaba'i rten rnams kyis/ /lcam dral mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang / pu saphomo'i thugs dam bskang / /bran g.yog 'khor gyi thugs dam bskang/ /b.rachad kun sol mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /hūṃ/ dmar chen rak+ta rgya mtshor skyil/ sha rusabaza' ba riltar spungs/ /bdud rtsi'i sman gyi chu rgyun 'bab/ /mngesapa'i rgyan gyis sprin ltar gtibs/ /dam tshig can 'dus gnas mchog 'dir/ /lcam dral sogs (〈rja〉 /hūṃ/) rus pa'i rgyan drug sprul rgyan dang / /stag sham dar gyi lhab lhub dang / khrag zhag thig le zo ris dang / /dpal gyi chas brgyad lasogs pas/ /lcam dral dmigs med thugs rjes 'gro don du/ /gdugapa'i —107—

gzugs su rnam sprul zhing / /stong dang snying rje dbyer med par/ /cesaparartogasapa'i shes rab 'dis/ /lcam dral sogs/ zhes bskang ba dag arnya sogasakyimachod pa dang / srin gzugs ma'i sho lo ka dang pos bstod/ 'dod don gsolabatab shugasaldoyod pas/ logs su ma byas kyang chog par bzhed do/ /zhalabazhi pa'i bskang bshags bya bar 'dod na/ logs su 'bri ba ltar shes parabyazho /bka' srol 'di'i lugs ma nyams pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len mdzad pa/ jo nang ba yabasras kyi bka' srol la/ kun spangs chen po dpon slob gsum gyi dus/ bka' bsrungagimathilaguralcam dral nyid yin/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos de steng du rnam thos sras kyang rtsal mngon du mdzad cing / yab sras de dag gis zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa la rtsal macan pa ma byung ba ltar/ bskangabashags kyi rim pa rnams 'dir ma bkod do/ /gzhan yang chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dngaldan pa gzhan 'ga' zhig gi mchod gtor bskang bshags dkyus 'di labya bar 'dod na/ ye shesadabyings kyi mgon po'i rigs rnams lcam dral gyi rjes labya zhing / las kyi mgon po'i rigasarnams de'i rjes la bya ste/ rgyal chen rnam sras kyi sngon nam/ rjes gang rigs labya'o/ /de yangalugs 'di'i khrigs chags kyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ sgrub pa po rang nyid gcig pus byed pa'i tshe/rang gang la gtso bore byed pa de nyid thog mar byas pas chog ste/ ye shes kyi lha la don dam parabazang ngan med pa'i phyir ro/ /'jig rten pa'i srung ma'i rigs ni/ rang de lagaco bor o pa yin kyang / chog sgrigs gcig po de'i skabs la ye shes kyi lha'i sngon la byed mi rung bas/ 'byung po spyi gtor gyi gong 'og gang rung du bya'o// // zhes pa dpal jo nang ba'i bka' srol las brtsamasate/ dam can chos skyong srung ma'i mchod sprin (phrin 3rgyas pa 'phrin las rnam rolazhes bya ba 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo sum cu rtsa dgu len pa la sgrigs pa ste/ ra sa'aphrulasnang—108—

chos 'khor chen po'i gnas su sbyar ba'o//dge legs 'phel/bkra shis//༄tsho//dpal gur gyi mgon po'i dmar chen gtor bzlog gi cho ga bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so//da༅༅//chaswā sti/bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//'dir dpal nag po chenapogur gyimagon po'i gtor ma'i las tshogs las/bzlog pa gtso por gyur pa'i dmar chen gtor ma'i rigapa ni 'di yin te/yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bris sku sogs rten dgram/gtor ma lngatsharamachod pa bskong gtor sogs bshams/de dag gi mdun sogs ji ltar 'os par rdulatshon namachutshon gyis dkyil 'khor 'bri ste/dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag mtha' me ris bskoragade'i dbus su mtshon cha 'bor losngon po rtsibs drug pa/mu khyud nag po la rdo rje sngon tsho phro ba'am/thod skam gyi phreng bas bsgor/rtsibs kyi bar rnams dmar por bya/rtsibasalasalteb suma'agyur gyi che bar byed cing lte ba la re kha nyis rim 'then/de'i nang du chos 'byung gru gsum dmaranag gcig bya/de'i gru chad ljang khu yin/chos 'byung nang ma la yang me ris 'bri thub na legs/de'i dbus su nyi gdan la gri gug dang /rtsibs rnams la nyi gdan gyi steng du phyag mtshan namatshosabu nag po re 'god/dkyila'akhor gyi dbus mazhi'i steng du/lcags snod yangs par nas nagarjen btags bre lnga las mi nyung ba/tsha ba gsum dang /lcags phye zangs phye sogs brdar ba lakhrag dngachang bsres pa'i chus sbrus te/dbus su gtor ma snying gzugs ma la khyad par rtse mo rno zhing zuradod pa/'khor bshos bu gru gsum phra sang nge ba drug gis bskor ba/de rnams gtso bo'i gtor ma'i sum—109

cha tsam du sleb pa/de dag gi bar mtheb skyus bkang nas gtor snod kyi kha mtshams dang mnyamapar zan gyi mu khyud lcags ri bzhin du bskor ba/gtor ma de la gri khrag dang dug sbyar ba'i khrag gtsangams byugs//yungs gar dang /mtshe dang skyer pa sogs dug shing dang tsher ma'i rtsang khragagisabyugs pas brgyan/zan gyi mu khyud la rtsang nyi shu rtsa gcig srin mo 'gros su gzugs/gzhan yang ling chung mgo bo thur du lta bdang /mi mgo skam lho sogs 'jigs su rung ba'i sa ji ltara'os pas bas/gtor ma dang chos 'byung gnyis ga'i zur rang la mi ston par balko/de'i mdun nasaslar yang chos 'byung ngam mi lpags sogs kyi gdan la lcags sder la sogs pa'i snod du zor gtor gru gsum mar nag dug khrag gis byugs pa/ngos gsum la zan gyis 'bur dod byasate/ngos gcig la//g.yas su bh+yoḥgayon du bzlog ces pa yong ba bya/'di la'ang 'bulagator logs (〈rdza〉la sogs )pa thun gtor 'dra ba gcig kyang bshams/zor gtor de'i g.yas nas phar rim pa bzhin du skam thun rnams bsham ste/rdo nag gru gsum ladug khrag gis khramarisadang bh+yoḥbris pa bdun la sogs pa dang /de 'phen pa'i 'ur rdo skor thag ni yug skra ro skra tsos padang /'ur mthil mi lpags las byas pa sogs bzhag/lcags snod du yungs dgadonag/lcagagaphye zangs phye rdo phye ske tshe shing tshe sogs snod so sor blug pa'am gcig tu bsres la bzhag/mtshe shing khrag gis bskus pa dang /'byor na thal chen yang bsham/mda' lug sgro ma skyer ma de grugasumamade'u lasnyi bzlog bh+yoḥbris/stong la las mkhan gyi bsad sngags bris/gzhu'i mchogamagayas g.yon la rbod rbad kyi sngags bris pa'ang bsham/zor gtor gyi g.yon du gri khrag la sogs pa'i khrag sna sna tshogs la dug sna sna tshogs sbyar ba khrag thun dngos dang /khyu mchog gi rwa g.yas pa'inang du yang dug khrag blug pa rebs kha phur ba dang /dug dang chang gis sdus pa'i kong zor bdun du yang dug khrag cung zad re blu pa dang //gyo tshaladang thod tshaladu yang dug khrag blug pa/ci rigs—110

bshams/ de dag gi mdun du rak+ta'i mchod yon dbang lnga'i me tog sha rus kyis brgyan pa'i zhalazas gru gsum rkang gling sogs drag po'i mchod pa sna chogs bsham/ /sgrub pa po'i mdun nam/dmar chen gtor ma'i mdun du 'brub khung gru gsum mthing nag me ris 'bar ba'i nang du tsha ba gsum dang ske tshe gri khrag sogs sbyar ba'i bag zan laling ga bcos/ bris pa'i ling ga sngagasacan de'i snying gar bcug na bzang / de min dar dmar po'i ras ma gcig tshon skud sna lnga'am sngo dmaragyis bsdams te snying gar bcug de'i sne mo snying ga'i thad nas phyir bton te ske la se chings btagasno mo zangs kyi phur pa labatags te zor gtor la 'dzugs/ gzhan yang yo byad thams cad tshangabar bya ste/ sha dum sna tshogs dang / phud ma nyams pa dang / khrag gtsang ma sogs thog tudagos pathams cad 'dzom par bya'o/ /de dag ni de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i shoms yin la/ de'i sngon du bskang gso'i shoms thams cad tshang bar bya dgos so/ /de nas sgrub pa po rnams 'dus te/ sngon 'gro gtor ma yi dam gang byed rang rang gi cho ga'i lugs bzhin btang / de ma thag bgegs gtor yang spyi dang mthun par gtong ste cha gsum bzhin no/ /de nas gnas yo byin rlabs yi dam gyi cho ga gang yin de'i lugs bzhin du bya/ de rjes gagabaskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bar du bya'o/ /de nas mdun bskyed kyi byab laganyis las/ mdun bskyed spyi'i bya ba ni/ yi dam chos skyong gi gtor bsngo nas gzhi gagagatorama'i bar du gtor chog dkyus tsam gtong ba'am/ bskang gso dang 'brel na'ang de'i bya ba tsharagacig skabs 'dir rdzogs par byas na legs so/ /gnyis pa khyad par gyi mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa 〈(gi gisasbyabs/ lhongepa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du yi ge khaṃ lasadagra bgegs sgrol ba'i gzhal med —111—

khang mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba/ sgo med lcagasakyi mun khang rgya dang tshad yongs su chad pa med pa/ phyi rol me rlung 'tshubs shing / nang khragazhaga'akhrugasapa/ phyi nang thams cad dur khrod 'jigs su rung bas khyab pa/ de'i dbusasuzlo las byung ba'i 'khor lo nag po rtsibs drug pa/ gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ragribazhin rtse mo rno ba/ dgra bgegs thams cad mnan pa'i steng 'khor lo'i ltebarapaṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ/ lko pa nas/ dbusan bzhugasapa'o//oṃ shrīmahā kā la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'am/ spel tshig can lanagasumagyisagatso bo bskyed/ 'khor lo'i mdun gyi rtsibs la mo las e ka dzaṭi/goponas/sgrasgrogs pa'o/ /oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba to si ka ma la rak+ṣa si hūṃ bh+yoḥsnyi/ spyo pa'am de nyid spel tshig dang bcas pas yum chen dang lha mo bskyed/ gzhan yang lcam dral nas/bskor bar gyur/ lho stod kyi rtsibs la ya las nag po gnod sbyin sos/ rnamacan/ oṃ kā la yak+ṣa ye hūṃ phaṭa/ lto smad kyi rtsibs la rma las nagamoganod sbyin sogs/ lan tshar can/ okā li yak+ṣa ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ nub kyi rtsibasalatrilasabu ṭasogs/ na bza' can/ oṃ yak+ṣa pu ṭa ye hūṃ phaṭa/ byang stod kyi rtsibasal khyi(〈rdza〉dri )las bha ḍa sogs/ 'dzin zhing gsol ba/ oṃ ru ṭa bha ṭa ye hūṃ phaṭa/byang smad kyi rtsibs la bh+yoḥlas sring mo sogs/ me 'bar ba/ oṃ rulu rak+ṣabiḥphaṭa/ lnga char yang spyo pa nas/ bskor bar gyur/ a li a li mdzadza shaṃ lishi nged a shwa nged mu smugs pu ṭi a li ma dza dzaḥ nag mo sha la rubasarbabasadzadzaḥ go pa zha gsum dang / oṃ ro ru ro du tri tsa pa la a shug me maḥmabh+yoḥdzaḥdzaḥlan gsum gyis lha rnams bskyed zin pa byin gyis brlabs/ zor gtor sogs ladamigs nas/—112

dkyil 'khor chen po'i mdun phyogs su dur khrod chen po'i dbus me rlung 'khrugs pa'i nang khrag mtsho khol ma'i steng du mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor pad nyi la dgra bgegs pho mo bsgyel ba'i steng du hūṃ mthing nag 'bar ba las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thamasacad tsharabacad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gsod byed las kyi mgon po skumadog mun pa ltar gnag pa/ phyag g.yasagri gug 'phyar zhing sdigs pasadagrabagegs kyi srog rtsa gcod pa/ phyag g.yon thod khrag snying bcas thugs kura'adzin zhing zhal du gsol ba/ spyan gsum gnod byed la sdang mig tu gzigasashing zhal gdangs pa/ mche ba zangs yag tu gtsigs pa/ skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ gad rgyangs drag pos bdud sde 'joms pa/ dar nag gi 'jol beradang/gser gyi ske rags dang sag ti'i lham rgyan pa/ thod pa skam rlon gyi phrengab dngasprul gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang bas khyad kyi dor stabasakyi bzhugs shing / 'bor gshin rje pho mo dang / srin po pho mo'i chosakyisabaskoraba'o/ /oṃ mahā kā la ru tra sa ma ya ཿphaṭa/ g.yas kyi skam zor rnamasayi getri nag po las dregs pa pho sngo skya g.yas mtshon cha sna tshogs dang / g.yon zhags pa 'phen pa dpag tu med pa rlung dmar 'tshub ma'i dbus na gnas pa dang /g.yon phyogs kyi rlon zor rnams mo las dregs pa mo tshogasabud med dmar nag /g.yasakhram shing dang g.yon nad rkyal thogs pa dpag tu med pa rnamasadug mtsho dang khreg mtshor rgyu ba'o/ /de dag gi mtha' skor du bdud dang mamodang lha srin sde brgyad la sogs pa dregasapa'i tshogasadapag tu med pa sa dang —113—

bar snang thams cad khyab par gyur/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ zhesapanas/'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo/ rdo rje gdan gyi spo nas lasamagon ming sring rnams dang/ durakhrod chen po ro thang nag po nasalas kyi mgon po mahā kā la zangs gri can dang/ durakhrod chen po brgyad la sogs pa phyogs mtshams thams cad nas dregs pa pho mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dza kli rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga mā/ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin dran mdzod la/ /bdag gi don phyir gzhal yas 'dir/ /nag po chen po spyan 'dren na/ /rangagidam tshig sems shing byon/ /bosapa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /g.yabs pa'i tshe na spyan ma brtul/ /rbad pa'i che na mthu ma chung / /bsten pa'i tshe na rgyangamaring/kyai/ bos so nag po snyan ma sra/ /g.yabs so nag po spyan mabartul/ /rbad do nag po mthu ma chung / /bsten no nag po rgyang ma ring / /sgrub po nagapo thugasamagayel/ /bkur ro nag po 'phrad ma dog /dur khrod mi ro'i thangachen nag /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskul//gdug can ma lus tshar gcod cing / /sangasargyas bstan pa bsrung mdzad phyir//spyan 'dren myur du gshegs su gsol/ /bka' yi las mkhan stobasapo mre /bdudadang srin po 'dul byed cing / /mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid can//bstan pa yongasakyi dgra lha ste/ /dam can yongs kyi tshe 'dzin pa/ /dmanyamasarnams kyi srog gcod mdzad/ khyod kyi thugasadam bdag bskul na/ /gnasa'adir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /mgon po gnas 'dir byon nas kyang//—114

'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub tu gsol//oṃ e h+ye hi mahā ka ru ṇi ka mahā kā ladza8PROB baṃ ho/sa ma ya e gu sha dzaḥrolawo rgyun bsrings/hūṃ tshogasar tshogasaganyis 'jigs pa'i sku//mthing nag wo po drag shul can//dur khrod khasashul dpa' bo che//lha yi dpa' bo bdud 'dul rnams//dgrabagegasabasgralaba'i ti ra dang //'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol//'baraba'i gdan la bzhugs nasakyang //bdag gis bcol ba'i lasakun sgrubs//sngon gyi dam tshig ma g.yel bar//dgyes shing mchod pa bzhes nas kyang//sangasargyasabastan pa bsrung ba dang /khyad par sde 'di'i mgon mdzod cig/bstan laganod byed dgra dang bgegs//sna tshogs thabs kyisa'adul ba'i phyir//mchod pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir//dgyesashing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/oṃ mahā kā laye sa ma ya ka ma la ye sur+ya ye she ba ye tiṣ+ṭa lhan/pad+ma ka malayes+t+waṃ/de nas/oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye mahā kā li de bī ye griste rda a: nas/rgyasaparamadzad du gsol gyi bar mar pa dang dam bas gtor chog ltar bya/rang gi snying gnasa'od zer 'phros/gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma dang bcas pa thams cad bkug ste gtor ma la thim par gyur/bar 'dir gtor chog ltar gtor ma sngags tsalagyis phul/mgo stod bsdus pa gtor bsngo bzhin byas la/hūṃ dur khrod chen po 'baraba'i dkyil 'bor nas//mgon po nag po wo po 'jigs pa'i sku//sapasargyas bstan pa shin tu rgyas mdzad mabon//chos skyong wo po khyod la bdagabastod do//phyi nang las byed gdug pa srin po'i tshul//dam tshigabasrungalartagatu phyogs (〈rja〉grogs )mdzad cing //dam tshig nyams pa'i 'chi bdag gtso —115—

bo mdzad/ /mgon po dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /lasakyi mos po mahākā la ni/ /sangs rgyasastong gi bstan pa bsrung bapo/ /bla ma dam pa'iskudagra'adul ba po/ /lasakyisamagon po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon tshebade gshegs spyan sngar bka' bsgos te/ /bstan pa srung dang 'gro la phan gdagasaphyir/ /dam bcas ma 'da' dam tshig rjesadagongs la/ /gsol gdab lasamadzod bdag don yongs rdzogs mdzod/ /las kyi mgon po mahā kā lani/ sha za gnod sbyin ma mo mkha' 'gror bcas/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtorama'adi bzhes shig /ces pa lasogs pas bstab po/ /skabs 'dir yang bskang ba ji ltar 'osapa bya/ hūṃ nag po chen po 'bor bcas la/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bulabani//dmar gyi arnya rgya mtsho dang / /dbang po lnga yi me tog dang / /sman sbyaratshulo bdug spos dang / sha rus dmar gyi gtor ma dang / /til dang tso ོ maratshedang / /smanadang a mṛ ta dang dri/ /'bru nag mar gyis byugs pa'i bsgos/ /rkang gling rnga dang cha lang sgra/ /phyi nang gsang ba de nyid kyi/ /mchod rdzasanamama'i mtha' klas pa/ /lha chen dpal 'bar khyod la 'bul/ /bstan pa rgyasaparabya ba'i phyir/ khyod kyi thugasadam gnyan skong nas/ /bzhes shig rolashigadagyesapar mdzod/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya i rda arnya/ pupo dhā pe/ ā lo ge garnye/ ni we te/ shap+ta mahā pū dza sa ma ya hūṃ/ hūṃ khro bo gdug pab 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /dpalaldan nag po wo po dang / /lha mo nag mo la sogs pa'i/ /lasakyi mas po pho nyar bcas/ /gsod dang gcod la dga' ba rnams/ /sha khrag dmaraladaga' ba yi/ /bshan pa 'khor bcas ma mo dang / /mkha' 'gro gtum mo'i tshogs—116

bcas la/ /sha chen dmar gyi gtor ma dang / /rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rang bskyil nas/ /keng rus ri ltar spungasapa dang / /tshogasadang mchod pa gtor ma 'dig /chosaskyong khyod kyi thugs dam bskang / /gdug pa can rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /gsol zhig 'thung zhig dges par mdzod/ /rol zhig dgongs shig kha ༷khāhi/hūṃ 'bru sna sha sna khrag sna sogs/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad 'dig /mgon po nag po 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs dam gnyan po skong gyur cig /g.yarodamaganyan po gso bar gsol/ /de ltar thugs dam gnyan skong bag r+sā sbyorayon gyi bdag po dang / /bdag gi bar chad bzlog tu gsol/ /bstan t+pa lasdangalog lta can/ /sems can yongasal gnod byed cing / /bdag la logaparasems pa rnams/ /zo zhig 'thungs shig kha raṃ khā hi/ hūṃ dur khrod ོ po'i gzhal yas khang / /ro thang 'bar ba nag po nas/ /smug nag 'baraba'i klongadakyil nas/ khren tu mi bzad 'bar ba'i sku/ /gtum chen mahā kā la khyod/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba la/ /thal chen zhag gis kun tu byugag /dpalaldan mgon po nag po yi/ /yon tan 'phrin lasabasam mi khyab/ /singasnyalayi dur khrod du/ /bdud dang srin po 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i thugasarjesaskusprul pa/ /gsod byed mahā kā la khyod/ phyogs mtshamasasteng 'og thamasacad nas/ /sprul pa pho nya'i tshogasakyis bskor/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di dgagis/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang / /zlog cig bdag gi rkyen rnamasabazlog /bskang bzlog mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /yum chen lha mo nagamodang / /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /drag shul stobs gsusapo —117—

che/ /mthing nag 'bar ba 'jigasapa'i sku/ /dur khrod chas kyisarab tubargyan//lto 'gro rnams kyis yan lag dkris/ /dbu skra gyen du brdzesapa yis/ /stengagilha rnams 'dar zhing dngangs/ /ljags ni drag po'i glog ltar 'gyu/ /stongagasumadagra la nad 'bebs shing / /mche ba zangs yag gtsigs pa yis/ /dgra bgegs kun gyi don snying 'byin/ /dpa' bo stag gi sham thabs can/ /logaltatshar gcod thod phreng gsol/ /rnam rtog gcod mdzad gri gug g.yas/ /nyon mongs zad mdzad brgyu g.yon/ /gdug pa 'dulamadzad zhabrugs pa'isku/ tagapo me stag phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /ma rung 'jomasapa'i las la dpa'/ dgra bgegs thams cad rlag byed pa/ /'khor bcas khyed kyi thugs dmabaskang/ /pho nya rngams byed dgra la rgyug /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ ltasapa'adi gtso bor las mgon zangs gri can gyi bskang ba yin no/ /de nas ling ga bsgral ba'i las ni/ bskyed dang dgug gzhug dmod bskul bya/ /lha dbyesgrol zhing ling ro bstab/ /ces pa ltar don phywa drug go/dang po bskyed pa ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ las byung ba'i drag po'i las kyi 'brub khung gnam lcags 'bar ba las grub pa kha dog nag po dbyibs gru gsum rgya che ba gting zab pa/ nang khrag zhag 'khrugs pa/ dug gi na bun dang/ nad kyi 'tshub ma dang / tshon cha'i ser ba 'khrugs pa bya dang gcan gzan gdugapa can dang gshed ma ma rungs pa dang / 'bar ba'i mes yongs su khyab pa lasakyi btson khang chen po'i nang du ṇi ljang khu lasabyung ba'i dgra bo pho mo'i tshogasadang /tri dkar po las pho gdon sri ser po lasamo gdon rnams phung khams skye mched —118

dbang po rnams tshang ba 'jigasashing skrag la 'dar zhing nyams thag pa mgon skyabs dang bral ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/de ltar sh+ka gsum sogs yang yang khalabatab na bzang ngo//gnyis pa dgug gtso ni/hūṃ bh+yoḥshar phyogs sgo ma seng ge'i gdong //phyag na lcags kyu 'bar ba thogs//dgra bgegs 'gugs pa'i las mdzad ma//grangs med 'khor gyis bskor ba ste//lcags kyu thogs pa sprin ltaragatibag/de 'dra gcig pur ma nges te/khams gsum khyab par sprul nas kyang//dgra bgegs gnod byed da khug cig/nyams pa'i khrag la mnga' mdzad ma//bstan pa gshigs pa'i dgra rnams kyi//chu khams nus pa thams cad com//brlan gsher khrag gi mdangs phrol zhig/oṃ sing ha mu kha hūṃ phaṭa/badz+ra e gusha dzaḥlho phyogs sgo ma gzig gi gdong //phyag na zhags pa dgra bgegasagazhugapa'i grangasamed zhags pa thogs pa de 'dra gcig pur khamasagasum dgra bgegs gnod byed da chos shig/nyams pa'i rus la bsnya pa spokhams sra ba rus pa'i mdangs phrol zhig/oṃ tsi tā mu kha ཿphaṭa/badz+rapāsha k+shinub phyogs sgo ma dom gyi gdong //phyag na lcags sgrog dgra bgegasabartserapa'i grangs med lcags sgrog thogasapa de 'dra khams gsumྈ dgra bgegs gnod byed da sdoms shig/nyams pa'i drod la bstan pa ri'aju byed drod kyi mdangs phrol smo/oṃ raṃ k+ṣa mu kha hūṃ phaṭa/badz+ralhoṭagibyangaphyogs sgo ma dred kyi gdong //phyag na dril bu dgra bgegasalhungaba'i grangasamed dril bu thogs pa de 'dra khams gsum dgra bgegasaganod byed —119

myos par gyis/ nyams pa'i dbugasal bstan pa rlung khamabargya 'gyub dbugs kyi mdangs phrol zhig /oṃ tā rak+ṣu mu kha hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra ā be sha hodagug gtso bden ba dar brjod pa ni/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcasapa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / phyogs bstodusagasum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / lung dang rtogs pasabasdus pa dam pa'i chose rnams kyi theg pa gsum la gnas pa 'phagasapa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dang rdo rje rin po che dang pad+ma dngalas kyi rigs su bzhugasapa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi snying po dang phyag gyodangagasang sngags dang rigs sngagasakyi lha tshogs rnams kyi/ chos kyi dbyingasarnamapar dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa dang / kun rdzob rgyu 'brasabaslub med pa'i bden pa dang / byaba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / khyad par du yangabacom ldan 'das 'di zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhes skabs der yi dam gang la brten nas bsgrubs pa'i mtshan nas smos so/ /dpal nag po chen po guragyi mgon po/ yum chen e ka dza ṭi/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khamasakyi dbangaphyug ma/ gsod byed las kyi mgon po/ bran bdud gshen rje nag podamacan gnod sbyin yab yum bka' stod pu ṭa ming sring / phyag brnyan sgospung gdongabazhilas byed sdebazhi ru 'dren/ rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍi'i khro tshogs/ dregasapa phorgyud/morgyud bka' nyan sdebargyad kyi dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden —120

pa dang / yang skabs 'dir gtor gral labazhugs pa'i chos skyong gzhan yod na yang de dang de'i mtshan nas smos shing bden pa bdar/ gzhan yang dpal mgon dam pa chos skyongaba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rdzu 'phrul gyi zhabs dang ldan pa/ mthu༄bsakyi rtsal dang ldan pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / zhes sogs mtshams sbyaranas/bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra/ dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra/ dge 'dun tshogasakyi sdangadagra/ skye'agrosems can yongs la 'tshe ba rnams dang / khyad par du rnal 'byor pa bdagacana'akhor dang bcas pa dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod cing / bsamasbyoraphyin ci log byed pa'i mir gyur pa'i dgra mi ma yin pa'i bgegs/ rbad 'drerbod gtong byad ma snga dgra lag tu khyer ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da ltadangos su sbyor ba'i las ngan gyi dgra bo/ bsam pa ngan pa/ sbyor ba rtsub pa/phod 'dzugs pa/ do bdo ba'i dgra bgegs byad ma gang yin pa de dag thamasacad/ mtho srid pa'i rtse mo nas/ dma' dmyal khamasayan chod/ b.rastongagasum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gang na gnasakyangaskad cig thang cig yud tsam 'di la ming dang rus su smos pa gzugs dang rtags su byas pa'i mtshan ma rdzas kyi ling ga 'di nyid la khug shig phob cig : yaṃ dzaḥ dritha dzaḥ zhes dang / a li a li ma sogs/ bod ('ja nasngagasakyigazhamadu/sarba bisnrun shā trun ā garnya ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes btags pa mang du bzla/ rol mo'i sgra branatu bya'o/ /de ltar lan gsum la sogs pa yid ches rnyed kyi bar du dgug gzhug bya/ /gsum pa dmod bskul ni/ hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dkon mchogagasumapo yi/ /—121—

bka' yi srung ma thams cad dgongs su gsol/ /bsten bsten bsgrubasabasgrubs pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ /gsol gsol mchod mchod pa rnamasadagongs su gsol/ /chos skyong bstan pa mi srung ci zhig srung / /dam can dam la mi gnas ci la gnas/ /sngags bdag dgra bgegs mi sgrol ci zhigasgrol/ /phyag brnyan 'phrin las mi sgrub ci zhig sgrub/ /bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /srung ma dam can khyed rnams bsten/ /sdang byed dgra la mthumachung/ /gnod byed bgegs la rtsal ma zhan/ /bcol ba'i las la bang mabul reltos dpung gnyen khyed la zhu/ /dmag dpung ram mdar khyod spron gyi/ /dmabacas ma yel mthu rtsal bskyed/ /lha khang gnas gzhi'i srung ma mdzod/ khulakhyim 'khor gyi mel tshe mdzod/ /mi nor phyugs kyi gnyer kha mdzod/ /gnod byed 'joms pa'i dgra lha mdzod/ /bdag gis ma nyes ma yo'o/ /gzu dngadapabadu dkon mchog bzhugs/ /zhal lce sde brgyad yongs kyis chod/ /bden pa'i lasakyi rgyab dpung zhu/ /gnod byed las ngan dgra bo 'di/ /spyir gyi das lugadabu 'phang smad/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi bde skyid bcom/ /sgosasu nora'abyorasgrub la sdang / /bdag gis zhi ba'i thabs byas kyang / /gdug sems can de phyirazhing 'khrug /'di 'dra zhi bsami thul gyi/ /'di yi gnas lus longasaspyod kun/ /da lta nyid du rdul du rlogs/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag steng nasachod/ /sayi lte phur 'og nas phyung / /dkon pa'i tshe srog gnyis dang phrol/ /lasakyi rlungagis rgyab nas phul/ /dus kyi mun pas mdun nas bsus/ /lodangazla b.ramabazhag cig /zhag dang za mar rtags phyung zhig /ces rol mo'i sgra dngab༅te/rbod —122

rbad bsad gsum gyi sngags drag tu bzla ba gal che/ /bzhi pa lha dang dbye ba ni/ gong bzhin bden bdar drag tu byas nas/ dgra bgegs byad ma de thams cad srung tshungabasabyed pa'i lha dang phye shig /pho lha dgra lha zhang lha srog lha yul lha la sogasapa mgon skyabasagadong grogs byed pa'i lha dang phye shig /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'dasapa'i srung ba dang byin rlabs rang dang gzhan gyis byas pa'i nus mthu dang phye shigaces lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar rol mo drag tu brdung zhing / ling ga la gu gul gyis bdug /lcam dral gyi snying po dang / shā sa na dang / rbod rbad bsad gsum gyi mthar/ dgra bgegaga'adi rnams 'go ba'i lha thams cad dang bi dre shā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces btags paskranatubazla/bsgrub bya'i gnas gsum nas 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i srung ba dang byin rlabs gang yod yi ge 'bru gsum gyi rnam pas tshur bsdus te rang la bstim pa'i dmigs pa bya'o/ /lnga pa liṅga sgrolab ni/ phur pa/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā wasasbyangs/༄mepa'i ngang las hūṃ las gsod byed las kyi mgon po sku mdog nag po sku stod khro bo gri gug 'phyar zhing thod khrag 'dzin pa/ lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa dgra bgegs thams cad 'joms pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃ/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i mthustobasathams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dza8PROB baṃ hoḥ oshrī mahā kā la ye badz+ra gī lokyilayoganod byed mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzlas/ shā sa na tshar ga༅tagaye dharma tshar gsum brjod la/ phur pa la khrag dang yungs gar gtor/ de nas phur bu 'ag tuchothogs nas bsgril zhing / hūṃ khros pa'i gzugs can gdug pa gang / /ji ltarargyalabs mi 'dul ba/ /dam bcas ji bzhin rjes dgongs la/ /da ltanyid du 'dir —123

khug cig /'bar ba me yi khung bu mā /rab tu 'chings nas mnarabayi/ /gzugs kyi ling gar phur bu che/ /nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa/ gnamalcagasa'abar ba'i zur gsum dbal/ /rab tu bsnun no mnar ba'i sems//rnamartogam rig bral gyur nas/ /nag po chen posarjes bzung shog /sabosha krun bisnan gī li gī la ya mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa dang / sngags drag tu bzlas shing/phurabulingagazhisnyingagarabatab/ bsgrub bya gnas spar ba'i dmigs pa bya/ de nas rolachen yun bsring ba'i nga nas/shā san dang / thun sngags bzla bzhi du skam thun rlon thun sogs ca zad brdeg 'i sa na dbadz+rad gyo bsad gsum bzla bzhin du ralagri'am gri gug gis rkang pa nas mgo bo'i bar du gtub bo/ /drug pa zhal du bstab pa ni/ skabs 'dir bdud rtsi lnga mchod mtshon byed gsar pa gtsenakyang bshams la/ las kyi rdo rje zhig gis 'cham stabs dang bcas nas/ ling ro stob pa'i stas kabyed pa'i srol 'dug pa ltar spros pa la dga' na bya zhing / gang ltar yang 'di skad ces/ hūṃdakon mchog bden pa'i stobs dang sngags kyi mthus/ /zhing bcur gyur pa'i dgra bgegs kun bsgral ba'i/ sha khrag rusapar bcas pa'i phungapo 'di/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin brlabs nas/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du khorakhāhi/ /yi dam lha tshogs zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/ /nag po wo po'i zhaladu yums ral gcig zhal du 'dod khams dbang phyug zhal du gsod byed lasamagon gnod sbyin yab yum pu ṭa ming sring zhal du sgo skyong khro mo'i zhaladuḥpho nya yang sprul zhal du — gaṇ+ḍi'i dmag tshogs zhal du ru 'dren sde bzhi'i zhaladu dregs pa pho mo'i zhal du lha srin sde brgyad zhal du dam can gyomatsho'i zhaladu khe ra khā hi/ mahā me sa lta khā hi/ mahā rak+ta la khā hi/ mahātsit+ta 5khāhi/ mahāko—124

ro tsa na la khā hi/spyo pa'i mthar sa roladang gtor sngags bya/ling ro nas sagastonang/snang gtor la ca zad re gsos/spro na drag po'i mardzo pa byin rlabs kyi tshig brjod/bsdunayid kyis bsam pas chog go/dgra bgegasarnams ni thams cad kyi//rak+ta'i gyomatshorab 'khyil ba//sogs/mahā keng ni ri ti khā hi spyo pa'i bar du bod rtsilnga0na kyitshig rnams brjod/rol mo'i tshig 'don gyi skabs/dbyangs dang rnga tshigs byed cing /gas rnams la 'dur gdangs sngags kyi skabs phyag rgya dang bcas pa byed pa phyis kyi lag len du snang la/canakyang mtha' gcig tu ma nges so//de nas sngar nas sdogs pa'i sha dum rnams tsho dgur bcad/gtor chen gyi g.yas dang /ling ro rnams dum bu mang por bcas pa yang tsho dgur byas pa g.yonadu bzhag/chang snod dang rak+ta'i snod ji ltar bde bar bzhag nas/las kyi rdo rjes lcagasasnod gcigatu sha dum dang ling ro tsho re byugs//phud dang rak+ta bran/mgon po lcam dran so so'i gong sngag5tshar gsum/shā sa na lan gsum gyis phulate/rol chen dang bcas gtor chen la btagadapal ldan mgon po nag po sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal ba kun gyi bka' srung /lha dmag yongs kyi ded dpon/dur khrod kun gyi zhing skyong /chos gzhi ca gyi srung ma/rig 'dzin yongasakyi dgra lha/dam nyams kun gyi srogagacod/gdugacan kun gyi gshed ma/bdud 'dul gyi dpa' bo chen po/lha chen dpala'abarakhyed kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/yang tsho gnyis pa sngar bzhi bsham/lha mo'i gtor sngags dang dregs pa pho mo'i rbod bod bsad gsum yongs rdzogs sam/bsdu ba bod sngags tsam gyi mthar/a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis 'khor rnams labasngos/gong bzhin rol mo dang bcasate gtor wo la btab/dpal ldan lha mo nag mo 'dod pa khamasakyi dbang phyugam/gshin rje'i lcam gcig bdud kyi yum chen/nad do cog gi bdag mo 'khoram—125—

mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang / gnod sbyin pho mo mon bu lcam sring / ru 'dren sprul pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du kha raṃ khāhi/gzhan yang dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ phyogs skyong zhing skyong 'jig rten dnga'ajig rten las 'das pa'i bka' nyan mgon po grangasamed pa rnams dang /snang srid lha srin sdebargyad dang bcas pa'i zhal du kha re' hi/ gsol lotshang do mchod pa dam par 'bul lo/ /yang tsho gsum pa sngar bzhin bsham/shā sa na lan gsum gyis phul la/ sngar bzhin btagardo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' dang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che srung bar dgongs te/rab tu dges shing mos pa'i thabs kyis bzhes la/ bdag cag dpon sleb 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi 'gal rkyen nad dang gnod pa dang / gdon bgegs dang bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dbang thang dang nus mthu dang / snyan pa dang grags pa thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba pho mo thams cad dbang du bsdu bar mdzad du gsol/ gnod byed dgra bgegs log par ltab thams cad bsad pa dang / bskrad ba dang / dbye ba dang / rengasapa lasogasapa'i sgo nas thal ba rdul du rlog par mdzod cig /sangasargyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ yid la bsam pa'i don thamasacad sgrubs/ ji ltar bka' bsgos shing bcol ba'i 'phrin las thamasacad myurabanyid du sgrubs shig ces brjod/ de ltar gsol kha stob tshulade nyid tshar gsum song ban/bdud rtsi lnga mchod kyi mchod pa de yang gtor r+sā nang du btab bo/ /—126

de nas zor bsgrub pa ni/hūṃ rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma yis//zorachen rdzasakyi mthu bskyed la//zor mchog 'di la byin gyis rlobs//mi mnya phyogasaca gzhom du gsol//tshig lhag ma gsum 'dra ba la/yi dam dkyil 'khor lha chogasakyis//lho dang /dpal ldan nag po chen po yis//go dang /maciga'adod khams gtso mo yis//zhes dang /pho nya las mkhan tshogs rnamasakyig/zhesadagadapa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kun gyis//spyo dang /dkon mchog gsumagyi bden stobs kyis//spyo sam/sangs rgyas dkon mchogasogs so soraphralakyangarung /rang bzhin spros bral bden pa'i mthus//zhes dang /lasa'abrasabasgrumed bden pa'i mthus//zhes sogs sbyar ro//mgon po lcam draladang zangs gri can gyi sngagasarbod bod bsad gsum ci rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/shā sa na ci mang dang /khyad par gyi thunasngags/sum trig raka bh+yoḥthibs thibs tsakra bh+yoḥsnying khar gdun ༷bh+yoḥrbad rbad tri na shig shig se na stubs stubs/kha rag rbad rbad dum bu snrobadz+ra tsi tri raka tsi tri ya ma ra ya rbad bh+yoḥbazlogaces drag tu bzla/de nasasprosapaladaga' na zor gyi bskul byed par 'dug/de ni yi ge snga ma rnams su lta la/nges par dgos pa'angamin pas 'dir ma bris so//de nas bzlog pa ni/hūṃ dpal 'bar mahā kā la ni/shar gyi phyogasakyi durakhrod nas//dri za 'bum tshogs 'khor gyis bskor//dmar chen gtoramasathugs dam bskang //las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs//zas sudagra bgegs sha khrag zo/khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab//dgra bgegasaganod pa bzlog tu gsol//hūṃ dpal 'bar mahā kā la ni//lho yi phyogs kyi durakhrod —127—

nas//gshin rje 'bum tshogs 'khor gyis bskor//dmar r+pā gtoramasogatshig rkang lnga po 'dra'o//de bzhi du/nub kyi chu lha byang gi gnod sbyin ཿbyangasharadabang ldan shar lho me lha lho nub srin po —nub byang rlungalha stengagilha dmag 'og gi klu gnyan zhes 'don pa spos pa ma gtogs snga ma bzhi no//de ltar na 'di la dur khrod gnas pa'i phyogs skyong gi bskulazhes grags so//de nas/hūṃ lha chen dpala'abar mthu ma chung //go pa nas/da lta nyid du grub par mdzod//cesapho saskang ba ltar bya/hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po da gshegs shig/bzlog pa'i dmagadapung da mdzod cig/sde brgyad dmag sna thams cad bzlog/byad kholha 'dre'i chad pa rnams/khyod kyis mi bzlog gang yang med/khyod kyis mi 'gyuragangayangamed//yon mchod 'khor bcas mtshan ma 'khrug/zlog go dmar chen gtorams bzlog/lha dang gnod sbyin gshin rje dang //klu dang rgyal po bsko dngabadud/smu dang the rang 'gong po dang //byang sman ma mo bal modang/khulalha nad bdag 'byung po sogs//gza' dang sde brgyad 'khyams po dang//thod gtong byad kha gzhan gyis bskul//'jig rten 'jig rten 'dasapa yi//gnod pa byed pa ma lus kun//bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog/'byungapo'i sprul pa sna tshogs kun//bzlog go dmar chen gtor masabazlogakhrebargyad byol kha sna tshogs kun//bzlog go lha srin cho 'phrul sna tshogasakun//bzlogago phyi nang ltas ngan mas ma ga//bzlog go dpal ldan mgon po 'borabacas dang //dpal ldan lha mo'akhor bcas kyi//mi mthun phyogasarnamasathams cad kun//bsgyur zhing bzlog par mdzad du gsol//rnala'abyorabadag—128—

gis bcol ba yi//'phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod//rnala'abyorabadagacag 'bor bcas dang //rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi//bdud kyi byolakhadagra la sgyur//gshin rje'i khram kha 'debs pa sogs//ngan pa bzlog lartsub mornams//dgra dang bgegs gyi tshogs la sgyur//zhes brjod/spros pa la dga' na mdos chog nas 'byung ba bzhin byol bzlog rgyas par byed pa yin pa gda' na'ang 'di tsam 'tsham mo//der rol mo drag po dang cas gtor r+sā la yungs gar gtor te/de yan chad dngos gzhi sgrubapa'i rim pa'o//de nas gtor chen dang /gtor zor rnams la phud dang rak+tas sa zad gos/mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas/lha tshogs rnams zhu ba las dug dang me dang mtshon cha'i phung toragyur bar bsam pa'am/yang na yig brgya lan gsum sngon du 'gro bas/gtor chen gyi lhanamamakhar bteg/gtor ma gong bzhin bsam mo//zor gyi lha rnams 'degs mi dgos sngar bsko bsam pa kho nas chog go/de nas/dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan sngar rangarangagizhesasogs lcam dral gyi bskuladang /gnod sbyin yab yum 'jigs pa'i gzugs sogasabastod pa bskul du bsgyur te/bstan srung yab yum las la chos//zhes padadapu ṭanag po las la ya//zhes dang /bha ṭa la yang de dang 'dra/nag mokhyod kyisalasamadzod cig/ces dang /'khor bcas thams cad las mdzod cig/dgra bgegs rdul bzhin brlag bar mdzod//ces 'don pa spo/de nas gsebaskyemasasogasakyis sna drangs te/zor dang gtor ma rnams phyir khyer/'og gzhi dkyila'akhor yang gtoramal 'debs pa'i srol yod/sgrub khang gi phyi rol ji ltar 'os par g.yang gzhi'i steng du stegs bu lathun gtor bshams nas spyi btab gyer bas 'bul/de nas gom pa bzhi bcurtsa dgu las mi thung pa'i sa phyogs su song ste/gser skyem sngon du 'gro bas zor lam dbye ba spyi dang mthun par bya tshe—129

dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang gi bka'//'byung po'i tshogasarnamasakun nyen cig/rnal 'byor rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams//gtor zor drag po pho nyara'agyed//zor 'phen phyogs dang nye ba na//yul lha'i rigs dang chu mig bragazhabadangs la gnas pa yi//'byung po thams cad sku bzur cig/don gnyeraphyogasasu'agro ba dang //lam du zhugs dang mkha' la rgyu//dgra bgegs mgatogasa'agro ba rnams//rang rang phyogs su yol bar gyis//bzur bar 'dod kyangabaskyod ma nus//brtan par gnas pa'i sa bdag sogs//mtho ba rnamasani zhabs bskums shig/dma' ba rnams ni dbu chums shig/bar pa rnams ni sku bzur cig/bag yangs gnas pa bsgrim par mdzod//zor lam phyelagrogasamadzod cig/bstan pa'i dgra bo sdig can 'di//skad cig gcig la rduladu rlogs/ces so//de nas slob dpon gyis bden pa bdar zhing slar yang gser skyems gtogags rnams kyis rol r+pā bya/de'i rjes su/hūṃ bh+yoḥmahā kā la stobs po che//sogs dang /hūṃ/dpal chen legs ldan nag po che//steng nas 'gyed pa'i pho nya ni//tshapasalha'i tshogs rnams khyung du sprul/khyung chen mthing nag bye ba 'bum//'phrurazhingagazhungs shing dgra la rgol//dgra bgegasasha zos khrag la 'thung //de rjesagazham bu'i tshig la/bsang gtor gyis skabs yin na/mi nor thal ba rduladu zlogs//rigs brgyud rtsad nas chod la shog/ces dang /rim 'gro sogs garkyen nganabarachad thams cad bzlog/gnod byed thal ba rdul du rlogs//spyo brjod/hūṃ dpal chenaḥ shar nas 'gyed pa'i dri za'i tshogs rnamasarta parasprul/rta dmag mtshon thogs bye ba 'bum//drag gtum rngams zhing dgra lanol//dgra —130

bgegs sha sogs gong bzhin sbyar/hūṃ dpal wo lho nas gzhin rje'i tshogasarnams stag tu sprul/gcan gzan dpa' bo mche gtsigs rngamamachong— dgra bgegs hūṃ dpal chen— nub nas klu'i tshogs rnams sbruladu sprul/dugasprul rngams pa phud sgra sgrog cing dgra la dgra bgegastsohudapalachenaḥ byanganas gnod sbyin tshogs rnams seng ger sprul//seng ge khros pa sbarab gdengs shing dgra bgegs sne dpal wo byang shar khrungapho chogasarnams glang du sprul//'thab glang myos pa gnam lcags gri 'debastsodagra bgegs hūṃ dpal wo shar lho'i mtshams nas drang srong tshogs rnamasa'aphar bar sprul//'pharaspyang rngams pa mchong rgyug khros pas dgra bgegs hūṃ dpal wo lho nub srin po'i rdzas rnams ru trar sprul/cudranagapo rngams shig drag pos dgra bgegs hū dpal chen nub byang riga'adzin tshogs rnams rlung por sprul//rlung nag mtshon char sa gzhi boskyed cing— dgra bgegs hūṃ dpal chen 'og gi gas bdag tshogs rnamasasdigaparasprul//lcags sdig mgo dgu rgyug mchong 'khrab cing — dgra bgegs hūṃ las mkhan chen po 'khor bcas kyi//g.yas nas dmag gi ru'adren pa//gying gi tshogs rnams dmag mir sprul//skyes pa go mtshon thogasapa brgya//gying dmag bye ba 'bum dang bcas//mda' zor mtshon cha dgra laphob//hūṃlas mkhan g.yon nas dmag gi ra tsa'i tshogs rnams btsun parasprul//dgra bcom seg shang thogs pa brgya//rgyal dmag bye ba gyo zoraskams dgra la :rgyob//hūṃ las mkhan /slad nas dmag gi /gza' rgod tshogasarnams—131—

sngags par sprul//sngags nag phur bu thogasapa brgya/taba' dmagabyeb rwazor thun zor dgra la rtsub//hūṃ lasamakhan sngon nas dmag gyimamo'i tshogs rnams srin mor sprul//bud med gri thod thogasapa brgya//mamobye ba khrag zor dug thun dgra la rgyob//nag mo ral ba g.yengs pa'i tshogag/bh+yo bh+yoḥde ni dgra la bh+yoḥgos sbyar te bskulaba'i mthar/rol mo drag la ༅ringabaragade'ingang nas thams cad kyis rbod bod bsad gsum drag tu bzla/gtor ma'i las kyi slob dponagyisamada' zor ra zor khrag zor tshe zor yungs zor tha malardo zor 'phangs/de nas zangs gri can gyizor gtor 'phangs/de nas gtor chen phrag pa g.yas su thogs te/dmigs pa gsalabatagadamod pa shes tshad bya zhing mi la lab pa ltar las bcol/kha bub tu gdab pa'am/rgyangadu'aphangapa gang bde bya'o//de nas gtor lam bcad bsrung 'khor gsalabatab/thams cad phyi migamiltabar sgrub khang du 'ongs nas tshogs la rol/bkra shis kyi bar gyi rjes chog rnams bya'o//cho ga'adi zhag mang por sbrel nas sgrub na'ang /zhag snga ma rnams la dngos gzhi bzlog pa yan chad song ba'i rjes su spyi btab kyis thun gtor phul/tshogs dang rjes chog bya'o//zhag tha ma lani gongadu bzha pa nyid do//dmod pa dang 'dod gsol yi ge rnying pa grong pa'i tshig tu sbyar ba mang po yod pa rna05dben pa'i gnas su las sgrub pa dang /bla brgyud chos brgyud gcig pa rtog dpyod nyung ba'i chogasanang du'ang brjod rgyu yin mod kyi/skye bo bsam pa tha dad pa sna tshogs pa'i nang du dbye ba'i gnasasu 'gyur ba'i dgag cha yod pas 'dir re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag go/ // de ltar na dpal gur gyi mgon po'i dmar chen gtor bzlog gi rim pa mdo tsam brjod pa 'di yang /rgyalakhams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o// zhus dag/ maṅga yaṃ//—132

༄tsho/ /mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i sgos bskang bzhugs so/ /༄tsho/ /tsheswā sti/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpasmosmo cas bzhi pa'i bskang ba cung zad spros pa la dga' na/ lha mchog mahā kā la mthu bo ske /'phrin las drag po'i gdug pa tshar gcod phyir/ /lko pa nas/ zhing skyong chen po gnasa'adir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar gyer la/ de rjes/ hūṃ dmaranagatshedapungaglog phreng rgyu ba'i klong / /'jigs rung phyag mtshan mtshon cha'i gur khang 'khrigs/ /mi ro rta ro bam chen brtsegasapa'i mkhar/ /rlung nag 'tshub ma'i dbus nas sku bskyod 'tshal/ /ha ha bzhad pa'i nga ro mthon po ni khorayugalcags kyi ri bo'i pha mthar thon/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten 'dar zhing g.yo ba yi//hūṃ phaṭa h+pha kyi shugs glu tshe re re/ /las bzhi'i 'phrin las myur mgyogasabaskulaba'i sgras/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro las byed skar ltar zhabrugs/ /srin yul lang ga'i bdag po khros pa'i gzi/ /zur tsam thos pas bka' gnyan thal mo sbyor/ /lha min nam mkha'i bu mo glog 'phrong ma/ /g.yul du sgrol ba'i dpa' chen khrosapa'i gar/ /gom stabs gcig gis sa gsum lhag par brdzis/ khrag 'dzagamagophreng sil sil g.yer kha'i skad/ /mu cor sgrogs pas 'ur sgra 'brug stong bzhin//sdigs rngams bsnun pa'i tshul du bskyod pa'i phyag /gyigug ral gri 'barab rtsegasum bsnams/ /thod nang don snying gsol la dgyes pa'i zhal/ /mchu 'phyang—133

hom ras dam nyams 'gugs pa'i sgo//sgos pa'i skud thogasamago bo'i no pan lnga//zla tshes nag bun g.yogs 'dra'i ral pas sgribs/kham nag6lce lhab lhab 'bar ba can//zhing skyong dbang phyug gzi ldan nag po mre/ha ha rgod dang gru 'dzin bsil ba'i tshal/ti se gangs ri'i byang phyogs lamatshesogs//phyogs bcu'i zhing nas 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol//dur khrod bas dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas//yul ོ so gnyisanye bar spyod pa'i zhing//rolapa'i zhing dang rab 'byams phyogs bcu nas//pho nya lasabyed 'khor bcasagashegasasu gsol//zhes pa 'jug/de nas gtor bsngo dkyus bzhi las/gtor bsngo grubagoyosabaskang rdzas/a mṛ tas bsangs/swa bhā was sbyangs la/stong pa'i b.ralasaganasakhangadrag po'i las kyi gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thamasacad yongs su rdzogs pa/thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/'byung bzhi lasakyigur khang dang bcas pas skor ba'i nang du hūṃ zhu ba las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dam rdzas thod pa yangasashing rgya che ba'i nang du/dmar wo khrag gi.asgodabang po lnga'i me tog/tshil wo gyi bdug spos/zhun wo gyi sgron me/dzagosawo gyi dri m+mu/sha rus kyi zhal zas/rkang gling dang thod lnga'i rolamo/yangagazhi'i bla re/rgyu sno gyi lda ldi/glo snying gi sting las/rosnra'i rnga yab/go tshal gyi zla tshes/nal bu'i rgyal mtshan/zhing chen gyi 'phan gdugagarusapa'i phreng ba sogs mgon po mnyes par byed pa'i dam rdzas dang thun rdzas sadang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/oṃ badz+ra slaraṇa khaṃ/rolamo brdung ngo //spro na sngags drug phyag rgya drug sogs bya/de rjes snang ba'i dor gzho—134

thog mar/lha mchog mahā kā la mthu bo che/khyed la mthun pa'i dmardzasa'abulab ni/(〈rja〉 /rta mchog rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang /)/g.yag rog zhol chen sprin ltar gtibs pa dang //lug nag spyi dkar shel ltar 'tsher ba dang/khyi nag snying dkar dom ltar 'phyo ba dang //mthing nag dar gyi cod pan mngapos brgyan//lha mchog mahā ka la'i thugs dam bskang //lha chen nagapo gdongabazhi'i thugs dam bskang //zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug thugasadamabaskang//bram ze'i gzugs can dpa' bo'i— yum chen g.yung monag mo'o lasamadzad gtum mo ljang khu'i ser nag sing ga gling ma'i spyodamar nag srin mochen mo'i— 'khor gyi zhing skyong tshogs kyi badregs pa sde brgyad tshogs kyi zhanasadangabacasapa'i thugs dam skong gyur cig/rak+ta dmar chen khrag gi arnya dang //drildan gsar rnying me tog nag po dang //tshil wo rma sa'i spos kyi dud i dang//zhun chen sgron me 'bar ba'i snang gsal dang /khrag zhag rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dri mchog dang //zhal zas bshos bu dmar nag ri rab tsam/khrag zhagasha rusagatams pa'i tshoms bu bkod//rkang gling snyan pa'i rol mo sgra sgrogs shing //sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin gyis brgyan pa 'dis//lha mchog mahā kā la'i thugasadam bskang //lha ོ man chad 'gre/dam rdzas rgyan dang ldan pa'i gtoramadang//'chi med bdud rtsi sman gyi rgya mtsho dang //dza gad phud kyi bco ba sna tshogasadang //bza' dang btung ba ri rab rgya mtsho tsam//ting 'dzin sngags dngaphyagargyas byin brlabs pa//ro brgya ldan pa mchod pa'i rgya mtsho'adi//lha mtshogaḥlha chen— zhing skyong /bram ze yum chen las mdzad ser nag spyodamaranag —135

'bor gyi badregs pa 'khor dang —rnal 'byor bdag gi nyamasachagasasosagyur cig/gdong bzhi dregs pa 'khor dang bcas pa yis//sangasargyasabastan pa bsrung zhing skyongs ba dang //gnod pa'i dgra bgegasathams cad thalabararlog/zhi rgyas dbang dang dngos grub bdag la stsol//lho pa legs palong mtshams su 'di skad ces bya ste/hūṃ ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod sogs/ /gdugatso 'dul ba'i gnas kun nas//dpal ldan mgon po zhal bzhi pa//gnasa'adir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol//drag shul 'jigs rung da tshurabyon//stobs 'phrog nag po da tshur byon/khyod la mar cing bsten pa'i phyir//dmatshig can la dgongs su gsol//chos skyong mgon po nag po che//mingagirnamagrangs mang po can//zhing rnams skyong bar mdzad pa po//stobs 'phroganagapo'akhor bcas la/phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i//rnam dag dam rdzasamalusa'abul//mgon po 'khor bcas thugasadam bskang / khyed kyi thugasadamaskongaba'i rdzas//mthun pa'i dam rdzas dgyes rgu'i gter//ma tshang med pa'i tshang sprin rnams//ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin rlabs nas//rab 'byamasanamamakha'i mthas klas pa//gusapa'i yid kyis bdag 'bul na//dmatshigadabangagi bzhes su gsol//bzhes nas dngos grub rgya chen stsol/g.yaganagaluganag phyi yi rten//zhwa nag gos nag nang gi rten//gri snying thod pa gsangaba'i rten//dpal ldan mgon po'i rten du 'jug/stobs wo shugs drag gri gugarno//gdug pa bsgral phyir bzhesasu gsol//rgyu rtsub dug gis ngar slud pa'i//gri gug mgon po'i phyag na 'bar//'og la drag po'i sngags bkod pag/—136—

mgon po 'khor bcas sprin bzhin 'du/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje rno ngar bas/gdug can dgra bo'i snying la gzer/ /stobs 'phrog nag po'i phyagatu'abul/ /dgra bgegs bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol/ /de ltar tshig bcupo de la 'don pa spo nyestobs chen shugs drag rtse gsum rno/ /lko dang / rtse gsum mgon po'i phyagan 'bar/ /wo pa dang de bzhi du ral gri dang / mdung thung la'ang sbyar/ rkangaglingasnyan pa'i sgra sgrog pa/ /dam tshigs mtshon phyir 'du ba'i sgra/ /stobs 'phroganagapo'i phyag tu 'bul/ /dam cig skyong phyir bzhes su gsol/ /rnal 'byoraskyongaphyirabasnams su gsol/ /'og ma gnyis la'ang 'di'i rigs 'gre sag can phrengamadzesa'agug pa'i rgyan/ /rin chen bum pa nor gyi dbyig /stobs 'phrog spyo dmatshig rnal 'byoraḥ dar nag ba dan g.yo ba'i don/ /bde wo thod khrag bdud rtsi'i rgyan/ /stobs 'phrogaza dam tshig rnal 'byor gzhan yang gtor ma rak+ta dang //bdud rtsi lnga dang sha chen spos/ /tshil chen mar me chang phud dang / /maṇ+ḍalalasogs rten du 'bul/ /rnal 'byor skyong phyir bsnams su gsol/ /gting mtha' mi mngon rak+ta'i mtsho/ /rba klong 'khyil zhing 'bar ba'i dbus/ /thod chen brtsegs pa'i sku mkhar 'dis/ /mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dmabaskang/ /rgyu rlon lda ldi mchu 'phyang la/ /nyams pa'i dbang lnga rgyan du byas/ 'khochen g.yang gzhi'i 'phan gdugs can /dam rdzas rgyan gyi thugs dam bskang/ dgra bgegs mgo bo'i cod pan dag /skam rlon spel ba'i kha pad la/ /kengarusabartsegs pa'i ka gdung 'dis/ /mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dmabaskang/ /char sprin rlung gis bskyod pas 'dra'i/ /ro skra'i rnga yab nag po dang / /zla ba —137—

mkha' la shar 'dra ba'i/ /thod tshal dum bus thugs dam bskang / /nalabusarlung bshus rgyal mtshan dang / /yan lag nying lag spel ba yis/ /dragapo lasakyi pho brang 'dir/ /mgon po 'bor bcas thugs dam bskang / /zhingaga' sdangadagra ma lus pa/ /thams cad bsgral ba'i thod rlon dang / /mchod yon nyeraspyod sna tshogs pas/ /nye bar bskang 'dis thugs dam bskang / /dam nyamasasnyingartsa'i khrag rgyun la/ /ga bur zegs mas rab brgyan te/ /chal chil 5phrengarlabs g.yo ba'i/ /rak+ta'i arnya thugs dam bskang / /blta byed mig dnganyan byed rna/ /snom byed sna dang myong byed lce/ khrag rgyun gsar pasasbagasapayis/ /dbang lnga'i puṣ+ṭi thugs dam bskang / /drag po dri yis bgos pa'i sman/ khyin za chen po rab sbar zhing / /ro sol me la legs btab pa'i/ /tshil chen bdugapas thugs dam bskang / /rkang sbubs las skyes mar khu'i rgyun/ /rorasasdongabus rkyen sbyar nas/ /mun pa'i snang ba 'gog byed pa'i/ /zhun chen di pesathugs dam bskang / /gser mdog khu ba'i thig phran dang / /rang byungarak+ta rab sbyar zhing / /kun da'i zhag phreng tshom bu can/ /mkhris chen garnyes thugasadamabaskang / /dgra bo'i nag khrol sna tshogasapa/ /gri lcags snod du rab bsregasashing / sgog skya dri dang rab sbyar ba'i/ /me sa'i zas kyi thugs dmakhang/ /g.yul du bregs pa'i mi thod dang / khrag zhag lhag pa'i gzi ldan zhing/ /klad rgyas g.yogs pa'i thod rnga dang / /rkang gling shap+tas thugs dam bskang/ /'phralabashusapags pa'i bla re las/ khrag gi thig phran rab 'bab cing / khyu rlon spelaba'i lda ldi dang / /dbang po'i rgyal mtshan thugasadam bskang / /mi rusadamabu —138

spel ba yis//'khor lo rna rgyan mgul rgyan sogs//gdub bu skoragasasemodo//rus pa'i rgyan gyis thugs dam bskang /rkun chen bgegs nas shi ba'i skra//bshan pa'i bu mos bkal ba yis//cho ga bzhin du legs sgrubs pa'i//tshangs skud nag pos thugs dam bskang //ru rak+ṣa dang ni raṃ shu//sna chogasaspelaba'i phreng ba dang //sil sil g.yer kha'i sgra dbyangs kyis//stobs chen nagapo'i thugs dam bskang /shugs drag bskyod pa'i ral gri'i rtser//g.yuladu longasapa'i mgo bo'i phreng /khrag 'dzag lnga bcu rtsagacig 'dis//zhing skyongawo po'i thugs dam bskang //lcags kyu lnga dang mi 'chi lnga//rab sbyar bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che//dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'dis//ye shes mgon po'i thugasadamabaskang //bza' dang bca' ba sna chogs dang //lhag par sran chen khragachen bcas//dza gad dpa' bo'i ston mo 'dis//lha mchog nag po'i thugasadamabaskang //bstan dgra'i don snying rlangs par bcas//glo mchin la sogasadragapo'i zas//klad khrag 'dres pa'i dam rdzas 'dis//gtum chen 'khorabacasathugs dam bskang //sgal tshigs nyer brgyad sha lpags tshogs//lhu dumarab bkod sha khrag dang //rgyu rlon snye ma la sogs pas//bshan pa'i chogasakyi thugs dam bskang //mdor na nag po 'khor bcas la//'phrin lasadragapo'i las bcol ba'i//bsgral pa'i mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis//thugasadamaganyan po skong gyur cig/rdzu 'phrul rma gi shugs ldan pa'i//rta nag rting dkar 'tsher bag can//g.yang gzhi'i sga g.yogs ldan pa 'dis//zhing skyong 'khorabacasathugs dam bskang //g.yag rgod rab khros 'gyings pa'i stabs//rirab —139

'degs pa'i rwa rno zhing //nag bun 'tshubs 'dra'i zhol chen 'dis//zhingaskyonga'akhor bcas thugs dam bskang //mthing sngon rwa bzhi mkhyil ba'i dbus//zla ba shar 'dra'i klad dkar can//bdud lug nag po'i spyi dkar 'dig/zhingaskyong 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs//chab sgo'adzin pa 'brug sgongagi/gad rgyangs mthon por sgrog pa'i gdong /khyi nag dom ltar 'phyo ba 'dig/khoskyonga'akhor bcas thugs dam bskang //de ltar thugs dam skong gyur nag/bdagacag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi//nyam chags ma lusagasos gyurate//mthun pa'i dngos grub rgya r+pā stsol//'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar//bu gzhinapa yi ma bzhin du//nam yang g.yel ba med pa ni//bsrung zhing skyob pa'i mgon mdzod cig/bar chad bdud dang 'gal rkyen spongs//mthun rkyen tshe dang dpal 'byor spel//bla ma dkon mchog dbu 'phangs bstod//'phrul gyi lha ོ 'khor bcas rnams//gsol lo mchod do dgyes par mdzod//bstan pa srungs shig sems can rnams//bde skyid dpal la spyod pa dang //rnala'abyorabargyalaba'i las mdzod cig/bstod pa'i skabs su mi rtog ma chung ba ni/ri sul gyi rnal 'tshimasamadzad pa yin la/bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs bstod pa ni/hūṃ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bsgos pa'i//bstan srung nag po wo pokhyod//༅sani gang du 'khod gyur kyang //dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang //popad raṃnyi ro steng du/hūṃ skyes nag po 'jigs pa'i sku//zhal bzhi phyag bzhizhabasaganyis pa/khro gtum rngams pa khyod la bstod//g.yas gnyis sngon po mche ba gtsigs//spyan rtsa dmar zlum nyi zlar 'khyil//smin ma sma ra khamasaser—140 byu

'bar/ /ljags gril ha ha bzhad la bstod/ /g.yon gnyis ljang khu khroganyera'akhrigs/ /dpral bsdus sdang mig log 'dren gzir/ /shangs nasarlunga'atshub rngul gyis 'gengs/ hūṃ hūṃ sgra 'byin khyod la bstod/ /g.yas g.yon gri gugathod khrag ni/ /thugs gar steng 'og bsnams pa yis/ /dgra bgegs snyinga'abyin dgra khrag 'thung / /phaṭa phaṭa dgra bgegs sgrol la bstod/ /g.yasagayon 'ogama'i phyag gnyis kyis/ /rtse gsum bum pa bsnams nas ni/ /mdungarnon dgra bgegs lus la 'debs/ /bum pas sgrub la dngos grub stsol/ /mimagokhraga'adzag lnga bcu dang / /dril bu g.yer ba sil sil gyis/ /zhing skyongakhyod kyi skulabargyan/ /srid gsum g.yo byed khyod la bstod/ /zhabs gnyis dorastabasagaragyis rol/ /sa gzhi rab g.yo dgra bgegs 'dul/ /dpa' bo khro gnyerasha gcod gsol/ /rngams pa'i dpa' bo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /las mkhan 'khoragyi khro mo bzhi/ /g.yas phyogs rgyug byed g.yung mo khyod/ /gri gug thod 'dzin shugasapas 'gengs/ /dgra bgegs myos byed dbang byed ma/ /g.yung monagamokhyod la bstod/ /g.yon nas 'gying stabs bzhad cing rgyug /gri gug thod 'dzin sha rus za/ /dgra bgegs rmongs shing myos byed ma/ /gas mo ljang khukhyod labastod/ /mdun na srin mo 'phyongs thabs rgyug /gri gug thod khrag dgra snyinga'abyin/ /ban+ta khrag bkang yab la stob/ /dgyes shing 'khril mdzad yumalabastod/ /rgyab nas gar stabs g.yal zhing rgyug /gri gug thod pa khragabaganga'adzin/ /'o dod khus 'debs dgra bo dgugs/ /sing gha li ma khyod la bstod/ /gtso bo 'khor bcas ti ser gnas/ /zhing skyong srung ma gtso 'khor lngag /—141—

bstan la gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /sgrol byed gtso 'khor lnga la bstod//sha chen sran bcas tshetog snying / /rus chen sbags pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /ye shes lnga ru byin rlabs pa/ /'di bzhesadagra bgegs brlag par mdzod/ opa'o/ /g.yas gnyis sngon po mche ba gtsigs/ /zhes pa bsnyen pa'i skas/ dbusaganyis nag po mche ba gtsigs/ /zhes dang / g.yon gnyis ljang khu zhes pagagayas g.yon ljang nag khro gnyer 'khrigs/ /zhes 'don pa spo/sgrub dusagadabusadang steng zhal nag po khros/ /lko dang / g.yasadakar g.yon dmar khroganyerabasdus/ /go 'don pa spo'o/ /hūṃ rgyal ba kun gyi drag po'i 'phrin lasapa/ /rngamabarjid khros pa char sprin lta bu'i mdog /srid gsum dregs ldan yongs kyi gtsor gyur pa/ /gtum po gzi ldan dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ /zhi rgyas dbangadangadrag po'i 'phrin las kyi/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bzhir skyong mdzad pa/ /rab brjid dpa' bo dgyes byed pho nya mo/ /las mdzad sring mo bzhi la brna par bgyid/ /bka' nyan mthu rtsal rmad byung ba/ /srog gcod bshan pa nyi shu gcig /gnod byed dgra bgegs 'joms la dpa'/ /rab tu gtum po'i tshogs la bstod/ /log 'dren kun 'joms ma rung gzugs/ /mtshon mdu mthogs shing rgyug /bdud 'dul nyi khri chig stong gi /dpung tshogs rnamasalabastod par bgyi/ /gzhan yang bstan la mthon dga' ba'i/ dregs pa sdebargyad dmag tshogs rnams/ khams gsum khyab pa'i cho 'phrul can/ /dkaraphyogasaskyong ba rnams la bstod/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dam rdzas tshogs/ /—142

phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten ma lus kun khyab pas//lha mchog khyod la rtagatumachod byed na//dngos grub ma lus ji bzhin stsal du gsol/khyad paradapalaldan bla mar gnod sems can/bstan la gnod par byed pa'i tshadrangasapa//rnal 'byor bdag la sdang byed dgra bo rnams//rdul phran tsam yang med paramadzad du gsol//gnas skabs kun tu'ang bdag cag 'khor bcasal//mimathun rkyen gyi bar chad ma lus kun//dpal mgon 'khor dang bcas pasazhi mdzad cing /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//mdorabasdus pa la de tsam gyi chog la/spros pa la dga' na/bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mdzad yaṃ borna rnying mang du yod pas//de dag las ji ltar 'os pas bstod par bya'o//de nas bshags pani/yig brgya mang du bzlas pa'i mthar/hūṃ rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang //sangasargyas byang sems yi dam tshogs/khyad par mgon po 'khor bcas rnams//malus gsan zhing dgongs su gsol//bdag cag mi shes bag med cing//slalus le lo'i dbang gyur pa'i//rang bzhin bcas pa'i nyes lhungarnams//gnongapa'i yid kyis bshags par bgyi//bla med theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas//riga'adzin nang gi dam tshig la/khas blangs dam bcas nongs pa gang//'chabasapa med pa'i sems kyis bshags//bla ma rdo rje slob dpon la//lus ngagasemasakyis smod pa gang //gdung zhing 'gyod pa drag po'i blos//mi sbed k+ṣiṃ sngard lta bshags//mgon khyod brtan par zhugs pa las//mchod dang gtorama'i rnal 'byor la//nyams chags grib kyis sbags pa rnams//dpalamagon dmacan che la bshags//phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas dang //sha lnga bdud rtsigan+t+ra—143—

ta/ /dam rdzas ma tshang gyur pa kun/ /mthuldan srung ma khyod labashags/ khyu chung phud nyams lhag ma 'dres/ /'khor can rdzas kyis sbags pa dang / /snod min mthong thos gyur pa yang / /dam can srung ma khyod la bshags/ khyod skuskalamin bstan pa dang / khyod gsung bzlas brjod nyams chags dang / khyod kyithugs dang 'gal ba'i tshogs/ /bdag cag snying nas bshags parabagyi/ /blama'i sku dgrar gyur pa dang / /dkon mchog gsum 'tshe sems can gnod/ /bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo la/ /byams bsten 'grogs pa mthol lo bshags/ /dur khrod bas mtha' dben gnas su/ /bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod mchod gtoragyis/ /thugs dam dus su skong ba la/ /lelor spyod gangamatholalobashags/ /'don chen yul che'i lhag bsam gyis/ /chos skyong gnad nas bskulab dang/ /las sgrub dus su mchod gtor gyi/ gtang rag ma thengs mtho lobashags/ /mdor na zhing skyong 'bor bcas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs la nongs pa'i cha/ /bgyis dang bgyid stsal gang legs pa/ /dag tshangs chen po mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa'i mthar 'jam rol rgyun chags dang lhan cig yig brgya tshar gsum brjod/ de nas gtora'abul gyi spyi btab ni/ gur rnam dang sbrags te byed pa yin na logs su mi dgos kyang/ zhal bzhipa nyid la sgos su 'bul na/ spyan gsum sras po gzi brjid mtha' g.yasapa/ khams gsum dbang phyug drag po lha yi lha/ /dpal ldan mgon po zhal bzhi dregasapa can/ /'jigs mdzad khyod kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ ḍom+bi ni sogasasringamo 'khor dang bcas/ /tsaṇ+ḍi kā sogs ma mo 'khor dang bcas/ /marutsesogasabashan pa'i 'khor dang bcas/ /mig dring la sogs gsod byed 'khor dang —144
