bcas/ /dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir sh+kagasa.o gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /ces pa man chad spyi dang 'dra/ mjug tu dge legs kyi tshigs ༷/nye sgyu misgyu mi lag tsho shā//sdo sgyu mi r+sā tsha shāje( ra rdzacad dang / da zha' dpal 'byar ma lus 'byung ba gzha/ /sags ltarangasapa brjod// // dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i sgos kyi bskang gso byed tshul/ gtor chog dngagangagaso wo tsho zur 'debs kyi tshul du sbyar ba 'di yang / don gnyer mang pos yang yang bskul bal brten nas/ bla ma gong ma'i gsung las bsdus te/ tā ra nā thas sgrigs pa'o/ /tsodag/ /dgelegs 'phel// mthole//—145

nyer bsdus bzhugs so//༄tsho//chaswā sti/bla ma dang mas po 'jam pa'i dbyangs laphyag 'tshalalo/zhadiradapalamagon gdong bzhi pa'i cho ga'i rnam gzhag thung tsam 'di ni/sngags drug phyag rgyadrug la sogs payang nges par snang bar mdzad do//hūṃ lha mchog mahā kā la mthu bo che//'phrin las drag po'i gdug pa tsharaspyod cing //ha hā rgod pa'i dur khrod wo po nas//zhing skyong wo po khasa'adir gshegs su gsol//myur mgyogasasde brgyad dmag dpon mdzad tsan//te se'i gangs ri gnas 'dir sa/shegs su gsol//gdong bzhi sprul pa phyogasabacur 'gyed tsa na//po ta lha yi gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//mkha' 'gro mang po'i gtso bo mdzad tsa na//dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal nas gshegasasugasol//dam nyams dgra bgegs cham la 'bebs tsa na//dar lungaganyan gyi gnas nas gshegs su gsol//rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa skyong tsa na/ kha'u brag rdzong gnas nas gshegs su gsol//sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs bcur spel tsa na//ri khrod jo nang gnas nas gshegs su gsol//sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan sngas/gsalapo khyod kyi ji ltar khas blang zhing //'phrin lasarnam bzhi las la spyan 'dren na//sangs rgyas bstan pa srung phyir gshegasasu gsol//hūṃ lha mchog mahā kā la—146

mthu bo che/khyed la mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni//rta mchogarin chen rgyan gyi brgyan pa dang //g.yag rog zhol chen sprin ltar snyibs pa dang/khuganagaspyi dkar shel ltar 'tsher ba dang /khyi nag snying dkar dom ltar phyo ba dang//mthing nag dar gyi cod pan mang pos brgyan//lha mchog mahā kā la'i thugasadam bskang //lha ོ nag po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang //zhingaskyongagazigs ldan dbang phyug thugs dam bskang //bram ze'i gzugs can dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang /khum chen g.yung monag mo'i thugs dmabaskang//las mdzad gtum po ljang khu'i thugs dam bskang //ser nag seng ga glingama'i thugs dam bskang //dmar nag srin mo chen mo'i thugs dam bskang//'khoragyi zhing skyong tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang //dregs pa sde brgyad chogs kyi thugasadam bskang //'bor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skong gyur cig/rnala'abyorabadag gi nyams chags sos gyur cig/skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsaladu gsol/hūṃ lha mchog mahā kā la mthu bo che/khyed la mthun pa'i dmardzasa'abulab ni//rak+ta dmar chen khrag gi arnya dang //dri ldan me tog gsang snyinganagapo dang //tshil chen mang pos spos kyi dud sprin dang //zhun chen sgron me 'bar ba'i snang gsal dang /khrag zhag rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i dri mchog dang //zhalazasabashos bu dmar nag rirab tsam/khrag zhag sha rus stam (gtams )pa chomibus bskong //rkang gling rnyan pa'i rol mo'i sgra sgrog cing //lha mchogamahākā la'i thugs dam bskang //go pa nas/skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsoladu gsol//lko pa'i bar gong dang 'dra/lha mchog mahā ka la mthu bo che/khyed la mthun —147

pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni//dam rdzas rgyan dang ldan pa'i gtor mdang//'tshemed bdud rtsi sman gyi rgya mtsho dang //dza gad phud kyi btung ba sna tshogasadang//bza' dang btung ba ri dang rgya mtsho tsam//ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyasabyin rlabs pa'i//ro brgya ldan pa'i mchod pa rgya mtsho'adi//lha mchog mahākalasathugs dam bskang //lha chen nag po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskab//zhingaskyong gzigs ldan dbang phyug thugs dam bskang //bram ze'i gzugasacan dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang //yum chen g.yung mo nag mo'i thugs dmabaskang //las mdzad gtum mo ljang khu'i thugs dam bskang //seranagasengagagling ma'i thugs dam bskang //dmar nag srin mo chen mo'i thugs dam bskang//'khor gyi zhing skyong tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang //dregs pa sde brgyad chogasakyi thugs dam bskang //'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skong gyur cigasnyala'abyor bdag gi nyams chags sos gyur cig/skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol//gdong bzhi dregs pa 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi//sangasargyas bstan pa bsrung zhing rgyas par mdzod//gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thalab rdul du rlog/zhi rgyas dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// //zhes pa 'di ni tā ra nā thas nye gnas dar ma seng ge la gdams pa'o//bkra shis//—148—

༄༅//zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug gi gtor ma chen po sgrub 'phen gyi lag len cho ga las bzhi lhun grub zhes bya ba bzhugs rbes//༄tsho//na mogu ru badz+ra dhi ka ār+ya tā rā ye/'dir dpal ldan nag poha spogapho zhingaskyong chen po zhal bzhi pa'i gtor chog las rim gyi man ngag mdo tsam bshad par bya'o//de yangaganas dang dus 'dzom pa na/dang por/sgrub pa po dam ldan yi dam gyi bsnyen pa 'themasaporasongab zhig nges par dgos la/de yang gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dkyil 'khoraltabu'am/dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje khro bo'i rigs gang gis kyang rung zhing /khyad par du 'di largyud 'jam zhing 'khul che ba'i gnad yin pas/bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i rigs kyi bsnyen patsharagacig song na gnad du che bar bzhed/de yang brgyud pa gcig pa'i rten 'brel gyis/gnyan sgrol nyid bsngags par grags la/gzhan ku ru kul+le la sogs pas kyang rung ngo //de ltar yi dmagyibasnyen pa sngon du song nas/dpal mgon po 'di nyid kyi bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa yang //lan gsusaskyar ba lta bu byung na rab/tshar gcig song ba zhig med du mi rung ste/'on kyang bod 'diraphyisadangad lta'i lag len ltar chog grwa ngom pa gtso bor byed na/tshogs kyi gtso bo de dpal mgon 'di'i bsnyen pa'ang song ba med du mi rung la/gzhan rnams ni yi dam gang rung re'i bsnyen pa song na/'di'i chog grwa la 'jug rung tsam yin no//chos skyong 'di la gong gnon gyi mgon po gzhan dgos sam mi dgos snyam na/spyir nges par dgos pa ni ma yin te/yi dam khro bos gcun zhing /bcom ldan 'das mas gnad nasabaskul—149

bas chog pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang bod yul 'di na/ sgrub pa po gcig gis chos skyong rigs migacig pa du ma bsnyen pa'i srol yod pas/ de'i dbang gis man ngag gi yi ge rnams na/gongaganon re mdzad par gda' ba/ bla chen sa skya ba man chad nges par gur mgon gyis mdzad pas legasapar byung la/ spyir de ltar byed par 'dod na/ de kho nar ma zad dpal mgon po bzhi sbragagam/sgangaston lugs kyi gri gug can nam/ ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi drug sogs/ mgon chen gang labarten kyang rung ngo / /de lta na yang / spyir mgon po 'di kho na sgrub pa gcig yod dgos la'adi rangagi sgrub thabs dngos rnams kyang de lta bu'i dbang du byas pa yin dgos pas de gtso bor 'chad do/ /de la gtor sgrub gtor skyong tsam gyi dbang du byas na/ yi dam legs par bsnyen na chos skyongagi sgos bsnyen ma song kyang mi rung ba ma yin la/ gtor chen 'phen pa la ni 'di rang gi sgos bsnyen masong na/ rang g.yin thams cad phan pa ma yin pa skyed par byed do/ /da ni ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa bshad par bya ste/ gnas der bla bre yol ba sogs mdzes byed ci rigs par bya/ stegs bu mtho ba la bla ma'i gtor ma dang yi dam spyi dang / chos skyongadathosadangamakha' 'gro spyi dang / gzhi bdag gi bar gyi gtor ma lnga tshar rnams bshams/ yang na yi dmalagacig /rigs drug gi gtor ma ste lnga'o/ /sgrol ma sogs yi dam sgos kyi gtor ma dang bskangagator dkyus ma nor gzugs bshos phran zur gsum bzhi thod gzugs bzhi dang ldan pa bshams/'grub na rten rdo'i steng du chos 'byung gru gsum dbus nag la/ mu ran dmar ba/ de ladabusadangaphyogs bzhin nyi gdan la/ 'bru nag gi tshom bu lnga bkod pa'am/ yang tshom bu bcu bdun 'god paltar na/ chos 'byung 'bri mi dgos/ de'i steng du dar nag gi gur phub pa'o/ /rten rdo med kyang/gtor chog 'di dag la dgos nges ma tshang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang ltar na'ang / yi dmagatobama'i mdun gyi phyogs sa gzhi stabs bde ba zhig tu/ stegs bu gru bzhi dngos su yod pa'am/ med na rdul —150—

tshon sogs kyis dmar po'am/nag po gru bzhi pa bri/der pad+ma 'dab brgyad chen po ltebanag/'dab ma sngo/mu khyud ljang khur bya/lte ba'i steng du mañdzi sogs stegs mtho ba lkalcags snod yangasapar/sran nag gi chan dang /me tog nag po rnying pa dang /mi rus kyi phye ma btabapa'i sgrubagatorasnying gzugs ma phyogs bzhin bsgos phran zur gsum can mtshams rnams su mtheb kyu nyer bdun re brtsegs pas mtheb kyu brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bskor ba'o//de la sha khrag sogs rgyan gyis bayo/zas phud sna tshogs kyis bskor ro//pad 'dab brgyad kyi steng du/stegs bu cung zad dma' brtsebazhag ste/mdun ma larak+ta'i snod/gzhan bdun labashos bu gru gsum re rebashams/de thamasacad la ling rkyang re 'dzugs/mtha'i stegs du rnams dbus kyi stegs bu'i phyed dang gtor phran rnams dbus kyi gtor ma'i phyed du sleb pa byed gsung na de las mtho ba mi rung ba'i don yin/gzhan tshad nges pa med/de dag gi mtha' drag po'i mchod gtor spyi dang mthun pas bskor ba las/zhal zas bsgos bu dmar nag gru gsum lnga tshom mam lnga sgrengs byas kyang rung dbus ma mtho tsam byed/phyi rten rta lug g.yag khyi sogs nang rten zhwa nag gos nag phyag mtshan gsang mtshan gri snyinga'akhor locan sogs/dngos su yod na legs/med na gzugs yas sam sogs thung tsasagyisakyang rung bar 'dod/sgrub khang gi steng du rnga thug re yang 'dzugs/de yang lnga tshom byed pa'i srolayod spyan 'dren pa'i brda yin zer/gzhan yang spyan gzigs sna tshogs//g.yabadar/rdodrigashā ru thod pa rol mo sna tshogs 'grub na tshogs kyi yo byad rnams kyang bsham mo//de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma/gnas yo byin rlabs/bdag bskyed/mdun bskyed yi dam gtor bsngo yan chad nges par sngon du 'gro bar bya/de nas gong gnon byed na/de'i gtor chog tsam mam/gang batshwalokyang bya/mi byed na der zad/dkyus kyi yi dam la med/cho ga'i yan lag rang ma yin kyang bar 'dir gnyan sgrol gyi gtor bsngo bzlas pa dang bcas pa re byas na shin tu legs so//de nas—151—

dpal mgon po nyid kyi cho ga la 'jug ste/gtor ma thams cad lathun mong du yi dam gyi gtoramaltar byin gyis brlabs/mdun bskyed/a mṛ tas bsangs/swa bhā wasasbyangs/stongapa'i ngang las/bsrung ba'i 'khor lo 'byung bzhi las kyi gur khang yangs shing rgya tsheba'i nang du/rdo rje brag ri dmar nag 'jigs shing lhun chagasapa'i stengadu/bh+rūṃ las gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang yangs shing rgya dang tshad chad pa med pa/miro'i gdan dang /zhing gi 'phan gdugs/skra'i rnga yab/mimago'i phreng ba/tsit+ta'i phon tho/rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi sogs 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/phyi nang thams cad du zhing chen gsang rnying/e sa'i lhu dum/keng rus chal chol/rak+ta'i lteng dbya dang /gcan gsan mibasrun pa'i tshogs dang /gdug pa'i sprul nag sogs srog chags ma 4pasapusagang ba/shaza/sgri po/ma mo/mkha' 'gro bdud dang /gshin rje ro langs kyi tshogs lang long du rgyu zhing gar byed pa/'jigs pa'i nga ros khyab pa/phyiroladur khrod wo pos kho ra khor yug tu bskor ba/de'i dbus su gru gsumamathinganag wo po'i dkyil 'bor/de'i phyogs bzhir yang /e khri gyi dkyilageyobazhi ste/thams cad kyang 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrug pa'o//dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang /raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'bor gyi steng du/hūṃ yig mthing nagalasardorje gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa/de las 'od zer 'phros/'phags pa mchod/semasacan gyi don byas/dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/tshura'adus yongs su gyur pa las/nag po chen po zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbangapo zhal bzhis/sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs shing /gzi brjid bcad —152

par dka' ba nyi ma stong dus gcig tu shar ba dang mtshungs pa/ rtsa zhalanagapo ches cher khros pas/ bstan dgra bsgral ba'i mi ro cham chom du gsol ba/g.yas zhal dkar po rgya cher bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar po rab tu 'jigasapa/ /steng zhal dud nag ya sos ma mchu mnan pas mche ba zangs yag tugatsigs pa/ zhal nas ha ha dang / hūṃ hūṃ dang / k+ṣe k+ṣe gi sgra dragapo bsgragasapas/srid gsum 'dar bar mdzad pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rjes mtshan pa'i grigug gis log par lta ba thams cad kyi mgo lus gcod pa/ g.yon gyi dang posaka pā la gnode byed kyi khrag gis gang zhing / dam nyams kyi snying dang bcasapa thugs gar 'dzin zhing zhal du gsol ba/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri 'barab 'phyar bas bdud sde ma lus pa 'joms par mdzad cing / la lar dgra lalalar mdung thung bsnun pa/ g.yon 'og mas mdung rtse gsum pa dang / rusa'aphreng 'gag thabs su 'phyar ba/ mchan khung du gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsisagang bar bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum bzhengs pa'i stabs kyi gyad kyi 'dor stabs chen pos dgra bgegs thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo bam chen bsnol ba'i lus la nyed pa/ zhalagadangs mche gtsigs ljags bskyod pa/ dmar la zlumapa'i spyan gsum gsum nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu dgra bgegs la sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ mchu 'phyang zhing / sma ra smin mdabu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ stag lpags gsar pa'i sham thabs dang mimago skam po dbu rgyan/ rlon pa'i do shal/ rus pa'i phyag rgya/ tshangs pa'i skud pa gdug pa'i sprul chen po/ dril bu g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba la sogs pas brgyan pa/—153—

drag la rngam pa'i cha lugasacan/bskal pa'i me lta bu'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o//de ltar gtso bo bzhengasapa na lus dang grib ma'i tshuladu/e khri gyi dkyil 'khor bzhi la/lasabyed rnal 'byor slabazhidang/gas yang srog gcod bshan pa lnga sogs kyang grub par gyur pa ni/g.yas suyumawo g.yung mo nag mo/g.yon du lasamadzad gtum mo ljang khu/mdun du dmaranag srin mo wo mo/rgyab tu ser nag sing ga gling ma rnamasakhro zhing gzhugapa lang tsho la bab pa/gcer bu rgyan med pa/rab tu gril zhing/dragashulachen mo/pho nya mo'i cha lugs can/g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing /g.yon thod khragawon pa/dbu skra khams ser lhug par grol ba mun ltar gtibs pa/khamasagasumagyi srog la mnga' mdzad pa'o//gzhan yang bshan pa nag po lcags kyu 'dzen pa/bshan pa ser po zhags pa 'phen pa/bshan pa dmar po lcags sgrog skorab/bshan pa ljang khu ral gri 'debs pa/bshan pa sngon po mda' gzhu 'gengasapa/thams cad kyang srin po'i lus la mon bu lings pa wo po'i cha lugs can/dgra bgegasakyi bla tshe skad cig la 'gugs shing gsod pa'i shwa na khrid pa/gzhan yang de dag gi phyi rol du bdun gcod kyi bshan pa nyer rnyagakhrid pa'i rgyal momu kha le srin mo ral pa gcig ma/bdud 'dul gyi dmag nyi khrichig stong /dmag dpon wo po gshin rje khro tshogs sogs pa dregasapa lha wasrin sde brgyad kyi tshogasas gzhi bar snang mkha' dbyings thamasacad yongs su gang ba 'khod par gyur/de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/gos dkyuganga'adra/sbyar spos sreg cing /(〈 〉 sne )lha mchog mahā kā la mthu bo che/nas/phyogasabacu'i —154

zhing nas 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol//lha mchog mahā kā la gshegasasugasol/lha chen nag po zhing skyong gzi ldan bram ze'i can— yumachen— las mdzad dmar nag ser nag 'khor gyi dregasapa sdebargyad 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol//ma lus 'khor bcas 'dir byon bdagaladagongs//rnal 'byor nyams chags bskang phyir gshegs su gsol//yangan/bstan dgra gnod byed 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol//zhes pa lta bu skabasasugang bab dang sbyar te shes par bya'o//nye snying gi mthar/pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/denasagemegazhi lkasdom ni/mardzo bstod gtor bsngo mchod bstod dang //shigs bstod gtor gags sh+ka twan dang //slar yang bskangs shing mchod bstod do//de yang mchod bstod/gtor sngo/slar yangamachod bstod/phrugs bstod/yang gtor bsngo sngon du 'gro ba'i shigasas pa ༅ twan/slarayang snang ba mchod bstod rgyas pa ste/don wo drug go/dang po ni/bskang rdzas ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/gtor skyong skabs 'di'i mdza phreng 'di la rnga tshigs byed de/'jig rten khams kyi dgra bgegs rnamag/bsgralaba'i khrag gi arnya 'di//zhal bzhi gnyan po'i spyan sngar 'bul//derjesakhragagi.arnya lho pa'i tshab tu/dbang lnga me tog 'di/spyan sngar 'bul gyi dod du dbu la 'bul/de bzhi du/tshil chen bdug spos/shangs la/zhun chen mar tsheche/spyan la/'khris pa'i dri chab/thugs gar/sha rus zhal zas/zhal du/rkangagling rol mo/snyan la/spyo brjod/rol chen gyi sgra la/arnya nas/shap+ta'i bar gyi sngags brjod/lnga lnga lnga yi dam rdzas 'di//ye shes bdud rtsi a mṛ ta//'dod yon rnamalnga rdzogasaparasprul//stobs 'phrog nag po'i zhal du 'bul//mchod sprin ri lamosa'i thang//—155

phyogs bcur rba klung g.yo ba yi/rak+ta'i rgya mtsho bcud kyi mchog/stobasa'aphroga'akhor dang bcas la 'bul//nyams chags bskang phyir bzhes sugasol//rolamo'i skabs/snying po'i mthar hrū gsum btags/sku gsum mngon gyur rdo rje 'changadabang gi/rnam gsum bstan pa spel zhing bsrung ba'i phyir//dugagasumabadud dpung ma lus 'joms mdzad pa//'phrul gsum mnga' ba khyod la phyag 'tshalabastod/khams gsum me lce dmar nag 'bar ba'i dbus//stong gsumazilaganon zhing skyong rgyal po'i sku//sa gsum 'dar byed khro gas rngamabarjid che//srid gsum dbang gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//dus gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bo blam dang //sgogasum rdo rjes bsrungs pa bdag cag la//lus ngagayid gsusasdang bas rab 'khrugs pa'i//dgra bgegs log 'dren rnam gsum tsharagacod mdzod//ces so//oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta samaya sma rasamaya/mati kra ma ye/sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa phonya bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla mdamapa rnams dang sangs rgyas sras bcas kyi bka' dang dam las ma mda' bar/dam tshig srungs/bstan pa skyongs/dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs bstod khyad par du bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang /rnal 'byor pa bdagacana'akhor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba/lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod parabyed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi/bsam ga sbyorartsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/gal te zhi —156—

bas 'dul du ma 'tshal na/ gang la gang 'tshams pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang/bskrad cing gzir ba dang / /dbye ba dang / sdigs shing dpa' skongabaramadzod du gsol/ mdor na chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang/bsam sbyor chos dang mthun pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub cing / bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa dang / 'jig rten du bde legs rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ 'di'i sngags kyi skabs rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya ston te dam la 'jog go/gnyis pa ni/ de nas dbus kyi gtor ma la dmigs te/ bsangs sbyangs/ stongapa'i ngangalas/ a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dgra bgegs ma lusapa bsgral ba las byung ba'i me sa'i sa gzhi/ rus pa'i ri bo/ rak+ta'i rgya mtshosagazhi bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ zag med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin ye shes rnamapa lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ ā2PROBPROB khohrīḥs khagaso'o/ /'di thob thang gtor wogyiyinayagagator skyong la yang byed do/ /de nas sngags ring tshar gsum mam bdun gyis gtso bo yab yum rnamasal phul/ gtor ma gzhan rnams a kā )sdo'i sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig gis dregs pa pho mo mtha'adagal bsngo/ gsum pa ni/ hūṃ dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad dang / khyad parabyangashar 'jigs pa'i gnas/ /bsil ba'i tshal sogs thams cad nas/ /chosaskyongamagon po zhal bzhi pa/ /spyan 'dren gnas su da tshur byon/ khyad parado nub gnas 'dir byon/ /'phrin las/ sgrub phyir gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rnams 'dzugs/ /mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang / /mar modrichab zhal zas dang / /rol mo bla bre 'phan dang gdugs/ /shes rab ma da na yi chang / /thabs mchog mo sa bā liṃ sha /dam rdzas rgyan gyi tshogs phud 'di/ /—157—

dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal du 'bul//dam tshig ldan pa'i tshogasakhangan//sanag steng na thod nag snod//mi nag sha la khrag phyung ba//bsur nagadriladaranag phod/dkar gsum dngar gsum rgyan gyis brgyan//sha lnga bdud rtsilngaraldan pa'i//dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di//ting 'dzin sngags dngaphyagargyayis//gnyis med bdud rtsir byin rlabs nas//dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs dam bskang //stsol zhig dgongs shig dges mdzod la//rnala'abyorabacol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//bar chad bdud dang 'gal rkyen spongs/dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod//sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs//zhes rol chen dang bcas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags brjod/hūṃ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs las sprul pa'i sku//thugs rjes drag tukhrosapa rngam pa'i sku//sdig can tshogs rnams thal bar mdzad pa'i hūṃ//ye shesagazi 'od phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i sku//nag po wo po khyod la bdag bzhi do/go sku lhun po'i dpal ltar rab tu brjid/khyod gsung 'brug stong ldir 'dra'i (sgrasgrogakhyod thugs rgya mtsho nam mkha' lta bur yangs/khyod kyi yon to bsama'aphel rin po che//'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas la phyag 'tshalabastod/khrimachen bzhi dang las kyi bshan pa'i tshogs//ma lus 'khor bcas rnams 'khungabastod pa 'bul//bzhi pa ni/gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yi//dngosagrub slob dgo rjesa'aphyogasungs//de bas de la brnyas pa ni//rtsa ba'i lhung ba dang por bshad//rtsa lhung dang pos gos pa rnams//mthol lo bshags so dag par mdzod//bde—158—

gshegs bka' las 'das pa ni/ /lhung ba gnyis pa yin par bshad/ khri'iltungaganyis pas gos pa rnams/ /mthol lo bshags so dag par mdzod/ /ces pa nas/shes rab rang bzhin bud med la/ /smod par byed pa bcu bzhi pa/ /bcu bzhipa yis gos pa rnams/ /mthol lo bshags so dag par mdzod/ /mthuchen sdangab dgra yi dgra/ /phas rgol mu stegs bdud kyi bdud/ /zhal bzhi mnga' ba lha yi lha/ khyed la bdag gis bstod pas bstod/ /'dir gshegs 'dir byon dam la mnos/ /'dir gshegs 'dir byon mchod pa bzhes/ /'dir gshegasa'adirabyon 'phrin las mdzod/ /'dir gshegs 'dir byon bzod par bsheg /bdag cag dam ldan slob mar bcas/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /nag po chen po khyod kyis srungs/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi grub par mdzod/ /de ltar bshags pa dang bstod pa sbrelab de tshar gsum bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ gtor ma rnams kha gsos byin rlabs gong ltar byas te/ 'bul tshulayang snga ma dang 'dra/ slar yang skang ba'i dkyus na yod pa bzhi/ (〈rja〉 ྅ ) rtsa rgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /zhes pa nas/ dag tshangs chen po mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa)b.rabarjod nas yig brgya tshar gsum bzla/ de ltar na gtor ma kha gso/ byin rlabs/gospo'abul bshags pa yig brgya rnams khrigs chags su byas pa de lan bdun bya'o/ /drug pa slar yang bskang ba mchod bstod ni/ bskang rdzas/ a mṛ tas bsangs panasagazung / rnal 'byor bcol ba'i las mdzod cig /ces pa'i bar skang brgyasapa'akhya la/ yang gong du bskang ba byas zin na/ stobs wo shugs drag nas/ rnal 'byoraskyongaphyirabasnams su gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar du/ phyag mtshan dang rten phul/ oṃ mahākā lakwa la—159—

bi kā la ra tri ta sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ.arnya sogs nas shap+ta āḥsnyisnyibo'imathar/oṃ.āḥsnyi nang mchod phul/bar 'dir slob dpon rin r+sā rdo rjes mdzad zer ba'i bstod pa de tshad par snang ngo //rdo rje 'chang gis bka' bsgos pa'i//sogs dang /rgyalab kun sagasakyis kyang bstod de/de nas bar 'dir gtor bsngo gas dgos pa rnams dang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs btang ngo //des gtor ma sgrub pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga bstan zin to//gal te nyams chags shin tu shas che na/rdo rje sems dpa'i bum sgrub bam/grib sel gyibusasgrubagang yang rung ba smo byas la/rang gi snying gar snying rin po che pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kha gyen bstan/glo ba rin po che pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad kha thurabastan/kha sbyor bar mtshams med pa'i nang du/rtsa ba'i bla ma mi bskyod pa he ru ga'i rnamapa can du bzhugs/he ru ga'i yi ge brgya pa gang mang bzlas zhing /mthar/mahākā latsatur mu kha sa ma ya ma nu sogs mgon po'i yi ge brgya pa yang /nyi shu rtsa re sogasaji ltara'osapa bzlas nas/bum pa la dmigs te/oṃ bi shukhye swa bhā wa sdokhrezhehaṃ swā smashesakyangamangadu bzlas te/gtor snod rin po che'i gzhal yas khang du chos skyong 'khor bos bskyed nas/khrusachu gtor ma la sdugs shing /khrus gsol gyi 'don pa spyi dang 'dra bar bya'o//'di jo bo rjesamakho po seng sto gyi man ngag blangs pa yin no//de nas gtang rag dga' ston dpa' bo'i ston mo byasalamathar/dbang dang /rgyas pa dang /zhi ba spyi la bsdu na khang steng du/spyi stabs tsasagyisaphulakyang chog la/spro na khang steng du cho ga da ltar 'chad 'gyur ltar byas kyang rung ngo //yang lar nas zhi ba sogs yin kyang /dmigs gsal bzlog pa lta bu la gtor ma rnamasago mtshon rol mo dang cas pas khyer te/gnod byed kyi phyogs sam bzhi mdo sogs su me togashi tshom bu dgu bkod pa'i steng du stegs bu la bzhag/chu chang nang mchod kyis bran/spyan 'tho tshigs —160—

bcad rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa bya/ gdan 'bul dam bzhag /sngags ring gisagator mabasngo/mi rtog dbyings las thugs rje'i skur bzhengs shig nas/ gdong bzhi te se'i zhing skyong mdzad la bstod/ /mdog nag me'i dbus nas phyag bzhi pa/ /grithod ral gri mi rus phreng ba 'dzin/ /mkha' 'gro bzhi dang dregs pa'i 'khor gyisabaskor/ /g.yog dang bcas la gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdzogasapa'i sangs rgyas spyan snga n+dasga /zhes sogs bya/ 'di stabs gtor dgra phyogs su gtong btsamakayin pas/ sgo dbyer 'phrang sol gser skyems zor lam dbye ba sogs gal mi che la/ci ste sprosapal mos na/ gser skyems dang / lam sel cung zad byas kyang mi 'gal lo/ /thogamar spyi stabs bya ste/ hūṃ lha chen thugs kyi sprul pa drag shul can/ khrud gsum dbangasgyurazhingaskyong 'jigs pa'i sku/ khams gsum srog gi mnga' bdag yum chen bzhi/ /gsod byed dregs pa pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas/ /snang srid dregs pa sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyis gtor ma 'di bzhesashig khosasogs spyi dang mthun par sbyar nas rol chen yun ring du bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma dgra phyogasasu gtong na/ rol mo drag tu bskul wo / hūṃ bh+yoḥ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'ibagasabaskulazhing / /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i mthus/ /chos skyong srung ma'i dmagodapung 'gyed/ /bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ de ni dgra labh+yoḥ chos chos de ni dgra lachos/ /'aspo/nus mthu med byung srung ma'i gtso/ /gdong bzhi mgon po 'khor dang bas/ /rumatshon dgra bo'i yul du 'gyed/ /bh+yoḥ chos zhal bzhi'i klong nasatshe'abarazhing / /phyag bzhis 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha bsdigs/ /zhabs gnyis dor stabs bskyod bzhin du/ /bh+yo chos— yum chen bzhi'i dpung bsdus nas/ /nagamo—161—

'bol ba mthong //'di yang bla ma rdo rje slob dpon la//smod ṣ+ṭhabazhud pa'i sdig lta mkhan//las ngan 'byung pos mnar ba yang //'di yang skugasungathugs kyi 'gal rkyen la//spang bya mi mthun phyogs rnams dang //byad khathod gtong ma lus pa//'di yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog/bdag canayon mchod 'khor bcas la//gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa yis//byad khophurakhaganod pa'i tshogs//'di yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog/rmi ltasartsub cingamatshan ma ngan//mo ngan phyogs ngan lo skeg dang //rgyu skar ngan pa'i sbyorab rnams//'di yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog/mon mo bse'i rna chacan//lag na thun dang dug phye thogs//de ni ma mo'i rbod gtong ste//'di yang 0ha la nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs//rgyu rlon ga sha lus la thogs//de ni gshin rje'i rbod gtong ste//'di yang nam mkha' glog dang ser phran 'khrigag/ribo'i rtse nas thogs 'bab pa/de ni phur pa'i rbod gtong ste//'di yang stongagasum mig gis gang ba'i gzugs//'ur 'ur sgra sgrog mkha' labaskyod//de ni gza' mchog rbod gtong ste/'di yang — gtsug lag 'jig cing glegs bama'akhrur//sku gzugs g.yo zhing mchi ma 'dzag/de ni mu stegs thod gtongaste//'di yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog/mthu stobs dbang phyug lha yi lha/khyod kyis mi bzlog gang yang med//byad kha khrod gtong gnod pa'i chogs//thamasacad dmar chen gtor mas bzlog/bdag cag dpon slob 'khorabacasakyi//sngon las 'phran rkyen gyur pa yi//nad gdon mi mthun phyogs rnamasakun//bzlog sgyur 'phrin las gnyan po mdzod//ces pa'i mthar rtsa sngags dkyus mdag/—163—

bsad sngags ring thung gang rung dang bcas/gtor ma de nyid de gar dgra phyogs su rtse bstan nasa'ajog pa'am/yang na gtor stegs su bzhag go/yang denyid nas zor du 'phang pa'i lugasakyangayod/yang gtor ma'i snying po rtse mo dgra phyogs su bstan/gzhan rnams 'phen pa'i lugs kyanga'adug/gtor ma dgra phyogs su mi gtong ba'i phyogs la/drag bskulani mi dgos/spyi stabs kyimathar gtor ma'i snying po ma skyel bar 'theb kyu sogs thur lanyil du 'jug pa'i srol yod do//de nas/srid zhi'i dpal yon sogs dge legs kyi tshig brjod/nang du yong /tshang pa khagasos byin gyis brlabs/'jig rten khams kyi sogs gong bzhin las/'phrin 'thagasgrub phyir bzhes su gsol/spyo 'don pa spos nas mar pa 'bul/hūṃ yon tan myurardzogs dngos grub mnga' ba'i lha//ma lus med byung phan pa'i dgongs pa can//'phrin las rnam bzhis bdud dpung tshar gcod pa'i//legs ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'dud//mi rtog dbyings las thugs rjes skur bzhedasashig/'byung ba gur chen brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas nas//bde gshegs bka' yi srung ma dam tshig can//rdo rje nag po chen po dbyings nas gnos//dpalaldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur zhing //mche ba gtsigs shing mchu'achang shugs che ba//sgra sgrog dril bu'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa yi//gdongabazhi ldan khyod te se'i zhing skyong mdzad//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan snga mābastan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i//nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa//yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas//sha chen zan dang me tog spos//chang phud sha khragadagagisamachod//rgyal ba'i bstan pa skyong ba dang //bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub paramadzod//yig brgya/bzod gsol/rten la brtan bzhugs/mgron gshegs gsolarnams—164

bya'o//dam tshog pa rang la stim/smon lam dang /bkra shis rnams kyang bya'o//'di nyid dkyusakyigator skyong nyams len 'jam po'i lugs gtso bor gyur pa yin pas/yang yang sgrub na legs shing/de yang /nyin zhag mang por sbrel te/sgrubs na bzang bas zhag snga ma rnams la dngos gzhi'i sa bcad drug po rnams rdzogs par bya/khrus gsol nyin re bzhin byed mi byed skabs dngasbyar/thun gyi mthar/rjes chog ni/mchod bstod/gsol btab/yig brgya/bzod gsol/brtan bzhugs rnams bya/'di dag tu gtong mgron gshegs gsol mi dgos/smon lam dang bkra shis ji ltara'os pa'o//de dag ni gtor sgrub bam gtor skyong lag tu blangs ba'i rim pa mdo tsam du bzhad si to// //bkra shis//༄༅//gtor chen du grags pa zhes bya ba drag gtor bzhugs so//༄tsho//bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo//danigatorachen du grags pa//drag gtor 'phen bar 'dod na//rten rdo phyag mtshan dang bcas pa bshams dgos par 'dod kyang 'grub na ni bzang /mtha' gcig tu nges pa med/sa gzhi la gru gsum mthing nag me 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dgra bgegs kyi ling ga bris pa zhigardulatshon chu tshon gang rung gis 'bri/nyin rgyugs kyi gtor ma lta bu yod med pa dang /gnas kyi khyad par las 'bri stabs ma bde na/ras bris kyis kyang rung /de yang med na zhing lpags bting na mchog tu'agyur/stag sogs gcan gzan gtum po'i pags pas kyang rung ngo //de'i steng du stegasabumatho ba/lcags snod chen por 'bru sna lnga'i phye las/gtor ma chen po bca' ste/rgyu bre lngalasachungabs—165

mi rung zer/dbyibs thog lde lta bu dug khrag ro sol la sogs pas dmar nag tu byugs/khrimabazhi'i bshos bu byed pa'ang yod/mtha' 'theb kyu'i ra bas bskor/de la rtsang dang thod stugadangayungs dkar dang rgyu rlon gyi lda ldis brgyan/drag po'i rdzas kyi zas sna 'bru sna sna tshogs kyis byug/zan ling dkyus ma'am/sngags can nam/'khor lo can sogs gang yin kyang rung/mgogazhunabazlog la gtsugs/de yang gcig nges par dgos/ngos gsum la re re byas kyangalegs/khorayug tu rtsang nyi shu rtsa gcig dug khrag gis byugs pa yin/mdun du drag po'i mchod pa thams cad sgrengs tshar du bshams/sgrub pa po'i mdun du 'brub khung rtsigs pa'am bris pa gang rung spyi dang mthun par bya/rtsigs pa yin na kha la rtsang 'dzugs/der bag zan la bcos pa'i dgrabagegasakyiling ga bzhag/dmigs gsal yod na nang (〈rja〉rkang )rjes kyi sa bsre/skam thun rlon thun bshams lugs spyi dang mthun/rlon thun la dug ru byung na legs te nges pa med/gtorachen gyi rgyab phyogs ji ltar 'os par/snod lngar mtheb kyu dang sha dang /mkhur ba dang /sran btsosadaga'abru nag gi chan sogs/zas sna tshogs kyis gang ba bzhag/gtor chen gyi mdun phyogs gakapā la'am/zhal bu khrag dang /chang gis gang ba bgod/gzhan rten rdzas spyan gzigs sogasakyangargyas par bkod par bya'o//de nas cho ga'i rim pa la/sngon 'gro gtor ma/khasayo lga rlas/bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa/yi dam gyi mchod gtor rnams sngon du btang nas/mgon po'i mdun bskyed/dam tshig pa bskyed pa dang/ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa sngar bzhin byas lka'ajig rten khamasasogs kyi tshigs bcad la/dgra bgegs bsgral phyirabaces/sugasol//zhes 'don pa spo/oṃ mahā kā la tsa tu ra mu kha sa pa ri wā ra.arnya pratīts+tshanas/shap+ta āḥ& gi bar so so'i mthar sbyar la sngags dang phyag rgyar bcas pas 'bulgashap+ta'i skabs kyi rol chen ma gtogs 'di la rnga tshigs mi byed/de nas dam bzhag bya/bar 'dirasnying po —166

nye snying sngags ring rnams ci rigs pa bzla zhing / khyad par du 'di nyid kyi bsad sngags che chungagang rung zhig /nyer gcig tsam bzla'o/ /de yang / oṃ u tsa ṭa tsa ṭi swāhā dgra bo māraya hūṃphaṭa/ oṃ mahā kā la bi kā ra tri ta dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍo bi ni dgra bo māraya hūṃ phaṭa/ tsaṇ+ḍali dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ rak+ṣa si dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sing ga li dī bi dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sa i yaṃ dgra bo mā ra ya ཿphaṭa/ sakaralahi yaṃ dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sa hu baṃ dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sgrita gī lokyilaya dgra bo mā ra ya ཿphaṭa/ pi bhi sha na pa tā ya na maḥdagra bo mā ra ya ཿphaṭa/dgra bo che ge mo de bī ha na ha na/ bhan+dha bhan+ta/ ma ramar/ da ha da ha/ pa tsapa tsa/k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ le hi ba ling di hi sirnyi/ dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'o//bsad sngags ring ba ni/ oṃ u tsa ṭa tsa ṭaswāhā/ dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kā laka labibalha/ka rā la/ zhes pa nas/ ud ta ra bu ra/ zhes pa'i bar sngags ringabartsodanas/ dgra bo mār ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍom+bi ni dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa nas/ de hi sidhi dgra bo ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta dgra bo mā ra ya ཿphaṭa/cesapas/'dir bsad sngags ring thung zhes pa snying po la mgo 'dren dang sham bu btags pa dang / rtsa sngagasal mgo 'dren dang sham bu ma btags pa'i khyad par yin la/ ring ba'i nang na snying po'ang yod mod kyi/ rtsa sngags kyi 'jug sdoms sham bur sbyar ba yin no/ /de las gnyis ka bzla bar 'dod na/thung ba gtso bor bzla zhing / che ba zhar byung du bzla'o/ /gang ltar na'ang gtor chen gyi skabasa'adirabasad sngags gang rung zhig nges par bzla dgos so/ /de nas mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya'o//dngos gzhi la dang po gtor ma sngo ba ni nye snying gi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan bdun/ ḍilbi ni sogs btags pa'i snying po la lan gsum/ skyed sa yi yaṃ ba'ika ra la hi yaṃ ba/turba snyirtota —167

gī li gī la ya/bhi bhi sha na ba ta ye/zhes pa la a kā ro btagasapa lanagasum/de rjes rtsa sngags ring mo lan gsum mam/bdun gyis gtor ma 'bul ba ni khyad par ro//gnyesapabashags pa ni/yang mchod bstod bsdus pa cig byas la/yig brgya mang du bzlas/gong gtor skyong gi skabs su bshad pa bzhin/rtsa lhung sogs kyi bshags pa tshar gcig bya/gsum pa brten 'dzugs pa ni/g.yag nag lug nag phyi yi brten sogs dang /phyagamatshan 'bul ba yin la/bzhi pa mchod pa ni/dur khrod wo po'i gnas brgyad sogs mchod 'phreng yin/lnga pa bskang ba ni/lha mchog ma'i bskang ba rnams yin no//de nas/dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad ces pa nas/sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs//zhes pho b.ramachod 'phreng song nas/lha mchog mahā kā la mthu bo che/khyed la mthun pa'i zhesapanas/dag tshangs chen po mdzad du gsol gyi bar bskang bstod shigs pa rnamasasto/des na mchod bskang rgyas phyin chad/rtsis mgo gsum po de logs logs su khral te byed mi dgos/de kho na la tshang ngo //drug pa ling ga sgrol ba la/dang por bskul ni/rdzogs pa'i sangasargyasagasung dang ni//rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag nyid kyis//ji bzhin bsgo ba bsgrub pa dang //dam tshig chen po'i dam mnos la//drag po'i 'phrin las 'di sgrubasashig/las sbyor 'di yis myur du sgrol//gsod cig srog rtsa myur du ོ//thon cig snying rtsa myur du thon//chod cig mgo dang yan lag gas//grod cigakhadang pags pa khrol//zo zhig sha khrag khā raṃ khā hi//ma 'gyangs myuradu lasa'adi sgrubs//dpal ldan mgon po nag po che//rig 'dzin kun gyi srogashingache//gtsug lag khang gi srung ma che//bdud dpung 'joms pa'i dmag dpungache//dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma che//dug gsum nad kyi sman pa ske/rnala'abyor—168

yongs kyi dgra lha che//bstan pa bsrung ba'i mthu bo che//lus bong tshezhingadamatshig che//bdag gis bcol ba'i las 'di sgrubs//sangs rgyas bstanapa gnyan po srungs//bstan la gnod pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs//srog dngamyuradu phrol las shog/rdo rje bla ma'i sku dgra dang //bdag la gnod pa'i dgra bo rnams//gsod cig chod cig snying khrag 'thung //rgyob cig chom cigacingasalashog/thal ba rdul du rlog las shog/rul du chug la myags suchug/sdangab dgra bo'i yul rnams su//nad dang 'khrug pa mtshon gyi char//rgyun mi'achad par phob las shog/bcol lo bcol lo las bcol lo bcolaba'i lasalarel ma byed//rbad pa'i dus na rtsal ma zhan//bos pa'i dus na snyan masra//rnal 'byor bdag gi bka' la nyon//rig 'dzin bdag gi bka' 'dini//dpal ldan khyod la ri bas lci//bdag gis bka' la ma nyan na//bdagani rdorje 'cha wo gyi//dam tshig gis ni rdo rje yis/khyod kyi mgo bo lasaparabyed//de phyir dam bcas ma snyel bar//bcol ba'i las 'di myuradu sgrubagazhes rol mo drag tu bskul lo//bar du dgug 'dren ni/'brub khung gi dbus su ling gabadapa/'deb kha g.yas g.yon du bkod/ling ga bskyed chog ma byas kyang rung /dgug gzhugabyaste/guragyi mgon po'i dmar wo gtor mar bshad pa nyid la 'dor len byas pas khyab bo//sngags ni snying po'i mthar ā dar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes btags pas 'grub bo//de nas phud snod du chang ha thabakyu dang bcas pa blugs la/nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang bcas la rol mo bya/dbozhe mchog gsum po dgongs su gsol//mkha' 'gro srung ma dgongs su gsol//dam las 'das pa'i sdig can 'dis//rdo rje slob dpon sku la bsdos//theg pa —169—

wo po sun yang phyung //darkan mchog gsum gyi rten yang bcom//sasargyasabastan pa 'di yis bshig/gsang sngags chos la skur ba btab/temasacan yongs la 'tshe bar byas//rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi//dgeba'ibar chad brgyud mar byas//srung ba'i lha tshogs thams cad kyis//'di yi srungaskyob ma mdzad par//rang gshed rang la dbab par mdzod//rdo rje won pa'i bka' thos nas//'di yi srung stob lha rnamasadengs//zhes gtor te lingag lagagul sogs rdzas kyi dud pas bdug cing /sngags drag tu bzla'o//mthar bsgral zhing bstabapani/phyag mtshan bzhi rim pas spros te/dgra bgegs tshar bcad par bsam la/gri gug thogasate/stobs chen shugs drag gri gug rno//gdug pa sgrol phyir dgra la rgyob//gas 'dra ba las/stobs 'phrog nag po'i phyag nasabaskyed//ces 'don pa spo/snyingawa'i mas/ha na ha na ban+ta ban+ta da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa dgra bo 'di zhes bya bamāraya ཿphaṭa/ces ling ga la gri gug 'debs tshul bya/de bzhin du/rtse gsum/ral gri/mdungathungarnams la'ang sbyar/thun gnyis kyis grub/bsad sngags 'don zhing rol mo'i sgra bya/'di laphur bus 'debs pa'i lag len mi mdzad pa shas che mod/ling sgrol gyi mthar thug phur gdab yin pas byas na legs so//gang ltar yang de nas ling ga gtubs ling ro rnams gtor chen la bstagagator sngags drag tu bzla/mgon po spyi sngags yin pas shā sa na lan gsum tsam gyis kyang zhal du stab/sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje slob dpon dang //ye shes zhabasasogasabargyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs//yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lusapazhi/zhal du bstab po sha khrag khā raṃ khā hi//mthu stobs bsam gyis mi khyab dragashulacan//sangs rgyas stong gi bka' yi bya ra ba//'phrul ldan nag po cidaskyong—170—

stobs 'phrog gi /zhal du bstab po sha khrag khā raṃ khā hi/ /dgra bo'i mdangasadangagazi brjid zhal du bstab/ /'gal byed bla tshe bcud rnams zhal du bstab/ /gnod byed stobs dang srog dbugs zhal du bstab/ /lus ngag 'byung bzhi'i dwangs ma zhal du bstab/ /dpal ldan khyod kyi gzi brjid rgyas paragyur/ /sku'i stobs dang gsung gi nus pa dang / /'phrin las mthu rtsal thams cad rgyasaparashog /rgyas shing dam las ma mda' las kun sgrubs/ /yum chen g.yungamonagamo'i zhal du bstab/ /las mdzad gtum mo khros pa'i zhal du bstab/ kha byed srin mo chen mo'i zhal du bstab/ /gsod byed sing ga gling ma'i zhaladu bstab/ /sring gcig e ka tsa ti'i zhal du bstab/ /dbyings kyi ma mo'i tshogs kyi zhaladu bstab/ /sgrol gying bshan pa lnga yi zhal du bstab/ /bdud gcod gyingapo rnamasakyi zhal du bstab/ /bdud 'dul dmag tshogs rnams kyi zhal du bstab/ /dmag dpon gshin rje khro che'i zhal du bstab/ /wang gyi zhing skyong rnamasakyi zhal du bstab/ /dregs pa sdebargyad rnams kyi zhal du bstab/ /yulalha gzhibadag rnams kyi zhal du bstab/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi zhal du bstab/ /zhal du bstab po gzi brjid rgyas par shog /dgyes shingadamalasama'ada' 'phrin las sgrubs/ /bdun pa las bsal gyi sngon 'tsho bstod pa ni/ hūṃ rgyal ba kun gyi drag po'i 'phrin las pa/ /rngam brjid khros pa char sprin lta bu'i mdog /srid gsusadregasaldan yongs kyi gtsor gyur pa/ /gtum po gzi ldan dbang phyug khyod labarna/ /gangathugs spros pa ma lus nyer zhi yang / /ma rungs gdug pa 'dul phyir dragapo'i —171—

sku/ /zhal bzhi gdangasapas khams gsum za bar nus/ /rab 'jigasarnongaramache ba gtsigs la bstod/ /glog 'phreng lta bur g.yo ba'i ljags 'gril zhing//dbu skra smin ma me lce ltar 'bar ba/ /sdang mig g.yo ba'i spyan gsum bgrad pa las/ /dusamatha'i me 'od 'phro ba khyod la bstod/ /sbom thung ragasapa'i phyagabazhi g.yas gnyisakyis/ /dam nyams rdul du rlog pa'i mtshon cha /g.yon gnyis dang po thod pa khrag bkang dang / /'og ma rusa'aphreng 'changabaza las bzhi stsol ba'i bum pa mchan khung g.yon/ /byis pa'i gzugs can mamachu'aphyang ba po/ /zhabs gnyisabaskyod pas sa gsum 'gems par byed/stagalpags sham thabs bkra ba sku la rus rgyan dril bu tshangs skud dang/ khugasprul shin tu 'jigs pas sku brgyan zhing / /'jigs rung thod skam lnga yidabu rgyan dang / /thod tho do shal 'phyang ba khyod rab brjid zhal nasaha 'a rka rgyangs dang / hūṃ hūṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ drag po'i nga ro can/ /bskal pa'i me dpungaworaba'iklong dkyil na/ /rnam 'gyur du ma ldan pa khyod la — dpa' bo wo podekho dgyes byed yum/ /g.yung mo gtum mo srin mo seng gha li/ /nag ljangadamarasera'ajigs pa'i gzugs 'chang ba/ /las bzhi'i dbang mdzad sring mo bzhi labastod/ /gang gi bka' nyan mthu rtsal med byung bas/ /srog gcod lasakyi bshan pa nyi shu gcig /bstan la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs gsod la dpa'//rab gas gzi byin ldan pa rnams la bstod/ /log 'dren yongs kyi sroga'aphrog ma rungs gzugs/ /mtshon rnon du ma thogs shing rab khro ba/ /nyi khrichogastong drug brgya'i dmag dpung gis/ /rnam 'phrul gar gyi rol ba rnamasal—172

bstod//yang 'khor 'jig rten dregs pa lha tshogs rnams//rang ranga'aboratshogs du mas yongs bskor zhing //dam tshig can la bu bzhin skyong ba dang//gnod byed dgra bgegs tshar gcod rnams la bstod//gzhan yang dkarapo'i las la mngon dga' ba'i//dregs pa chen po sde brgyad lha tshogs rnamag/gsod byed mtshon cha sna tshogs lag tu thogs//mi srun tshar gcod rnamasal ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs pa'i//phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin mtha' yas kyis//lha mchog rnams la mngon par mchod byed na//dngosagrub ma lus ji bzhin stsal du gsol//gang yang bdag gi spyi dang khyad paragi/dam tshig nyams chags 'gal 'khrul la sogs pa'i//nyes pa ma lus snyinganasabashags bgyid na/ /thugs brtse ldan pas bzod par bzhes su gsol//gnas skabs kun tu bdag cag 'khor bcas la//mi mthun rkyen gyi rnamapa malus pa//dpal mgon 'khor dang bcas pas zhi mdzad cing //mthun rkyen bsam don chos bzhin 'grub mdzad gsol/khyad par rgyal ba'i bstan laganod pa dang //dpal ldan bla ma'i sku la mtho 'tshams shing //rnala'abyorabadag la gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams//rdul phran tsam yang med pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//ces pa bstod gsol zhes pa'o//brgyad pa drag tu bskul ba ni/bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba mnga' ris rtsad po dang mkhon pa'i tshemadzad par grags pa'i bskul ba rgyas bsdus 'dra min gnyis yod pa las/nyung ba 'di byed do//de yang /hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā la ya//sangs rgyas stong ṣ+kabastan pa srungab po/dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang stod pa po//bla ma dam pa'iskudagra —173

'dul ba po/ /dam tshig can gyi 'phrin las sgrub pa po/ /rang gi khas blangs dam bcas skyong ba po/ /rig 'dzin rnams kyi srog shing dam pa po/ /dmatshigango gyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ lha chen nag po'i las byed pho nya ni/ /sangasargyasabastan pa gnyan po srung ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje nag po mthu dang rtsal mchung/ /tshasapa'i gtsug thag gnyan po gcod pa'i tshe/ /rdo rje nag po 0 tshe srog bsto nasaklad khrag dkrug pa'i tshe/ /rdo rje nag po khong khrag dmar po shub kyisa'adebasapa'i tshe/ /rdo rje nag po bab gzhi bla rus dral nas za ba'i rmu /rdorje nagan rkang lag mgo gsum sosor phral ba'i tshe/ /rdo rje nag po bstan pa'i spyi dgra rtsad nas gcod pa'i tshe/ /rdo rje nag po dam nyams sdig can dgra larbad pa'i tshe/ khrag mthung nag po mthu dang rtsal ma chung / /las mkhan yumabazhi dgra bo'i sha la zo/ /phyogs skyong bcu ni nam mkha'i sprin ltar stibs/ /rgyal chen bzhiyi ru mtshon pur ru sa /dpal mgon bdun bcu'i 'bod sgra dir ri gi khragari'athung stong gi tshogs ni chems se chem/ /zhing skyong stong gi tshogs ni phungasasephung / /zhub chen stong gi tshogs ni shar ra ra/ /mkha' 'gro stong gi sgraskad ngarar ra/ /dam can stong gi tshogs ni zangs se zang / /bka' srung stongagitshogasani k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ/ /bdud dang srin po'i dung 'bud rums se rum/ /stag spyangasengage'i ngur sgra 'ur ru mā /bshang dang dang ka bya tshogs phungs se phung / khya nagakhagadangs mang po thibs se thib/ /lce spyang mang po'i rkan sdebs dir riri/ /minag ging gi 'o dod lhangs se lhang / /mon mo'i glu len mang po kyur rus /rgya gar mang po'i bro rdung chems se chem/ /bshan pa nag po'i gri skor lingasase —174

lings //mi nag zhags thogs mang po khrabs se khrab//mi nag rnga thogasamangapo khrigs se khrig/mi nag mtshon thogs mang po zings se zing //mchusderarnon po rnams ni thibs se thib//ma mo'i zor 'phen mang po shar ra ra//sngagasapa phur thogs mang po rongs se rong //nag po'i dmag sngos mang po nyer res/bskul lo bos so mahā kā la'i tshogs//thub pas sngags pa'i dam can lasalabh+yoḥdrag shul spyod pa'i cha byad las la bh+yoḥsmod pa ga sngagasamathi cha 0smra ba dug gi kha rlangs mu stegs 'dam bu'i glang chen srin po pho nya zhingaskyong dgra bgegs gshed po khrag 'thung — chos byed srung ma nag po snying ring bshan pa khrag 'thung mna' bzanagashed po nag po ngan byed gnyan po khrag 'thung rnal 'byor dgra lha nag mo nag po stong gi tshogs rnams ma mobye ba'i chogasarnams bdud dang srin po'i tshogs rnams las kyi bshan pa nyeragacigalasal bh+yoḥbadag la sdang ba'i dam nyams sdig can 'di//rgyob cig sregasashigatshos shig zhal du gsol//thul zhig bzung zhig chings shig dam por sdoms//lo dang zla bar bzhag pa'i skabs mede pas/khug cig sdoms shig chingasashigarnam par gtor//zhag dang za mar ma bzhag myur du sgrol//phye zhigabaskod cigaganon cig rmugs par gyis//thul cig choms shig rengs shig rnam paragashig/sku gsung thugs kyis gtad la ma g.yel cig/gsod cigachod cigasrog rtsa myur du chod//dgra bgegs rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod/sha chen khrag la rol cig shub kyis drongs//ma thogs myur du sgrol cig gsasalagasol//bcol ba'i las rnams mdzod cig sa mā ya/khrag 'thung rgyalapo —175

'khor dang bcas pa rnams//bsten pa'i tshe na chosaskyong rgyang ma ring //bstan pa'i spyi dgra yal bar ma bor zhig/bosapa'i tshe na mgon po snyan masra//glama'i sku dgra yal bar ma btang cig/g.yabs pa'i tshe na mgon po spyan mabatul//chos kyi sgra 'di yal bar ma btang cig/rbad pa'i dus na dmacan mthu ma chung //rnal 'byor dgra 'di yal bar ma btang cig/mdor na riga'adzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/khyod la yang yang bskul kyang dgosapa med//bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba'i sdig can 'di//ma thogs myur du sgrolaba'i dus la bab//ces skula'adi skabs thams cad langs te byed/de nas stan la 'dugaste sngags ring ji ltar 'os pa bzla'o//dgu pa gsol ka ni/hūṃ mgon po'i mtshan gsol dpal ldan nag po che//rgyal ba'i bstan srung bka'i phyag brnyan mchog/gdug pa tshar gcod dragashulamathu rtsal che//bdud 'dul dpa' bo bdag la dgongasasu gsol//'dod yon rgya che'i gtor ma rgya mtsho dang //longs spyod sna tshogs zhal zas mchod pa 'di//dpal ldan nag po chen po'i zhal du 'bul//dgyes pa'i tshulagyisamachod gtor 'di bzhes la//sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan po nyer dgongasate//rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi//mi mthun nod pa'i rkyen rnamasazhi ba dang //'dod pa'i don rnamasa'agrub par mdzad du gsol//gnasalasman phud dang rak+ta sgrengs/zas sna sna tshogs kyis gtor ma dang po de/shar du rim pas blugasate/gtor sngags shugs phyung lag gsum brjod/mthar/hoḥdapal mgon po nagapo dugagasum gyi sman pa/rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/bdud —176

'dul gyi dbang phyug/mna' bzan gyi gshed ma/dam nyams kyi srogagacod/dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dpa' bo/bstan srungasakyi mnga' bdag chen po/'khor pho nya las mkhan g.yog 'khor grangs las 'dasashing brjod du milang ba rnams kyi zhal du 'bul lo//gsol lo//mar do//mas no//tshad pa dam pa bzhes su gsol/dam rdzas bdud rtsi'abar ba 'di bzhesal/bdagacag dpon slob yon mardzo 'bror dang bcas pa rnamasakyi nad dang gnod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byorathamasacad rgyas par mdzad du gsol/mi dang mim yin pa'i 'gro ba thams cadadabangadu bsdu bar mdzad du gsol/bar du gcod pa thams cad thal ba rdul du rlagapar mdzad du gsol/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs shig/dkon mchogagodabu 'phang bstod cig/dam chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan phyor zhig/bsasapa thams cad sgrubs/re ba thams cad skongs/snyan pa'i grags pasaphyogasathams cad khyab par mdzod/khyad par du yang deng drag po'i 'phrin las 73 par zhu ba lags kyi/bstan pa la sdang ba'i dgra bgegasalog 'dren byad ma'adi dag/skad cig nyid la bsad pa dang /bskrad pa dang /dbye ba dang/rengs pa dang /bcings pa'i sgo du ma nas 'khor dang bcas pa dang/grogasadag bcas pa dang /srung skyob dang bcas pa thams cad thal ba rdul du rlogapa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig/ces pa'i mthar/bsad sngags ring thung gang rung zhig tsharagatsekagam gsum brjod/de kho na'i rim pas/slar yang /hūṃ mgon po mtshan gsolakhor chad/bsad sngags kyi bar gsolaka las bcol bskulab 'di tshar lnga bya ste/gtor r+ṣa gyi lho—177—

dang /nub dang /byang la re re dang /mtshams bzhi lagacig rnams so//de nas bcu pa zor 'phang ba ni/'phyar dar nag po dang /dam rdzas kyi dud padang/gsoraskyems sogs kyis sna drangs te/spros pa ladaga' na pho nya las mkhan gyi cha byad 'dzin pagobragapo'i rol rtsed ci rigs pa dang cas shing /go mas thogs pas kyang mtha' bskor/slob dgo 'khor cas rol mo ba dang sas pas rting mnan nas 'ongs te/gtor wo stegs mtho b.labazhag/zor sna rnams dang /thun rnams kyang bshams/skabs 'dir gzu dpanga'adzugs te/hūṃsrid pa'i rtse mo man chod nas//dmyal ba na rag yan chod du//gzudangadapangal dkon mchog bzhugs//yi dam chosaskyong dpang mdzod cig/zhal bzhi yab yum dpang mdzod cig/tshangasapa brgya sbyin—gza' dang rgyu skar dbangacen khyab 'jug lha srin sde brgyad g.ya bdun rgyal po man chad nag/'tshengabyed zhags thogs yan chod du//do nub gzu dang dpang mdzod cig/skyesabu klubatsan man chad nas//drag dmar btsan rgod yan chod du//do nub srid pa'i rgyal mo man chad nas//'gong po spun dgu yan chod du//do nub dbyingasaphyug rgyal mo man chad nas//dam sri pho mo yan chod du//do nub:zhalartselha 'dreyongs kyis chod/kha smra srung ma gnyan gyisathob//nga yis ma nyes 'di yisanyes//dam la 'das pa'i sdig can 'di//bstan pa bzhig cing darkan mchonasmod//srung ma khyod la snyad btsugs so/ /sngags 'chang bdag la do yangabados//rgyal khamasaphung bar 'dis yis byas//mkha' 'gro srungamaramada' log/sdang byed dgra bo dam nyams 'di'i//gnam gyi 'ju ponagabochod//sayi brten phur nag po phud//las kyis rlung gis rgyab nas phul//'jigasapa'i —178—

mun pas mdun nas gsus/khod pa'i nang nas snying byung cig/dpralaba'i dbyings nas mig brus shig/ltag pa'i phyogs nas bdud chod cig/lo dang zla bar ma bzhag cig/myur bar khug la rings par sgrol//ces go/de rjesagagloskyems dang /zor lam dbye ba sogs spyi dang mthun par bya/spro na slar yang /dpalaldan mgon po mahā kā ya//sogs kyis kyang 0la lo//mthar/dpal ldan rdorje 'amapaṣ+kabaka' nyan pa//dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs sprul pa//gtusapo khraga'athung skye 'gro'i srog gi bdag/zhing skyong nag po wo po las la ya/sgro kyi 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab te//gang 'dul sprul pa ma thogs cir yangaston//bdud dpung dgra bgegs 'dul bar chas pa'i tshe//mkha' lamibazad i rum dmar nag 'khrigs//rdo rje'i thogs dang ser wo phyogasabacur 'bab//'ur 'ur sgra yis ri bo'i tshogs rnams bsgyel//phyogs mtshams thams cad me 'bar khrochu 'bab//sa gzhi sdig sprul srog chags gdugapasakhyab//stag seng gcan gyi tshogs rnams lang long rgyu//gsod byed sgri po'i tshogs kyis sa steng khyab/khrag 'thung ma mo'i tshogs kyis bar snangakhengag/nyi zla gza' skar khros pas mkha' dbyings khyab//mtshon cha'i bu yug phyogasabacurabun nu nu//dgra tshogs da lta 'joms pa'i dus la bab//bstan pa 'jigapa'i dgra bo 'di//rings par song la drag tu ded//myur bar song la dam du chis//mgyogs par khug la nges par gsod//gri gug 'bar bas dgra srogachod//ral gri 'bar bas yan lag gtubs//mdung thung 'bar bar lusakun phug/rtse gsum 'bar bas sgo gsum drol//nag po wo po sku bskyod cig/zhings—179

chen po rtsal ma zhan//stobs 'phrog nag po mthu ma chung //zhal gdangasadragapo'i bshugs pa 'tsher//g.yung mo nag mo dgra la ya//gad rgyangasar+pā posadagra snying 'gems//mi srun gtum mo dgra la ya/khrag rgyun gsol bas myos pa mo//srin mo 'jigs rung dgra la ya//skye gnas nad yamasan bun mthul//sing ga gling ma dgra la bh+yoḥ/dam nyams dgra laspyo 'bog gtong //bshan pa sngon po dgra la chos//dgra la nang 'brug thog ser 'bebs//bshan pa serapo dgra la chos//bstan pa 'jig pa nad kyisa'adebs//bshan pa dmarapo dgra la chos//'gal byed mi phyugs phyogasakyis 'debs//bshan pa ljangakhudagra la chos//srog gcod rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab//bshan pa nagapo dgralachos//ling pa wo po khyed rnams kyis//do nub dgra bgegasachosalaphob/yum cig e ka dza ṭi ni//ral pa gcig gis khams gsum khyab//dbangaphyugawo mo mthu rtsal can//dgra bgegs snying la da zo cig/gzhin rje khromolusapo che/khab mig tsam la'ang rtag tu 'jug/sde brgyad yongs kyi dmanadapon te//bi nu rā dza dgra la ya//srid pa'i rgyal mo mu kha le//stongagasumabha ga'i dbyingasasu 'jugakhyab byed sna tshogs gzugs can ma//bdud 'dulachen modagra la bh+yo:/bshan pa nyi shu rtsa gcig kyang //mthong ba tsam gyis sdangasaparabyed//do nub dgra bo'i yul du chos//dgra bgegs thal ba rdu5du zlog/sgosapa dung gi thor tshugs can//'bor byed wo po dgra la ya/khragabadagaganam lha byang tso ste//spyo byed wo po dgra laya//skyes bu gying ོ dgra lhakhyod//cho 'phrul ltasangan dgra la ya//nag po 'bum phrag drugalachogs//—180—

zhing skyong mthu chen bsam mi khyab//do nub dgra bo'i yul du chos//lhag ma med par choms las zhog/dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad rnams//drag po'i lasald bskul gyi//dmag dpung skyed la ru mtshon phyor//dgra bgegs thalab rdulabazhin rlag par mdzod//lhag ma ci yang ldangs rgyu med par mdzod//sastenga'adi ru ming yang med par mdzod//dam pa dus labab po sa mā ya//zhoyogatuskral la/ḍo bi ni de bi bh+yoḥ(zor 'phangs/tsaṇ+ḍa lis ra zor dang / ra kha(〈rja〉rak+ta )sis khrag zor dang /sing ga lis mda' zor dang /de thams cad la/mahā kā lathun bh+yoḥzhes pas rgyab brten/bsad sngags drag tu bzla zhing thun 'phang ngo /hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po'i bka' 'khor ni//nag po'i dmag tshogs nyer re re/sha za'i saskad dir ri ri//ma mo'i zor 'phen shar ra ra//mkha' 'gro'i shugs klurtserares/lha mo'i glu dbyangs kyur ru mā/mi nag gar byed khyugs se khyug/ro 'angasagad rgyangs dir ri ri//keng rus gar byed zangs se zang //bya nag mngapo thibasasothib//lte sbyang ngu 'bod lhangs se lhang /khyi nag mang po khengasasekheng/rnama'aphrul du ma ston pa rnams//la la 'gying zhing dgra la rol//lala'aphyongazhingabagegs rnams 'joms//la la hab chub khrag la 'thung //la lathode cingarol za//la la chem chem rus pa mur//la la 'gying zhingadagra rnamasagasod//lal rgyug cing dam nyams sgrol//sdig can chos la sdang ba 'di//bdud kyikhasal thob la shog/sho sde nag po khrom la shog/zhags pa dmar nag thob lasashogakhyod kyis khas blangs dus la bab//dmar kyi gtor ma 'dis bzhes la//bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bo 'di//bdun brgyud rtsa nas chod la shog/oṃXhā—181—

kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta/ ḍi bi ni/ tsaṇ+ḍali/ rak+tagi ringagazhi de bi bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ a ya ma ru ru tsasha na bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ go pa dang / bsad sngags g.yo bsgo ṣ+ṭhagator ma zor du 'phang / dgra bgegs phyogs gtogs yul 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad lhagam tsam yang med par byas par bsam/4rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas pas mtshams bcad de/slob dpon gyi rting mnan la'ongs/ rjes kyi bya ba ni gong gtor sgrub kyi skabs su bshad pa dnga'adra'o/ /'dir cung zad nges 'tshal pa la/ sgrub skor rnying pa khungs ma phal cher du/rnam 'gyuragasum pa nyid bshad de/ de yang bsnyen dus ni gtor chog dkyus kyi de yin/ 'di la rtsazhal brtsegs ma nyid nag po la 'dzol so med/ g.yas g.yon gnyis ljang nag bya ba la/ phyisakyiphalacher ljang lanag pa'i mdangs can du mtshungs par bzhed/ yi ge rnying pa rang mang po na/g.yasasngo g.yon ljang du bshad pa'ang 'dug /sgrub pa dang las sbyor gnyis phal cher rnam 'gyur 'dra b.rabyed/ spogs chog la g.yas brtsegs ma gnyis nag po/ g.yon brtsegs ma gnyis ljang khurabashad/de ga'i dbang du byas nas skabs 'dir gtor ma'i las sbyor yin pas/ las sgrub gnyis po rnama'agyur gcig pa'i phyir dkyus la de bzhin du bris pa yin/ kha cig las sbyor dang spogs chog rnamasa'agyur gcig par bzhed de/ de la'ang 'gal ba ma mthong ngo / /'ga' zhig rnam 'gyur bzhi par 'dod pa ltar na/ gzhan gsum spyi dang 'dra/ las spyor mgon po zhal bzhi'i 'khor zhaladu'adod do/ /'on kyang sgrub pa'i bya ba ni/ thog ma bsnyen pa'i phyogs la yang 'jug /phyi ma lasasbyor gyiphyogs la yang 'jug pas/ kun khyab yin pa'i phyir sgrub nus nyid gtso bor bya'o/ /zhesabadagacanagi bla ma dam pa rnams gsung ngo // //de ltar na nag po gdong bzhi pa'i gtor ma'i las rim zhi drag nyer mkho tsam gsalabar brjod pa/ las bzhi lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang / rang gi slobarigs me 'bar gyi gtsunalag—182

khang sgrub gnas byang chen gyi dge 'dun rnams sogs don gnyer can mang pos snga phyir yang yang bskul ba la brten nas tā ra nā thas zhor byung du bris pa'o//'di dag la yig rnying rtsa ba rnams/thoyig tsam las med cing /bar skabs dang phyis kyi yi ge ci rigs 'dug pa rnams/tshig chogs ha cang ches bas gzung dka' bar 'dug pas 'dir mdor bsdus tsam tshig zor yang bar bkod pa yin no//hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dang /skṛ skṛ sil sil ngom ngom rang byed mkhan cig ma lags pa/'di 'dra rigs la rtsala'adon rang med mod//'on kyang man ngag cung zad rig cing /gas kyis bskulabal brten nas bag tsam zhig bris pa'o//dge legs 'phel/zhus dag༄༅//lha chen lcam dral gyi ba thabs dgra bgegs kun 'joms sa bya ba bzhugs so//༄༅//na mogu ru mahā kā lā ya/rab 'jigs dregs pa 'dulamadzadadas bo zhekhrisal bu gcig ltar brtse dngos grub stsol//bla ma dang ni nag po chen po la//gus pas gas nasagator ma'i cho ga bshad//'dir bris sku dang mardzo gtor bshams/bdag bskyed dang yi dmagyi mar gtor sngon du 'gro bas 'di skad ces bya'o//oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na hūṃphaṭa/oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dhi3nya/stong pa'i ngang lasarangagi mdun du sting bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor/dur khrod r+pā po'i ༅gshin tu gtum pa'i ljongs/dregs pa bdud kyi yul/dug gi na bun 'thulab/drag po'i glog 'byug cing /rgyob sod kyi 'brug sgra sgrog pa/gnamalcagasakyi —183

thog dang mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi ser ba 'bab cing /ma mo 'du ba'i gnas/mtshan mo me 'bar ba/nyin mo rlung nag 'tshub cing /na bun rnagakhragadangazhagatu 'bab pa/miro skam lhun rid gsum sna tshogs bcal du bkramazhing/khragazhag gi rba klong 'khrug pa/gcan gzan gtum po rnams ngar skad 'bod pa'i dbus na/rmangs gzhi lcags las grub pa'i steng du/shar mi'i thod pasabartsigs pa/lhor rta'i thod pas brtsigs pa/nub spre'u'i thod pasas pa/byang lug gi thod pas brtsigasapa'i pho brang wo po/phyi rin po tsho gzhalayasakhang la/nang thod pa'i mkhar du yod pa/gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa shin tu'ajigasashing rab tu 'bar ba/zur bzhi zangs la byas pa/sgobazhi bse lasabyasapa/gser gyi re cha gsal ba/mu min 'phrul gyi g.yag shing can//rta babs dung la grub pa/zangs lcags kyi khrag gi bang yod pa/nang ke rus kyi kagadungarnamasakyis phub pa/rus pa'i drwa ba drwa phyed dang /mi mgo brtsigs pa'i togagisams pa/ngos rnams la khrag gi zar chu 'bab pa/de'i nang mi rorta robamaradu bkram pa/mi khrag rta khrag mtsho ru bskyil ba/milpags rta lpagasayolabarabres pa/gsur chen dud pa phyogs bcur 'thul ba/phyi rol rmangagazhi'i stegasabu la ro langs kyisashon byed pa//keng rus kyi gar mkhan 'khrab pa/phyogasathams cad du zhing chen gyi bla bre/mi ro'i rgyal mas dang ba dan/rgyu rlon gyi snyenaldi/mgo bo sna tshogs kyi do shal dang //skra'i rnga yab la sogs pa nyasangalabag tsha ba'i rgyan dang ldan pa'i pho brang gi lte bar nag po bdun brtsegs mkhar zur drug pa la mthing bzang g.yu'i skas btsugs pa'o//de'i dbus su mthing—184

nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor la rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du mi ro rta ro la gnas pa'i raṃ las dug sdong raṃ gyis mas pa las 'od 'phros/dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa lasalha chen dpal 'bar mahā kā la srog bdud nag po thod pa'i phreng ba can sku mdog smug nag bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ zhal gnyis phyagabazhi pa/ g.yasashwa na mu kha'i gdong shel mig gyen du phyogs pas dgra bgegs la zug cing bla 'gugs pa/ zhal gnyis rka'ang mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'grikhi/zhidarkan rgyosdeb pa/ ཿphaṭa kyi gad mo dang nga ro drag po sgrog pa/ phyag g.yasaganyisakyisadung gi sdong po me 'bar ba dang bdud zhags/ g.yon gnyis kyis khram shingadangathod pa snying bcas khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsumasdang mig tu bsgrad pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang skra khams nag gyen du brjesapa lasprul nag dang dar nag gi cod pan can/ mimago skam po lngas dbu labargyan cing / rlon pa khrag 'dzags pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'chang ba/ dug sprul stong gi chun pos brgyan pa/ sku la dar nag gi 'jol ber sum brtsegs mun pa'i g.yungadrungaris dang gser gyi ska rags can/ de'i steng na dred mo'i bcang slag seng gosngon po'i gong lag can gsol ba/ zhabs la sag ti'i lham gyon pa/ snyan nasa'abrug stong ldir zhing / dri 'dzin nas nag po brtsegs pa'i rlung dmar ldangab/sdang mig las me 'od spro zhing / zhal du sha khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil ba/ sgodagunas nyams pa la dug gi char sprin 'bebs pa/ spyibo la nyi zlasabargyan pa/ sku che la yan lag rags pa/ khams gsum 'dar zhing skrag par byed pa/ dgra —185

bgegs dang log par lta ba thams cad skad cig gis rdul du rlog pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du bh+yoḥlas ral gri bh+yoḥs mtshan pa zhu ba las dpal ldan lha mo gnyan gyi re ma tī sku mdog nag mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ zhal rasaphyirgyasalcophyogasapas gzigasapa/ miro zhal du gsol bzhin pasamatsheb gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral ba dmar ser g.yon ngos su 'gyerab/ phyagagayas gnyis na zhing chen dang ral gri sdig pa'i yu ba can me 'bar ba/ g.yon gnyis na ne'u le'i rkyal pa nor bu'i char 'bebasapa dang / thod pa khragagisagang ba 'dzin pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang / tho pa'i do shalas/ snyan g.yas g.yon la dug sprul dang seng ges brgyan pa/ zhal nasadrag sngagasakyi 'o dod 'bod cing / mig nas khrag gi char pa 'bab pa/ shangs nasand kyi na bun 'thul ba/ lteba'i thad ka nas nyi ma 'char zhing / spyi po'i gtsug tu zla ba rgyas pa/mi lpags kyis stod g.yogs shing / re ldesasmad dkris pa/ sprularigasabazhi'i ska rags bcings pa/ zhabs la dbang gi lcags sgrog 'brol ba/ srin po'i bongabu gwa dmar la chibasapa/ nad kyi rkyal pa martson gyi gru gu byang dmar gyikhresapo/sho rde'u dkar nag bdud kyi khram bam ste sprul pa'i mtshon cha lnga dang bcas pa/srin po'i ya 'khal la snga ru dang ma 'khal la phyi ru byas pa/ gong smed sbrulalasabagyis shing rak+ta'i rgya mtshor rgyu ba/ yab yum gnyis ga'ang me dpung rab tu'abar ba'i dbus nas bzhugs pa'o/ /zur drug tu bh+yoḥdrug las sprul pa pho nya mon mo shwa na nag mo drug skad cig gis grub pa ni/ gser mig ma/ dngul mig ma/ zangs migam/ zhabaramig—186

ma/ g.yu mig ma/ mchong mig ma rnams khyi'i gdong can zhal gcenaphyagaganyisam sku mdog nag mo g.yas rdo rje nam mkha' la gsor zhing / g.yon zhagasapa nag po 'phen pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan can/ ral pas rting paraslebasapa/phyag rgya bsgyur zhing gar byed pa/ khyi skad 'don zhing ri rab bskorab/ lhangalhangangu zhing dur khrod nyul ba/ byang phyogs kyi gnod sbyin r+ṣa po brgyad ni lcagasakyi bya khra brgyad du sprul nas sngon la ldeng bas snga dgra dar ba rdul du zlog pa/ lhophyogs kyi gshin rje wo po brgyad ni/ stag/gzig /dom/ dred/ porab/seng ge /ce spyang / khyi rnams su sprul nas phyi bzhin du 'breng bsaphyi dgra semasapa rdul du rlog pa'o/ /phyi bskor du sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa bdud pho seng ge'i gdong can gsum dang ri bdun dang ma bdun las byung ba'i sprul pa'i mon pa pho bdun mobadun rnams dang / gzhan yang sprul pa dang yang sprul gyi tshogs rnams dang/bdud kyi dmag nyis khri chig stong / lha dmag 'bum sde dang bcasashing/ lha tshasrin sde brgyad rnams dang bcas pa thams cad kyang gcer bu 'dab chags thang la bor ba ltar 'dar med yed 'dug pa thams cad kyang sgrub pa po'i bka' sdod par gyur/ rang gothugs ga'i hūṃ las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis rang bzhin gyisaganas nas mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan ras gzigasamagon thugs kyi 'phrin las las/ /rnam 'phrul zhi bas 'dul bar mispyod cing / /drag po'i stobs kyis gdug pa tshar gcod pa/ /'jigs pa'i gzugasacan khyod ni 'dir byon cig /lha wo thugs kyi pho nya mthu bo che/ rna kyi rnam—187—

'phrul phyogs bcu ma lus khyab//yab gcig rtag tu 'dod rgyal khang bzangan//phal cher u tsa la yi dur khrod na//res 'ga' bsil ba'i tshal na srin po'i gzugs//da lta tsa ri rong gi pho brang na/khyod kyi brten sa rtsub tsā'i bragaphugan//rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa'i rjes 'brang zhing //gang gis brgyasaba'i las rnams sgrub mdzad pa//drag po dbang phyug gzi ldan 'dir byon cigakhron tshe phyag na rdo rje'i spyan snga mā/trakad khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangasabasnya/tagapo'i las la gnasa'adir spyan 'dren gyi//sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyiragashegs su gsol//e h+ya hi mahā kā la trasgad sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mādzaḥ.arnya nas/shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/'bru gsum gyi nang mchod phul/hūṃ lha min dmagatshogs g.yul bzlog cing //lha dmag dkar po'i dbug 'byin pa/snya chen dpal 'bar 'khor bcas la//mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal//gobastod la/dzaḥsnyi baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/slar yang 'od 'phrogarigasalnga 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ.o badzibha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes dbangabaskur/sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso 'khor thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/oṃ shrī mahākā latrakad mahā kā la sirnyi tri yaṃ dun dza dzaḥgo dpal mgon po dang /ororurorutsapa la a shug me ma 〉ma bh+yo dzaḥdzaḥgo dpal lha mo'i sngags so//de nas gosamosatsesbyangs/stong pa nyid du gyur/stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung /raṃlasame'i stengadu kai las mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum/de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkaralanang dmar ba'i nang du bi mu shu ma ra las bdud rtsilnga/go ku da ha na lasasha lnga —188—

bskyed/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyisamadun gyi nam mkha' la rdo rje hūṃ dngabacas par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yog rlungagisatshesbar ba'i sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi ge dang bcas pa zhu zhing khol bas lha ba oṃ du gyur/ de las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pasaye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkuganagade la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥsnyi gagatso/rdorjethalamo kha yo du phye la/ mgon po yab yum 'khor bcas kyi ljagasagatoramabadud rtsi'i rang bzhin can la reg cing gsol bsatshim zhing mnyes par gyur/ yomahākā la tri yaṃ dzaḥ sa ma ya sa ma lo ki ni mun bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa bā liṃ i rda grihā kha khyakhyahi khā hi bhuñdza ho/ rak+ta pi ba to sa ma ya swāhā/ oṃ de wi mahā kā li re ma ti mahā bā ling ta khā hi/ mahā mang sa kha hi/ rak+ta khāhi/ tsit+ta la khā hi/ mahāgorotsan lakhyashimahā palha sam mṛ ta bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul la/ dpal ye shesakyi mgon po mahā kā la rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ bdud 'dul gyi dbangaphyugadug gsum gyi sman pa/ rig 'dzin gyi srog shing / gtsug lag khangadangadakyila'abor gyi srung ma/ lha'i ded dpon wo po/ srog bdud nag po go pa'i phrengab can bā ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig kha raṃ khā hi/ dpal ldan gnyan gyire ma tī/ bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ nag mo dre'u lanyon pa/ ga'imobong bu la chon pa/ 'grogs ma rlung la zhon pa/ bā ling rgyan gyi gtorama'adi bzhes shig kha raṃ khā hi/ gzhan yang 'khor gyi mon mo drug /byang phyogasakyi gnod sbyin wo po brgyad/ lho phyogs kyi gshen rje wo po brgyad/ sprulapayangasprul pho nya 'khor gyi dmag nyis khri chig stong sde brgyad dang bcas pa thams cad —189

bā ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig kha raṃ khā hi/oṃ shrī mahā kā la ga na pa ti yak+ṣa be+e ta li sa pa ri wā ra arnya nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/yabayulagyisnyinga'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar nas nang mar phul/hūṃ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gigakhrinasbyon srog bdud ma rung pa//mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thabs kyi gtso//drag po'i zhal la gtum pa'i sku//rdo rje mahā kā la ste//lha chen lcam dral spyan 'dren gli/gnasa'adir mchod kyi gshegs su gsol//srog gi bka' sdod mgon po'i sku/khrin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can//tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste//grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jigs par byed//gas po khyod la bdag gos do//mdog nag gzugs chen brjid pa la//ral pa khams nag gyen du 'khyil//steng gi lha tshogs dbang du bsdud/khros bas zhabs brdabs sa gzhigayo//'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab sgyel//dbang phyug che la bdag bstod do//g.yas pa dug sdong bdud zhagasabasnams//g.yon pa thod pa snying bcasagasol//dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa'i//dam tshig can labadagabastod do//las kyi srog bdud wo po ni//bdud rta nag po rting dasa'achibs//sku che yan lag rags shing brjid//spyan dmar zhal gdangasaljags 'gril zhing //sku la ber nag smug po gsol//sag ti'i lhamalapad zhi'i gdan//bskal pa'i me dpung nang na 'gying //mthu stobs tso labadagabastod do//'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi//dus gsum sangs rgyasathamasaro kyi//bstan pa bsrung bar thugs bskyed pa//nag po khyod ni yin pa ste//gangazhig dkon mchog gsum po dang //bla ma brnyas byed sems can 'dze/bdag—190—

la gnod byed dgra dang bgegs/ /thams cad khyod kyisagazhom pa dang/ /bstan pa bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ /nad dang gnod pa zhi ba dang/ tshedangabasod nams 'phel pa dang / /thamasacad dbang du bsdu ba dang / /mimathun phyogs rnams gzhom pa yi/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi khyod kyis bgyig /rgyan gyigator ma 'di long la/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /spyo mayi nang nasam gcig ma/ /sring gi nang nas sring gcig ma/ /dpalaldan gnyan gyi re ma tī/ /bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ /lha yiganasan lha monamagrum//klu yi gnasan klu mo glog 'gyu ma/ /srin po'i gnas na srin moshamashamago /mi yi gnasan bdud mo re ma tī/ /mi la bdud du khyod las che ba med/ /gnasani byang shar mtshamasan gnas/ /rgyu ni bar snang mkha' la rgyu/ /skye'agro yongasakyi dbugs 'cha' ma/ /rkang la lcags kyi lham gyon ma/ /sku la mdzesapa'i reldegasol/ /mi mgo rta mgo mkhar du brtsigs/ /thod pa dgu brtsegasagazhalayas 'dir/ /ma cig lha mo spyan 'dren no/ /do nub nam gyi gungastod la/ /mingapo rdo rje las 'chol gyi/ /sring mo dam can las mdzod la/ /brnagapa'i lasarnams grub par mdzod/ /bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /sgrub pa'i tshenazoramanyi// sbad (rbadakapa'i tshe na mthu ma chung / /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di longal/ /bcomoba'i las rnamasagrub par mdzod/ /hūṃ srog bdud nag po chen po yi/ /badzin nyan sgrol byed ma mo drug khyi mo nag mo shes rab gsal/ khro chu'i zhal la rdo rje'i sku/ /ri rab bskor zhing rdzu 'phrul 'gyed/ /lhang lhang ngu zhing durakhrod nyul/ /sdig can sgrol ba'i mthu mo che/ /bdud kyi bu mo las la ya/ khyi monagamogaser—191—

mig ma/khyi mo nag mo dngul mig ma/khyi mo nag mo zangasamigam/khyimonagamo mkhar mig ma/khyi mo nag mo g.yu mig ma/khyi mo nag momachongamigam//bdud kyi bu mo khyed drug kyang /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la//nyamasapa'idagra bgegs sgrol la shog/bsad rtags don snying khyer la shog/b.raho sol la mthun rkyen sgrubs//bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod//mon monag mo shel mig ma//mon mo nag mo gser mig ma//zangasamigam/g.yu mig ma/dngul mig ma/lcags mig ma/mon mo nag mo bse mig ma//mon mo wo mo khyed bdun yang //sha khragaḥsogs gong bzhi/hūṃ mon pa nag po byi lazhon//mon pa nag po 'brug la zhon//sbrul la thon/glogalas/stagalazhon/khyung la wo/rlung la lko/bdud kyi bshan pa lko bdun yang/gakhrag sogs gong bzhi/gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul dang //phyogasabazhi'i ru'adren dmag gi tshogs//bdud pho nyisakhri chig stong dang //lha dmanadagarapo 'bum sde'i tshogs//gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad rnams/sha khrag sog5kyisabaskulazhing 'phrin las bcol/thun gyi gtor ma med na 'jug gi cho ga bya'o//gal te sa gtorayod na/skabs 'di nyid du gtong ste/hūṃ srid gsum dbang bsdud mgon po yab yumadang //stobs ldan pho nya mngag bzhugs 'khor dang bcas/khren tu'ajegasakhrosadrag la rngam pa'i gzugs//rno ba'i mtshon 'dzin 'gyogs pa'i shugasatso rnams//zag med bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/sman rag phud kyimachod pa 'di bzhes shig /dza gad dpa' bo'i sman phud 'di bzhesashig/dzam bu ti ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes shig/dam nyams dgra po'i sha khrag 'di —192

bzhes shig/sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/da bcol lasakyi gsol 'debs wo por bzhes//bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod zhanasabacas kyi//nad dang gnod pa'i rkyen rnams zhi ba dang //tshedang bsod namasadapal 'byor 'phel ba dang /khyad par sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba dang//glams bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod//rgyal ba'i bka' dang dmatshigabaden pa bzhin//byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad byed pa yi//sdang ba'idagra dngaganod pa'i bgegs la sogs//thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlag paramadzod//rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//bstan pa rgyasapa'i las 'di myur du sgrubs//phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba so0bkrashisakyi tshigs cad brjod/slar yang arnya nas/shap+ta'i bar gyis mar/gong gi bstod sa kho stod/bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la mchog dang thun mong gi dngosagrub malusapa sgrub pa'i gdong grogs dang /phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi bar chad mimathun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung zhing bzlog pa dang /dgra bgegs loga'adren thams cad thal ba rdul du rlog pa dang /mi'agyur ba'i tshe/mizad pa'i longs spyod/rab tu rgyas pa'i dbang thang /thub par dka' ba'i mthustobasarnams stsal ba dang /mdor na bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/yi ge brgya ba ci 'grub tu bzla zhing /ma 'byor pa dang sogasakyis bzod gsol/rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang /med nabadz+ra muḥye shesapa gshegs/dam tshig pa rang nyid la bstim/dpral bar oṃ/mgrin para.āḥthugasadzinahūṃgis bdag bsrung /slar yang smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par byas la thun mtshams la 'jug —193—

go /'dir mon pa pho bdun mo bdun sogs kyi zhalaphyag bathon pa bskyed par 'dod na/ bskulabargyas pa so so dag nas 'byung ba ltar bskyed kyang rung la/ man ngag ltar na mon pa byi la la zhon pabadud zhags dang nad rkyal/ 'brug lazhen pa ral gri dang thod khrag /sbrul lazhon pa dugasdong dngabe con/ glog la nyon pa phyag gnyis kyis be con nag po/ stag lazhen pa spu gri dang snyingazhags/khyung la zhon pa sta re dang sbrul zhags/ rlung la thon pa ralagri dang zhags pa nag pogo /hūṃ gsum las sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa 'jigs byed bdud pho gsum khram shing dang nad rkyal 'dzin pa seng ge'i gdong can seng ge las pa'o/ /mon mo shelamig ma shel gyi ral pa can nas/ bsomig ma bse'i ral pa can gyi bar rdo rje dang nad rkyal 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo'o/ /gzhan yang dpal mgon po sku mdog nag po yang rung zhing / lha mo phyag dang po gnyes kyisartse gsum dang mi ro'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa dang / ne'u lend skyal du bsgyur zhing / dre rta rkangagasusal chibs pa dang phyag gnyis ma sogs sna tshogs yod cing / shwa na mo rnams kyang/ gser/ gagamachong / zangs / dung / mkhar ba/ lcags rnams kyi mig can dang / mig dang mthun pa'i ral pabyed pa sogs yod pa 'ga' zhig 'dam ka dang / 'ga' zhig bsnyen sgrub dang las tshogs so so'i skabs yin no/ khrel mig ma'am/ dung mig ma'am/ khyi mo shes rab gsal phyagabazhimarabaskyed par yod do/ /man ngag logs su bstan par bya'o/ /bsnyen pa tsam dang nyer 'brelas/ sgrub thabs mchod chog 'di byas pas/ /bstan dgra bdud sde bcas bcom nas/ /'phrin lasarnam bzhe 'grub par shog/ //lha chen lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs dgra bgegs kun 'joms zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'jamadabyangs rdo rje bla ma'i gtor chog la gzhi byas te/ yig rnying nas kha bkang ste lhag chad nor pho drim spangs shing / rgyas bsdus 'tshams la klag chog tu byas pa ste/ rgyalakhams pa tā ra nāpos rang lo —194

nyer dgu pa la smras pa'o//'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnasaparagyur cig bkra shis/gcig zhus dag /༄7//dpal mgon trak+tad kyi bskang gso'i cho ga las bzhi rnam rol bzhugs so//ra༅༅//skyed swā sti/bla ma sangs rgyas nag po chen po dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo//rab brjid bzod dka' gdug pa 'dul ba'i sku//ma rungs bdud kyi klad 'goms drag po'i dbyangs//dmigs med thugs rje mkha' ltar khyab pa'i thugs//slob dpon mchog dang mgon po dbyer med la//gus pas btud nas mchod pa'i cho ga ni//rgyas bsdus skyon bral 'jug bde rnams gsal ba//gong ma'i gsung las gzhan du ma 'gyur bar//mchog tu brtse ba'i sems kyis bri bar bya//'di laspyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/sbyor ba la lnga yod pa las/dang po rdzas tshogs par byabani/'di skad ces/bshos nag zur gsum khru gang dang //nam rgyang nag po mda' tshad gnyis//rta lug g.yag khyi dom spyang 'phar//de rnams gang 'grub mtha' nas bskor//bya nag rma bya'i rgyal mtshan gzugs//mi rkang g.yang gzhi gri snying rnams//yod na dngos bshams med na dbyibs//bya lug smuganagalasogs bshams//mchod rdzas gtor ma bdud rtsi dang /khrag chen chang phud spos chen dag/dkyila'akhor dam rdzas tshang ba bshams//gu gul mo sa'i dud pas bdug/ces so//gnyis pa sngon 'gro'i chos gnyis ni/yi dam gang byed pa de'i lugs kyi sngon 'gro gtor modang /gnas yo byin rlabs so//gsum pa ni/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed do//bzhipa ni yig brgya'i sgom bzlas so//lnga pa tshogs bsag sngon du 'gro bas mtshams bcad pa ni/bsrunga'akhor—195—

yan chad so so'i gzhung ltar bya'o/ /lta ba mkha' ltar dag pa'i ngang nyid las/ /zhes sogs gyer ni rnying ma'i bdag bskyed dang 'brel na bya la/ gzhan ma byas kyang rung ngo / /gnyis pa dathosagazhil bco brgyad las/ dang po bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor sgom bzlas dang / gnyis pa mdun bskyed yi dam gyi gtor ma ni garnya ltar bya'o/ /gsum pa rten bskyed pa ni/ gtor rdzo ltar gyi mas po gzhal yas khang bskyed la gyer ro/ / hūṃ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i gzhal yas nas/ /bzhedas shigabazhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /bskul lo bskul lo semasacan don la bskul/ /bsten no bsten no ye shes lha bsten no/ /sgrub bo sgrubaboyeshes lha sgrub bo/ /ye shes gzhal yas khang bskyed rgya ma chung / /sengage glangachen khri bshams dpangs ma dma'/ /nyi ma zla ba'i gdan bshams 'od mazhan/ /rutra pho mo'i gdan bshams brjid ma chung / /dam rdzas bdud rtsisgrub po bcud mazhan/ /mgyogs pa'i pho nya mngag go bang ma bul/ /bdud pho bdud mo bskul lo ro ma gyong / /dbang phyug rtsa brgyad tshogs rnams 'khor ma zhan/ /brtan mabran du 'khol lo ru ma nga / /zhes so/ /'on kyang bsdus pa'i skabs gyer 'di ma grubaspyang zhalabamed do/ /bzhi pa lha bskyed pa gzhung ltar bya/ lnga pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ gtor chogaltaras/yangan 'di skad ces/ hūṃ thugs rje wo po mi g.yo gtsug tor can/ /mchod k+ṣi skyabasamadzad phyag rgya nyid las ni/ /bdud 'dul dpa' bo wo po'i skur ston zhing//byang shar mtshams na gnas bcas shin tu bde/ /bar snang sprin rum lta bu'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /sku mdog sngo nag mi bzad dug gi mdog zhan tukhrosashing gtum bag ldan pa ste/ /nam mkha'i khams kun ma lusakhyab par ston//—196

brjid mnan stabs su bzhugs pa ste/ /ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i lha/ /nag po chen po spyan 'dren na/ /lha chen dpal 'bar gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes nyi zer stong khams rgyas pa'i sku/ /gsung gi dbyangs snyan pad+ma kun du rgyas//thugs kyi thugs mchog gsang ba'i dbyings dang mnyam/ /mchog gsum rnamadag mnga' ba gshegs su gsol/ /phyag na rtse gsum mi mgos brgyan pa bsnams/ khros pa'i tshul gyis phyag mtshan drug la spyod/ /thod rlon dngani tsit+ta'i phyag rgya can/ /spyan gsum 'jig rten dbang phyug gshegs su gsol/ /dbyings kyi ma mo thugs las sprul pa ste/ /dur khrod bdag mo dbang byed mamobadun/ /sprul pa mon mo yang sprul khyi mor bcas/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo 'dulazhingabastan pa bsrung / /dur khrod ma mo 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol//nagamo 'khor dang bcas pa'i lha tshogs dang / /nag po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan 'dren na/ /lha chen dpal 'bar 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /bh+yoḥ namamakha' stong la rol pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /dpal ldan lha mo nag mo srid gsusabadag /dus gsum spyod pa'i mnga' bdag re ma tī/ /dgra 'dul chen mo gnas 'diragashegs su gsol/ /oṃ e h+ye hi mahā kā la ga na pa ti mahā ka ru ṇi gaXshu ho/sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hūṃ dza dzaḥ nag mo s+t+waṃ lo ya dun bh+yo dzaḥ( baṃ hoḥ drug pa dam ye bsre zhing rgyas gdab pa'ang gzhung ltar bya'o/ /bdun pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūṃ gtsug lag khangadang dkyil 'khor gnas 'di sa /rdo rje brag chen rab tu gtams pa'isteng/ /rin wo gdan khri nyi zla bag tsher ldan/ /mi ro rta ro mang po'i bcalastengadu/ /dugagi me tog sngon po bcal bkram nas/ /milpags rta lpags brtsegs pa'i gdan —197
