steng du/ /rab brjid dpa' bo chen po bzhugs su gsol/ /lha min gdugapa g.yul las bzlog pa'i phyir/ /ded dpon dpa' bo chen po bzhugs sugasol//dam nyams dgra bo gtan nas brlag mdzad pa/ /mon pa dug gi skyes bu bzhugs su gsol/ /dug gsum rtag tu 'joms pa'i dpa' mtshan ni/ /rtsegasum mgul bar thod pa'i rgyal mtshan bsnams/ /rgyal mtshan kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin zhing bzhugs su gsol/ /dgra khrag dgra snying gsol zhing ru tra 'dul/ /phyagan thod pa snying bcas bzhugs su gsol/ /srog la mnga' mdzad nyams pa'ibadud mdzad pa/ /srog bdag chen po gnasa'adir bzhugasasu gsol/ /thabasadangashes rab gnyis med ldan pa'i phyir/ /yaka be ta lī dang thabs gzhinas /bdag gis mchod pa bshams pa'i gnas 'di sa /bdag gis bcol ba'i 'bras bu mchis pa dang / /chos kyi bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i phyir/ /'khoradang bcas te brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā latraka shad mahākā la sirnyi tri yaṃ du dzaḥdzaḥ tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ bh+yo: srid gsum dbang bsdudanag mo re ma tī//mthing nag ral pa sprin dpung 'thibs pa 'dra/ /ti ra'i gnas nas byis pa'i dur byed ma/ /mi dur gcod byed nag mo bzhugs su gsol/ /ma monagamoraka ma'i sku la sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ /brgyad pa mchod tshogs 'bul ba la gnyis las/ snga ma mchod tshogs bsham pa ni/hūṃ bcom ldan rdo rje las byung ba/ /srid pa'i grong khyer sum brtsegasa'ajig /srid pa'i ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas/ /dpal ldan mgon po mthu chen khyod/ /yon tan byin gyis brlabs po che/ /'phags pa'i sa kun brnyes gyurakyang/ /—198—

dus ngan sems can 'dul slad du/ /dbon mchog gsum gyi bka' yangabasrung / /skye 'gro 'phongs pa'i skyabs kyang mdzad/ /phyag na mdungadang bingachen bsnams/ /bskal pa'i tsheltar gzi brjid 'bar/ khyod la mchod pa 'thulabani/ /gri snying la sogs snying sna'i tshogs/ /mi sha rta sha la sogs sha sna'i tshogs//me tog phreng ba la sogs rin chen dbyig /la du la phug la sogs yid bzhin 'bras bu'i zas/ /phyogs bcu'i chu skyes thang skyes la sogs longasaspyod rkyen/ /ris su ma chad longs spyod rgyas par 'bul/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo mdzesapar bkra ba dang / /bshos gtsang mar me lha bshos sna tshogs dang / khris changal sogs btung ba'i mchog /sbrang rtsi la sogs mngar ba'i ro/ /zho sum̐ la sogs dkar gsum zas/ /sna tshogs mchod pa mang po rnams/ /srog bdud 'boradangabacas la 'bul/ /yun gyi mgon por khyod mchod kyi/ /rtag tu phyaga'atshalamachod pa 'bul/ /mchod pa dam pa bzhes nas kyang / /thugs rjesagadungaba'i zhing la dgongs/ /bdag cag re skong smon lam rnams/ /'phags pa'i mgon po khyod kyis grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la ga na pa ti/ a ha ra yasgo du/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ pra tīts+tsha ho/ mahā yasgo be ta li khā hi khā hi/phyimatshang tshogasakhrulabani/ hūṃ bcom ldan rdo rje las byung ba/ /srid pa'i grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig /srid pa'i ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas/ /dpal ldan mgon po mthu chen khyod/ /yon tan byin gyis brlabs po che/ /'phags pa'i sa kun brnyes gyurakyang/ /dus ga sems can 'dul slad du/ /dbon mchog gsum gyi bka' yangabasrung / /skye 'gro 'phongs pa'i skyabs kyang mdzad/ /phyag na bdud 'dulakha—199

na/ /rlung nag khros pa 'tshub ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ khrag gi rgya mtshorakengarusari rab spungs/ /dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas mchog yi jin monag mo khyod la mchod pa 'bul/ /gzugs snang gzugs su 'bul lo bzhesasugasol/ /sgra grags dbyings su 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /rnam rtogayid kyi tshogs rnams bzhes su gsol/ khyod la mchod pa dmigs su 'bulab ni/ /midabang 'bras bu snying gzhon bcud khrag dang / /keng ga'i tshal thog shing lo rlungakhyer sogs/ khyed la dmigs su 'bul gyi 'di bzhes la/ /bcolaba'i lasa'adi 'char bar mi btang 'tshal/ /ma mo nag mo sa ra ta ku lu ku lu ha ha ha mo sakhā hi/ rak+ta khā hi/ go brjod do/ /: ༄ pa sman phud 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥ(/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ཿhrīḥtha/ shu bhan+ta snod bzang yangs pa mā /rang byung gdon nas dag pa ste/ /rtsa brgyad stongalasbyar ba'i sman/ /rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogasagrub pa'i rdzas/ /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /rgyud drug sems can kun sgrolazhing//rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams kyis gsol/ /thugs dam dbyings nyid bskul ba'i mchog /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas/ /mchod pa dam pa 'bulagyibazhes/ /mchod bzhes las kyi dngos grub stsol/ /wu gcig pa rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ āḥ& mahā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa tsakliṣ+ṭiPROB/ mahārak+ta bsgral ba'i khrag /mū la tan tra rtsa ba'i khrag /pad+ma rak+ta sbyor ba'i khragakhu dang ma 'dres dwangs ma'i khrag /sha sna brgya dang khrag sna stong / /'bulani nagapo che la 'bul/ /mchod ni yi dam chos skyong las mkhan mchod/ skongani snangasrid —201—

ma mo thugs dam bskang / /bskongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub zhu/ /mahārak+ta khā hi/ go ro tsa na khā hi/ rak+ta'i rgya mtshochen po la/ /zhing chung nya 'phyo tshilachen 'phyar/ /bsur phud bdud rtsi rak+ta'i gtor ma 'bul/ /slob dpon lani sdangab dang / /rdorje spun la khrob dang / /rnal 'byor bdag la gad pa dag /de dag nag po chen pos sgrol/ /yan lag kun gyi sha chod la/ /rtag tumabon po nag pos gsol/ khrag gi rgyun yang btung bar gyis/ /de yi tshe srogadabangadu bsdus/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /rkyen dang nad rnamasathamasacad bzlog sa tsan da mahā kā la dhi le na ta/ ba liṃ ta khā hi/ mahākā lam5sha t+t+waṃ/a mu kai mo sa me da/ bha sa me tsa ru ti/ dzi baṃ/ pri yaṃ/ ba ka sha ni/ i rda ba liṃ ta :hā khā hi khā hi/ bhu dza ho/ sa mā yaṃ/ a ti kra ma hūṃ phaṭa/ /bcu gnyis pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥ& mahā bā liṃ ta te dzob lita bā lab te gu h+ya sirnyi sa ma ya hūṃ hrīḥtha/ hūṃ snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du/ /bcud kyi semasacan gtor mar bshams/ /sha sna brgya dang snying sna stong / /'bulani legs ldan khyed la 'bul/ /mchod ni zhing bcu'i khro rgyal mchod/ /skongani snangasrid lha srin bskongs/ /bskongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub zhu/ /bzhesashigarol zhig kha raṃ khā hi/ /zhes gyer la/ de rjes gtor chog nas 'byung ba gtor ma byin rlabasadang / gtor ma 'bul ba dang / zhal du bstabs pa rnams bya'o/ /bcu gsum pa skang rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang rgyal ba shākya seng ger gyur/ /gtoranang zla stengs dkar po/ /thalamo khong stong du snying gar sbyar/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dhasasubhā ba shud+dhihānya/ rang nam mkha' mdzod sngon po rin wo sgrom bu 'dzin pa/ zla steng gserasgo—202

dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mukhebh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+pa te s+pha ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ bdud rtsi thal sbyor dmar po mnyam gzhag can/ zla steng raṃ dmar po/ thal mo phyir bskyed mthe bong bsnol ba kha'i ra du bzhag oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ rgya chen shugs ldan 'od ljang khu ral gro'adzenapa1stengaha ljang khu/ g.yon khu tshur g.yas snying gar sdigs mdzub byas pa snod la btang / na maḥsarba ta thāg ta a ba loki te oṃ saṃ bha ra 6bha ra : ye shes skar mda' dkarapordoradrilag zlasteng hūṃ sngon po/ g.yas khu tshur g.yon snying gar snod 'degs tshul bya/ oṃ dzñā na ā wa lokite sa man+ta sga ra ṇa rasmi bha ba sa ma ya mahā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dz+wa la ni hūṃ/ dang༅ra 'bor lo dmar po 'bor lo 'dzin pa/ zla steng dza dmar po sor mo nang du bsnol ba spyi borabazhag na maḥs man+ta bud+dha sum̐ gra he shwa ri pra bhalji na mahā sa ma ye swāhā/ zhes so/ /bcu bzhi pa thugs dam bskang ba la/ yab gtso bor gyur pa'i thugs dam bskang ba dang/yum gtso bor gyur pa'i thugs dam bskang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ hūṃ bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor dam tshig can/ /dam la gnasashing lha la'aphreng/khyed ni srung ma mthu rtsal can/ /sngon tshe dpal gyi spyan snga rtswa /bstanapa bsrungabar zhal bzhes pa/ khyed kyi dam bca' gnyen po de/ /da lta rnala'abyorabadagabaskul na/ /bsgrub phyir bskul phyir gshegs su gsol/ /mahā kā laganasa'adir spyon/ /nag po chen po gnas rig 'dzin srung ma legasaldan nagapo bos so bdud rgyal snyan ma sra/ /g.yabs so bdud rgyal spyan wartul/ tarnyan no bdud rgyal rgyang ma ring / /sgrub po mgon po gong ma g.yel/ /skulalobadud rgyal phrag ma dog /rbad do legs ldan mthu ma chung / /thugs dam skongalaganas—203—

'dir byon//do nub chad dang khrims la spyon//do nub mna' dngamatholaspyon//do nub mthu dang dpung la spyon//grogs por byas so gzhung ma ngan//mdza' bor byas so ngo ma chung //mna' mthor byas so khrel ma shor//rje borabazhi no dbang ma che//bran ltar bsgrubs sorgyud ma ngan/khyed dam tshig gnyan lamisems sam//dang po'i chad so 'di min nam//dam tshig 'da' b.ramachad do//bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam//dam bcas ma g.yel da tshur snyen//bcol ba'i las 'di ma byas na//bde gshegs rgyal ba'i bgazha yangabaslus//dang po'i chad so ma gsos na//dam tshig gnyan gyi ho pa 'ong //bga' yi dmod pas sdigs par mchi'o//de bas dam la ma 'da' zhig/thugasadamaganyan po bdag skong ngo //bdag kyang dam las mi 'da' yi//ho pa'i gzhungalas mi ldog go/gnyis ka dam las mi 'da' 'tshal//de tsam mtshangalamabargal na//mi shes snyoms las byed par mchi'o//kye/r+yā dngamakho po go phreng can//rgyal ba'i bka' la misems med//zab mo'i don la misemasamed//mna' dang khrims la mi brten med//zas dang skom lamichagasamed//do nub khyod kyi thugs dam bskang //do nub nyam chag ma lus bskang/khonub zhig ral ma lus gso//do nub lha la bshags pa byed//do nub lha lasemasa'abon sbyong //do nub nyes par khas kyang len//do nub mnyes pa'i zasashiga'adren//do nub mdza' ba'i gzhung zhig srong //do nub byams pa'i lan zhigaldon//do nub snga ma'i gto rag gtong //do nub phyi ma'i zhu skyems 'bul//do nub khyed rnams dgongs su gsol//phyag brnyan rgya nag dgongs sugasol//—204

pho nya lcags spyang ཿr+sās kyi bdag po yum chen pe ta bka sdod mas 4 ma bdun sring bzhi klu mo mgo bzhi'i 0phyogs skyong mgon po skangaroskalaba'i thugs dam bskang //brten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/khyungaga'i rgyalams gyis thugs dam bskang //dmatshig gnyan po bsreba'i phyir//bdud rtsisman gyis ljags kyi dbang po d+ku byed phyir//bsgosabu nagapostsorak+ta sgosadu 'thung ba'i phyir//dmar r+pā ar+ghas rtag tu 'phrin lasa'achoraba'i phyir//rgyun gyi gtor mas thugs dam gnyan po bskangs pa yis//tshogs bdag chen po'i thugs dam bskang /khum ོ pe ta'i bka' sdod mgon po'ogang/ta ra'i:rigs bzhi mgon po'i— ma bdun sring bzhi'i klu mo mched bzhi'o phyogs skyong mgon po'i bdud kha dgra la bsgyur ba'i phyir//rgya garanagapo'o dgra bgegs gnas nas 'gugs pa'i phyir//lcags spyang sngon po'o dmagadapon ru mardzo 'gyed pa'i phyir//yang sprul 'bum gyi thugs dmabaskor//bskang ngo skal ba'i thugs dam bskang //do nub lha la 'khon spangasapa//nyesapa mchis na khyed la bshags/phyin chad nyes pa mibagyid do/khyod kyangaringadu mamadzad cig/bdag gis tshor ba ma nongs skyong //bdud kyi thugs nurasrid pas su//bskang ngo bshags so byas lags so//thugs dam bskang ba de lags so//sgrub la bar chad gyur pa dang //dam rdzas tshang bar mabachogasadang //thugs dam dus su ma bskongs dang / /rtsa ba'i dam tshig 'cholab rnams//do nub bskang zhing bshags par bgyi/khyed kyang dam las ma'ada' bar//skul na rings ba'i las 'di mdzod//nga yang dam las mi 'da' ste/—205

khyod kyang rtag tu bsgrub cing mchod/ /'o skol gnyis kyi dam bca' 'di /srogal bab kyang gzhung bsrang 'tshal/ /bdag la sdang ba'i dgra byung na/ /pha khura'adug kyang sod la shog khyed la mchod pa'i dam rdzas 'di/ /rgya mtsho'i gting na 'dug kyang rung / /cila'ang bsdos nas thugs dam bskang / /)nye rdzegadungaganyis gas bgyi'o/ /kye/ grogs la gzhung med mi srid kyi/ /nora'abyeradamamed mi srid kyi/ /chad 'di mi 'grub mi srid kyi/ /mgu ba'i zasashigangesakyanga'adren/ /zas kyi ngo yang khyed kyis gyis/ /chad pa'i gzhung 'di ngayangasrong/ /smras pa'i tshig 'di khyed kyang nyon/ /bskul ba'i gnyer 'di nga layod/ /brgyasaba'i las 'di khyod kyis gyis/ /gnyis ka chad pa'i gzhung bsrang 'tshal/ /gnyis ka las kyi gnyer bskyel 'tshal/ /smra'o chad do thugasadamacan/ /gsolalo mchod do srung ma'i tshogs/ /sod cing chod cig dgra dang bgegag /ltosasoganyer ro thugs dam can/ khyed dang rnal 'byor bdag cag gnyis/ /bskalapa zhig kyang mi 'bral lo/ /ltems se rgyangs se ma mdzad par/ /brtsegadungasems la ce cher mdzod/ /mthu stobs ci yod lta yang lta/ /sku shugasaphyungalalas 'di mdzod/ /rnal 'byor gar+sā po'i srung ma mdzod/ /nor rnamasabasrungaba'i srung ma mdzod/ /thugs dam gnyan po bskangs ba yis/ /lha dang mi'abralagrib ltar 'grogs/ /zas dag phud kyis khyed mchod do/ /rtag tudagapo'i phrin las mdzod/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ skokhoshaṃ/ bh+yoḥ dpalaldan lha monag mo ni/ /gnas 'dir brtse phyir gshegs su gsol/ khrobogacig lha mo dgongs su gsol/ /bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ /nad dang —206

rims kyi bdag mokhyod//thugs dam bskang phyir gshegs su gsol//nyamasachags gso yis gnas 'dir spyon//bskang ngo bskal ba'i thugs dam bskang//bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir//zhing chen g.yang gzhis thugs dam bskang//brten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir //mi dbang snying gis rang bzhin gnasanas spyan drangs phyir//mi rkang gling bus dam tshig gnyan po bsroba'i phyir//bdud rtsisman gyis 'dod pa'i gtso mo yin pa'i phyir//rma bya'i rgyalams gyis shangs kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir//sha wo dud pa4mguragyi gsanganas drangs ba'i phyir//dmar chen rak+tas nyams chags ma lus bskangaba'iphyir//bya lug smug nag gis nag mo 'bum sde'i thugs dmabaskang//dkaramo 'bum sde'i ser mo 'bum sde'i dmar po 'bum sde'i mthinganaga'abumasde'i ljang mo 'bum sde'i smug mo 'bum sde'i mon mo nagamo'i— 'dod khams brtan ma'i:khyed kyang dam las ma 'da' cig/da yang dam lasami'ada' 'o//thugs dam gnyan po 'dis skongs nas//nyams chags mchosapa bzod par gsol//sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol//'phrin lasadragashul ma chung cig/bcom ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod//bco lnga pa bstod pa ni/gtor chog ltar ram/yang na/'od phung bskalapa'i tsheltara'abar ba'i 'od//smin gnyis 'khrigs pa'i khro gnyer bzhad pa'i zhal//rab bzhad 'dzum dang mche ba gtsigs pa po//ye shes spyan gsum nyi zla sharaba'i 'od//ston pa bla med chos rje'i bka' bzhin du//dam tshig 'khoralo'i rgyud rnams srung mdzad cing //klu yi cod pan brjid pas 'gyings pa ni//ngesapar—207—

che btsan rgyal po'i bdag po lags/ /dgon pa'i nags 'dabs dur khrod chen po na/ /rab 'jigs ma mo'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor zhing / /zhi gnasalhagamathong nyi zla'i rgyan thogs pa/ khyod ni rnal 'byor grub pa'i dbang phyugayin/ /nad gtong gshin rje'i tshogs rnams kun bcom ste/ /mdangs 'phrog srin po kun kyang phyag 'tshal bstod/ /log 'dren bgegs rnams shin tu 'dulamadzad pa/ /seng ge glang chen pags pa gos su gyon/ /lha yul grong khyer nagasa'adabs thams cad du/ /lha dmag dkar po 'bum gyi dbugs 'byen pa/ /tan mongs g.yul las lha chen rgyal ba'i rtags/ kha ṭ+wāṃ mi mgos rgyan pa phyagan bsnams/ /ban+ta thod pa snying bcas snying zhags can/ /dug sdong ha la'abarab bsnams pa ni/ /thod pa'i khar 'jog spyan snga brtson pa yis/ /gnod sbyin gzi brjid mdangs kun 'phrog par mdzad/ /zhe sdang ro langs rnam par 'jomasamadzad cing / /lha min bdud dpung g.yul gyi mtshams bcad nas/ /loga'adren srin po mtha' yas dgra gnon pa/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stagalpagasacan/ /lha yi lha khyod me lha tshogs bdag sogs/ /drag po la sogasalha chen kun gyis mchod/ /phyogs rnams kun dang gzhan du rnam par grags/ /smon lamakhyad par mang pos thugs sbyangs nas/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam pa cir yangaston/ /phan mdzad sman sdong ljon pa khyod drung du/ /sdug bsngal tsha bas gdungs pa bdagal sogs/ /mgon dang gnyen 'tshal skyabs su byon nas kyang / /'jigasamed rgya chen dngos grub stsal du gsol/ bh+yoḥ khams gsum dbang sdud nagamorematī/ /sman mo brjid pas srid gsum zil gyis gnon/ /skye 'gro sgrol mdzad yum —208— —

r+pā kun gyi ngang / /nag mo gtso mo khyod la bstod pa 'bul/ skyongagasusadabangasdud bh+yoḥyi sgra sgrog ma/ /lcags kyi ral pa mang po sprul par spro/ /leb gan nad kyi mtshon sprin sku la gsol/ /cadagra 'dul g.yul zlog ma la bstod parabagyi/ /dus bzhi dbang byed nam zla'i stangs 'dzin ma/ /za byed srog la rol pa'i mche ba can/ /sems can rgyal mobazhi zhon 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /namazla'i dbang byed ma khyod gus pas bstod/ /rang bzhin dbyings las sprul pa dpagamed ston/ /srid gsum bdag mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /'diraspyon rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /ming pos bcol ba'i 'phrin lasagrub par mdzod/ /wu drug pa bshags pa r+sā po ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyag na rdorje dang/ /brasaze mchog sred mkha' 'gro bde ster ma/ /bā ling a tsar gnyos lo yon to grags/ /rdo rje bla ma dpal seng grags pa dpal/ /sangs rgyas rasachen rin chen dbang rgyal dang / /mkhan chen byang dar 'jam dbyangs gzi brjid rgyal/ /gnyan ston kun rin mtshungs med nam mkha' dpal/ /'khrul zhig kun rin 'jam dbyangs rdo rje'i mtshan/ /bsod nams grub rgyal grags pa 'od zeradang / /grags pa dbang phyug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / /'jam mthon grub pa'i dpa' bo dam pa rje/ /thugs sras rnam gsum rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /byang chub dar dang bsod nams rgyal po dang / /kun mkhyen saṃ gha grub chen blo gros brtan/ /yon tan rgya mtsho yon tan snying po dang / /bsod nams rin chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / /'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan la sogasapa//—209

rtsa brgyud bla ma thamasacad dgongs su gsol//bdag cag mi shes ma gusabag med dang //nyon mongs dbang gis rtsa ba yan lag dang //skugasungathugasakyi dam tshig 'gal 'brul sogs//thams cad chos dbyings ngang du mtholalobashags//rang bzhin stong nyid ngang du rnam dag ste//mchog dang sa mongadangos grub kun 'grub par//rtsa brgyud bla mas byin gyis brlabasanasakyang//bshags pa mchog 'dis sdig sgrib dag gyur cig/hūṃ/dam la 'dud cingadamatshig bshags//mgon po nag po mthu bo che//mahā kā la srogagibadud//b.rasnang mkhams na rgyu ba na//dbang bskur ming btags dam tshig byin//nagapo dbang byed ces kyang btags//tshogs bdag chen por bskos pa ste//mahākā la mthu bo che//chags byed rdo rje'i phreng ba can/lha mo nag mo mthutshedang//bka' nyan 'khor dang bcas pa rnams//bdag gis bsten zhing mchod pa las//gzhung dang 'gal ba bzod par gsol//rgyu chung phud nyamasa'abyorapa chung ba bshags//sgom sgrub mi brtson bsnyen sgrub g.yel ba bzlasabarjod zur chag ting 'dzin g.yel ba bsgo gsum rgyus 'tsho le lor shor ba —4na chags ser sna'i dbang gyur zhabrul ba dgon pa nags 'dabs dur khrod wo po mā/tso ho ji ltar bskang ba ma grub mthol lo bshags//rdzas dang mar pa tshul bzhin ma bshams dang //lha dang bla mar ma gus yid gnyisasogs//sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig 'gal 'khrul kun/khyed thugs chos dbyingasangangadu bzod par gsol//sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags//gsungagi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags//thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa —210

mthol lo bshags/ /sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi /dmatshiga'agalab ma lus so sor bshags/ /mthol bshags phul nas tshangs par mdzad du gsol/ /bcu bdun pa drag po'i las la bskul ba ni/ dang po mgon po'i bskul bya ste/ hūṃdad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs srog bdud ma rungs pa/ /rdorje 'chang gi sprul pa ste/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs kyis/ /bdud po legs ldan mthu rtsal can/ /byang shar mtshams na bzhugs pa ni/ /thod pa 'baraba'isku mkhar te /zhe sdang bdud kyi rgyal po'i mkhar/ /logs gcig miyi thod pasabartsigs/ /logs gcig rta yi thod pas brtsigs/ /logs gcig spre6) thod pas brtsigs/ /logs gcig lug gi thod pas brtsigs/ /rin chen gseragyi sgo btsugs te/ /mthing zangs g.yu yi skas kyang btsugs/ /zur bzhi rin chen lcags las byas/ /zangs lcags sgo la khrag gobang / /mi ro rta robamasadu bkram/ /mikhrag rta khrag mtshoru bskyil/ /mi lpags rta lpags yolabasarjes//mi rta'i bsur chen thul lu lu/ /mi thod gad mo yal la la/ /rta thod rta skad tse re re/ /mi rkang gling bu congs se cong / /sku mkhar de yi nang shed na/ /bdud kyi rgyal po bzhugs pa ni/ /rngam pa'i zhal la gtum pa'i sku/ /sku ladaranagaralaka gsol/ /phyag g.yas dug sdong bdud zhags bsnams/ /dgra bo'i snyingadangaske la 'debs/ /g.yon pa dam nyams thod snying dang / /bdud kyi khramabaslanagapo 'dzin/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du brdzis/ /sprul dang nyi zla thod pas brgyan/ /spyan zlog ljags 'gril mche ba gtsigs/ /zhal nas me 'bar lhabs selhab//—211—

shangs nasadrag po'i rlung nag 'tshub/ /bra nag rting dkar chibs su chibs/ /lha mo gnyan dang gnyis med rol/ /gser ska rin chen sked la bcingag /sagati yu ring zhabs la gsol/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /dugagibakaskyugs dgra la gtong / /tshe dang srog la mnga' mdzad pa/ /rgyu ma mi mgo'i do shal can/ /dam tshig can gyi gdong grogasamadzod/ /dam nyams kun gyi rtsargyud chod/ /mna' zan kun gyi srog dbugasalen/ /srog bdud wo po ma rungasapa//lan 'ga' drag tu bskul ba'i tshe/ /srin po'i dmag tshogs nyer rege /yun gyi mgon du khyod brten na/ /rgyan gyi gtor me 'di bzhes la/ /sngon gyi dmatshigarjes dgongasate/ /yid la re ba skong ba dang / /bcol ba'i phrin lasagrubaparamadzod/ /de nas dpal lha mo skul ba ni/hūṃ lha mo gnyan dang gnyis med pa'i/ /byang shar mtshams kyi dpalalha mo/ /'dod khams kun gyi dbang phyug ma/ /nad kyi bdag la rimasakyi rkyen/ /bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ /rgya mtsho'i klong na me 'bar ma/ /mtsho rnams skem par nus ma ste/ /bud med thams cad zhi mdzad phyir/ /lha cen skula'atshesapar bzhugs/ mahā kā la'i sku la 'khril/ /bka' blon chen modagra 'dulam/ /mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi bdag mo ste/ /ma mo 'bum gyi gtso mo khyod/ sha za 'bumagyi bdag molags/ /gling bzhi 'bum gyi sha za mo/ /srin mo 'bumagyi khraga'athung ma/ /sems can 'bum gyi srog gcod ma/ /dam nyams kun gyi bshan pa ste/ /mna' zan rnams kyi gshed ma lags/ /sdig can rnams kyi srogagacod ma/ /zasasu sha dang khrag la dga'/ /las su gsod dang gathod lamakhas/ /—2126

bang ni glog gis bskyod du med/lag na nad kyi rkyal pa thogs//lan 'ga' drag tu bskul ba na//mkha' 'gro mang po'i sna la 'gro//zas su misha rta shaza//skom du mi khrag rta khrag tshong /khyod kyi longs spyod der bskos go/dgra bo'i srog chod snying rtsa gtubs//sngags 'chang bdag gis phul ba yi/sha khragadamar gyi gtor ma dang //dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'di bzhes la//dgra bo'i rigasabargyud rtsad nas chod//bachol ba'i las rnams mthu ma chung //denasaltobazhilkornams bskulate/bh+yoḥlha ོ mahā kā la dang //lha mo nyid kyis byin btsosalag/bka' nyan mon mo nag mo bdun//dgra srog cham la dbab pa'i dusalabab//mon mo nag mo rkang 'cha' ma//dgra rkang za ba'i mthu mo che//yan laga'acha' ba'i dus la bab//sgrol cig myur du dgra dpung chom//mon mo nag mosha za ma//rma sa za ba'i mthu mo che//dgra sha za ba'i dus la bab//sgrolacigamyuradu dgra sha gtubs//mon mo nag mo khrag 'thung ma//mi khrag 'thung ba'i mthumoche//snying khrag 'thung ba'i dus la bab/sgrol cig myur du dgra khrag 'thung /mon mo nag mo snying 'byin ma/dgra snying 'byin pa'i mthu moche/tsit+ta sleb pa'i dusal bab//sgrol cig myur du dgra snying thon//mon mo nag mo dbugasa'aphrogam//srog dbugs 'phrog pa'i mthu mo che//lus sreg 'phrol ba'i dus labab//sgrol cig myur du srog dbugs phrol//mon mo nag mo bla len ma//tshesrogaphrolaba'i mthu mo che//dgra chos 'gugs pa'i dus la bab//sgrol cig myuradu mtshephrol//mon mo nag mo srog gcod ma//srog rtsa gcod pa'i 4mozhe/dgra —213—

srog gcod pa'i dus la bab/ /sgrol cig myur du dgra srog chod/ /bdoni mi'aphrod lho bal mon/ /mon mas mang po wa la la/ /mon mo rna cha wapasasowang//mon mo sgra 'gag di ri ri/ /dri ni mon dugs chil li li/ /bcol ba'i lasarnams rtags phyung shig /de nas sprul pa khyi mo twan skul ba ni/ bh+yoḥ khyi monagamogaser mig ma/ /mkha' la rgyug pa'i rtsal mo che/ myur du rgyug la7chakhug/casasu chug la dgra snying phyung / khyi mo nag mo g.yu mig ma/ /bar snangargyugapa'i rtsalamo che/ /myur du rgyug la bla tshesrol/ /lha rnams sku la bog tu chug khyi monagamomachong mig ma/ /sa la rgyug pa'i rtsal mo che/ /myur du rgyug la glatshestos/ /klurnams sku la grug ltar sgongs/ khyi mo nag mo zangs mig ma/ /durakhrod rgyugapa'i rtsal mo che/ /myur du rgyug la bla tshe zung / /srog gshed skul la gsod du chugakhyi mo nag mo dung mig ma/ /rtsibs la rgyug pa'i mthu mo che/ /myuradu rgyugalablatshe chings/ /snang srid skul la dbang po sdoms/ khyi mo nag mo mkhar migam//chu la rgyug pa'i mthu mo che/ myur du rgyug la bla tshegazir/ /chu srin skulalasub tuchug khyi mo nag mo lcags mig ma/ /rlung la rgyug pa'i rtsal motshe /myuradu rgyugal bla tshe sgrol/ /snying phyung srog chod dbugs kyang phrol/ /gnam gyi 'juponastenganas rdzo/ /sa'i lte phur 'og nas thon/ /zhe sdang sgo ba'i don snyingaphyung/ /dkon pa'i tshe srog gnyis dang phrol/ /lha chen yab yum 'khor bcasakyis/ /dgra bo'i bdun brgyud rtsad nas chos/ /bcol ba'i las rnams mthumachung/ /de nas mon po rnams skulab ni/hūṃ gzhan yang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ /mon pa nag po rdzu 'phrul—214

can/ /byi la zhen nas dur khrod nyul/ /zhal nas tshe'abar dgra snyingasreg/spyan nas khrag 'dzag zul lu lu/ /phyag na dung gi be con bsnams/ /lha bdudamon pa'i dus la bab/ /mon pa nag po sprul la shon/ /phyag na bdud kyi bothon bsnams/ /dam nyams dgra bo rdul du bzlog /zhal nas me 'bar snyingalarngub/ /mig ni gser mig lams se lams/ /klu bdud mon pa'i dusalabab//mon pa nag po khyung la zhon/ /phyag g.yas dug gi spu gri bsnamag /dmanyamasadagra bo'i srog rtsa gcod/ /zhal nasame 'bar rgya mtshoskem/ /spyan nasakhraga'abab zul lu lu/ /gang la dmigs pa rdul du bzlog /bdud kyimon pa'i dusal bab/ /mon pa nag po 'brug la zhon/ /phyag g.yas ral gri glogaltara'adebs/ /dam nyams srog rtsa gting nas len/ /'brug sgra shangs nasathoga'abeb shing / khrag dang ser ba'i mchi ma 'bab/ /gang la dmigs pa rduladu bzlog /gnod sbyin mon pa'i dus la bab/ /mon pa nag po rlungalashon/ /lcags mda' dgra bgegs snying la gzer/ /zhal nas mi khrag rta khraga'adzag /mig ni nyi zla'i zer bas 'tsher/ /gang la dmigs pa rdul du brlog/gshin rje mon pa'i dus la bab/ /mon pa nag po stag la zhon/ /ral gri 'debasashinganags tshal rgyu/ /zhal nas nad kyi rlangs pa gtang / khrag gi mchimasha rar/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod/ /srin po mon pa'i dus la bab/ /rān pa nag po rta nag zhon/ /phyag na tsan dan bing chen bsnams/ /dmanyamasadagra bo sgrol la brtson/ /sdig can 'dul ba'i mthu bo che/ /mgon po mon pa'idusalabab/ /yang na mon mo nyon la skyel 'di ltar byas kyang rung ngo / bh+yoḥ shel migamathingagi—215—

lan phran can/ /gser gyi dra ba wangs se wang / khrag gibe khyon cerares /phyag na dung gi phur pa sgril/ /lha bdud mon mo'i dusal bab/ /mon monagamogaser mig ma/ /gnas ni srid pa gsum na gnas/ /dgongs pa b.rasnangakhams la mdzad/ /bzhugs ni rgya mtsho'i gting na bzhugs/ /dbu lathod pan mthing nag bcings/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje nad rkyal g.yon/ /klu bdud mon mo'i dus la bab/ /mon mo nag mo zangs mig ma/ sprul nag ral pa shigasasoshig/lcags kyi rna cha khral la la/ /phyag na gser gyi phur pa sgril/ /bdud kyi mon mo'i dus la bab/ /mon mo nag mo g.yu mig ma/ khrag gi ral pa sha rar/ /bse yi snyan cha khra la la/ /phyag na bsoyi phur pa sgril/ /gnod sbyin mon mo'i dus la bab/ /mon mo nag mo dung mig ma/ khrag gi ralapa shar rar/ /byi rba'i rna cha khral la la/ /phyag na byi ru'i phur pa sgril/ /gshin rje mon mo'i dusalabab/ /mon mo'i nag mo bse mig ma/ /zangs kyi lan phran sha rar/ /zangasakyi rna cha khral la la/ /phyag na zangs kyi phur pa sgril/ /srin mo mon mo'i dusalabab/ /mon mo nag mo khrag mig ma/ /mthing gi lan phran shar rar/ /mtshoraṣ+kacod pan khra la la/ khrag gi rba rlabs chil li li/ /nad kyi kha rlangasathulalu lu//phyag na bdud kyi khram shing bsnams/ /re ma tī yi dus la bab/ /ཿbh+yoḥ tragashad yab yum drag shul can/ /lha srin kun gyi rgyal po ste/ /mon pa phomokhyed rnams kyang / /dbu skra gyen brjes thod pas brgyan/ /zhal gdang spyan bzlogamache ba gtsigs/ /rngam pa'i zhal nas 'jigs sgra sgrog /sku la dar nagamilpags gsol/ /me rlung 'tshub ma'i klong dkyil nas/ /phyag mtshan mtshon chas—216

dgra bgegs 'dul//bstan pa gnyan srung mthu bo che//sngon gyi dmalasama'ada' bar//sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la//dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab//bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod//gas yang sprul pa yangasprulasogasakyang bya'o//bsdu na gtso bo yab yum la bstod pa las gzhan pa'i skul mi dgos/dusalabab zhes pa rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod ces pa'am/thugs dam bskang zhes par 'don pa spo ba'i srol yang yod la/yang na 'khor la gtor chog tu bshad pa de tsam gyis kyang chog go/bco brgyad pa mnga' gsol ba ni/ hūṃ dur khrod gsang ba'i gnas chen 'dir//mgon po yab yum mchod pa'i rdzas//dam rdzas gtor mi ri ltaraspungs//sman rag bdud rtsi rgya mtshor bskyil//sna tshogs rol mo 'brugaltaraldir//rgya spos gsur chen dri ngad ldan//zhun chen mar me skar ltarabakram//dar nag ru mtshon ba dan 'phyar//dam rdzas snying sna rdza ltar lhags/sha rusamang po ri ltar spungs//bya nag mang po phur zhing lding //mi nag ging po rngam pa'i gzugs//rta nag rting dkar rlung ltar 'phyo//g.yag nag zhol chen sprin ltaragatibs//lug nag lcags ru rgyan dang ldan/khyi nag snying dkar domaltaranyer//tsa ra rog po brjid pa dang //gcan gzan mang po 'durazhingargyug/'dod yon sprin ltar gtibs pa 'dis//hūṃ dpal lda na mgon po mnga' gsoralo//mahā kā la legs ldan nag po lha chen dpal 'bar+ṣa srogabadud chen po nag po chen po bshan pa chen po lings pa chen po bdud rgyal thod phreng traka shad nag po rnal 'byor dgra lha dam nyamasasrogagazha—dpalas lha mo 'dod khams gtso mo bdud kyi yum gcig gshin rje'i lcamagazug —217—

mon pa pho bdun mon pa mobadun phyag brnyan sprul pa gophonya lasamakhan bdud dmag bye ba —bdud mgon 'khor bcasaḥ chos skyong 'khorabacasams gsol lo//de ltar gsol ba'i byin mas kyis//rnal 'byor bdagacana'akhor bcas kyi//phyi nang bar chad zhi ba dang //tshe dang bsod namasargyasaparaspel//lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus//bstan pa bzhig pa'i dgrabo sgrol//rnal 'byor bsam pa yid bzhin sgrubs//bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub paramadzod//ces skang rdzas mchod pas mnga' gsol lo//de rjes mdos kyi skang ba sa bsdusagang byed 'dod kyang bya ste/logs su shes par bya'o//gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba lalnga las/dang po dngos grub blang ba ni/thun mong ma yin khyad tso che bas na/rdo rje khrag 'thung thugs kyi dpal be'u nas//bdud 'dulamathuchen nag po wo po'i sku//'phrin las rnam bzhi'i gzi brjid 'od 'phro bgazhalaldan bdag la dngos grub rtsal du gsol//rab rgyas sprul pa'i dngos grub stsaladu gsol//dpal chen khrag 'thung mahā kā lar bcas//'khor bcasamachod pa'i cho ga sgo lags kyi//mgon po thugs rjes byon pa na//sngon gyi thugasadam gso ba yis//'gro ba ma lus bsgral slad du//dngos grub stsolaba'i dusal bab//skya rengs dang po shar ba dang //ri rab rtsel gdugasadar /sgrub po gtor ma der gtong na//da lta dngos grub stsal du gsol/khro rgyalakhrusapa'i dngos grub bdag la stsol/khro rgyal thugs kyi dngos grub khrorgyalagasungagi gakhro rgyal sku yi sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol//rdorje'i tshemachog dngos grub stsal du gsol//pho nya rkang mgyogs dngos grub stsal du —218—

gsol//rdzu 'phrul mngon shes dngos grub stsal du gsol//mthu dang gragasapa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol//yid bzhin lhun grub dngos grub stsal du gsol//ces brjod do//gnyis pa gtor ma gtong ba ni/de nas gtor ma gtor stegs sam/khang steng du khyer lkaspyi btab rgyas bsdus gang yang rung bas 'bul/mdos 'bul na'ang skabs 'dir 'bul dgos so//bstan skyong rgyas (sdus gang rung re byed pa phyag len du gnang zhing /ma byas na'ang chog chad pa'i skyon med mod kyi/bod kyi phyogs 'dir sgrub pa po'i mthun rkyen sgrub pa sogs kyi phyir 'gru༅ shin tu legs pa yin no//de nas bde legs su byed pa'i 'phrin bcol gang 'os shig byagaphyis kyi lag len la ni/gas gyi lag len dang bstun te/srid bzhi'i dpal 'byoramalusa'abyung ba'i gzhi//thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang //de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa kun/ /dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan shog/bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la//tshe ring nad med 'ongasaspyod phun sum chogs//bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang //'groba'i don la mthu dang ldan par shog/ces pa 'di byed i snang ngo /masa'adiraganamanan la sogs pa byed pa'ang long skabs dang bstun nas byas kyang legs mod/nges par dgosapa ni ma yin no//gsum pa mchod pa ni/nang du yi dam la mchod bstod bya ba'o//bzhi pa tshe chog ni/hūṃ/phyogs bcu rnams nas tshe 'gugs pa//dpalachen khrag mthung yab yum dang //rdorje ma hā kā la'i tshogs//'khor bcasakun gyi mthu stobs kyis//tshangs pa'i gnas nas tshe khug cig/ri rab rtsenasatshekhugacig/phyag mtshan gri gug la sogs pas//steng gi 'jig rten khamasadrolal//—219

bgegasakyi lag nas tshe drongasashig/tshe rten 'di la tshe stims shigaphyagamatshan rtse gsum la sogs pas//'og gi 'jig rten khams grol la//bgegs kyi lag nas tshe drongs shig/tshe rten 'di la tshe stims shig/phyag mtshan bebachen la sogs pas//phyogasamatshams 'jig rten khams drol la//bgegasakyi lag nas tshe drongs shig/tshe rten 'di la tshe stims shig/ces bcanas/yidamachos skyong gi sngags kyi mthar tshe sgrub kyi sngags gzham bur btags laci rigs par bzla'o//lnga pa rjes bsdu shis brjod dang bcas pa ni/de nas yi ge brgya pa bzla pa dang/bzod paragasol ba lan mang du byas la/rten rnams labartan bzhugs dang /mgron rnams gshegs sugasol ba dang /bdag bsrung ba rnams byas pa'i mthar smon lam dngabakra shis ci 'grub tubya'o//sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las dngos//'phrin las mgon por sku sprul pa//sprul pa'i khro rgyal 'khor bcas rnams//mchod pa'i cho ga mdo tsam ste//'di sgrubs pa las byung ba yi//bzha namasaca zad gang bsags pa//de las byang chub myur 'grub nas//'phrin las rnam bzhis don byed shog/dpal ye shes kyi mgon po trakad mchod pa'i cho ga las bzhi rnam par rol ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/don gnyer 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba'i ngor/rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang rtog dang sbyar ba'i tshig legs legs su bsgrigs pa dag spangs te/rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi gsung la bcos bslad ma byas par/yig rnying yi ge mang ba dang /'thor ba'i tshul can du yod pa rnams 'dusashingago bde bar bsgrigs pa ste/rang lo nyer dgu pa dbyar zla 'bring po'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i si bzang po la/dpalabazang ldan gyi chos grwar sbyar ba'o//sngags rnams las rgya skad du mja parnams la tha snyad kyi gtsug lag dang mthun pa'i zhus dag byas na/rig gnas sbyangs pa rnamasakyiblo ngor 'phral du 'bab cing /legs legs 'dra ba yong ba 'dug na'ang /byin rlabs la gnod pa'i —220—

ltas mthong bas/yig rnying mang po zhal mthun du yod pa'i zhus dag tsam las gzhan ma bcos palags so//masgolo/dar rgyas 'phel//zhus dag/༄tsho//legs ldan mahā kā la 'khor mang gi bstod pa 'phrin las kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so//༄7//chaswā sti/dpal legs ldan mahā kā la'i bstod pa 'phrin lasakun 'grub ces bya ba/bla ma dang mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo//lha chen dpala'abaramathu stobs bsam mi khyab//thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i gnyen gcigapu//rgyal ba'i ye shes mkhyen pa thugs su chud//legs ldan nag po 'khor bcasabastod par bgyi/khams gsum 'jig rten kun khyab rtag pa'i gtso//dusagasum sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa srung //phyogs bcu'i zhing khams kun ladabang sgyur ba//dgol spyod pa kun gyi steng 'dzin zhing //dam tshiganyamasapa kun gyi srog gcod mkhan//'bor lo'i dbang phyug kun gyi bka' sdod de//gsang sngags chos rnams kun du skyong ba'i mgon//traka shad mahā kā lakhyed labastod//'jig rten mthun phyir mahā de ba'i sras//res 'ga' mi bzad dug gi nags su 'khrungs//phal cher 'jig rten dbang po'i thugs lasasprul//gzhan du gsang ba'i bdag po'i las byed mchog/gzi brjid khro rgyal 'chol ba stobs po che//gshin rje gshed po'i gcan pa 'jigs gzugs ṭhā//rtag—221—

par ma mo'i tshogs dang lhan cig rol/ /bdud 'joms drag po'i sku la phyaga'atshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas stong dang lhan cig thugs bskyed pa/ khyed ni 'dren mchog shākya'i rgyal po yis/ /bstan srung kun gyi rgyal por mnga' gsolamadzad//sdig can yongs kyi gshed ma dpa' bo khyed/ /ma rungs kun la srog garna mthar byed nyid/ /chos gzhi kun gyi srung ma mel tshe mkhan/ /chosabazhin spyod pa kun gyi dgra lha'i rgyal/ /srid pa'i byed po khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ khutsalayi dur khrod wo po ni/ /mi dang 'byung po'i bam wo ri ltar spus/ /rusapa'i gram khrod du mas phyogs kun khyab/ /zhag dang klad pa'i 'dam rdzab ltengaka'akhyil/ khrag rgyun dron mo'i chu klung brgya phrag 'bab/ /mi bsrun bya dngagacan gzan tshogs kun rgyu/ /sha za srin po bro brdung glu gar byed/ /drag po'i zhingamachog de la'ang bstod par bgyi/ /rin chen sna tshogs las grub gzhal med khang / /de dbus thod mkhar me rlung 'tshub ma'i nang / /'degs byed glangachen seng ge bya khyung can/ /gser gyi khri mchog pad+ma nyi zlas spras/ /bstan dgra bsgral ba'i mi ro rta ro 'bum/ /dud sprin 'thul zhing me stag 'phro ba gi /dugagi me tog bcas par bkram pa'i gzhi/ /ye shes las sprul gnas mchogade la'adud/ /gru gsum mthing nag brtsegs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dpalachen mgon nag srin po khros pa'i tshul/ khwa na'i zhal gyis 'gal byed bladzerngub/ /dug sdong 'bar bas stong khams khyab par bsregs/ /bdud zhags nag posalog 'dren khrag khrig 'ching / /ngan sems can kun bdud kyi khram la 'debs//dgra snying phung po thod par blug ste gsol/ /phyag bzhis bdud bzhi 'joms—222

pa'i dpa' bo che/ /rab khros gtum po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sdangamiganyin byed bye ba'i 'od dang mnyam/ /mche gtsigs ston zla 'bum gyi 'od dkara'agyed/ /glog dmar grangs med 'gyu ba lta bu'i ljags/ /bskal pa'i tshematshungs sma ra smin ma ser/ /ral pa bskyod pas sa gsum mun para'ajug /goms stabs shugs kyis rtsom chen rlung yang bsgul/ khugs drag phyag gisastong gsum skad cig nyul/ /nag po gzi ldan khyod la phyag 'tshalabastod/ /gad rgyangs gcig gis ri dbang stong phrag sgyel/ /lhab lhub na bza' g.yo bsamakha' dbyings 'gengs/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyi snang bas zhing kun khyab/ /ltazera'abar bas lha min grong khyer bsregs/ /snyan nas glog 'gyu 'brug stong dusagacig ldir/ /sha khrag rus pa'i ri bo zhal du 'debs/ /shangs kyi khong nas dus mtha'i rlung yang ldang / /srid gsum byed po khyod la phyag 'tshal bzhi/ /tshasadang dbang pos mdun nas gus pas bsu/ /gshin rje srin po bka' nyan lasal 'gyed/ /gdong drug tshogs bdag lha dmag skul mar gtong / /gza' dngaganod sbyin thams cad phyi yi bran/ /klu dang gsang ba pa rnams nang gi 'bangag/rlung dang sreg za'i lha yis logs nas bstod/ /lha yi lha mchog khyod laphya ga'atshal bstod/ /rdzu 'phrul rta nag chibs nas phyogs kun gnon/ /sengage chibs nas pha rol g.yul ngo zlog /'phrul gyi bya khra gter bdag tshogs rnamasakun/ /sngon du rgyu zhing snga dgra dar ba 'joms/ /gsod byed gshin rje rngamapa gcan gzan tshul/ /phyi bzhin 'brangs nas phyi'i dgra rdul du rlog /rutshasko thogs te lha rnams dbugs kyang 'byin/ /sde brgyad dmag dpon chen poraphyag—223—

'tshal bstod//bdud 'dul tsan dan bang chen thogs pa'i tshe//dmagachogasamakha' dbyings khyab pa'i sprul pa ston//bdud rgyal nyi khri chig stong sku lasasprul//bye ba dung phyur bdud dmag lings la 'gyed//g.yas nas lha dmagadakar po 'bum sde 'phyo//gdug rtsub gcer bu 'bum sdogayon nasargyug/srin po'i dmag tshogs grangs med bka' la sdod//gzi byin mtha' yasakhyod la phyag 'tshal bstod//phyogs bcu'i sde brgyad ma lus las la'akhol//sangasargyas kun gyi dgongs pa khyod kyis sgrub/khyod sku dran pa tsam gyis dgra chogasastongs//mas smos tsam na bgegs kun phyogs bcur 'bros/khyod ladad gus skad :/ga gcig bskyed pas//nad med tshe ring 'byor ba thams cad 'byung /snying po bzlas pa tsam gyis sgrib kun sel//thugs rje'i dbangaphyugakhyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud//gnas mchog 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i khangabazangan//lha rdzas 'dod yon kun la dges rgur rol//mi bzad 'jigs r+pā durakhrod brgyad po mā/mas mo rgyu ba kun gyi sde dpon tshul//o rgyan la sogasanyerabazhi'i yul chen du//dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyi dbang//wogasamardzo khyod ni rdo rje theg pa 'dir//rgyud kun bdag por gyur la phyag la'ibastod//dpa' bo che khyod res 'ga' sa steng rgyu//dug dang me dpung mtshon cha'i char sprin 'khrug/nag phyogs 'dre kun dwangs shing snying khrag skyug/ga semasacan gyi mi rnams srog rtsa 'chad//lan 'ga' bar snang mkha' la gshegasatsan//nyi zla gza' skar tshogs kyis me tog 'thor//bdud rnams skragacingamyosal klad pa 'gems//stobs chen pha rol gnon la phyag 'tshal 'dud//dus—224

gzhan dag tu sa 'og 'jig rten rgyu/ /ri rab dang bcas sa gzhir 'darazhingabaskyod/ /rgya mtsho bdun yang 'ar 'ur chal chil 'khrugs/ /'bum phrag grub pa'i sde rnams gar yang bsgyur/ khrag khrig bcu gnyis gdengs can bu moyis/ /gludabyangs stong dang rol mo bye bas mchod/ /mtha' dag lha min dbang pos thalamo sbyor/ /mchod 'os mthu ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mgon khyod 'dzawabu'i gling du rtag bzhugs tshe/ /gtsug lag khang rnams g.yel med bsrung ba dang / /dge 'dun thams cad chos bzhin spyod du 'jug /sangs rgyasabastan lasangs rgyas nyid dang mtshungs/ /bdud dang bgegs dang lha min gnod pa bzlogakhyod la mardzo cing khyod kyis bskyangs pa na/ /chos spyod bcu po yar ngo'i zla ltarargyas/ /bar chad kun sel chos srung khyod la 'dud/ /ma rungs gdugacan 'dul bar mdzad tsa na/ /misnying rdza ltar brnyil ba khyod kyi zas/ khragachen bshwa' rgal rgyug pa skom du 'thung / /me 'od zhabrugs pa khyod ni durakhrod du/ /rolangs chen po rnams dang sgyu rtsal rtse/ /rnal 'byor can la nyams kyi drod 3 nyul/ /dam tshig can la 'bral med gdong grogs mdzad/ /sngagasarigadagralha khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sgrub po mchog la rig 'dzin dngos grub stsol/ /rilu mig sman dngul chu gnod sbyin mo/ /ral gri rkang mgyogs gter chen khacigala'o/ /skal ba shin du chung yang zhi sogs las/ /thogs med rtsol khyod dngosagrub kun gyi bdag /ma sgrubs bar yang dbang thang phun tshogs thob/ /bsad bskrad dbye bas dgra 'joms nus par 'gyur/ /mthu rtsal 'gran zla med pa khyod la bstod/ /'di na 'jig rten dbang bsgyur de kun gyi/ /mgo lakhyod kyi —225

zhabs pad rdul phreng g.yogs/ khyod mthong tsam gyis gshin rje'i pho nya byer/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams sa gsum thams cad du/ /mi mthun g.yul lasargyal ba'i rnga chen brdungs/ /lha mchog legs ldan mahā kā la de/ jigashulacan khyod rtag tu bdag bsten no/ /dngos po kun gyis mchod cing phyaga'atsharago / dpal gyi thugs la dgyes bde bskyed byed yum/ /'phrin las kun sgrubadapalaldan re ma tī/ /sgrub po dam ldan ma yis bu bzhin skyong / khams gsusadabangaphyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mngon gcod 'phrin las sgrub la thags thogasamed/ /ri rab yud kyis bskor zhing rdzu 'phrul 'gyed/ /'gro ba drugagosrogalamanga' mdzad ma/ /las byed khyi gdong bdun la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /cho'aphrulamatha' yas ston byed mig sgyur ma/ /nad kyi bdag mo dgra bo'i sha larngam/ /bar chad log 'dren bgegs kyi khrag la rol/ /dur khro ma mo bdun la phyaga'atshal bstod/ /rab gtum pho nya mon pa nag po'i tshul/ /'jig rten dregasapa'i gtso bo dmag dpon bdun/ /bstan la 'gal byed ming gi lhag mar 'jog /rdo rje bshan pa'i tshogs la bstod par bgyi/ /mtho ris sastengasa'ogasrid gsum la/ /dbang byed drag ga65 zil gnon seng ge'i gdong / /sdang ba'i dgra la gnam lcags thogs ltar rgyug /gsang ba'i las mkhan gsum labastod par bgyi/ /dngos su bshams dang yid byung mchod pa 'bul/ taden stobs lasabyung mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas mtha' dag 'bul/ /legasaldan dgyesapa'i rten rdzas dpag yas 'bul/ khyo chen phyogs grol khyab pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /rang bzhi ye shes wo po'i ngo bor—226

'bul//rnam 'gyur 'dod yon bsam mi khyab par 'bul//nyamasaphyongasalhan skyes bde ba chen por 'bul//bdag dang rgyud lngar 'khor ba'i 'gro rnamasakyi//nyes byas gang yin chos dbyings ngang du bshags/khyad par dam tshig 'gala'abrul gyur pa kun/khyed thugs snying rje'i klong du bzod par gsol//dpalamachog mgon po lcam dral khyed nyid la//las 'brel 'jog pa'i dge larjesayi rang //'khor ba ma stongs bar du 'dir bzhugs la//bla med dmachosabadud rtsi'i char chen phob//dge 'dis dpal chen khrag 'thung legs ldan che/khyed bzhin bdag kyang dus gsum rgyal kun gyi//'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad par sgrub pa dang //gang la gang 'dul 'gro don nus par shog/ //cermi pa legs ldan mahā kā la 'khor mang gi bstod pa 'phrin las kun 'grub ces bya ba 'di ni/sa skyong mi'i dbang po kun dga' rab bstan dbang gi rgyal po'i gsung gis bskulanas tā ra nā thas smras pa'o//maṅga yaṃ//༄7//legs ldan nag po'i bstod pa bzhugs so//༄7//oswa skyi/rdo rje'i rang bzhin shugs drag rngam pa'i sku//khasatshulabadechen rnam 'gyur cir yang ston/ /gdug can dgra la nad mtshon me char 'bebs//legs ldan nag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo//ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭakyisabagegs kun 'joms//gsang sngags rang sgras sgrub la dngos grub stsol//rgyob sod skad kyis bdud sde'i snying khrag 'gems//trakad mgon po'i gsungal—227

phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod nas spros bral mkha' ltar dag pa la/ /kun khyab byams dang snying rje'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs/ /gdug la khro tshul dbang po'i gzhu ltarashar/ /mahā kā la'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug rtsub khrodangachagasapa'i tshul 'chang zhing / /gsod gcod tshig rtsub 'phrog sogs rnam cha kun/ /mkhyen brtse nus mthu tshul khrims rnam dag dang / khyod kyi yon tan tshul la gusaphyaga'atshal/ /gnod pa kun sel 'dod pa'i don kun stsol/ khams gsusadabangabasdud gnod byed thal bar zlog /gang la gang 'dul thugasarje'i 'jug pa can/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub mdzad khyod la bstod/ /gnyis med sbyorayumadapal gyi re ma tī/ /mkha' 'gro khyi bdun rjesa'abrangs grogasamo'i tshul/ /mon pa pho mo gshin rje gnod sbyin sogs/ /nang gi phyag brnyan pho nya rnams la 'dud/ /mtha' yas snang srid lha srin dregs pa can/ /bka' 'khorathamasacad bstan dgra 'dul la dpa'/ /sgrub la bkra shis dge legs stsol bar mdzad/ /dpal gyi bka' sdod kun la bstod pa 'bul/ /bdag gis bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /sngon gyis las dang 'phral rkyen las byung ba'i/ /b.rachad mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang / /tshedang bsod nams dbang thang rgyasaparamadzod/ shwakya so ge'i dgongs don dar ba dang / /'gro kun bde la'akho pa'i las nus can/ /rang gzhan thams cad bde dang thar pa dang / rtagatu'agod pa'i mthu stobs ldan par shog/ //ces pa'ang sa skyong kun dga' rab bag gyis bskul nas tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / zhus dag/—228—

༄tsho//dpal mgon tsod kyi 'phrin las bskang gso sogs nyer mkho 'ga' zhig bzhugs so//༄tsho//chaswā sti/oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dhi3haṃ/skad cigagisarirab gling bzhi gling phran bye ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/thun rdzas 'dod pa'iyon tan du ma dang ldan par gyur/na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khebh+yaḥsarba lhakhri.ut+pa te/s+pha ra ṇa i mo ga na khaṃ swāhā/oṃ āḥ(/k+shihra'adamahākā ladang //yum gcig lha mo ma pham ma//'khor gyi dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs//de ringasrid pa'i mdos la byon//srid gsum rab 'byams 'jigs rten khams//stong gsal nam mkha' 'od kyi gzhi//rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor la//rimatshogling bdun bkod pa 'dzes/khyad par gling bzhi gling phran brgyad//'dod pa'iyon tan sna tshogs ldan//ri rab rin chen bzhi'i rang bzhin//lha dang miyi bkod pa 'bar//shar phyogs dkar po shes las grub//dri za bye ba brgya yi rten//lho phyogs be+eḍūr+ya las grub//gshin rje bye ba brgya yi rten/zhub phyogasapad+ma rwag 'bar//sgophye bye ba brgya yi rten//byang phyogs rin chen gseralasagrub//gnod sbyin bye ba brgya yi rten//sum cu rtsa gsum la sogasapa//lha gnas bkod pa bsam mi khyab//'og min gnas kyi byang shar dang //dbangaphyug chen po'i gnas rab mchog/ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs dang //tshangatshing—229—

'khrigs sogs dur khrod du/ /dpal chen lcam dral gzhal med khang/ khyu ni rin chen bye ba 'bum/ /rmangs ni rdo rje pha lam la/ /thod pa sna tshogs 'ipa'i mkhar/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi/ /sna tshogs dur khrod rgyan gyisabargyan/ /mthing nag zur gsum lcags ris bskor/ /mdung dang ralagri gshibs pas mdzes/ /ro dang ro langs bya gcan sogs/ /'jigs surungaba'i bkod pa 'bar/ /bye ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /chos dbyingasabaden pa'i mthu stobs dang / /sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin dang / /rten 'brelardzasadang nus pa'i mthus/ /zag med phul byung rnam par bkod/ /hūṃ gling bzhi ri rab mdzes pa yang / /bye ba khrag khrig grangs med kyig/nag po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas/ /thugs dam gnyan po skong gyur cig/thugs dam gnyan skong bar chad gsol/ /thugasadam gnyan skong dngos grub stsol/ /thugs dam gnyan skong bsam pa sgrubs/ /thugs dam gnyan skonga'aphrin las mdzod/ /gzhal med khang bzang bkod pa yang / /bye ba khrag khrigagrangasamed kyis/ /nag po lcam dral 'bor dang bcas/ /thugs dam gas po༄ gas/'di man kun la 'gre'o/ / shel nag rgyal mtshan 'bar ba yang/ /bye baḥ daranagab dan 'bar ba yang / /bye ba gri gug ral gri( la sogs kyang / /bye bza rta nag rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang / /bye ba drel nag rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang/ /bye ba:rnga mong rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang / /bye ba 'brong chen rgyan gyisabargyan pa yang/ /bye ba lug nag rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang / /bye ba khyi nag rgyan gyisabargyan pa yang / /bye ba stag chen rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang / /bye ba gzhigachen rgyan —230—

gyis brgyan pa yang //bye ba seng chen rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang//bye ba domanag rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang //bye ba dred mong rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang//bye ba sbyang ki rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang //bye baḥ bya khra rgyanagyisabargyan pa yang//bye ba —thing chen rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang //bye ba5g.yu 'brugargyan gyisabargyan pa yang //bye ba —ma he rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang //bye ba lto'aphye rgyan gyisabargyan pa yang //bye ba bya rog rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang//bye ba mahāgaseragyi rus sbal yang byerngamathing nag nam mkha' mdzes paḥ bye 'phan dar rgyal mtshan brjid pa bye lha bsgos dkar zlum mdzes pa yang ཿbye bsgosaphran dmar po zur gsum yang //bye gsang phyi zla gam mdzesapa yang//bye bdud bsgos zur bzhi rtse rgyas yang /bye ba bsgos phran ting lor bcas pa yang bye ba thod pa khrag gis bskang ba yang //bye baḥ sman sna sna tshogasarilabu yang//bye bapaglud gzugs dbang po tshang ba yang //bye ba chang bumatheb kyubacasapa yang //bye ba zas sna bsam gyis mi khyab yang //bye ba dbangapornamalngabakram pa yang //bye ba don snying rnam lnga bkram pa yang /bye ba yan 'tha/lhudum bkram pa yang //bye ba rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil pa yang//bye ba sha chen riltar spungs pa yang //bye ba keng rus gcal du bkram pa yang/khyeb zhidagi bla re ba dan yang //bye ba gsur chen sprin ltar gtibs pa yang//bye ba zhun wo sgron me sbar pa yang //bye ba bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa yang//bye ba rten rgyun thun gyi gtor ma yang //bye ba —gzhan yang 'dod yon bsam mi khyab//bye ba khrag khrig grangs med kyis//nag po lcam dral 'khor dngabacas//thugs—231—

dam gnyan po skongs gyur cig /thugs dam gnyan skongs bar chad sel/ /thugs dam gnyan skong dngos grub rtsol/ /thugs dam gnyan skong bsamapa sgrubs/ /thugs dam gnyan skong 'phrin las mdzod/ /hūṃ draklad mahā kā la dang / /nag mo za byed be ta li/ /dgongasapa mnyamanyid chen po'i klong / /legs nyes bzang ngan rtags dang bral/ sprulapa yangasprul 'khor gyi tshogs/ /rtag 'dzin tshar gcod rjes gzung gi /'phrin las las la brtson pa rnams/ /deng 'dir bdag la gsan zhing dgongs/ /bdagazhi marig rmongs dbang gis/ /dam rdzas ma tshang mchod gtor g.yel/ /sgrub lamibartson le los gzir/ /gsang ba gzhan la spel ba sogs/ khyed kyi thugasadang 'gal ba rnams/ /do nub mdos kyis dag par mdzod/ /lta ba nyamasapa mdosakyis skong / /spyod pa nyams pa mdos kyis skong / /srid pa'i mdosakyisathasasacad tshangs/ /mdos kyis ma tshang gcig kyang med/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor bcas pa yi/ /bcings pa khrol la bsdams pa klod/ /gzung pa thong la nyamasapa gsos//mthun pa sgrubs la re ba skong / /'dod pa mtha' dag grub pa dang / /blamed bde chen thob par mdzod// // dar rgyas 'phel/ maṅga lam̐// ko ྅ mon pa dkar po seng ge'i mgo /the rang rgyal po lasala'akhol//bgegs kun 'joms pa'i cho 'phrul can/ /sku yi las byed dusalabab/ /mon pa dmar po seng ge'i mgo /rmu btsan sa bdag las la 'gyed/ khribatsan 'dul ba'i drag shul can/ /gsung gi las byed dus la bab/ /khyon pa nagapo —232

seng ge'i mgo/gshin rje gza' bdud las la'akhol//dgra kun gsod pa'i rdzu 'phrul can//thugs kyi las byed dus la bab////bkra shis//sne lta ba mkha' ltar yangs pas mnga' gsol lo//spyod pa chodasa'akhrul med pas mnga' gsol lo//sgoms pa steng 'grus med pas mnga' gsol lo//dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung bas mngal gsol lo//phyagargyatinga'adzin brtan pos mnga' gsol lo//bzlas brjod ma yengs tshang bas mnga' gsol lo//dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas mnga' gsol lo//ge'i'adas bkrag mdangs bcud kyis mnga' gsol lo//sde brgyad mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis mnga' gsol lo//srid gsum bdag po chen por mnga' gsolalo//rnal 'byor bdag gi dgra lhar mnga' gsol lo//bstan srung kun gyi rgyal por mnga' gsol lo//i 'bor yongs kyi srung mar mnga' gsogalo//bdud 'dul dmag dpon r+pā por mnga' gsol lo//bkra shisamathustobs dbang por mnga' gsol lo//phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar mtsho gsol lo//zhes gyer ro//bshags pa'i rjes la skul rnams gyer/de'i rjes su dngos su yangagazugasa'agros dang /na bza' dang /go mtshon sogs bstar nas bzhag/dmigs pa dang /bzlas pa cung zad byas nas/yid kyis 'khor mang po sprul/mchod pa mtha' yas pa spel/mnga' gsolagyerabar bya'o////zhes pa bstod bskulamanga' gsoladang cas pa'i tshogs mang po las/snyingapo khyer bde bar byas pa 'di yang /sa skyong mi'i dbang po kun dga' rab brtan gyi thugs dmasargyalakhams patwa ra nā thas bsgrigs pa'o//maṅga lo//—233—

lko o swā sti/ gtor bzlog bsdus pa ni/ bskang gtor gyi mdun nam/g.yon du bshos bu gru gsum nag po sha khrag gis brgyan pa khru gang ba mtheb kyu bcad kha phyi la bstan pas bskor ba/ de'i mdun du dgos mchod dang / snodagacig tu gtor chung du grags pa mtheb kyu brgya rtsa brgyad bshams/ bskang gso tshar gcig song mtshams/ bzlog gtor che chung la thun mong du byin sas dkyus ltar dang / mchod pa byin rlabs kyang bya/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/dgra dang bgegasadang gnod byed thams cad bkug nas gtor ma la thim/ oṃṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ ṣ+ṭha yaṃ dzaḥ tri yaṃ dzaḥ kho zha gsum brjod/ mtheb kyu rnamasatsho bzhir bcad/ yang nang mchod kyis bran/ oṃ āḥ&/ lan gsum gtor sngags lan nyerabadun gyis phul/ oṃ mahā ka la rnal 'byor gyi sgra lha sogs dang / rolamorgyunadagrolabya/de'i snang la'atheb kyu gtor ma chen por blugs/ de ltar lan bzhis phul/ bar 'dir bstod padang skularnams bya/ de nas snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ hūṃ nga ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dngog khrorgyal dpal chen he ru ka /dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /de ringadragapo'i zor 'phen gyi/ /bstan pa yongs kyi srung ma dang / /sems can phan byed dge la spro/ /dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba yi/ /'byung po thams cad sku zuracig /gzhi bdag gnasabadag grong bdag dang / /sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha' la/ /gnas pa'i lha klu mi ma yin/ /thamasacad rang gi gnas su song / /mtho ba rnamasani zhabs skum zhig /dma' ba rnams ni dbu chums shig /b.rapa rnamasani sku zur cig /sgo ba rnams kyis sgo phye zhig /'phrang pa rnams kyisa'aphrabasolacig /ces chang gi nang du mtheb kyu bcug pa lan gsum 'gro phyogs su gtor/ bh+yoḥkhyoldingaba'i dgra la bh+yoḥ /chosachos dgra la dmag dpung chos/ /dmag dpon rgyalapo—234

dmag sna drongs//dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor//dam can gyomatshoskubaskyod las//ltas ngan cho 'phrul phyi la bsgyur//sgeg dang bar chad dgra labazlog/bzlog go drag po'i dpung gis bzlog/bzlog go dmar wo gosams bzlog/nad yams dal yams dgra la bsgyur//rmi ltas mtshan ngan phyi labazlog/bzlog go drag po'i— bzlog gi dmar lakhram kha shod kha phyi la bsgyur//mthu gtad byad kha dgra la bzlog/bzlog go drag bzlog godams yasakyi bdud g.yos dgra la bzlog/mas kyi sri langs dgra la bzlog/thamasacad sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yoḥthams cad gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yoḥde nasakhorasalarak+ta dang nang mchod bran/snying po'i mthar/sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/zhes dam labazhagakhangastengangasaphyirol du dmar gtor mchod pa dang bos pa'i snod stegs la bzhag tha kyis bran/spyi bshadang /de rjes rol wo byas lashā sa na bzla'o//hūṃ chos skyong mgon po lcam dral dang //phyi nang gsang ba'i las mkhan dang //sde brgyad mgon po dmag dpung bcas/phyogs bzhi'i ru 'dren tshogs rnams dang //sprul pa nyi khri chig stongadang//lha bdud grangs las 'das pa rnams//sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongasanag/chos 'khor 'di yi bto bzung la//byad kha rbod gto byed pa dang//yod par byed pa'i gdon dang bgegs//log par lta ba'i dgra bo rnamig/thamasacad rdul bzhin brlag par mdzad//rdorje mtshon cha'i char pa phob//mind phyugs nad mun ltar gtibs/dus mtha'i me yis bsreg par mdzod/sha khragarus pa zhal du thob//'go ba'i lha dang phral nas kyang //ma thogasamyuradu lasamadzod cig/sdig cig ma rungs 'di rnams kyi//rnam shes dbyings susparadu —235—

༄༅//dpal legs ldan nag po trakad kyi gtor sgrub kyi lag len man ngag bzhugs so//༄tsho//na mogu ru badz+ra dhā rā ya/legs ldan nag tsho 'di'i gtor sgrub kyi mnagazhi/maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung mthing kha me ri can rtse mo phar bstan pa/dbus su nyi gdan la raṃ dang bh+yosamatshon pa bas pa dang /de'i phyi rolarngam bskor gyi nang ljang khu/phyi rol thod pa'i phreng ba dgardorame ri rnams byed pa 'bring po dang /bskyed chog dang mthun pa'i dkyila'akhor yongs rdzogs 'bri ba rgyas pa'o//dbus su mazhi'i steng du yab yum lasgrub gtor gcig/mdun du gtso bo'i 'bulagator dang /lha mo'i 'bulagator/g.yas g.yon du mon pa pho mo'i gtor ma bdun twan/mdun dukhyi mo bdun gyi gtor ma/g.yas su sman dang g.yon du rak+ta/mchod pa sogs lag len skusko bshams/mda' dar gri snying can yod na rab med na'ang sgrub gtor la mda' dar nang rten gyitshul dugazugs/bris sku med na nges par tsa ka li'adzugs/de nas sgrub pa pornams bshags bsdam lasogs pa sngon du 'gro bas/bdag bskyed dang yi dam gyi gtor bsngo dang /mgon po'i gzhalayasakhang bskyed pa yan chad bya/sgrub gtor wo po de gtor bsngo ltar byin gyis brlabs/bdud rtsi'ababs pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas gtor ma la gzungs thag bzhag ste/tso( mahā bā ling ta sogs kyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/yig brgya dang rten 'brelasnying po tshar gsum gsumagyis brtan par bya/de nas gzungs thag brdog/de lta bu'i gtor ma la dmigs nas/gtoramadang bris sku lhan cig tu lhar bskyed pa yin te/tshig cha mngon rtogs bzhin bzhugs gsol gyi bar —238

du bya/mchod pa tshan gcig byin gyis brlabs te/mchod bstod bsdus pa dkyus ma de byasalkadamigs pa shugs drag pos bzlas pa gang mang bya'o//sgrub pa po yi dam dang mgon po'i bsnyen pasong ba sha stag yin na/sngags brgya tsam la gzi byin bskyed pa'i dmigs pa bya/de nas dus skabs dang bstun pa'i las bzhi'i dmigs pa nyid kyi gzhung bsrang /gzhug tu nyer gcig tsam ladathosagrub blang ba'i dmigs pa bya'o//mgon po'i bsnyen pa ma song na phal cher bsnyen pa'i dmigs padang /mjug tu sngar ltar bya'o//de nas gtor ma thams cad phyogs gcig tu byin gyis brlabasalgayang so sor dmigs te gtsa bo'i 'bul gtor la 'bru gsum/lan nyer gcig dang gzhan rnamasal gsum/thun mong du sngags drug phyag rgyadrug gis byin gyis brlabs/gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags kyi mthar/i rda bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/btags pa lan bdun bdunadaga'akhorarnams kyi sngags la de btags pa gsum gsum dang /thun mong du gtor sngags dkyus ma dang /shā sa na lan gsum gyis 'bul/dpal ye shes kyi zhes sogs bstab pa'i tshe rol mo rgyun chags bya/slar yang gtor chung nyi shu rtsa drug byin gyis brlabs/'bru gsum nyi shu rtsa drugatubazlagamachod pa rnams kyang byin gyis brlabs/mchod 'phreng dang sman rak+ta gtor ma gsum gyis gzhungabasrang /de skabs gtor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi po thams cad la sman dang rak+ta sdugs/gtorachung stosagong bzhin bsngos nas/las kyi rdo rjes dpral ba'i thad tsam du gtor snod bzung la thams ha kyis 'di ltar gyer te/hūṃ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis//dpal ldan mgon po spyan 'dren na//sangs rgyasabastan pa bsrung ba'i phyir//mchod pa'i gnasa'adiragashegs su gsol//oṃ mahā kā la trak+ṣad sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra samādzaḥ'adiskabasasu 'thor ba bsdu ba'i dmigs pa bya/de nas/hūṃ bstan dgra ma lusabasgralab gi/snyingakhrag dron mo'i mchod yon dang //dbang po sna lnga'i me tog bshamig/zilo —239

bab/ /bdud dmag bye ba'i dus la bab/ /lha dmag 'bum gyidusalabab/ /lha srin sde brgyad dusal bab/ /mchod gtor bdud rtsi 'dir bzhesal/ /sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan dgongs la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bsam pa sgrubag /phyi nang 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang / /chos dang dpal 'byor rgyas par spel/ /lha 'dremi gsum dbang du bsdus/ ldang ba'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ /lusadangagrib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin lasam lus mdzod/ /lha chen dpala'abar 'khor dang bcas pa rnamasabadag gi gus pas mchod gtor phul ba 'di bzhes la/ spyir sangasargyasakyi bstan pa dar ba dang / semasacan rnamasabade skyid 'phel bar mdzod cig /khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rgyu sbyor ba 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thamasacad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam ngan pa dang mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad pha cholagyi byad kha phur kha mthu gtad sbyor ba ngan pa keg ki kai ma gshin rgyal sen sogasabagegs dang log 'dren gyis bar du gcod pa thamasacad bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang longasaspyod dang dpal 'byor rgyasaparamadzad du gsol/ skye bo dam pa'i chos la 'jug pa'i don du rgyan blon rgyal phranayulamigatso bo mtha' dag dbang du bsdu bar mdzad du gsol/ zhi bsami 'dul ba sdang ba dang gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa bsam sbyor ngan pa can gyi mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad bsad pa dang bskrad pa dang dbye ba dang rengasapa dang bcings pa la sogs pa tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol/ mdor na bdagacaga'akhor dang bcas pa la phan pa dang bde ba thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhorag—241—

bye brag 'dod don gsolab yod na'ang drag tu btab/mgon po yab yum 'khor bcas kyi sngagasadrag tu bzla/de nas bskang ba bstod pa bshags pa sogs kyi gzhung bsrang bar bya'o//bshagasapa'i sngon du yig brgya gang mang bzla'o//de dag ni dang po tshugs pa'i thun thog mar bya ba yin la/de phyin chad nas thun re re bsko du gtor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams 'theb kyu res gso zhing /srod thun ma gtogs pa la gtorasagong gi grangs bzhi dang //srod thun lagator chung sum stobatab/dang po rang de ma ga'akhogator chung btab pa'i skabs/gtor chung snga ma rnams nas gcig gnyis res sgrub gtor kha gagophyi ma bzhi po de rgyal chen bzhi la bsngo ba yin/thog ma'i thun gcig po de ma gtogs dam tshig pasngar yod gsal 'debs kyi gsar du bskyed mi dgos pas 'don bya las bon rnams bor bas chog go/'grol ba'i tshe tho rangs nas snga dro'i bar gang yang rung ba zhig la sngar bzhin cho ga rdzogs par btang nas//sgrub gtor chen mo'i lha bris sku la stim pa'i dmigs pa lan bdun bya/gtorama'i lha bris sku'i thugs gar thim par gyur/dzaḥ& baṃ ho zhes lan bdun brjod sgrub gtorachen mo de nyid gtor chog gis phul nas/gtor ma de nyid kyi snying po ma gtogs/gtor ma dngathabakyuthams cad khang steng du spyir btab kyis 'bul ba man chad dus gtor dang 'dra'o//gal te 'phrinalas bskang gso dang mnga' gsol byed par 'dod na nyi ma so sor bya'o// //legs ldan nag po chen po dpal mgon po trak+ṣad kyi gtor ma'i sgrub pa chen po'i man ngag gsal bar bkod pa 'di yang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o//rgyalaba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyasapar gyur cig/dge'o//—242—

༄༅//dpal mgon po'i zungs gso thabs kyi lag len cho ga bzhugs so//na mo gu saphyi rten zungs gso thabs mdor bsdus pa ni/chos skyong mgon tsho grasachun sogs ji ltar 'os pa sngon du song bas/ras gzhi dar gzhi shog bu sogs ji ltar 'os pa lkagaser dngul lam/mtshal lam/snag tshas kyang rung ste/mgon po nyid dam lcagadral 'am/gtso'akhor kun gyi sngogs ji ltar 'os pa'i tha mar/dpalamagon po 'khor bcas rten zungs su btsugs pa 'di la/rten bcas te dgyes par bzhugs shing /gtsug lag khang gi srung modagabastan pa'i gnyer kha mdzod/bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang /bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du sgrubs/'phrin las phyogs med du spel/rten 'brel legs phyogs su sgrigs/dgrabagegs log 'dren thams cad choms/bsam ngan sbyor rtsub can gyi dgra thams cad rlag paramadzod/mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/zhes bya ba bris lkalhar bskyed rab gnas byas/zhu ba las sngags 'phreng du bsam/zhabs nas bsgril/smyug sbugasasogs subazhugs pa'am/thums btab/dar mtshon sna lnga'am/rdo tshar gyi mgo la bcomagade 'dra rten gyigrangs dang mnyam par bya/de nas dus khyad par can la/sgrub pa po rnams kyis gtor bsngo dngasnang ba sngon du btang /rten gtor ram/snang gtor gyi gtor dbang byas kyang rung mod rgilag len mi bde zhing de dag dus ma yin par sgul skyod byed pa la dgag cha'ang yod pas/gtoradabang byed rgyu'i dmar gtor gru gsum zhig logs su bcos/de la gtor bsngo logs pa midagos —243—

kyang /byin rlabs sogs gtor bsngo dang bskang gso'i skabs thams cad du dmigs pa nan to dubyed cing /gtor bsngo'i skabs su yang dmigs pas legs su 'bul/gtor ma de'i stebage namamakha' lamagon po lam mer bzhugs pa'i mos pa byed/rnam 'joms lasogs pa'i bum chu sgrubapa'am/dkyila'akhor sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i las bum yod na des chog/bsdu na busapakha.a dri bzang gi chu dang bcas pa la/a mṛ ta brgyartsa sogs dang /a bhi ṣe ka brgyartsabazla/de nas zungs rten rnams ji ltar 'os pa'i sar khrid/bgegs sbyangs ba dang /til sbyabasasogasabya/a mṛ ta'i sngags bzla bzhi zungs rten rnams la bum chus gtor/yang gnyi3 gzhi sngags kyis kyang de dag lagator zhing /gu gul gyis bdugs nas/sngar gyi shog ril darasna dngabacas pa de rta'i sum̐ sum̐ dang /g.yag lug khyi rnams kyi sog ba g.yas pa'i thad du 'dogagagator dbang byed rgyu'i gtor ma de stegs bu'i steng du bshams/zungs kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i mthebakyus gsos/nang mchod kyis bran/chang phud cig kyang bshams/sgrub pa po rnams kyisadabyabasadang rol mor cas te/spyan rasagazigs mgon sogs kyis spyan 'dren bya/masarolar+sā yun ring du bya snyo /oṃ mahā kā la kā lide bi sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mādzaḥzhes pa lan mang po dang /badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ'iganas su pad+ma ka ma la ye stum/zhesasbyarasangalan mang du brjod/ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis me long la gzugs bas shar b.lakhrus gsolabya ste/de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la//zhes pa'i tshabatudapal ldan mgon po lcam dral 'khor bcas la//spyo 'don pa spo/dmigasapani/mgon po 'khor dang zungs rten rnams lhan cig pa la/bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis bkrus par basmo/arnya nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mardzo/bstod thung sho lo ka res bstod/gtor ma bsasasbyasa.oṃ āḥ& lan gsum gyis byin rlabs gsos/dgra bgegs bsgralaba'i sha khrag gi rgya mtshochen—244

por mos/gtor sngags dkyus ltar gyis phul/zungs rten rnams bsangs sbyangagalhongepa'i ngang las/o.āḥ& zhu ba las byung ba'i rta nag/g.yag nag/lug nagakhyi nag la sogs pa zungs rten khyad par can lus dpa' brjid nyams rtsal stobs dang ldan pa/ngag don ldan nus pa'i mthu dang ldan pa/sems shes rigasadapa' ba'i gdeng dang ldan pa/byed pa 'dod don 'phrin las sgrub pa'i 'phrul dngaldan pa/phung khams skye mched yan lag yongs su rdzogs shing /'dod pon mkho dgu ma lusapa 'byung ba'i gzhi gyur pa 'di nyid/dpal mgon po 'khorabacas dgyes shing tshim la thugs chags pa'i rten dang /mthu stobs nusapargyasapa'i gzhi dang /rgyu dang rten du gyur cig/nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags ring sagasulaphyag rgya dang bcas pa lan gsum gsum brjod/las kyi rdo rjes gtor ma de zungs rten rnamasakyimago bor 'jog cing /mar gyi zhur re 'debs/sngags gtor kha gsos pa'i mtheb kyu resbyin/4 phud nas gtor ba tsam bya/sgrub po gas rnams kyis snying po bzla zhing /rolamo 'jam rol bya/slob dpon gyis mgon po lcam dralagyi snying po'i mthar/badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/zhes bshagapa mang du brjod/de nas 'di skad ces gyer te/mig sman ltar gnag myur ba'i gomastabasakyis//gling bzhi ri rab yud kyis skor byed cing //sna tshogs rin ོ daragyi lhab lhub can/khong shes sprin gyis shugs can 'di nyid 'bul//dpalaldan mgon po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas//zungs rten 'di la rten bcas bzhugasanas kyang //bdag cag dpon slob dge 'dun bcas pa yi//'galarkyen mimathun phyogasakun zhi ba dang //mthun rkyen bsam pa'i don kun 'grub paramadzod//zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po la sogasapa//gang la gang 'dula'aphrin —245

las thogs med sgrubs//chos 'khor 'di yi bstan pa gnyan po srungs//mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol du gsol//rgyal blon rgyal phran yulamigatso bo kun//thams cad dbang du bsdu ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/khyod larebaltosa'acha' zhing bcol lags so//rtags dang mtshan ma mngon sum bstan du gsol//bdag cag sde 'di'i mi phyugs nor dang 'khor//rang dbangayula'akhor thams cad khyed la gtad//nyin mtshan bya ra mel tshe ma g.yelacig/bcol lo bltos somathu stobs ci 'dug blta//rtsal shugasabaskyed la 'gawaba'i sde choms shig/yal yol rnam g.yeng le lo ma mdzad par//sngon gyi dmatshig rdo rje rjes dran nas//bcol ba'i las rnams thams cad grub paramadzod//ces brjod cing rol mo'i sgra skugs/de bzhi du/mun ltar gtibasashing rab 'jigasangar sgra can//glog dmar stir ba'i ro 'dzin skyod byed cing //rdorje'i rwartsesari rab rib du 'phen//g.yag rgod zhol chen ldan pa 'di nyid 'bul/dpalaldan mgon po lcam dral sogs sho lo ka gsum gong bzhi/'jam legs 5sdugagos gyon nyams stobs rgyas//yid 'ong sgra yi dir dir khams gsusagayo//'byil pa'i rwa can skye 'gro dbang du bsdud//lug nag spyi dkar g.yangachagasa'adi nyid 'bul//dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral sogs gong bzhi/'brug stong skad kyis bdud sde'i snying 'gasashing //drag gtum mche ba'i shugs kyisadagra dpung 'joms//'bum phrag gdong lnga'i tshogs kyang zil gnon pazhikhyi nagasnying dkar stobs ldan 'di 'bul lo//dpal ldan mgon po lcamadral zholanas/rten du gsol gyi bar gong bzhi/de yang rta g.yag lug khyi bzhi gar yod shā dngadu —246

byas pa yin/gcig gam gnyis sam gsum yod na'ang de dang de'i tshig gis 'bul bsdu na gangal yang /dpal ldan mgon po sogs shwa lo ka gsum kho nas kyang chogago/yangan/rin chen rgyan ldan rta nag rting dkar 'bul//rngamabarjid stobs ldan g.yag rogazhol chen 'bul//yid 'phrog g.yang chags lug nag spyi dkar 'bul//misrun dgra 'joms khyi nag snying dkar 'bul//go so//re re'i masañtsabalpiltur bas legs par 'gyur ro//lag len bsdus pa byed na/bgegs sbyangs pa dgagazungasasngagasa'adogs pa dang /khrus chu gtor nas gtor dbang tsam bskur/'bul ba'i tshigs bcad bsdusapa tsam brjod pas kyang chog go/de nas yig brgya lan gsum brjod/spyan drangs pa'i mgon po zungs rten la thim par mos nas/dza8PROB baṃ hoḥg mang du brjod la metog gtor nas/supratiṣ+ṭha dang /ye dharma bzla/bkra shis kyi tshog ji ltar 'os pa brjod cing /rol wo dngalas te cas rten rnams btang ngo //'di nyid lha dang sngags dang spyan 'dren tshigs cad sogs so so'i 'don pa bsgyur pas mgon po'i rigs gang la sbyar kyang chog go/ //zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas nyer mkho tsam brjod pa'o//gcig zhus/bkra shis// ༄tsho//gser skyems bzhugs so//༄7//(〈rdza〉 nang mchod byin rlabs bya/)sne nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'cha //hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan he ru ka/hūṃ nga ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos//klingani dpal ldan 〈khro'i rgyal 〉dus 'khor lo//hūṃ nga ni khro rgyal〈go'irjega'i〉rdorje shugs//hūṃ nga ni khams gsum dbang phyug bdag/skyed dang sdud pa'i byed po —247—

yin//srid zhi kun gyi gtso bo'o//rgyal ba yab yum dkyil 'khoralha//byangachub sems dpa' lha mor bcas//ye shes khro bo khro mo rnams//'dirabyon mchod sprin rgya mtsho bzhes//mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/skabazhi'i bdag nyid sangs rgyasadang //rigasaldan 〈rig yon 〉sprul pa'i tshogatsurnamasadang //rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad kyang //'dir byon mchogadang yidamadakyil 'khor lha tshogs dang //theg gsum 'phagasatshogs ma lusadang//bka' sdod chosaskyong srung ma kun//'dir byon —mag dang hūṃ bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho dang //lasabyed ma mo mkha' 'grodang//snang srid lha srin sde brgyad rnams//nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhig/(dusagasum bde gshegs bka' nyan gtso/〈/dpal gyi mgon po mthurtsalacan//legasaldan nag po chen po'i tshogs//lha chen dpal 'bar 'phrin lasamagon//trakad lcam dral 'khor dang bcas/〉/sde drug srung ma drug bcu'i tshogagardo/rje nag po chen po dang //dpal gyi lha mo rdzu 'phrul can//dpal r+ha rgyalapo rnamathos bu//ha ha rgod pa'i zhing skyong che//gzhan yang lasamakhan pu 〈shwan〉tra sogs//'khor tshogs bsam mi khyab bcas la//gser skyems bdud rtsi'adi 'bul lo//bar ho sol la 'dod don sgrub//hūṃ phyogs skyong bcu dngargyalachen bzhi//lha chen brgyad dang klu chen brgyad//'jigasabyed dgu dngagaza' wo dgu/rgyu skar nyer brgyad 'khor dang bcas//ming po gsum dbasrin mobazhi//ma bdun dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad//zhing du spyod pa'i mkha' 'grom//bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa//zhing skyong bzhi bcu zhe brgyad dang//phyogs—248—

bzhi sosor gnas pa yi//thub pa 'byung po nyer brgyad dang //dmagadapon gnod sbyin nyi shu brgyad//stosar+sā sum cu rtsa gnyis dang //yo'askyongab bcu drug dang //ljongs wo skyong ba lnga brgya sogs//laṅga la sogasasgri po'i tshogs//pho nya sum brgya drug cu dang //grub pa drang srong 'phrog mdang//nyikhyim cha yi lha rnams dang //sbyor ba nyer bdun byed pa bcu//gzhin rje'i rgyalapo 'khor bcas dang //gzhan yang bstan ma bcu gnyis dang //skyesabu gyingachen bco brgyad dang //dge bsnyen mthu chen nyi shu gcig/rje yi mguralha sumacu sogs//bod yul gnasapa'i sde brgyad kun//rang rang bud go g.yogasadang 'khor//mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun grogs bcas la//gseraskyems— khyad par gnas 'di'i chos skyong ba//sman btsun nags sman rgyal modang//nang 'khor sman mo 'bum sde dang //che btsan dmag dpon 'khoradangabacas//yul 'di'i lha klu gzhi bdag ni//rnam pa sna tshogs dpag yas la//gseraskyem gzhan yang lha dang gnod sbyin dang //gzhin rje dri za grul bum dang //lto 'phye mkha' lding mi'am ci//klu dang sa bdag gnyan gyi sde//rgyalapo btsan dngam mo bdud//gza' dang the rang 'gong po rmu//ri dnganagasatsharashingagi lha//dur khrod lam srang bzhi mdo deng /khyim dang mtshan gcig gnas lasogag/mdor na 'jig rten dregasapa can//srid gsum gnas pa ma lus kun gser skyem 'jig rten 'jig rten 'dasapa yi//mthu ldan dam pa khyed kun gyis//sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang //bstan 'dzin dge 'dun 'phel ba dang //rgyal khams sems can bde ba dang //gnod byed gdug pa tsharachod —249

cig/hūṃ khyad par nges don bstan pa gsal mdzad pa//chos kyi rgyalapodapal ldan jo nang ba'i//bstan pa yul rnams kun tu dar ba dang/khrad mthar mi nub rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba dang //bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bdang //rnal 'byor bdag cag gsang sngags zab mo yi//'phrin lasabasgrub pa'i dam tshig grogs mdzod cig/ci bsam yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol// //'di rgyas pa yin/bsdus pa phyogs skyong bcu dang sogs sh+lau ka bdun po tsam gyis yo chog go/zhus dag/maṅga yaṃ//༄tsho /rgyal wo rnam thos sras kyi drag gtor na tu zab pa rtags mngon gyur can bzhugs so//gtso bodang las mkhan gyidrag sngags ma sbas par bris yod pas bka' rgya dam pa gal che'o//dmar nag gang la sbyar kyang 'dra//dge'o//༄7//na mo gu ru badz+ra dha rā ya/sto po ོ po rnam thos sras drag po'i gto0'a 4khya bar 'dod pas/gnas dben par bgegs bskud pa dang byur bsal ba sogs byas ga.a mṛ ta'i sngags bzlas pas sa gzhi la gtor/der dkyil 'khor 'bri dgos pa las/dmarapo rtaston can nang sgrub tu grags pa ltar na/'khor lo pad+ma zlum skor rim pa gnyis dang ldan pa 'bri dgosal/gsang ba ma mo ltar sgrub pa 'di dang /gshin rje bzhi skor lta bu'i sgrub pa dngosagagoralo —250

rtsibs bzhi kho nas chog pa zhig dang / rtsibs bzhi nyis rim byed pa'ang yod/ gzhan yangasgrubapami'adra ba ladakyil 'khor rgyas bsdus ci rigs 'dug kyang / 'dir kun bsdus spyi drilagyi dbang du byas na/ gtor bzlog sogs kyi las rim la stobs che bar grags pas/ de ltar bshad na/ dbasasu gru gsum mthing nag me ri 'bar ba la'akhor losngon po'am/ pad+ma sngon po dang nyi ma'i stengasaphyag mtshan ralagri'am/ sa bon be+e nag po'am/ de dag ma 'grub na tshom bu nag po zhig 'god do/ /de'i phyi rol zlum por bskor/ gru chad dmar po bya/ zlum skor gyi snam bu lashar dakha/lhoser/nub dmar/ byang sngo ba'i phyogs mdog can la chu ris 'bri/ de'i phyi rol 'bor lo sngonamortsisabargyad la/ sras bzhi dang / blon po bzhi'i tshom bu sku mdog dang mthun par 'god/ de'i phyi zlum skor sngon po'am ljang khu la rgyalar+sā bzhi'i tshom bu ni nges par 'god cing / spro na gshin rje bzhi dgasrin po bzhi dang / mchod lha bzhi yang 'god do/ /mtha' rdo rwa me ris bskor/ der maphyi'i steng du gtor ma r+sā po kha zas bzang rgu dang shakhragasna tshogs kyis brgyan pa zur gsum zhig bsham/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhin gtor ma chung bgru gsum re bsham ste/ rim pas ra khyi mi rta rnams kyi sha khrag gis brgyan par byed dgos palas/ma'abyor na so so'i gzugs bas btsugs te/ sha khrag ci 'byor gyis brgyan pa dang / gzhanayangabasgos bu gru bzhi rgya phibs can dang bse zhal du chang phud ma nyams pa dang / mda' bya rgod ma ladar leb rgan btags pa dang / zho cha dang / bre srang sogs bsham/ 'phen gtoratheg gzugs me ri can dang / de'i mdun du las mkhan gyi gtor ma/ zan gru gsum gyi steng du snying gzugasadangabacas pa bsham/ klu gtor yang bsham/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ rten bsham zhing rgyan dgramapar bya'o/ /de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs sngon du btang nas/ yi dmagyibadag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ yi dam ni spyir sgrub pa tsam yin na zhi khro gang gis kyang—251—

rung /gtor bzlog sogs drag po dang 'brelan yang /ye shes khro bo gang gis kyang sa rdzo/dregs pa spyi'i gar+sā po'am/gnod sbyin 'dulaba'i dbang du byas na/bcom ldan 'dasagasangabadag nyid dam rdo rje rnam 'joms sogs bsngags par byed/ma mo gshin rje'i las tshogs dnga'abrelaba'i dbang du byas nas/gshin rje gshed nyid bsngags par yang grags/yig rnyingalalanarta mgrin bsngags par byas pa'ang gda'/kun gyi gnyen po mthar thug ni/khams gsumarnalargyalalam dpalahe ru ka yin pas de ltar yang legs so//de nas mdun bskyed ji ltar 'os pa'i yi dmagyigator rdzo kyang grub par bya'o//de dag ni nges par dgos la/de rjes rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs kyang yin/sprulagazhi yang yinapas/rgyalachen zhi babade byed ma'i gtor chog bskang bstod yan chad kyang 'grub par byas na shinatu legs mod/yang drag gtor gyi cho ga'i yan lag tu ni nges can dgos pa rang yang ma yin pas/ma grub kyang 'galab med do//de las gzhan pa dpal ye shes kyi mgon po gang yang rung ba'i bskang ba sogs grub na rgyabadapung du legs par 'gyur ba'ang yin la/sgrub pa po'i blo'i khyad par gyis res 'ga' phan med gnod med dang /phanaganod gnyis gar yod par 'gyur ba'ang yod rdzo/drag las chos skyong rigs mi gcig pa ha cang mang bdus gcig tu byed pa ni mi bzang ste/tshang yulagyi sgo nas khyad med kyang /sgrub pa po rang gi dmigs pa sogs gnad la mi 'grilabar/blo mang du 'gro phe phyir ro//da ni 'dir drag gtor gyi cho ga la/zhi drag gnyis kyi cho ga spelanasam pa'i srolazhig kyang byung 'dug mod kyi/bskang gso tsam lade ltar mi 'gal yang /drag lasasgruban de ltar byed mi bde ṣ+ka 'byams pa'i rgyu yin pas/'dir drag gtor gyi cho ga sgos su o do//de yang 'di ltar/// yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir//spyan drangasagashegasasu—252

gsol ba dang //dbang bskur yang dag thob pa las//su yang 'da' b.ramabyed cig/oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/rdo rje gsor zhing phur pa'i dpal yo ldobastato//mtshams gcod do//hūṃ bdag cag ma rig lusadang ngag sems kyis//gsang sngags tshulabazhin sgrub sngo ma thogasate//rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyamasagyur pa//blamarnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags//yi dam lha tshogs spyan sngar mthoralo bshags//phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags//gtsangarisamagon po'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags//chosaskyong lcam dral spyan sngaramatholalo bshags/ /lha srin sde brgyad spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ /mthol bshags phul nasatshangasapar mdzad du gsol/ /tshar gsum/bgasayo//bshags pa rgyas pa la dga' na yig rnying du blta'o//sman rag gtor gsum sngar yi dam gyi gtoram dang lhan cig byin gyis brlabs pa de/gsos btab pa'i tshulagyis/oṃ āḥ& mahāsabopañtsa a n+t+rata hūṃ hrīḥṭha/oṃ āḥ& raṃ rak+ta dza la sa mu dra ya hūṃ hrīḥṭha/oṃ mahāb 6ta te dzo ba lita gu h+ya sa ma ya hūṃ swāhā/༅ skun snyun gyis byin gyis dgasasnyunatsod bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las 'od zer 'phrosapas gnamalcags 'bar ba'i tsha tsha zhabrug pa'i sagazhi'i steng du/rdo rje'i rwa gur rabatuyangs pa'i bsrung 'khor du gyur pa'i nang du/sprin nag 'brugs pa'i dkyila'akhor gyi gzhi la mi mgo skam rlon rid gsum brtsigasapa'i gzhal med khang /gru bzhi sgo bzhi 'jigs su rung zhing mi sdug pa'i rgyan dang rta babs kyis brgyan pa/phyi rol du dur khrod kyis yongs su bskor ba/nang gi lha snamaphyogasakyi —253—

mdog can gyi dbus su/ zlo las 'bor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa/ mug laral gri'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i dbus su ma mo'i gnas rgya mtsho kha dogabazhi las khor yug tu bskor ba/ de'i dbus su gru gsum mthing nag 'baraba'i nang du/ 'bor lo sngon po rtsibasabargyad pa'i lte bar/ ru tra pho modzi5ba'i gdan steng du hūṃ mthing nag de lasa'od 'phros/ dgra bgegasagadug pa can thams cad tshar gcad/ tshur 'dus yongasasu gyur pa las/ chosaskyongargyalapo chen po rnam thos srasasku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gnyisadagra bgegasal sdang mig tu blta ba/ mche ba gtsegasashing khro gnyer bsdus pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri me 'bar ba 'phyar bas gnod byed dgra bgegasabyad ma thams cad kyi mgo lus 'grel /breg pa/ g.yon pas mda' dar leb rgan phrag par brten zhing g.yob pas/ sde brgyad malusapa'i dmag dpung bsdu ba/ sku la dar nag gi ber chen bse khrab smug po dngabacas pa gsol ba/ dbu la lcags kyi rmog zhu gsere gyi thig le can pa/ zhabs la sag ti'i lham g.yu ris can gsol ba/ be+e ḍūr+ya'i mdogacan gyi rta mchog lusanyams rtsal dang ldan pa/ gser gyi sga dang / 'phra men gyi yob can la chibs pa/ sprul dang mi mgo'i rgyan can/ shin tu 'jigs sudrangab srin po'i cha lugs can me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbusan bzhugs shing / srin po dngagashin rje dang bya gcan gdug pa'i tshogs rnams sku lasaspro ba/ 'khor gnod sbyin bye bas bskor ba'o/ /yang na rta nag rkyang dang / phyag g.yon mdung dmar ba dan can byed pa'ang yod/ de'i thugs gar yang nyi ma la gnas pa'i be+e yig mthinganagago /phyi —254
