rol rgya mtsho bzhi la shar du traka las bdud mo gshen rje mgo dgu ma/ sku mdog smug nag gam dkar mo/ phyag g.yas dung gi spu gri dang g.yon thod khraga'adzin pa/ thod skam gyi dbu brgyan dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ dar dkaranagaspelaba'i na bza' can/ ba men ru yon la chibs shing / gti mug klad pa'i mtsho larol ba'o/ /lho ru raka las bdud mo gshin rje lag ring ma nag mo/ lagapa stong g.yas lnga brgyas ral gri dang / g.yon lnga brgyas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ milpags kyi stod g.yogs dang / stags lpags kyi smad dkris can/ mahe nagapo la chibs shing / nga rgyal rkang dang zhag gi mtsho la rol ba'o/ /nub tu sha yig las bdud mo gshin rje phung khrol ma dmar nag /g.yasalcags kyu'am dgra zor g.yon dgra snying 'dzin pa/ zhalanas khrag zor 'phen pa/mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang / rus 'phreng gi thod byasapa/ g.yagarnyed nagapo chibs shing / 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtshor rol ba'o/ /byang du bh+yoḥlasabadud mo gshin rje gsod byed ma ljang nag lag pa brgya pa/ g.yas lnga bcu khramashingadang / g.yon lnga bcu bdud zhags dang / dgra bo'i glo snying sbrags te 'dzen pa dred lpags kyi smad g.yogs can/ rkyang bu kha dkar ram rnga mong la chibasashing/phrag dog 'khris pa'i rgya mtshor rol ba'o/ /thams cad kyang mimago'i do shalacan/ rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i bud med drag shul can 'bum 'bumagyisabaskor ba'o/ /phyi rol kyi 'bor lo'i rtsibs brgyad la/ shar du sha yigalasagaza' bdud chen po rā hu la/ lhor ra yig las gnod sbyin dha na/ nub tumayig las gnod sbyin ka la/ byang du na yig las gnod sbyin ku be ra stosras—255

bzhi dang / shar lhor ye las gnod sbyin bum rna/ lho nub tu salasaganod sbyin dung rna/ nub byang du ha las gnod sbyin dril bu'i rna ba'am rna gsum/ byangasharadu e lasaganod sbyin rna bo che ste blon po bzhi dang / lha rnams kyi phyogasabazhin/shar du ṣ+ṭṛ las rgyal wo yul 'khor srung dkar po mda' gzhu dang pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ glang po che la nyon pa/ lhor be las 'phagasaskyesapo sngon po ralagri'adzenapa/ ma he la zhon pa/ nub byadzadu bi lasaspyan mi bzang dmar po skugadungadangasbrul zhagasa'adzin pa/ chu srin la zhon pa/ byang du be+e las/ lasamakhan ngalagasos po ljang nag dbyug to 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang go cha bgosashing/ srin po ltar ches khrosapa'o/ /sgo bzhin lcagasakyu zhagasapa lcags sgrog dril bu mabazhi dang / gra bzhin mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang / gzhan yang gshin rje'i rgyalapo bzhi dang / srin po'i ded dpon bzhi la sogasapa/ pho nya drag gtusagyi tshogs dang sde brgyad grangasamed pas bskor de bzhugasapa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phrosate/ ye shesasemasadapa' badz+ra samādzaḥhūṃ ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogasanas/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas/ /mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /chos skyong rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /tshan parardzogasapar sangasargyas kyang / /'gro ba'i don du sku sprul pa/ /chibasasurdzu'aphrul rta la chibs/ /sku mdog nag po bse khrab gsol/ /gser gyi rmonazhu gyen du brdzes/ /g.yas kyi ral gris dgra bgegasasgrol/ /g.yon pa mda' dar dmag dpung g.yob/ khyod ni dmag dpon chen po ste/ /gnod sbyin bye ba'i dmag dang bcas/ /ma mo gnod sbyin gshin rje'i tshogs/ /dgra bgegs—256

lcang lo can gyi pho brang na//bzang po'i khri la bzhugs nas ni//gter chen bzhi la mnga' mdzad pa//j-i bha la la phyag 'tshal lo//lha chen khyod ni khros pa'i tshe//spyan rtsa dmar po bzlog pa yis//dgra la mi nad phyugs nad gtong //lus ngan po la phyag 'tshal bstod//gshin rje ya mān ta ka yis//gdong dmara'adulabar dbang bskur ba//gzhin rje dmar po srog gi bdag/ma ru rtselaphyaga'atshal lo//rgya gar rdo rje gdan drung du//rgyal ba shākya thub pa yis//chosa'akhor srung mar dbang bskur ba//bsgob che la phyag 'tshal ཿ/gru gu'i yuladu gshegs pa na//gru gu rta dmag rgyal po yis//srung ma chen por dbangabaskurab//ku be ra la rgya nag yul du gshegasapa'i tshe//rgya chen darabatsan dmarapo yis//te te'i srung mar mnga' gsol ba//mdung dmar can laphyaga'atsharalo//bod yul dbusakyi bsam yas su//slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnasakyis//srung ma r+pā por dbang bskur ba//chos kyi rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo//chos skyong rgyal po rdzu 'phrul can/khyod kyi mthu stobs bsam mi khyab//sngon gyi thugasadamarjes dgongasal//da lta bdag gi mgon mdzod cig/shar phyogasargyamatsho'i klong dkyil nas//gshin rje khros pa'i mthu mo che//'jigs pa'i bud r+sā dkar la 'tsher//bdud mo mgo dgu ma la bstod//des 'gre/lho phyogasargya mtsho'i— gshin rje 'jigs pa'i bud med nag la rngam//gshin rje lagaringam la bstod//nub phyogs rgya mtsho'i— gshin rje 'jigs pa'i bud med dmeral 'bar//srin mo phung khrol ma la bstod//byang phyogs gyomatshog gzhin rje 'jigs pa'i bud med ljang neg 'thibs//ma mo lag brgya ma la'adud/tas—258—

mchog dam pa rā hu la//mgo dgu srin po'i cha lugasacan//chu srin rgyal mtshan sprul zhags 'dzin//gdug pa khrul mdzad khyod la bstod//gnod smi dha na sku mdog ser//zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis pa//rtsegasumathod khraga'abar ba 'dzin//gdug pa phrul mdzad sgri la bca//gnod gho rkala'ajigs gzugs smug/zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis pa//pecan thod khrag 'bar ba 'dzin//gdug pa sil mdzad khyod la bstod//kube rani sku mdog ljang //zhal gceg dbyugasatho 'bar ba thod khragawon//skugapa 'dul mdzad /dregs pa bum rna dmar ljang la//zhalagazhig— /rgyalamatshan dang ni ne'u le 'dzin//gdug paḥ dregs pa dung rna ser ljangal/zhalagacig — /mdung dmar dang ni ne'u le 'dzin//gdug pa dregs pa rna gsumaljagasanagal//zhal gcig rtse gsum dang ni ne'u le 'dzin//gdugapa dregasapa rnochen dkar ljang la/zhal gcig dbyug pa 'bar ba ne'u le'adzin//gdugapa bol mdzad khyod la bstod/shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor srung //shar gyi dgra bgegs phrul mdzad cing /shar phyogs bstan pa skyong ba po//driza'i rgyalapo phyag 'tshal bstod//lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po//lho yi lta lho phyogasabastan pa grul bum nub phyogasan ni spyan mi bzang/yis kyi nubaphyogayoklu 'brug rgyal po byang phyogs las mkhan rnam thos bu//byangagyibyangaphyogayoganod sbyin rgyal po shar phyogasasgo srungs wo mo na dkar mo ltogonaphyag gnyis ma/khro rgod brkyang bskum gar gyisarol//lcags kyuphan laphyaga'atshal lo//lho phyogs sgo ser mo zhal khro rgod lhasapa won pa nub —259

phyogs dmar mo khro rgod lcags sgrog byang phyogs — rdzonagakhros dril bu 'dzin gzhan yang mchod pa'i lha rnams dang / /gying pho gying mo pho nya bran/ /lha srin sde brgyad mthu bo che/ /de dag kun la'ang phyaga'atsharabastod/ /dzaḥsnyi baṃ hoḥ dmatshig 'khor lo dang gnyisasu med par thim/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa me/ mi bskyod pas dbu la brgyan par gyur/ dpralabaram/ mgrinapara.āḥthugasakar hūṃ/ bsnyen pa'i skabs yin na/ oṃ be+e shā ma ṇa ya ཿswāhā trakarak+ṣañtsazhes bzla ba man ngag zhal gdams kyi yig chung na yod/ rgyun bzlas la/ oṃ be+e shā baṇa ngohrīḥskyo bi kri sarba sha chun hūṃ rdu/ tshon rje ltar sgrub pa'i sngags so/ /hūṃ be+e tho/rasnabh+yoḥs bzlas kyi snying po 'phrudrug pa ste ma mo ltar sgrubapa'i snying po'o/ /de la raka mo ruX 34ri li li mā ra ya snying la khrag khro/ mā ra du ya sod bod su bod bu bh+yoḥchokho māraya rbad/ ces btags pa ni bod sngags so/ /de ltar bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ dun dunazlugagarmugasapa shang tsa la tsa la/ pa tsa pa tsa/ hi ma hi ma/ rbad na rbad na/ bod tulingarbad me sha ya tshege mo la mā ra ya rbad bod/ bod bsad sbrags pa'o/ /de dgacirigasaparabazla'o/ /bzlas pa grolanas/ 'dir gtor bsngo byed na/ gtor ma a mṛ tasabatshog sugawas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ lasarlung / raṃ lasame/ a las mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum/ de'i steng du oṃ las thod pa'i nang du/ oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrīḥ.a/ 8lo62 haṃlas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ de rnams zhu ba lasabyung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgyamatsho wo por gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gnod byed gdugapa can thamasacad bkug ste bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi phung po chen po dang gtor ma gcig tu 'dresapa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ o.āḥ&/ lan gsum/ a kā —260—

dam bskangs//phyi yi rten rdzasayin pa'i phyir//rta mchog sngon po o yā 'di//rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/khyed kyi thugs dam skongagyuracig/nang gi rten rdzasayin pa'i phyir//'khor bcas brisasku mtshanayā 'di//rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/khyed kyi thugs dam skong gyuracig/gsang ba'i rten rdzasayin pa'i phyir//gri snying 'khor lo sngags bcasa'adi//rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/khyed kyi thugasadam khamasagasusadabang du bsdu ba'i phyir//mdung dmar dar gyis brgyan pa 'di/rgyalachen— khyed kyi thugs 'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir mda' dar dmarapo sngags can 'di//rgyal chen khyed kyi rtag tu mi 'brala'agrogasapa'i phyir//'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rtag gtor 'di//rgyal wo /khyed kyi rgyun du 'phrin lasabacol ba'i phyir//dmar nag bshosabu zur gsum 'di//rgyalachen khyed kyi //dgyesapa'i dam rdzasayin pa'i phyir//dza gad phud kyi mgo pa 'di//rgyal chen khyed kyi sngon gyi thugs dam bskul ba'i phyir//bdud rtsisman gyirgyamatsho 'di//rgyal chenaḥkhyed kyi dgra bgegasartsad nas gcod pa'i phyir//rak+ta dmar gyi arnya 'di//rgyal chen— khyed kyi brtag tu dri la dgyesapa'i phyir/khrizhim spos kyi dud pa 'di//rgyal chen— khyed kyiḥganod sbyin dgyesapa'i dmardzas ni//sna tshogs shing 'bras dam pa 'di/rgyal chenaḥ khyed kyithugasadam gzhan yang mchod rdzas nor sna rnams//mo btsun g.yog 'khor rkang 'grosasogs//srid pa gsum na yod rgu cog/gzung rgyu thams cad 'bul gyi bzhes//chosaskyong mgon r+ya —de ring bdag gi mgon la byon//rgyan gyi yorama'adi —262

bzhes la/dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs//shin tu gdungabasakhyod bskul na//ma yengs chos skyong thugasadam can//sngon gyi dam tshigarjesadagongs la/rdzu 'phrul mthu yi dngos grub stsol//ces snang ngo //de nasadagrarmi sam 'phrin las bskul ba ni/gong bzhi/hūṃ ri rgyal lhun po spyo pa nas/bye ba'i dmag dang bcas//dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor//thu ba brdzes laphragapa phud//sto bo'i yul du dmag sna drongs//rnal 'byor bdagaladagra byungan//chos gcig rgyal po dgra la chos//chos gcig lha chen dmag la chog/rtagasadang mtshan ma khyer la shog/'bru drug pa la dbyangs zha gsum byas nas/gastomadatso ma la sman dang rak+ta bran no//bh+yoḥmathing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i shar phyogasanas//bdud mogashin rje mgo dgu ma//zas su mdzo mo ru yon 7sa//gshin rje khrosapa'i mthumo che//na bza' dkar nag 'bar ba la//phyag na dung gospu gri thogag/dgra bo'i bshan mo bdud kyi ma//bdud mogashin rje mgo dgu las//mgog6kabang gi lha la rgyug/mgo gcig phugs kyi nor la rgyug/mgo gciga'achan gyi bu la rgyug/mgo gcig steng gi pho la rgyug/mgo gcig 'og gi mo largyug/mgo gcig ra ba'i phyugs la rgyug/mgo gcig sgo yi khyi la rgyug/mgogatsenaphyi yi zhing la rgyug/mgo gcig srog gi gshed ma gyis//gshed masa'agugasashing cho nges thob//bdud mo ston rje mgo dgu ma//rnal worabadagaladagrabyung gi/chosastog sring mo dgra la chos//chosachugadamadzo sto lachog/bdud mogashin rje mgo dgu mas//dam khosadagra bo'i tsit+ta la mā ra ya na dza—263

byed ma/ /rnal 'byor bdag la sogs gong bzhi/ bdud mo lag brgya masadamanyams dgra bo tshal pa tshal pa/ snying khrag la mā ra ya rbad dza dzaḥ 4stothonartagasadabang btsan par byas kyi/ dpe rnying mang po na nub dang byang go brjes par yang 'jug go/hūṃ ri rgyal lhun po'i shar phyogs na/ /pho brang r+pā po sposangad si/ /rgyalapo chen po yul 'khor srung / /sku mdog dkar po bse khrab gsol/ /gseragyi rmog zhu gyen du brdzes/ /phyag na go'u rgyud mang bsnams/ khyod ni dmanadangon chen po ste/ /dri za 'bum gyi dmag dang bcas/ /dmag dpung bskyed larumatshon phyor/ /thu ba brdzes la phrag pa phud/ /dgra bo'i yul du nas/ lha cen dmag la chos kyi bar gong gtso bo'i skabs bzhi/ ri rgyal lhun po'i lho phyogs na/ /pho brang chen po chos kyi 'phags/ /rgyal po chen po'i 'phags skyes po/ /mahe brjid pa'i sku mdog sngon po bse khrab gsol/ /gser gyi phyag na ral gri 'bar ba bsnams/ khyod ni dmag dpon gshin rje 'bum gyi dmag dpungabaskyed la sogs gong bzhi/ ri rgyal lhun po'i nub phyogs na/ /pho brang wo po rgyamatshogling//rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang / /chu srin bsnol ba'i sku mdog dmarapo gser gyi phyag na sku gdung 'od 'bar bsnams/ khyod ni klungadud 'bum —dmag dpung bskyed sogs gong bzhi/ ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogasan/ /pho brangachen po lcang locan/ /las byed rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /sku mdogaljanganag seng ge brjid gser gyi phyag na dgra 'joms dbyug to bsnamagacad ni gnod sbyin 'bum dmag dpung sogs gong bzhi/ oṃ bh+ri ta raṣ+ṭa yā swāhā/ oṃ be+e ru dhe ka ya swāhā/ oṃ be+e ru pak+ṣa ya swā hā/ oṃ be+e shā ba ṇa ya swāhā zhesaphyogasabozhi —265 ri

gtor ma la sngar bzhi sman raka sgreng ngo //sras mchog dam pa'i rā hu la//'jigarten dregs pa'i mche ba can//gsod pa'i las la rab tu brtson//phyogasamatshamasaskyin thang 'khor lo can//bdag go dgra bo dbang du bsdus//dmanyasarnams la cog 'gyel thong //bcol ba'i las la mthu ma chung //gnod smi dha na srog gi gshed//dregs pa chen po rtsa rgyud 'dren//sku mdog gseranaga'abar ba la//lag na mtshon cha'i char pa 'bebs//gang nas gangadu rbad tsaman//dgra bo'i srog rtsa drongs las shog/bcol ba'i gnod sbyin ka la srog gi gshed//bdud 'dul nag po mche ba can//lag na be cen tshe4rathogs//dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod las shog/bcol ba'i bdud bolawo po kube ra//lag na ral gri phur bu thogs//'dul ni bstan pa 'jig pa 'dul//dgra bo'i mi phyugs phyags mas thob//bcol ba'i de yi bka' dpungagashed do bzhi//dregs pa bum rna ba dan 'phyar//bstanapa 'jig pa'i snying nas drongs//dregs pa dung rna rtse gsum thogs//bstan pa bzhig pa'i snying lalhub/khregasapa dril rna dbyug tho'adzin//bstan pa bzhigs pa'i mgo lus com//gnod byed kha phung thal bar rlog/dregs pa drag 'dul rna bo che//lag na mdungadamar zangs se zangs //bstan pa 'jig pa'i dmag tshogs chom/khregasapa kha bgrad dgra bgegs 'dul//bdag gi dgra bo rdul du rlogs//dun dun rmugs sogs kyi drag sngags brjod do//hūṃ srin po ya ma rā waṃ sku//smug nag be con 'khor lo snamig/dmanyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod//smyos shig ya ma me dak+ṣe//gshin rje myos—266

byed 'bar ba'i sku/ /ser nag be con 'khor lo bsnams/ /dam nyamastsodakrugs shig — bdud po ar+ya dmar po'i sku/ /dmar nag dam nyas༅rdungs shig gnod sbyin ral pa tshar dgu ni/ /ljang nag dmanya4sengazhig dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ nyi zla spa ra ya/ dmag dngon chen po sha ta ya/ /biṣ+ṭa rā dza be+e mā ra thang thang bh+yoḥ dgra bo mā ra ya rbad ces dragatu༅ga gzhan yangabaka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ /shar gyi phyogs nas bskul ba ni/ /sogapo lcagasakyi sma ra can/ /chibasasu chu rta sngon po chibs/ /phyag na gcod byed ralagri bsnams/ /dam nyams sgrol ba'i dus la bab/ /lho yi phyogs nas bskul ba ni//gnod sbyin zangs ma'i 'be slog can/ /chibs su btsan rta dmar po chibs/ /rab tu khros nas mda' gzhu 'gengs/ /dam nyams nub kyi phyogs nas bskul ba ni/ /bdud po dar nag g.yang gzhi can/ /chibs su bdud rta nag po chibs//phyag na dar nag ru mtshon 'phyar/ /dam nyams byang gi phyogs nasabaskulab ni/ /skyes bu 'ob kyi 'gying gzhu can/ /chibs su rgyal rta dkarapo chibag /phyag na dar dkar g.yab mo 'debs/ /dam nyams dgra bo sgrol la shog /oṃ be+e shā ma ṇa tri sa ra pra ya hūṃ 'bor ba 'bor ba hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ dgra bo'i srog labh+yo bh+yoḥdrag tu bskul/ phyag rgya bdud 'dul bka' nyan ni/ /dam can phyogasabazhi'i dgra 'dul ma/ /lcags kyu 'bar bas snying nas drongs/ /zhags pa 'barabasaganas nas khug /lcags sgrog 'bar bas yan lag sdoms/ /dril bu 'barabs rdul du rlogs/ /gzhan yang pho nya dam can ni/ /sde brgyad namamakha' gangab rnams/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po'i bka' byung gi /bdag gis bcolaba'i las—267—

bdag cag 'khor bcasal sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ bzlas pa cungar bya'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ lasabyed gnod sbyin mdungadamaracan sku mdog dmar po/ pho nya drag gtum gyi gzugs go chas can/ mdungadamar dang sku gdung bsnamasapa/ 'khor las byed bshan pa'i tshogs dngabacas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ arnya nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ srog dngadabugasaladabang byedapa/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po ma ru tse/ /phyagan rdo rje'i bka' nyan mchog/mthu stobs bsam mi khyab la bstod/ /sgrol gying shaṃ shaṃ rtsed rtsed sha sha radzamani gying ka ra kri kri yaṃ yaṃ shog shog bsdusabasdusakhyer thung khyer thung gying rā dza ma ni bh+yoḥ zhes srog sngags mang du bzlas la/ sngags de nyid kyi mthar/ e rda ba liṃ ta sogs gong bzhi sbyar la gtor ma phul/ gtum po yaṃ yaṃ sgrol gying yaṃ yaṃ ma ru tse las layotha/zhes pa'i bod sngags cung zad bzlas la/ raka phud kyis gtor zhing / hūṃ bar snangakhamasakyi gying rgod ku be ra/ /sku mdog dmar nag khrag rul baṃ gyi mdog /ba spu seranag tsha tsha sngo dmar 'byug kha rlangs sngo dmar nad kyi rlangs pa 'thol/ /kengarus mche gtsigs khrag gi kha phru 'debs/ /dug sprul nag pos ral pa thod du bcings/ /rus sbal nag po'i g.yang gzhi zhwa ru gsol/ /thod 'phrengabadud kyigayang gzhi phrag la bkal/ /g.yas na mi mgo'i rnga brdung di ri sri /g.yon na mi rkang gling bu kyu ru mā /seng ge chibs nas dam nyams khrag rjesagacod/ /nyams pa'i lus srog phrol cig mā ra ya/ /gying rgod ku be ra yi dusalabab/ /rdo rje rnam thos srasakyi dusal bab/ /ces brjod/ tring tring ra dza ma ni snyingashad shad hang hang mā ra ya ni du dza dgra bo'i srog rtsa la mā ra ya du dzaḥ zhoyogatusal—270—

lo//'di'i drag gtor gyi cho ga'i yan lag tu/tshogs phud kyi bsgral mchod ma gtogs/ling sgrol gyi gsal kha med pas/cho ga'i yan lag tu med mi rung ma yin la/spros pa la dga' naskabasa'adir byed la/de bzhi du gser skyems dang /sgo dbye 'phrang sol sogs spros pa byed natswa'adir byed/spyi dang 'dra'o//de nas drag gtor gnyis dgra phyogs su spags te/bh+yoḥsrid pa'i lha 'dres dpang mdzod cig/ngas ni ma nyes ma yo'o//las ngan srid pa'i dgra bo 'di//chos la bar gcod byed du byung //bdud momingasring rgyal mo bzhi/khros pas sprul pa'i tshogs dang bcas//bzhengasashigapho nya dbyings nas bzhengs//skyod cig chibs la myur du skyod//srog zan chen pod skyod cig/shar nas dkar mo'i tshogs rnams skyod//lho nas ser mo'i chogasarnams stod//nub nas dmar mo'i tshogs rnams skyod//byang nas ljangamo'i tshogs rnams skyod//sprul pa nag mo'i tshogs rnams skyod//yangasprulami bzad tshogs rnams skyod//ma thogs myur du las mdzod cig/bdag godagra bo lasangan 'di'i//tsit+ta phyung la khyer las shog/byams sdug gnyen dang myuradu phrol//rten pa rgya mtsho'i mtha' la skyod//yul sa bskor nas 'gangs su chod//smyo 'bog thong zhig tsit+ta dkrugs//'o dod mchi bshal brang lag rdobag/ltasangan nad yams dgra la thong //mi nad phyugs nad rim nad thong //dgra bgegs mun nag srogadus la//thugs chen bla 'bod 'khyams suchug/mtshon cha dug dang tsha ba'i nad//rang gis rang la skud du chug/rbad pa'i lasachen da mdzod cig/dus la bab po sa mā ya/hūṃ be+e traka raka bh+yoḥdagra bochegomo la bh+yoḥbh+yoḥzhes pa'i mthar/las mkhan mdung dmar can gyi sngags gsum sbrel nasabazla —271—

bzhin du/las mkhan gyi drag gtor 'phangs/de'i rjes su rgyal chen gyi drag gtora'aphen/de dag gi mthar/zor sna tshogs pa 'phen rgyu yod na yang 'phen la/hūṃ be+e traka rasnabh+yoḥphrigakhrigachum chum sngo nyer raka mo snying rtsa la stse breng dung dung bh+yoḥbh+yoḥraka sha bh+yoḥbh+yoḥzhes g.yang gzhi gdab cing ral pa sprug/de nas slob dpon gyis rting mnan te 'ongs lkanangadu mchod bstod rgyas par bya zhing tshogs la longs spyad/rjes kyi cho ga ni spyi dang 'dra'o/khas pa bsdus pa byed na/lha tshogs dbugs 'byin lha min 'joms la dpa'//mibazad bdud 'dul cha lugs bstan pa skyong //byang phyogs rgyal po bdud rgyal rnamathos sras//'khor bcas sprul pa yang sprul tshogs la bstod//narwakhagabyangaphyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras/khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i lha//gsod byed gshin rje'i cha byad can//mdung dmar 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ltasabya zhing gas la'ang 'don pa spos pas rung ngo //'dir spros pa la dga' na zor 'phen pa'i khasasu yang /gong du bshad pa'i las labaskul ba de dag ci rigs pa sngon du btang nas/srid pa'i lha'adre dpang mdzod cig sogs kyis btang ngo //gtor ma'i lag len cung zad tsam/yi ger bris pa'i dge ba las/nyon mongasadagra tshogasakun bcom nas//thar pa'i dga' ston 'byed par shog/de ltar na 'di ni drag las spyi driladu byas pa yin la/gtso bo nang sgrub la mos na dkyus la/sku mdog dmar po mdung dang ne'u lewonapayin kyang /drag las 'ba' zhig lamachod rten nag po 'dzin par byed/'khor lo rtsibasarga nangadu byas nas sras bzhi 'god/phyi ma rtsibs brgyad la phyogs bzhir bdud mo bzhi dang/mtshamasabazhir blon po bzhi bkod na rung /drag las kho na la blon po bzhi'i phyag mtshan ne'u le rnams nad rkyal du skur ba yin no//cho ga gas gong bzhi mngon rtogs dang /ri rgyal lhun po mal 'don —272—

pa skur/dgra chos kyi sngon la bstod pa dmag mas ma 'di gyer ro//rgyal chen rnam sras mdung dmar can/ /chibs su sngon po rgab nag chibs//rol du ngang pa phum dmar rol//seng ge rngam pa pho nyara'agyed//snga long g.yasanas sras kyi tshogs rnams gshegs//phyi long g.yon nas btsun mo'i tshogs rnams gshegs//dbus nas rgyal chen gtso bo bzhengs pa ni//rin chen rgyan dang bse khrab khyabo gsol//phyag na bsemadung dmar pobasnams//dbu la bseyi rmog zhu gsol/ /zhabs la bseyi go khrab mnabs//bse yi rmog zhu chen po la//rgod kyi dang ru ldemasaseldems//daradamar cod pan pu ru sa/bse khrab de ni sil li li//g.yu mthurade ni khrugasase khyugs//rta dmag tshogs kyis sa gzhi gang //gnod sbyin tshogasakyisabarasnang gang //ru mtshon dmar pos nam mkha' gang //mgon po dmanalamasatsam na//sa gzhi ri rab 'dar zhing g.yo//dgra bo'i yul mkhar rmangasanasazhig/'dir gshegs rgyan gyis gtor ma bzhes//rnal 'byor bcolaba'i 'phrin las mdzod//ces pa'o//rnam thos sras bka' gter gyi r+yā skor rnams/g.yer bo jo ston las brgyud nas rim pas so sor gyes pa'i lugs srol mang po byung ba las/khro lo nas brgyud pa dang /sbal ti dgra bcom pas brgyud pa gnyis po 'di ngo mtshar che bar byed/gnyis /labaka' gter gyi man ngag thams cad bzhugs mod kyang /mdzo spyod drag po'i skabs khro lo phyogs rnamasagasar ma drag byed la gtso bor mdzad/sbal ti phyogs rnams gsang sgrub rnying ma 'di kho na la gtsobor mdzad pa 'dug/yang kha skad du/rnam sras la zhi ba gsar ma zab/drag po rnyingamazab kyangazer ba ltar/drag byed las rta sngon can 'di las myur bar grags/gsang sgrub 'di lar gshin —273

rje khram thogs kyi rgyud sogs snubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi skabs su byung ba'i bka' ma gasku mdog nag po 'di byung ba yin/ gnyal ba nyi she'i gtor ma la gzhan 'dra ba las sku mdog dmarapor byed de/ spyir gnyal ba'i gter ma'i skor la/ phyi lha ltar sgrub pa/ nang ma mo ltarasgrubapa/gsang ba gshin rje ltar sgrub pa/ yang gsang mkha' 'gro ltar sgrub pa zhes kha skad du grags 'dugadang po ni ser chen sprin gseb ma'i skor yin/ gnyis pa dmar po bdud mo bzhi skor la ngos 'dzin/gsum pa mdung dmar can gyi rtsa ba'i sgrub pa rta sngon ma yin zer/ bzhi pa ni phyag mtshan bzhi paragrags par yin zhes 'dod/ 'on kyang mdung dmar rta sngon can nang sgrub dang / gshinarje mobazhiskor 'di gsang sgrub yin par nges shing / rtsa ba'i sgrub pa lagashin rje ltar sgrub pa zer ba ni kha skad bla thabs su bsnan pa tsam yin/ gshin rje ltar sgrub pa dngos de rang myos byed 'bar ba sogs gshed po bzhi skor rang la zer ba yin/ spyi dril du mi byed par rkyang pa'i lugs su sgruban/rtsasgrubal sras bzhi/ blon po bzhi/ sgo ma bzhi ste gtso 'khor bcugasum dang / gsang sgrubamamobazhiskora'adi la/ ma mo bzhi dang / rgyal chen bzhis chog /gshin rje bzhi skor dang / srin pobazhe skorayagasgrub thabs logs su yod pa bzhin lha lnga pa kho na yin no/ /las mkhan mdung dmar ni/ ser chen gyi las mkhan du bshad pa gcig yod na'ang sgrub thabs 'dra min yod/ 'di drag po'i skor du gtogs pa'o// // de ltar na rnam sras drag gtor gyi cho ga'i ngag 'don mdo tsam yid yang/rgya9/khams pa tā ra nā thas bar skabs su sbyar ba'o/ /gcig zhus//—274

༄༅//dpal lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i bskang ba nyer mkho bzhugs so//༄tsho//chaswā sti/rdo rje rab brtan ma'i bskong ba byed par 'dod na/r+ṣa dgram/lnga tshar dang mchod pa bsham/bskang gtor ni dpalagator gru gsum rab tu rgyas pa la/'khor can du byed na/bgos phran phra mo bcu gcig gis bskor ba dang /rgyun gtor zur gsum pa gcig kyang bsham/mdun kyi 'og phyogs su las mkhan gnyis kyi gtor ma bsham/gsang spyi'i tshul du bshos bu bad med kyi mgo can rgyan dang ldan pa/g.yas g.yon du gshog pa can du byed pa'i lugs kyang yod pa'agrub na legs/yang bsdu na dpal bshos snying gzugs ma rgyan gyis brgyan pa kho nasakyangachog/sman dang rak+ta dang /mchod pa dang /spyan gzigs rgya cher bsham/gtor bskang la de tsam gyis chog la/mdos bskang du byed na/'phying pa sogs kyi khong du mdos bca'/ri rab dbrasasu namamakha' mthing nag gam/smugs nag gur dang bcas pa shar du khong dkar/lhor khong ser/nub tukhong dmar/byang du khong sngon/mtshams rnams su khong nag re/thams cad kyang 'ja' ris ma yin/gur la nang nas nag dkar dmar ser sngon po/'khor lo rtsibs brgyad do//'ja' ris gzhan rnams de dang 'dra rung la/phyi'i mdog so so rgya che bar bya/bangarisatha malanam mkha' 'ja' ris ma chung ba bcuganyis/nam mkha' thams cad kyi mdun du rgyang bu re/g.yas su mda' re/g.yon du 'phang re bya/de btsug mi bde na nam mkha' phan tshun gyi b.radu mda' 'phang rgyang gsum btsug pa'i chog/ri rab kyi rtse mo'i dbus su bud med drelazhen/shar du seng zhon/lhor rnga mong bam stag zhen/nub tu sbal pa'am mdzo zhon/byang du sprul lamartalazhon —275

sna lnga'i me tog dang / /tshil chen bsur chen bdug sposadang / /zhun chen sgron me snang gsal dang / /rdo rje gsang ba'i dri chab dang /don snying rnam lnga'izhalazasabakram/ /thod rnga rkang gling rol mo'i sgra/ /nang gi mchod pa ci mchisarnams/nam gru sogs gong bzhi/ myosabyed kun gyi bcud bsdus pa/ /kun da 'khyilab byang chub sems/ /ma nyams nyi 'od rak+ta'i rdul/ /dri chu sman dang klad pa sogs/ /mdangs dang stobs dang bde ba'i rgyu/ /rab tu gsol zhigadamatshigacan/ /thabs shes dbyer med mnyam par sbyor/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa dmapa 'di/ /nam gru sogs gong bzhi/ rak+ta stong gi mchod pa bzhog kha snastongagimachod pa bzhes/ /snying sna stong gi mchod pa bzhes/ sman sna stong gomachod pa bzhes/ /bla bre rgyal mtshan 'phan dang gdugs/ /chibs dang bang mdzod na bza' sogs/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di 'thul gyi/ /bakhyol ba'i 'phren lasagrub par mdzod/ /r+ṣa mchod 'phreng gyer bstod pa ni/ chos skyong rgyal mo gzhogargod ma/ /srog bdag rgyal mo gsal shing can/ /dam nyams gsal shingartselatshugs/ /dgra bgegs brlag byed da tshur byon/ /byang shar mtshams kyi re ma tī//dur khrod wo po'i nang zhig nas/ /mi ro rta ro gdan steng nas/ /ge'ini mamo'abum gyis bskor/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'od 'bar ma/ /dbu la g.yu yi sgocog gsol/ /bse yi gdong la nor bus brgyan/ /zhal nas khrag 'dzagachilali li/ /spyan gsum me 'bar tal la la/ shangs nas rlung 'tshub dud pa 'thul/ /zhabasakyisadagra bo'i glo snying brdzi/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir mibazad mche ba gtsigs/ /srid gsum sgrol byed mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnamag khrin du —278

mi 'bral lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs/ /bdag gi 'chi bdag bzlog labadud 'di srungs/ /'di dang skye ba kun tu gdong grogs mdzod/ khus gyi mas dang gar+sā bshes khyod kyis gyis/ /bsten pa'i 'os su lha mo khyod bsten no//mchod pa'i 'os su rnal 'byor bdag gis mchod/ /sgrub pa'i 'os su sngagasadang phyag rgya bsgrub/ /dam tshig dus la bab po dam can ma/ khyod labarnyad pa 'bul gyi dgyes par mdzod/ /bka' yi pho nya chu srin mgo/dkar mo zhal gyi pho nya mo/ /sngon mo ral ba 'dzings pa mo/ /dmar mo chen mogatusapa mo/ /seramordo rje kha la bzhad/ /bka' nyan ba lang drel sna mo/ /mgyogs byed khrisman salem/ /sprul pa stag seng dur bya'i tshogs/ /las byed mkha' 'gro grangasalasa'adas/ /ma mo bye ba bsam mi khyab/ /rdzu 'phrul dpag yasa'aphrin lasasgrub/ /'khor bcas bdag gis bstod par bgyi/ /spyo so/ /de rjes tar+ya thā sogasagasapa dang / oṃ ā ཿ྅/ sogs gtor chog ltar gtor ma 'bul/ slar yang / dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /dam rdzas mchod yon 'bar ba 'di/ /nam gru 'khor dang bcasala'abul/ /thugs dam skongs la phrin las mdzod/ /oṃ mahā kā lore mkhrisapa riwā ra arnya pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhi du rol mo nas/ shap+ta'i bar du sbyar ro/ bstod pa ni/bh+yoḥ nam gru khyod kyi cho 'brang dang / /mas nyid kyang ni bshad bya na/ /nor bu'i rang bzhin khyod kyi lus/ /rgyab ni dzam bu chu mo'i gser/ khyod kyi gdong ni dngul yin te/ /lte ba'i ngos ni rdo rjes gtams/ /ming po'ad dngamadzod bsrung pa/ khyod kyi ma ni kun 'gro ma/ khyod kyi pha ni rlungazhesabya/ skalaldan shing rta khyod kyi lus/ /lha yul du'ang grags pa yin/ /mtshan monagamo —279

'jigs byed ma/ /gshin rjes sring mo wo po ste/ /srin mo yongasa'adu'i bdagamor bstod/ /bdag gi 'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrubs shig khosabya/tshon las gzhol/ de nas bskang rdzas rnams sngags drug phyag rgya drug ting nge 'dzin drug gis byin gyisarlabs pa'am/ bsdu na nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya kho nas kyang rung ngo / /de nas bskangabamadorabasdus pa ni/ kyi/ ma gcig gnyen gyi re ma tī/ /ma g.yel ma g.yelayalagasacan/ /dam las ma 'da' srung ma'i tshogs/ /dam can ma mo 'khor bcasarnams/ /bdag gisagadung bas bos pa'i tshe/ /ma thogs myur du tshurabyon cig/dam can ma ni gcig bos kyang / /dam can rgya mtsho kun kyang 'byon/ /thugasadam can du 'dra lags kyang / /dpal gyi lha mo sna la byon/ /mingapo bdagagisabosapa'i tshe/ /ma mo srin ltar 'dur zhing byon/ /ma mo glog ltarakhrugaṣ+ka byon//dam can 'khor bcas da tshur byon/ /bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /gaskabasapa'i tshe na spyan ma rtul/ /bskul ba'i tshe na bang ma bul/ /bsten pa'i tshe na rumang/khur ba'i tshe na brjid pa che/ /mngags pa'i tshe na rtsal ma zhan/ /rbad pa'itshen mthu ma chung / /bcol ba'i 'phrin las myur du sgrubs/ /shrī mahā kā li dzadzahūbh+yoḥ dpal ldan lha more ma tī/ /lha mo wo mo nam gru ma/ /rjongamos mo dka' bzlog ma/ /nag mo chen mo kha 'bar ma/ /byis pa kun gyi durabyed ma/dur khrod 'bar ba'i lo ma can/ /rak+ta chen mo tsa muṇ+ḍi/ /nam mkha'i khamasakyimathu mo che/ /bar snang khams kyi glog ma sprin/ kha nas tshe'abarargyamatshoskem/ /lag na rdo rjes ri rab snyil/ /ral ba nag po stong khams khebag khanasazhingakhrag rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /nyin gyi dus su rtog byed ma/ /mtshan gyi dusagargyu byed —280—

ma//nag mo 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang //sha chen tshogs ni ri ltaraspungag/tsit+ta'i tshogs ni rdza ltar lhags//rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khyil//'khorabacasathugs dam skong gyur cig/nag mo kha la dza ya du/sa ma ya ho/rulu rulu snyingakha la ma ti dun bh+yoḥzhes sa rol dang 4sa pas gtor ma la rak+ta bran/bh+yoḥbaskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas//hro nagasgorasa'atshub pa'i pho brang nas//ma gcig 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma//lha mochen mo rdo rje rab brtan ma//bskang ngo bskal ba'i thugs dam bskapagasha khrag gtor masaḥtshogs kyi mchod pasaḥdamar chen khrag gis tshil chen spos kyis sna tshogs rol mos:spyan gzigs du mas dam tshig gnyan po bsreba'i phyir//bdud rtsisman gyis —bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir//khor g.yang gzhisaḥ bsten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir//mi dbangasnyingagoyorangabazhi gnas nas spyan drangs phyir//mi rkang gling bus 'dod pa'i gtsomoyin pa'i phyir//rma bya'i rgyal mtshan shangs kyi dbang po tshim byed bzhig wo dud pas mgur gyi gsang nas drangs pa'i phyir//dmar chen rak+tasanyamasachags ma lus bskang ba'i phyir//bya lug smug nag gis dpal gyi lha mo'i rgyal gar yul du mtshan gsol ba//he la 'bar ma'i u rgyan yuladu mtshan gsol ba//rdo rje sna yon thugs za hor yul du mas gsolarbe/rdo/rje mdzozhon dkar chung rgyal sder mas gsol ba//rdo rje gshog rgod tho'isrung mar mtshan gsol ba//rdo rje dbang grub thugs rgyan gong gnas sumatshan gsol ba//rdo rje rab brtan ma'i /bstan srung wo mo'i ཿsngagasabasrungawo —281—

mo'i sgra ni 'brug las shin tu che/ /ma mo 'bum sde'i dgra sha za zhingadagra khrag 'thung / /sprul pa 'bum sde'i ming po klu chen thod dkar lasamakhan klubadud nag po'i las bzhi sgrubs mdzad mkha' 'gro'i ljang nag chu srin gdong gi ba li drel sna khri sman sa le sogs/ /bka' nyan ma mo'abum bstan ma bcu gnyis tshogs kyi — nyams chags bskangs shing chos 'byor rgyasapar mdzod/ /nges don bstan pa phyogs bcur dar ba dang / /bdagacanadapon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar ho sol/ /'dod don yid bzhi 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /snro dpalagyilha mo 'jigs gzugs ma/ /gsang mtshan rdo rje gshog rgod ma/ /gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum las lhag /sprul pa stong gsum bye ba khyab/ /lha srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol/ /klu bdud nag po pho nyar 'gyed/ /phyag g.yas ral gri 'barab yis//bdud tshogs 'joms shing nyen mongs gcod/ /bstan dgra thal ba rduladu rlog/g.yon pa ne'u le rin wo char/ /dgos 'dod dngos grub thams ro stsol/ /mnga' thang longs spyod stsal du gsol/ khyod kyi mthu stobs bsam mikhyab/ /bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo rnams/ /nag mo khyod kyi zhal du thob/ /rolazhin sprul (〈rdza〉skul )zhig kha ram khā hi/ /lha mo de yi khol mo ni/ /srin mo dmar 'dabs phur bu'i lha/ /klu mo gzhogs zha chu srin mgo /gang 'phrad de yi srog la gcod/ /gsod pa'i mtshon cha lag na thogs/ /bskal pa'i rlung naga'atshubasam lko/ /pho nya chu rtsi mang po 'gyed/ /'dir byon dam dgongs wen lasamadzod/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /dkar mo rdo rje pho nya mo/ /na bza' bya rgod —282

thul pa gsol/ /dkar mo bye ba 'bum gyis bskor/ /'dir byon pa lho yi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /sngon mo ral pa 'jongs pa mo/ /sku la mi lpags g.yangagazhi gsol/ /sngon mo bye ba 'dir byon nub kyi phyogs kyi ma moni/ /dmaramochen mo gtum pa mo/ /sku la 'brug giglog pa gsol/ /dmaramobye ba 'dirabyonaḥ byang gi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /ser mo kha la bzhad pa mo/ /sku lastagagipags pa gsol/ /ser mo bye brtsa 'dir byon 'phrin las rnamabasto lha rmornams/ /rang mdog dang mtshungs thod gdong can/ /phyag na ral gri thod khragabasnams/ /bdag gis bcol ba'i las 'di sgrub/ /dur khrod bsilaba'i tshalashed nas/ /rdo rje ba lang drel sna mo/ /gser g.yu brtsegs pa'i thod gdepasacan/ /phyagaganyis zhing lpags thod rlon bsnams/ /chibs su dre'u nag kha dkar chibs/ /ma bdud kun gyi sna 'dren ma/ /'dir byon — de yi sngon la'agrobani/ma yams nag mo kun gyi rje/ /phyag na thod pa khrag gang bsnamag /chibasasusha ba yu mo chings/ /stag gzigs dom nag stong gis bskor/ /'dirabyon: rgya mtsho chen po'i gting rim nas/ /rdo rje khri sman sa le ma/ /chu srin rgyalamatshan ban+ta 'dzin/ /chibs su so bya rog po chibs/ /sa 'og gnas pa'i dmanasna 'dren/ /'dir byon nag mo chen mo ha la mo/ /lag na thod pa khragaganga'adzin/ /chibs su srid pa rlung la chibs/ /grong mtha' skor zhing nad yamasa'abebs/ /'dir byonaḥ ming po klu wo thod dkar yang / /dkarags5sprulamago bum pa 'dzin/ /chibs su klu rta dkar sngon chibs/ /sa bdagakluganyan 'bum gyis bskor/ /'dir byon las mkhan klu bdud nag po yang/ /phyagan —283

bka' sdod pho nya brag g.yog 'khor dang bcas//srin po 'bum dang ma mobye ba'i tshogs//bdud dang srin mo gshin rje'i tshogs dang bcas//'angaga'i bdag mo zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas//snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khoradangabacas//'dab chags gcan gzan sprul pa'i 'khor dang bcas//dgra khrogadabang byed bshan pa'i tshogs dang bcas//'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtorama'adi bzhes shig/sman rag phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig/dam rdzasasnatshogs mchod pa 'di bzhes shig/sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan po 'bul//phye bcol legs pa'i gsol 'debs gnyan po bzhes//'phrin lasarnam bzhi phyogs med 'grub pa dang //nges don bstan pa phyogs bcur darab dang //'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang //bsamadon thamasacad yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod//bh+yoḥbh+yo:de ni dam nyams dgra la bh+yoḥbagegs rigs stong phragabargyad cu dgra la bh+yoḥgadon rigs sum brgya drug cu dgra la bh+yoḥnd rigasabazhi brgya rtsabazhi dgra la bh+yoḥsha za khrag 'thung thams cad dgra la bh+yoḥdagra bo'i srogalarol cig srin mo'i tshogs//dam nyams dgra bo da lta nyid du sgrol//thugs dam dus la bab po sa mā ya//drag rol yun ring du bya/shis brjod ca zad cig dngalasate nang du 'ongs/slar yang mchod pa byin rlabs bya/rten cing 'brel bar 'byubab yi//zhesapa man chad gtor chog bzhi du bya'o//de ltar na 'di gtor ma la brten pa'i skang ba yin lkamados bskang ni/se mkhar ma sogs yi ge rnying pa bzhin du byed pa yin pa las/gtorabaskanga'adi dang sbrel te byed na/bde legs dngos grub stsol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod ces las bcol song—287—

mtshams bshags pas sngon der mdos bskang bya/gtor bskangs mi byed par mdos bskang 'ogasasu byed na//bskang rdzas byin rlabs yan chad gong bzhin byas nas/de man chad mdos khangakho na gzhung bsrangs pas chogablo shin tu gzhan na mdos bskang labaklags chog byed pa'i sgol yang gda'o// //dpal ldan lha mo re ma tī//rdo rje rab brtan ma'i bskang ba'i cho ga tshig cha mdor bas shing /cho ga'i yan lag ma tshang ba med pa 'di yang /don gnyer mang pos bsku' ba'i thor/twar nā thas bar skabs su smras pa'o//tshig 'byams ches pa las snying po bsdus pa cung zad dang/khoskongatshig re tsam dang /go rim bde bar bsgyur ba re re tsam ma gtogs phal cher gzhung dang yig rnyingabazhin du bris pa'o//gcig zhus//maṅga yaṃ//༄༅//dpal lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i gtor chog ngag 'don bzhugs so//༄tsho//chaswā sti/dpal lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'am rdo rje gzhog rgod ma'i mtshan du gsolaba'adi la/gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul zhing bsnyen par 'dod na/gtor ma snying gzugs mashakhragagis brgyan pa ji ltar 'os pas kyang rung la/'khor las mkhan gnyis la bgos phran zur bzhi sprul thod can re/gtso mo'i gtor ma'i mdun du bshom pa'ang 'dug pa rung mod/la lasagasumapo sdams pa la 'theb kyus skor ba'i lag len byed pa'ang 'dug ste/de ni mi legs par mngon no//las mkhan gnyis kyi gtor ma logs su byed na/snod logs par bcug nye'og tu bshamasan legs/'on kyang bskang ba'i skabs yin na ma gtogs/rgyun gyi nyams len dang bsnyen pa'i —288—

skabs/ de gnyis la logs su gtor ma bsham mi dgos zhor byung gis chog go /de'i mdun du lto mchod dang rak+ta bsham/ chu dang nyer spyod sogs spyi dang mthun par bsgrig /yang rgyun khyer shin tubasdus pa'i skabs gtor ma gru gsum rang zhig bcas te/ de nyid 'dod yon kun 'dus yin pasamachod pa gzhan ma bsham kyang bsngo ru rung ngo / /de nas yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du song nas/ yi dam gang yin de ga'i lugs kyi gtor ma dang nang mchod lhan cig byin rlabs byas pas rung la/ rak+ta yang nang mchod kyi shor la 'grub pa'i lugasasam/ yang na a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang lasayo gasdos/las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gsum gyi steng du raṃ gsum las me'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de rnams kyi steng du a gsum las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba gsum/gtor ma'i gnas su bza' ba dam rdzas kyi khyad par sna tshogs pa thams cad sha lnga'i rnam par gyur te/ dbus su mi sha hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa/ shar du ba 'angagosha oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa/ lhor khyi'i sha traṃ ser pos mtshan pa/ nub turta'i sha hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa/ byang du glang po che'i sha aḥljang khus mtshan pa/ bdudartsi sman gyi gnas su btung ba dang baṃ rdzas kyi bye brag rnams bdud rtsi lngar gyur pa ni/ dbus su byang sems/ yig sngon pos mtshan pa/ shar du drichen modagarapos mtshan pa/ lhor dri chu me ser pos mtshan pa/ nub tu rak+ta paṃ dmaraposamatshan pa/ byang du sha chen gyi dwangs ma tī ljang khus mtshan pa rnams su gyur/rak+ta'i gnas su dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag phung por raṃ yig gis mtshan pa ste/ de thams cad la rang dang 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu zhingakhol ma dag pa rnams sbyangs/ oṃ āḥ& lan gsum/ ye shesakyi bdud rtsigadog—289

dri ro phun sum tshogs par gyur/ thamasacad kyi steng du oṃ dkar po reb de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad kyi dwangasam/ yeshes kyi bdud rtsir spyan drangs te oṃ lathim/ oṃ yig rnams 'od du zhunasardzasal thim pas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ mahāb lingata te dzo ba lang ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sirnyi sa ma ya hūṃ hrīḥtha/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta laḥhrīḥtha/ oṃ mahā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ hrīḥtha/ go byin gyis brlab bo/tenatu bsapa'iskabs gtor ma dmar gyi o dang myos byed kyis sbran pa nyid lagator sman rag gsum tshangs pa yin no/ /a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngangalas/ tsherlunga'atshub ma'i dbus/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang lcags risabaskor ba'i nang / rak+ta'i rgya mtshochen po rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dbus su/ zlo las gzhal yas khang bse mkharadamar po gru bzhi pa/ ngos bzhi gser deng / zur bzhi mchong lasagrub pa/rmangs gzhi lcags las grub cing / shel gyi skras /skas btsugs pa/de'i dbus su mi ro rta ro gcal du bkram pa'i gnas la/ nyi ma'i steng du shaṃ lasaral gri kai gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ semasacan gyi don byas/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshura'adusayongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma tī lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma/sku mdog smug nag /zhal gsag phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pas ra'/gri 'phyar bas bstan pa bsrung zhing gdug can tshar gcod pa/ g.yon gteragyi ne'u le 'dzin pas sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser spyi bor 'byilab/—290

mi'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs dang / ba glang gi pags pas smad dkrisapa/ relde'i sham bu can/ sprul rigs bzhi'i ske rags bcings pa/ thod skamagyi dbu rgyan dang / mimago'i do shal dang / rus pa dang sprul gyis brgyan pa/ lteb nasanyi ma dang / spyi gtsug nas zla ba 'char ba/ khrag zhag gi thig lesabargyan zhingaskulas me 'od 'phro ba/ rlung nag 'tshub ma'i dbus na drel rta rkang gsumalachibs pa'o/ /'dir lha mo 'di rdo rje'i gshog pa can du byed pa'i lugs gcig kyang yod pa ṣ+ka tu legs pa smo kyang yin no/ /'khor las kyi lha mo chu srin gdong can dang/ ba lomadrel sna dang / khri sman sa le dang / las bzhi'i lha mo dang / dusabazhi'i rgyalamodang / ma mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o/ /de tsam gyisardzo gas mkhan gnyis tsod par 'dod na/ phuḥtri dzaḥ sog phyogs g.yasazur du mingapo kluchen thod dkar sku mdog dkar po/ sprul mgo'i gdengs ka can/ g.yasakhasashingadang / g.yon gter gyi bum pa 'dzin pa/ klu rta sngon po la zhon pa/ du tri dzaḥgayon zur du las mkhan klu bdud nag po/ g.yas ral gri'am ru martson/g.yon sprul zhags 'dzin pa/ bdud rta nag po la zhon pa'o/ /zhe༄skyedado/ /ye shes lha mo'i sku'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal gyi lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bh+yoḥ dpalaldan gnyan gyi re ma tī/ khyod kyi spyi bo'i gtsug rum nas/ /nyi ma zla ba'i 'od zer 'phros/ /nag mo mi bzad cho'aphrulacan/ /ming pos 'bod kyi da tshur byon/ khyod kyi thugs kyi dkyila'aboranas/ /'dod khams ma mo stong stong 'gyed/ /ma yi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khoranas/ /—291—

par mdzod/ /tshemahā kā linge ma tī sa pa ri wā ra a: pra tīts+tsha swāhādebazhigasazhabs bsil/ nas/ rol mo'i bar dang / pubye nas/shap+ta'i bar gyis 'don 0spo/bsdus na sngags tsam gyis chogabh+yoḥ lha la dbang bsgyur lha mo dpal 'bar ma/ /dbang phyugazhi mosrasamo gzi ldan ma/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas kyi bdag mo ste/ /lha moremakyilaphyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdud la dbang bsgyur bdud mo dpal 'bar ma reti mgo yag bu mo re ma tī/ /nag mo rtse dgu'i gnas kyi bdag mo ste/ /bdud morem tī la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /klu la dbang bsgyur klu mo dpal 'bar mo/ /gtsug na rin chen bu mo yid 'ong byams/ /rol mtsho bdun gyi gnas kyi gtso moste/ /klu mo re ma tī la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gnod sbyin dbang bsgyur gnod sbyin dpal 'bar ma/ /gang ba bzang po'i bu mosham sham ma/ /nag tshaladrab can gyi gtso mo ste/ /gnod sbyin re ma tī la phyag 'tshal bstod/ tetshosastod/ bh+yoḥdapal ldan rdo rje rab brtan ma/ /sku mdog mthing nag chen po la/ /zhalagartsegaphyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ /phyag g.yas ral gri 'bar ba bsnams/ /gakhon pa'i phyag gis ne'u le 'dzin/ /chibs su dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs/ /skulamilpags g.yang gzhi gsol/ /lha mo rdo rje dbang sgrub ma/ /'phrin las bcol ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /nyin gsum khra ltar 'byug cing byon/ /mtshan gsum glogaltara'abyug cing byon/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la babs/ /ma gcig rdo rje rab brtan ma/ /dgra bo 'joms pa'i dus la bab/ /dpal ldan rdorje re mkhri/rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa gsol/ sha khrag—293—

gtor ma 'di bzhes shig khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bsam pa sgrubs/ /de rjes/mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar spyi dang mthun par yang 'phrin las bcol/ yig brgya bzlas/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bcad paragasolgarten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can sogs gtor mgron rnamasagashegs/ smon lam dang bkra shis sogs spyi dang mthun par bya'o// //dpal lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i gtor chog ngag 'don 'di yang don gnyer mang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /'di'i gtor chog ngag 'don phyis bsgrigs pa 'ga' re 'dug kyang / rnying ma la gsar ma bas dbang bzas pa'i stabs dgos ngosashes pa 'ga' re chad 'dug pa skabs 'dir cha 'grig par byas so/ / gcig zhus// maṅga yaṃ//༄tsho/ /yas gtam dang bsngo ba mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ /༄tsho/ /chaswā sti/ yas gtam dang bsngo ba mdor bsdus pa ni/ 'diltaradangosagrub 'byung gnas rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma/ don gnyis mthar phyin ston pa sangasargyas/sgrib gnyis mun sel skyob pa dam chos/ rig grol gnyis ldan 'phags pa'i dge 'dun te/ skyabs bslu med datan mchog gsum/ spyir sangs rgyasakyi zhingakhams na bzhugs pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ sgos bkra shis kyi gtsug lagakhanga'adi nyid na zhes sam/ ya mtshan rmad du byung ba'i pho brang 'di nyid na zhesaskabs—294

dang sbyar/ ngo mtshar gzi 'od 'phro ba'i nor bu/ byin mas chu brgya la4 pa'igangs ri/ nyon mongs dri ma 'brud pa'i dag byed/ mchog gsum gyi rten med du byung ba rnams/ bdud dpung ri bo 'joms pa'i gnam lcags/ bstan pa gangasari skyong ba'i seng ge /bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong ba'i srung ma/ dpalamagon dam pa chos skyong ba rnams kyi zhabs 'bring dang bcas te bzhugs/ de rnamasakyi skabs 'og nas/ deng 'dir 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu mngon du gyurapa la/ bstan pa'i srog shing yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gar+sā chen po rnams kyis gral gyi gung mnan/ mi che bar gyur pa rnams kyis gral gyi gzhung srang / yon tan mkhasapar sbyangs pa rnams kyis gral gyi zur nas brgyan/ bajod nams dpalagyisamangon par mtho ba'i yon bdag rnams dang / bya ba byed pa phyag len pa dang bcas pas gral gyi mtha' nas brgyan te/ rten 'byung zab mo'i dbang 'khogadan 'jom par bzhugs pa lags/ de ltar 'tshogs pa thams cad dkarab las kyis gzhi bzung / dag pa smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar/ chosadamatshigagosgo nas 'brel ba zab/ rnam grol thar pa'i gling du/ rnam dkar dgeba'i bya ba khyad par can la 'tshogs pas/ tshogs pa yang bzang / skabs 'diralorgyusacung zad zhu 'tshal na/ /spyir lo rgyus la/ gzhi skye bo mi chos kyi lo rgyus dang / rgyan dmapa lha chos kyi lo rgyus dang / byas shes bka' drin che ba'i lo rgyus te gsum las/ gzhi skye bo mi chos kyi lo rgyus la/ steng du rje'i gdung rab/ 'og tu 'bangasakyi mirabs/ stong sde sa'i ( 〈 〉 srid pa'i 3chags tshul/ /'jig rten lugs kyi —2956

rnam gzhag ste bzhir dbye ba las/ dang po ni/ bskal pa 'di la rgyal po la snga ba mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po nas bzung / shākya'i rgyal po don thams cad grub pa yan chad du/ shākya'i rgyal brgyud sa ya cig 'bum nyi khri chig stong lnga brgyadangabacu bzhi byung ba lags/ gzhan yang / ma ga dha'i rgyal po gzugs can snyingapo/ko sa li'i rgyal po gsal rgyal/ 'bang sa'i rgyal po 'char byed/ 'phagasargyalagyi rgyal po rab snang la sogs pa dang / sprul pa'i chos rgyal mya ngan med lasogs pa/ 'jig rten bde bar skyong ba'i rgyal po mtha' yas pa byon/thod zalamo gangs kyi ra ba 'dir/ mi rje lhas mdzad pa la snga ba/ rje gzha khribasdo po nas bzung ste/ gnam gyi khri bdun/ sa'i legs drug la sogasapa dang/ 'jamadapal rtsa rgyud nas lung bstan pa ltar sprul pa'i rgyal po du ma byon pa lag lha tho tho ri'i gto btsan gyi dus su dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes/ srong bsto gsapo'i dus su srol bstod/ khri srong sde btsan gyis dus su dar zhing rgyas paramadzad/ khriral pa can gyis bla sgo dang po dge 'dun la 'bulab sogag sa srid dam pa'i chos su bsgyur/ phyis de dag gi brgyud lasabyung ba3 lha glamakhudabon dang / mnga' bdag /rtse lde la sogs pas kyang / 'khor tshwangasabade bar skyangs shing / dkon mchog gsum la rgya cher mchod pa lagag gzhan yangargya nag dang rgya nag chen po la sogs par/ sprul pa'i chos kyi rgyal po dpagatumed pa byon pa lags kyang / skabasa'adir de tsam las gleng ba'i sngo ma thogs95gas/ / gnyis pa ni bskal pa dang po'i dus su gtso bo dang / 'khor 'bangasakyi —296—

dbye ba med/de nas rim gyis rigs rus cho 'brang gi dbye ba tha dad paragyurapa las/rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du mi rigs bzhi ma 'chol bar gnagaspur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/mi rigasabazhi'i dbye ba med kyang/mi'uthung gdong drug la sogs pa rus kyi dbye ba du ma yod par sogs/zhesapa tsamagyi yang chog la/skabs 'dir yon bdag sogasadamigs gsal rigs rusanges pa can yod na/rus kyi sde tshan de lta bu yod pa las/dengayulakhamasa'adi zhes bya ba nas/rus 'di zhes bya ba'i rgyud la/yab du btsun la yumadu mdzangs pa/dad pa dang 'byor ba dang blo gros phun sum chogs pas mdzesapa'i/yon bdag gam dge bshesasogs 'di zhes bya ba byon pa lags/zhesasam/rten bzhedas pa'am/dgo'adun gyi bsnyen bkur sogs tshogs gsog byasapa'i rigs la/rnam dkar dge ba'i las 'di dang 'di lta bu mdzad pa lagagazhes skabs dang sbyar te brjod/bya ba 'gangs che ba med na brjod mi dgos//gsum pa ni/'jig rten gdags pa la sogs pa chos mngon pa las/gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang /stong gsum gyi 'jig rten dang/khams gsum gyi rnam gzhag sogasamang du gsungs/ji skad du/glingabazhi pa dang nyi zla dang //ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang //sgos pa'i 'jigarten stongalani//stong ni spyi phud yin par 'dod//de stong la ni stong gnyosapa//b.raba'i 'jig rten khams yin no//de stong la ni stong gsum mo//zhes gsupasashing/de ltar na phyogasabacu rab 'byams mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na yang /'dod khams gnas rigs nyi shu/gzugs khams rigasabastobadun/—297—

gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi la sogs pa mtha' yas pa yod par gsungs shing / de bzhin du theg pa chen po'i mdo sde dang mngon pa rnams las kyangamangadu gsungs/ khyad par/ theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse dpal ldan dusakyi 'khoralo las/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ ri rgyalalhun posogs/ ri bdun/ gling bdun/ mtsho bdun/ 'dzam gling chen po las kyi sa dum bu bcuganyis pa dang / srid rtse'i gnas gyi mthar thug par 'bum phrag bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gsungs shing / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang/mtha' yas mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams spyi dang / nam mkha' la khyimagyi'akhor lo/ gza' dang rgyu skar la sogs pa'i 'gros dang bcas pa/ sa gzhi dum bu bcu gnyis la/ chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba sogs 'khor zhing/ dusabazhi tshechung gi rnam par bzhag pa la sogs pa dang bcas pa rgya cher gsung pa lags na'ang / mkhyen pa can klad nas bzhugs pas rgyas par zhu mi 'tshalakhribazhi pa ni mi chos bcu drug dang / sgyu rtsal drug cu la sogasate/ 'jigarten lugs kyi bstan bcos rnams las kyang / rgya cher gsungs pa lagasashing/mdor na/ 'jig rten ya rabs kyi spyod tshul la brten pa ni/ 'di dang pha rolakyi dge legs thams cad kyi rtsa ba lags te/ ji skad du/ mi'i chosalugasalegs spyad na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring / /lha dang miyi cesaskasal/ /'dzegs na thar pa gam na 'dug /ces gsungs pa ltar lags/ /gnyis pa rgyan dam pa lha chos kyi lo rgyus la/ ston pa sangs rgyasakyikhyon tshul/ bstan pa dam chosakyi dar tshul/ bstan 'dzin dge 'dun gyi byon tshul—298—

gsum du gleng bar gda' ba las/de dag mdo tsam zhig snyan tu gsol na/ston pa sangs rgyas kyi byon tshul la/spyir dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas/mkha' mnyam du bzhugs pa las/'o skol gyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangasargyas/rgyal ba shākya seng ge 'di nyid/dang por byang chub mchog tuthugasabaskyed/bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/mthar mngon parardzogs pas sangs rgyas te/chosakyi 'khor lo ma lus pa bskor ba ā+o te/r+sā pa 'di sngon rdza mkhan gyi khye'u snang byed du gyur pa'i tshe/de bzhin gshegasapa shākya thub pa chen po'i drung du thugs bskyed par bshad pa dang //bskalabazangalas kyang /da ni sngon tshe dman par gyur pa na//de bzhin gshegasapa shākya thub de la//'jam gang zhig ni rab tu phul nas kyang //dang por byang tso tuni thugs bskyed do//zhes gsungs/tshogs bsags tshul yang /thegapa thun mongagi lugs ltar na/ji skad du/rnam gzigs mar me rin chen gtsug/grangasamed gsum gyi mtha' mar byung //dang po shākya thub pa yin//kun lathamasacad snying rje yis//sbyin par byed pas sbyin pa rdzogs//chags bcas yan lagabacad kyang ni//mi 'khrugs bzod dang tshul khrims kyi//skar rgyalabastod pasabartson 'grus kyi//de ma thag tu ting 'dzin blo'i//zhes gsupasate/bskalapa grangs med gsum la rim pas/sangs rgyas bdun khri lnga stong dang /bdun khrodrug stong dang /bdun khri bdun stong gi bar mnyes par mdzad ces gsungs/theg pa wo po las ni/lam lnga dang sa ༅ yongs su rdzogs par bgrod dgosapa yi na pas/'phags pa'i sa brnyes nas/skad cig re re yang/phyogasabasto—299

chos kyi 'bor lo/bar pa mas nyid med pa'i chosakyi 'bor lo/thamalegasapar rnam par phye ba'i chos kyi 'bor lo ste/'khor lo rim pa gsum dang/mthar thug rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo ste rim pa bzhi gsungs/bzhi pa dam chos dang /bstan 'dzin dge 'dun 'byon tshul ni/'od srung ོ po dang/'phagasapa kun dga' bo la sogs pa/bstan pa'i gtad rabasabadun dang/gzhan yang dgra bcom chen po rnams kyisabastan pa yun ring du skyangs shing/de rjes 'dzam gling mdzesapar byed pa'i rgyan drug la sogs pa/rgyal ba'i gsungarab kyi don la rang dbang thob pa'i/slob dpon mtha' yas pa rnams kyisagatsocher pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa gsal bar mdzad/grub thob brgyad curtsabazhi la sogs pa/grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis/gtso bor theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi sgo nas/skal ldan dpag tu med pa smin grol la babod/de lasakyangakhyad par du/grub pa'i slob dpon chen po dus 'khor zhabs dang /tsi'u pa lasogasapas/sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i bzhugasaganas/byangasham+bha lachos kyi pho brang nas/dpaladus kyi 'bor lo'i rgyud dang /semasa'agrelaskoragasum la sogs pa/chos zab cing rgya che ba'i gsang sngags kyi chos dpagatumed pa spyan drangs/sems can dpag tu med pa byang chub mchog gi lamalabakod/bod yul 'jig rten mgon po'i zhing khams 'dir dang por chosargyalabyang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bdag rkyen mdzad pa la brten/slobadapon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshodang /'dul 'dzin dzi na mitra lasogs pa/rgya gar gyi paṇa grub ches mchog tu gyur pa rnams dang/skachogazhang—301—

gsum la sogs pa/lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyis chos bsgyur bshad lagalen gyi sgo nas gtan la phabs/bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus 'dir/g.yo dmaragatsangagasum las/bla chen dge ba rab gsal gyi sdom pa blangs shing /'dulamangon gyi bshad pa dang lag len ma chad par mdzad/de las brgyud nas bod yulathams cad du dge 'dun gyi sde dpag tu med pa dang /lo tsā ba rin chen bzangapo dang /rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab dang /'brog mgos maragasusalasogs pa/lo paṇa sprul pa'i skyesamachog rnams dang /de dag girjesasu'abrangapa'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi skyes bu dam pa dpag tu med pa rnams kyis/bstan pa rin po che sgo mtha' dag nas nam langs pa dang /nyi ma shar ba ltaramadzad/khyad par rang re'i chos brgyud 'di la/mdo sngags bshad sgrulasdesnod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i/tshig don lag len byin rlabs kyi bka' thamasacad tshang bar bzhugs pa yin la/de las khyad par du/sangs rgyas thamasacad kyi dgongs pa/byang chub semasadapa' thams cad kyi thugs bcud/grub thob thams cad kyi nyams su myong bya/mkhas pa thams cad kyi legs par bshad pa'i snying po/gzhan stong dbu ma che po'i lta sgom dang /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i smin grol gyi lam zung du 'brel ba/rgyal tshab 'phags pa klu sgrub dang/rgyal sras 'phags pa thogs med la sogs pa'i gzhung dang man ngag rnams dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba rngog btsan gzu gsum las brgyud pa'i bshad sgrub nyams myong byin rlabs lag len rnams bka' ma chad pa dang /chos thamasacad kyi mthar thug dpal dus kyi 'khor lo 'di 'gyur byed mkhan po bcu drug tsam —302

gyis bsgyur ba las/ gyi jo rwa 'bro tsa mi sogs byin rlabs kyi bka' ma chad pa thams cad dang / khyad par du kha che'i paṇa chen zla ba mgon po'i bka' srolal/grub thob brgyud pa zam ma chad pa'i zhal gyi rim pa rnams/ rigs ldan sprulapa'i sku/ kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas dol po pa/ shes rab rgyalamatshan dpal bzang pos/ chos bdag po'i tshul gyis/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rgya cheraspel bar mdzad pas/ byang phyogs kha ba'i ljongs 'di skal pa bzang por mdzad pa lags/ de nas spro zhing shes la dgos par yod na/ dgon sde sogasarangarang so so'i chos brgyud bla brgyud rnams kyi che ba ci rigs pa brjod/ mi spyon sngar bshad pa de tsam gyis chog go /gsum pa byas shes bka' drin che ba'i dbang du byas na/ spyir khamasagasum gyi sems can dug gsum gyi nad kyis gzir ba rnams la/ dusagasumagyi sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa bka' drin che/ sgos mi mjed 'jig rten khams pa rnams la/ mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po sras dang slob mar bcasapa rnams bka' drin che/ yang sgos 'dzam bu gling pa rnams la/ 'dzamaglingamadzesapar byed pa'i rgyan drug dang grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams dang / sa bcu'i mgon po rnams kyi rnam 'phrul/ chos rgyal rigs ldan rim par byon pa rnams bga' drin che/ nying sgos bod kha ba can pa rnams la/ dang por byon pa'i chos rgyal mes dpon rnam gsum/ bar du byon pa bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal mkhan brgyud dang bcas pa/ tha mar byon pa jo bo mar me mdzad dpal ye shesadang/ paṇa chen shākya shrī la sogs pa/ bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi paṇa chen de rnamasabadzi' —303—

drin che/ khyad par nges don snying po'i bstan pa ma nor ba gsal bar mdzad pa la/ dpal jo nang pa chen po yab sras brgyud par bcas pa rnamasabaka' khrin che/ sgos rang rang so sol/rulus bskyed cing 'jig rten ston parabyed pa lapha dang ma/ sems bskyed cing thar lam ston par byed pa la/ bla ma dmapa rdorje slob dpon mkhan slob dang bcas pa bka' drin che/ dgosapa skabs don gyi dbang du byas na/ gdugs de ring gi skabs su/ 'di ltar zhal mngon du gyurapa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la/ mang ja 'dren 'gyed lasogs pa skabs su gang bab kyi tshig dang sbyar te/ dper na/ mang jagangalabazang ba dge 'dun so so la grwal 'gyed bsngo ba'i rten dang bcas pa/ zhesapa'am/ bzang ngan rgya che chung dang bstun pa'i tshig gi brjod tshul shesan bya ste/dper na mang ja mang po dang / 'gyed sogs mang ba'i skabs che ba brjod na/dge 'dun 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la/ gsol ja'i bsnyen bkunagrwal 'gyed kyi dngos po 'bul ba bsngo rten dang bcas pa rgya cher bshams pa ni/bdud rtsi'i mardzo yon rgya mtsho ltar bskyil/ 'bul ba'i dngos po ri ltarasbupagamachod sbyin gyi dga' ston sa steng thams cad khyab par brdal/ rdzogasaldan gyi dpal 'byor la 'gran bzod pa lta bu sgrub par gda' zhes pa lta buzho /gangaltar yang 'jug tu 'di skad ces bya ste/ de ltar legs par sgrub pa'i skabasadon/ spyir phan bde'i 'byung gnasargyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyasapa dang/'jig rten gsum gyi 'gro ba rnams bde zhing skyid pa'i don dang sgos su bla ma'am/ yon bdag 'di zhes bya ba'i sgo gsum gyi zhes sam/ sku gsungathugs—304

kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba'i don dang / ji ltar bsam pa'i don nam/ de ltarabazhed pa'i don yid bzhin du 'grub cing tshe dang bsod nams dang 'byor pa rnam dkar dge ba'i mdzad pa rnams gong 'phel du 'grub pa'i don dang / zhesapa'i/sku tshe brtan cing 'phrin las rnam par dkar ba gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i don du/phyag len pa rnams kyis phyag len dag cing gtsang sbras thon par sgrub par snang bas rjes su yi rang / rgyu de dag las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnamig glan med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba bkra shis kyi mtha' brten dang bcas pa'i mthun 'gyur rnams rim pa bzhin du thugs la 'dogs pa zhu/ zhesamatshams sbyar nas bsngo ba dngos la 'jug /lo rgyus mi byed par mtshamasasbyorabasdus pa tsam byed na/ khyad par can la tshogis pas tshogis pa yang bzang/dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du byas na zhes pa man chad kyis chog /yangagatam bshad byed la/ cung zad bsdus par byed pa'i skabs yin na/ michosakyi lo rgyus bzhag kyang chog ste/ de ltar na 'jig rten lugs kyi rnam gzhag stobazhin dbye ba la sogs pa mang bar gda' na'ang / rgyas par zhu mi 'tshalazhesabasdus nas/ gnyis pa rgyan dam pa lha chos kyi lo rgyus la zhes pa man chad gongabazhin bya/ /de yang mdo tsam du bsdu na/ 'o skol gyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskalapa grangs med gsum du chogs bsags/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangasargyas nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa bskor bas/ rigs can gsusagyi —305

gdul bya grangs med pa thar pa la bkod/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogasapa'i tshul bstan/ de ltar ston pas gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos kyang / bstan len gyi skyes bu rnams kyis 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring du rgyas par mdzad pa yin te/ rgyal tshab bstan pa'i gtad rab bdun/ 'dzam gling mdzesaparabyed pa'i rgyan drug /grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa rnams kyis/ 'phagasapa'i yul du rgya cher dar bar mdzad/ rgyal khams gzhan rnams suyang/ mngadu dar ba dang / khyad par kha ba can gyi zhing khams 'dir/ rgyal blon byangachub sems dpa' rnams dang / lopaṇa sprul pa'i skyes mchog rnams dang/ mkhasabatsun bzang gsum gyi zhes pa man chad gong bzhin sbyar bas legs par 'gyur ro/ /gshin bsngo'i skabs kyi mol gtam yin na/ gong du bstan pa dang mi'adra ba'i khyad par ni/ gral gyi mtha' nas rten te gdan 'dzom par bzhugasapa'i skabs 'dir/ lo rgyus cung zad zhu 'tshal na/ zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin du/blo gros phun sum tshogs pas mdzes pa'i yon bdag gam/ dge bshes 'di zhes bya ba 'di/ sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba khyad par can bsags pas/ dala'abyoragyi rten phun sum tshogs pa lugs gnyis dang rjes su 'brel ba'i legs lam phun sum tshogs pa/ skye bos smon pa'i gnas su yod pa lags kyang/ 'dusabyas spyi'i mtshan nyid la/ rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis kyang 'da' bar mi spyod na/ gzhan gyis lta smos kyang ci dgos/ 'di ltar skyes pa thamasacad kyi/ /mdun na gnas pa'i 'chi ba ste/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyig 'jigarten pha —306

rol la mngon du phyogs song ba der gda' na'ang / dge ba'i rtsa ba rlabasapo tshephyi rjes su sgrub par gda' na/ mthoris dang thar pa'i them skas la 'dzegabazhin pa lta bur song bas/ rjes na yod pa gzhan rnams kyi sdug bsngaladang yid mi bde'i gnas ma lags so/ /zhes brjod/ de ltar legasaparasgrub pa'i skabs don/ che ge mo zhes bya ba'i sgrib gnyis kyi phung po myur du zad pa dang /mtho ris dang thar pa'i rgyu dgeba'i rtsa ba khyad par can phyi bzhin du 'brangs te/myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i don du/phyag len pa rnams kyis phyag len dag cing / zhes sogs gong bzhin brjod/ /yang 'ga' zhig gis rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sogs byas pa'i ston modang / bshad ston la sogs pa'i skabs su/ gzhan spyi 'gro dang 'drab las/dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du byas na/ dgebashes 'di zhes bya ba chogasarang rang gi skabs dang bstun pa'i che ba brjod la/ 'di zhes bya ba 'di/ khyod dge ba khyad par can bsags pas tshe 'dir rigs kyi nus pa sad/ rkyen dgoba'i bshes gnyen gyis yang dag par bskul nas/ mngon mtho nges legasakyi phan bde thams cad kyi gzhi/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la yang dag pa'itshulakhrims kyi brtul zhugs blangs/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob tu gyurapa'i dga' ston chen po bgyis pa la/ gdugs de ring gi zhes sogs mtshamasasbyaraba'am/ yang dag par bskul nas thos bsam la rtag 'grus su bgyis pa/rgyal ba'i bstan pa las brtsams te/ gzhung lugs zab mo la legs parabashad pa gsar pa rgya cher spel ba'i dga' ston no zhes mtshams sbyar rdo /de —307—

nasa'adi skad ces bya ste/ phyogasabacu na bzhugasapa'i sangs rgyasadang byangachubasems dpa' dge 'dun 'dusapa rgya mtsho tshogis dang bcas pa thams cad/ rgyu sbyor ba sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtso byas/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thamasacad la dgongs su gsol/ 'di ltar sgrub pa'i dge ba'i rtsab 'di nyid mtshon byed du byas/ rang dang gzhan gyi 'khor 'das dus gsumadang mngon par 'brel ba'i tshogasaganyis kyi rgya mtsho chen po rnamasaphyogasagacig tu sdom pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnasapar gyur cig /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa gong ma rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongasapa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogasapar gyur cig /da ltar zhal bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan blamadam pa rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /rnam dkar gyi 'phrin las dang 'gro don phyogs dusaganas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cigaphyogs bcu'i dge 'dun rnamasathugs mthun zhing yi ge 'dri (〈rja〉 'bri)mchod sbyin pa la sogasapa/ chos spyod bcu'i sgrub pa khyad par can gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyasapar gyur cig /thos bsam gyisa'akhor los bstan pa'i sgron me yun ring du 'bar ba'i nusapa dang ldan par gyur cig /sgrub pa'i zhanaralosargyal ba'i gdung chad pa med par 'dzin pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur cigade ltar bshad sgrub rnamapa gnyis kyi sgo nas sbyin pa po rnamasakyi yon yongs su sbyong ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /rab tu byung ba rnams lta ba dngagrub —308

mtha' tha dad pas mi mthun par 'gyur ba spangs te/ yang dag pa'i lta ba laganas par gyur cig /rgyal ba'i spyan sngar bstan pa srung bar zhal gyisabazhesapa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi/ mthu dang nus pa thams cad gong nas gongadu 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig /de rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi mthu labarten nas/ sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di zhes bya ba'i 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa mimathun pa'i phyogasathamasacad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /mthun rkyen 'dod pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /tshe dang bsod namasaye shes 'byor ba thamasacad zla ba yar gyi ngo lta bur rgyas par gyur ciga'ajig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa mtha' dag dang bral bar gyur cig /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'dasapa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang yang dag par ldan par gyur cig /bde ba dang yid bde bdangami'i mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i skal ba dang yang ldan par gyur cig /bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ /cung zad spro na ji srid de ma thob kyi bar du yang / gnas skabs thamasacad du mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /'tshemed ye shes kyi bdud rtsisasrog gi dbang po yongs su rgyasapar gyur cigalongs spyod mi zad pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin myur du thob par gyur cig khams gsum dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor losasgyur ba'i dbang phyug dmapa myur du thob par gyur cig /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyithugs rje chen po'i 'od zer gyis skyong bar gyur cig /dkar po dge ba gas —309

las kyi lam dang nam yang mi 'bral ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cigabyang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis kyis rang rgyus yongs su gang bar gyur cig /gsung rab sde snod gsum gyi don la rang byan chud pa'i skal ba dngaldan par gyur cig /rnam dag bslab pa gsum gyis rang rgyud mdzes pa'i skalab dang ldan par gyur cig /lam lnga dang sa bcu'i mngon rtogs thams cad rgyud la skye ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid rnamapa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dmapa rnams dang / dpon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/dziltarasmin lam btab pa thams cad de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /phan bde 'byungaba'i gnas gcig pu/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / /bstan 'dzin skyesabu dam pa rnams/ /sku tshergyal mtshan brtan gyur cig /gtsug lag khangarnamasaklog pa dang / kha don gyis rgyas legs gnas shog /rtag par dge 'dun mthun pa dang / /dgo'adun don yang 'grub par shog /byang chub semasamachogarin po che/ /ma skyes pa rnams skyes gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa yang/ /thotenas gong du 'phel bar shog /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyuracig /ngan 'gro thams cad dag tu stongs bar shog /byang chub sems dpa' gangan sar bzhugs pa/ /de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub gyur cig /'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang / /byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed par sheg /bzangapo spyod cing de 'dra'i sa thob nas/ /kun nasakun kyang bzang por red gyuracig—310

ces pa tsam gyis kyang chog/de las kyang cung zad rgyas par spro na/gzhanayangadage ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/yangs pa'i rgyalakhams 'di nyid kyis gtso byas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du/char chu rnams dus su 'bab par gyur cig/lo phyugs rnams rtag tu legs paragyuracig/mi nad dang phyugs nad thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig/yamasand dang rim nad thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig/'thab rtsod dang 'khrunalongathams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig/dus kyi 'khrug pa dang mtshon gyi bskalapa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig/sems can ma rungs pa rnams kyi bsasasbyor ngan pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig/sems can thams cad bdud kyi zhags pa las yongs su thar bar gyur cig/sems can thams cad rangarangagi rdzas dang 'ongs spyod dang dbang phyug gi chog shes par gyur cig/semasacan thams cad phan tshun du pha maltar byams pa la gnas par gyur cig/lha yangadus su char 'bebs shing //lo thog phun sum tshogs par shog/rgyalapo chosabazhin byed gyur cig/'jig rten dag kyang dar bar shog/sman rnamasamathudangaldan pa dang //gsang sngags bzlas brjod 'grub par shog/mkha' 'gro srin po la sogs pa//snying rje'i sems dang ldan gyur cig/'jig rten bde zhingalolegs dang //'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang //dge legasathamasacad 'byung ba'i gnas//yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog/gzhan yangadageba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/sa phyogs 'di skoran gnyug mar gnas pa'i gzhi bdag dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba —311—

rnams kyis/tshogs rnam pa gnyis bde blag tu rdzogs par gyur cigastsokhi pa rnam pa gnyis bde blag tu byang bar gyur cig/dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthudang nus pa thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig/rgyalamatshan rtse mor dbang gi rgyal po ltar sogs/tshogs gnyis mthar phyin sogs/ston pa 'jig rten khams su sogs/mi 'gyur lhun po sogs/sbyin pa gtongazhingasogs//bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba sogs//lo brgyathub cingasogs/'bad dang rtsol ba mi dgosapa'i sogs/sngon tshe bcom si 'dasasogs/zab cing rgya che sogs/de dag la sogs pa bkra shis rgyasabasdusaskabs su gang babs dang sbyar la/mjug tu/nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs//nyin ma'i gung yang bde legs shing //nyin mtshan rtag tubade legasapa'i//dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog/ces so//de dag las rgyu sbyor ba sbyin pa'i bdag po zhes pa'i tshab tu/tshedangaldan pa 'di zhes bya ba'am/dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di zhes bya ba la/sogasamiche chung gi rim pa dang ldan pa'i tshig brjod/chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma yin na/dgongs gsol gyi skabs dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad/bdag cag rnams kyi gtso byas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyamapa'i sems can thams cad la dgongs su gsol zhes brjod/bla ma'i mtshan mismos/bsngo ba dngos gzhi'i skabs su yang /de rnams kyi byin gyisabarlabasakyi mthu la brten nas/mchog gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid dpal ldan glamadamapa/mtshan 'di zhes bgyi ba'i/sku tshe 'phrin las kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad —312

nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /gzhan snang du bdud bzhi'i bar du gcod pa posasacad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /bzhed don thams cad dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sku'i rgyal mtshan lhun po ltar brtan par gyuracigagasung gi nyi 'od phyogs thams cad du 'char bar gyur cig /thugs kyi gyomatshorab dga' bdud rtsis gang bar gyur cig /'phrin las kyi nyi 'od nam yangaminub cing srid zhi kun tu rgyas par gyur cig /thugs rje'i 'od dkar gyis 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdug bsngal sel bar gyur cig /gzhan snang du rim gnyisakyi rnal 'byor zab mo sku nyams su bstar ba la rnam g.yengs dang bar chad kyi mtshan ma nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /gdul bya rnams bslab pa gsum dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gegs med du 'god par gyur cig /'gro ba'i don du bsnyun pa mi mnga' zhing sku tshe'i rgyal mtshan brtan par gyur cig /sa dang 04khugyi mngon par rtogs pa thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cigazung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang sku tshe 'di nyid la mngon du mdzad nas/bdag cag gdul byar gyur pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad byang chub mchog gi rgyal thabs la 'god par gyur cigaces pa tsam gyis kyang chog la/ rgyas par byed na sngar gyi bsngo ba'i sham bu rnamasasbyar bas rung ste/ ji srid de ma thob kyi bar du zhes pa'i tshab tu/ gzhan yangabadag cag gdul byar gyur pa rnams/ gnas skabs thams cad du/ midangamim yin pa zhes pa man chad do/ /yang bsngo ba bsdus pa byed na/ dgongs gsol song ba'i rjesal/ dgo—313

ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang rang gzhan gyi dge ba thams cad gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu las/ tshe dang ldan pa 'di zhes bgyi ba'i 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba zhes pa nas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig /ces pa'i bar dang / sems can thams cad bde dang sogs/ sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / /chosanyid mi'agyur brtan pa'i byin rlabs dang / /dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pa'i byin rlabasakyis/ /bsngob smon lam btab pa 'grub par shog /nyin mo bde legs sogs brjod do/ // tshe'adas 'ga' zhig gi don du bsngo ba byed dgos na/ phyogasabacu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dgo'adun 'dus pa rgya mcho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad/ dmigs yul 'di nyid kyi gtso byas namamakha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la dgongs su gsol/ tshe'adasa'adi zhes bgyi ba'i/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ thamad ltalathugagi bar du/ sbyin sogs dkar po dge ba'i las ci dang ci bgyis pa thamasacad dang / slar yang mngon par sgrub pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag thams cad/dmig yul gyi 'gro ba 'di nyid/ kham gsum skye gnas bzhi 'gro ba rigasadrugasrid pa bar ma gang du gnas sam skye bar yang 'gyur ba'i las can yin na yang /dge ba 'di kun dmigs yul 'di'i khong du chud cing / phyi bzhin du 'brangab dang rjes su 'jug par gyur cig /de ltar zhugs nas kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ rigs drug po so so'i sdug bsngaladang —314

kun 'byung mtha' dag las myur du thar bar gyur cig /bdud dang gshin rje'i spyod yul mtha' dag las myur du thar bar gyur cig /ngan song dang ngan 'gro log par lhung ba rnams su nam yang mi skye bar gyur cig /skye ba dang tshe rabasathams cad du bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar gyur cig /rten de lamatho ris kyi yon tan bdun dang ldan par gyur cig /legs pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa dang zhal mjal ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /bdud dang sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang du skad cigakyangami'agro ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /byams snying rje byang chub kyi semasakhyad par can rgyud la skyes pa'i skal ba dang ldan 'dul ba dang mdo sde dang mngon pa'i sde snod mang du thob pa'i tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang shesarab kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam par grol ba dang rnam par grogaba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i phung po yongs su rdzogs pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /phar phyin drug la bsdus pa byed na/ rang don pha rol tu phyin pa drugagispyod pa phun sum chogs pa la gnas pa'i gzhan don bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i sgo nas/ sems can gyi don rgya cher byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyuracigazhes dang / /'bring du byed na/ sbyin pa dang tshul khrims kyi sgo nas gzhan gyi don rgya cher sgrub pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /brtson 'grus dang bzod pa'i sgonas bdag nyid kyi don mchog tu sgrub pa'i bsam gtan dang shes rab kyi sgo —315

nas gnyis ga'i don semasanyid rnam par grol ba la 'god pa'i sbyin pa dang/snyan par smra ba dang / don mthun pa dang / don spyod pa ste/ bsdurgasabazhi labarten nas 'gro ba kun byang chub kyi lam la 'god pa'i zhes dang / /cung zad rgyasapar byed na/ lan dang rnam par smin pa la re ba med pa'i sbyin pa rlabasapo che gtong ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /yang srid la'adun pa dang bral ba'i tshul khrims phun sum tshogs par srung ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can rnams la zhe 'grasapa med pa'i bzod pa glan med pa sgom pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /dkar po dge ba'i chosathams cad yongs su bsdud pa'i brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa rtsom pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i khams lasa'adas pa'i bsam gtan bla na med pa la mnyam par 'jog pa'i skul ba dang ldan par gyur cig /thabs snying rje chen po dang ya ma bral ba'i shes rab phun sum tshogs pa rgyud la skyed pa'i skul ba dang ldan par gyur cig /zang zingagisbyin pas semasacan rnams tshim zhing mgu par byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /chos kyi gtam snyan par smra bas mos pa khyad par can bskyed pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /pha rol du phyin pa la don mthun pa'i sgo nasasgrub pa rnam par dag pa la 'god pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /don spyod pa'i sgo nas slar mi ldog cing lam rnam par sbyong ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /ces so/ /de ltar tshogs gnyis yongasasu rdzogs nag rnamapa thamasacad mkhyen pa sangs rgyasakyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan —316

par gyur cig /ngan song sdug bsngal ma myong zhing / /dka' ba spyad pa med parayang / /lha lasalhag pa'i lus thob nas/ /de yi sangs rgyas myur thob shog/migatsang lus 'di bor bar gyur ma thag /bde ba can du rdzus te skye bar shog/skyes ma thag tu sa bcu rab rdzogs nas/ /sprul pas phyogs bcur gzhan don byed par shog /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'bor bzang zhing sogs brjod/ 'di layangamathun 'gyur byed mkhan dgo'adun yod na/ bsngoba'i mgor skabs 'diramathun 'gyur thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhes brjod dgos/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs chen po sogasal dge rtsa rgya chen dang 'brel ba'i dus/ gtam bshad dgos na bya zhing / de nas gshin don gyi bsngo ba byed na/ nye du sogasashulagyimi yod na/ de rjesagason bsngo rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa rdzogs parabya zhing/ de 'dra med na'ang / gzhan yang 'di ltar sgrub pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di nyid mtshon byed du byas zhes pa nas/ mthu dang nus pa thams cad gong nas gong du 'phelazhing rgyas pa'i bar dang / phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas cig pu man chad bkra shigakyi bar rdzogasapar bya/ yul khyad par can la mchod bsngor byed na/ dgongagagasol gyi skabs bla ma'i mtshan nasami smosate/ gson bsngo'i skabs dnga'adra/'di ltar bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa/ skye bo'i tshogs la sbyin gtor/ zhesasogs de skabs kyi dge ba sgrub pa'i skabs dang sbyar la/ gzhan yang thosabasam sgom gsum la sogs pa bsod nams dang ye shes kyis bsdus pa'i dge ba'i phung po rgya r+pā po 'dis/ yongs kyi dge ba'i gshesaganyen wo po zhesasam/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po 'di zhesabya ba la 'bul bar bgyizho /phulab de—317

thams cad gzhan don du bdag gir mdzad nas/ thugs kyi dgongs pa zab mo khyad par can gong nas gong du yongasasu rdzogs par gyur cig /gang du bzhugasapa'i zhing khams der/ mtha' yas mchod pa'i sprin phung rgyun mi chad par 'byungabar gyur cig /sku gsung thugs dang mdzad pa 'phrin las la bar du gcod pa skad cig kyang mi 'byung bar gyur cig /sa lam gyi mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig /myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa'i rim pa mtha' dag bstan nas/mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad theg pa rnam pa gsum gyi byang chub la 'god pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /dge ba 'di'i skye bo kun/ /gas nu norabazang ji bzhin du/ /yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu yi/ /bla ma dam pa mnyesabyed shog/skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma sogs/ de tsam mam cung zad rgyasapar spro na/gson bsngo'i skabs su bshad pa'i spyi'i bsngo ba sogs ci rigs pas kha bskangs nas brjod do/ /gson gshin gang la sbyar kyang chog pa'i bsngo ba shin tu bsdus pa ni/dgongs su gsol sngar bzhin/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang dus gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gcig tu sdom pa'i mthu las/ tshe dang ldan pa'am/ tshe lasa'adasapa tshege mo zhes bgyi ba'i/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nyen mongasapa dang / snyoms 'jug dang shes bya'i sgrib pa mtha' dag rtsa ba nas byang zhingadagapar gyur cig /bsod nams dang ye shes dang tshul khrims kyis bsdus pa'itshogs kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /de ltar sgrib gnyis sbyongab —318

dang / tshogs gnyis gsog pa la bar du gcod pa skad cig kyang mi 'byungabaragyur cig /sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangasargyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig /sdug bsngal gsum gyis gtsesapa'i sems can thams cad zag med kyi bde ba mthar thug pa la 'god pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /de na gshin don yin na/ nganasongasdugabasngalasogs dang / gson bsngo yin na/ sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i sogasadang / bkra shis gyi tshigs bcad ci rigs par brjod do/ / gzhan yang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs byas pa'am/ bshad ston la sogasapa'i skabs su bsngo ba byed na/ gson bsngo spyi dang phal chen 'dra ba lagadagongs gsol gyi rjes su/ tshe dang ldan pa'am/ dge bshes 'di zhesabya bas/khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung / dmapa'i chos thams cad kyis rtsa ba sosothar pa'i sdom pa blangs/ ngur smrig gi brtul zhugs bzung bas bstan pa'i migarkyen la phan par byas/ sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'di dang 'brel bar/ zangazingagimachod pas kyang mchog gsum la bsti stang du byas pa'i dgoba'i rtsa ba 'di dang zhes sam/ 'di zhes bya bas/ dang por dad pa brtan pos dam pa'ichosalazhugs/ bar du shes rab dang brtson 'grus zung du sbrel bas gzhung lugasamachog la sbyangs/ da ltar rang gi rnam dpyod dang blo gros rnams dge ba'ibashesaganyen rnams dang / dge 'dun gyi spyan sngar mchod rdzas su phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang / zhes motshams sbyar nas/ 'khor 'das dus gsum dang 'brelaba'i zhes pa man chad gong bzhin la/ skabs su gang bab tu 'di skad cesabya ste/—319
