so sothar pa'i sdom pa la nyes lhung gi dri masam gosapar gyur cig /byangachubasems dpa'i tshul khrims thabs la mkhas pas yongs su bzung bar gyur cigarig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa lasadam tshig wo po'i dngos grub myur du thob par gyur cig /lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pas rgyud yongs su phyug par gyuraciga'aphags pa nye bar 'khor ltar 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i mchog tu lung ston par gyur cig /mkhyen pas shes bya ma lus pa mkhyen pa 'phags pa 'jam dpalaltaburagyur cig /dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rjes mkha' khyab kyi sems can sdugabasngal las skyob pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /gang la gang 'dul gyi mthu stobs thogasapa med pas/ dusagasumargyalab ma lus pa'i 'phrin las sgrub pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i mdzad pa dngamanyalapar gyur cig /ces pa la sogs pa ji ltar rigs par sbyar ro/ /'dir smras pa/gtam bshad bsngo ba'i bye brag la/ /legs par sbyangs pa'i blo gsal rnamag/tshogs pa'i dbus su gzengs mtho zhing / /blo ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i gzhi/ /zhes bya'o// // mol gtam dang bsngo ba'i brjod pa/ mdor bsdusasusbyarab 'di yang snga phyir don gnyer du mas nan to du yang yang bskul ba'i ngor tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / bkra shis par shog/ —320

༄tsho/ /smon lam dgos pa kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mogu sa thog med dus nas 'bor ba ji srid bar/ /dgeb gangadag bgyis dang bgyid rtsal dang / /yi rang bsngags pa brjod pa'i legasabyasasogs/ /mdor na bdag gi dus gsum dge ba kun/ /mkha' khyab 'groba'i dge rtsa mtha' yas dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags tshogasakyi//rnam dkar 'phrin las legs byas rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /ma lus gcig tubasdoms pa'i mthu stobs las/ /smon lam 'di kun nges par 'grub pa dang//myur du 'grub cing gegs med 'grub pa dang / /mchog tu rgya chen stobs ldan 'grub par shog /skye ba kun du bla ma dkon mchog la/ /mi phyed dad pa rnamagasum 'bral med ldan/ /bcos ma min par snying rje byang chub sems/ /namayang rgyun mi chad par skye bar shog /rtag tu rab byung dge slong gnasathob ste//nyis brgya lnga bcu la sogs bslab pa'i gnas/ /'dul ba rgya mtshor ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ /cung zad tsam yang ma nyams bsrung bar shog /byangachub semasadapa'i bsla ba gzhi mtha' dag la/ /rgyal srasarnams kyis ji ltaramadzad bzhin spyod/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i nyams len mthar phyin nas/ /bsod namasaye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog /khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugasate/ /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor kun du zhugs shing mthong / /rmad byung dbangagi—321—

rim pa kun thob nas/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon mtha' dag gsos 'debasashog /dam tshig mchog la nyes lhung dri mas dben/ /rig 'dzin rnams kyis 'da' b.rami dpyod pa'i/ /blang dor dgag sgrub mnyam bzhag rjes spyod kyi/ /dmatshigamatha' dag tshul bzhin bsrung bar shog /rdo rje slob dpon kun dang khyad paradu/ /rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon po khyod nyid dang / /rtag tu mi 'bral rtag tu rjes 'dzin zhing / /rten 'brel legs phyogs kho nar 'grigs par shog khyed lamos gus gdung shugs 'bral med dang / khyed dang rten 'brel nam yangami'achug cing / khyed kyi bka' las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin/ /dga' zhingasproba'i yid kyis bsgrub par shog /bka' bzhin bsgrub tshemanar med gnas su yang//'jug par spro na gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /rang 'dod med par khyed kyisaci gsungs dang / /thugs su ci dgyes thams cad bsgrub par shog khyed ni 'khora'adas kun khyab mdzad pa can/ /gang 'dul lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin lasate//snang ngor spyod tshul bzang ngan ci ston yang / /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa kho narartogasagyur cig /log lta'i dri ma tsam yang mi skye zhing / /mdo rgyud kun nasadziskad gsungs pa ltar/ /sgo gsum longs spyod bya ba thams cad kyis/ /blamadamapa rtag tu mnyes byed shog /skye ba kun du khyed kyi dgongs pa skyong / khyod kyi gsunga'adzin khyod kyi 'phrin las bsgrub/ /'gro kun khyod kyis rjes su 'jug pa dang/khyed kyi bstan la bya ba byed par shog khyed gsung chos kyis sa gsum kun khyab nas/ /mi dang mi min thams cad der rjes 'jug /rnam dag grub mtha' ltaspyod bzang po 'di/ /phyogs dus kun du spel bar bdag gyur cig khyod kyi —322

thugs dgongs ji bzhin rtogs pa dang / /gsung gi gsang ba mtha' dgalegs bzung nas/ /dgongs don ji bzhin shes la zhabrul ba'i dri/ /tilagyi zegs ma tsam yang spangs bar shog /skye zhing skye bar 'bad med lhun grub twa /chos kun 'dzin pa'i shes rab mchog thob cing / /mi brjed gzungs thob brtson 'grus mchog dang ldan/ /dam pa'i chos bzhin rtag tu spyod par shog /bdud dang mu stegs lta ngan log lta can/ /thams cad tshar bcad chos la 'bod pa dang / /ma dad pa rnams dad pa'i gnas la 'god/ /de 'dra'i thabs tshul mtha' yas 'grub par shog /nad med rigs gzugs longs spyod dbang thang grogs/ /'khor g.yog la sogs thams cad phun tshogs shing / /rtagatudageba'i chos la spyod pa yis/ /rang gzhan don gyi mchog kun 'grub parashog /rje btsun khyod kyi bstan pa'i mi mthun phyogs/ /ma lus skad cig re rer phyirabasal nas/ /rgyal khyod bstan pa'i nyi 'od phyogs kun du/ khyab parabyed pa'i'aphrin las sgrub par shog /sdig grogs log 'tsho 'gal rkyen kun spangasashing / /chos phyir dka' ba spyod kyang yid mi g.yo/ /rtag tu mtha' yasa'agro ba smin par byed/ /rgud par gyur kyang chos bzhin spyod par shog /myur du tinga'adzin chos kyi stobs thob nas/ /la lar mkhas dang la lar grub pa dang/ /rgyal po rgyal phran blon po pho nya 'khor/ /sna tshogs sprul pas bstan pa gsalabyed shog /bla med byang chub myur du thob pa dang / /de srid du yangasrid dngazhi ba yi/ /phun tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab rtag par 'byor/ /bstan dnga'agroba'i don chen 'grub par shog /bskyed rim lha yi rnal 'byor brtan pa thob/ /rig—323—

sngags bzlas pa'i nus pa mthar phyin nas/ /zhi sogasalasakun thogasamed 'grub pa dang / /thun mong 'jig rten dngosagrub kun thob shog /lhan skyesayeshes rdzogasapa'i rim pa brtan/ /ye shes smra ba po la ye shes nyid/ /gcig pus 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub 'gyur ba/ /'jig rten 'das pa phyag rgya che thobashog /ji skad bshad pa'i lam gyi yon to rnams/ /bar mo med paraphyuradu mthar phyin nas/ /ye shes lnga dang sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can/ /rdorje 'bo+o myur du thob par shog /khams gsum skye 'gro kun yang de la 'god/ /brtan g.yo mtha' dag dpal ldan bla ma yi/ /thugasagyi rgya mtshor ro gcig 'jugapa la/ /glo bur dri ma'i zhabrul ba sangasabar shog /smon lam de kun 'phraladu 'grub par shog /ji bzhin 'grub cing rgya chen 'grub par shog /gegasamed 'grub cing 'bad med 'grub par shog /bkra shisadage legs phun sum tshogasapar shog/ //ces pa 'di yang dad ldan kun dga' lhun grub gyis bskul nas tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / maṅga yaṃ/ // o swā sti/ rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes shing semasacan kun/ 'u'i zhi'i phun tshogs dpal la 'god pa'i phyir/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsungarab dpag yas la/ /nyams len bde bar byed thabs smon lam 'di/ /paradu sgrab sa brag dmar bla brang yin/ /'di yi legs spyad bdag gi 'brel can sogs/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba dam chos sgor zhugasate/ /myur du byang chub thob pa'i rgyur—324
bkra

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ tshangs po/mdun shog mdzes 'god pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/ )5 dugashe/(1la 'anan la5/deb bdun cu pa/༄7/ /jo nang tā ra na tha'i gsung 'bum/(28(45)dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs/snyingakrung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun te bkram/pe cin ma'o rin tshon khra par 'debs kung sis dpar btab/spyi lo 2008lo'i zla 4par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/spyi lo 2008lo'i zla 4par par thengs dang po btab/dpar grangs/ 0001wa 15001522978wa 7wa 80253wa 013wa 372 51gsung 'bum cha tshang (deb 1—45yod )la rin sgor/ 910 00

nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gi las sgrub mi snar lo bstud mar 'tsho ba'i yon sbyor gnang mkhan mchog sprul pad+ma dbang rgyal rin po che la snying thag pa nas thugs rje zhu ba dang /krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma par skrun thad la rgyab skyor dang mnyam las gnang bar snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba yin/dpar yon zhal 'debs gnang mkhan/rang re'i spun zla rnams kyi mtshan tho/ ka mad kyi go rim ltar lags/gdung sras phrin las nor bu rin po che/ bla ma mthar phyin rin po che/ bla ma yon tan/sman pa rig 'dzin lags/ las rab gling pa rin po che/ bsod nams bde skyid/

rdomo ri (snyo44 na sko tshi shu snye ne sa/ 39 7 4༄ ༄r+sha snyosprel ri nga ༷shashā nga rwa rdzi pa —— — ——bye ṇasnorwa sgo tsā ——— blo —— snye sde sa ༄walatsha 4 ༷ snangaX rjedang — — sdu ge——— —— la | sgro ba zla ri sgyu me sdeg ༷/rdo sdu rdo tsho ra sdu ji zhe tsho sde — — ljagobasgo ——46 4༷ ༷༷ sgrol lo ༷ slo /rgyu nga zhe mi3 4snyeX 4 4 ༷༷ 4 ༷ sde
